#include "assetregistry.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <random>
#include <cctype>

AssetHandle GenerateAssetHandle()
{
    static std::mt19937_64 generator(std::random_device{}());
    AssetHandle handle = 0;
    while (handle == 0)
    {
        handle = generator();
    }
    return handle;
}

AssetRegistry::AssetRegistry(const std::filesystem::path& root)
    : m_RootSpec(root)
{
}

const std::filesystem::path& AssetRegistry::Root() const
{
    std::error_code error;
    const auto base = std::filesystem::current_path(error);
    if (m_Root.empty() || base != m_RootBase)
    {
        m_RootBase = base;
        const auto absolute = m_RootSpec.is_absolute() ? m_RootSpec : base / m_RootSpec;
        std::error_code canonicalError;
        m_Root = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(absolute, canonicalError);
        if (canonicalError || m_Root.empty())
        {
            m_Root = absolute.lexically_normal();
        }
    }
    return m_Root;
}

bool AssetRegistry::Contains(const std::filesystem::path& path) const
{
    std::error_code error;
    const auto canonical = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(path, error);
    if (error)
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto relative = canonical.lexically_relative(Root());
    return !relative.empty() && *relative.begin() != ".." && *relative.begin() != ".";
}

AssetType AssetRegistry::Classify(const std::filesystem::path& path)
{
    std::string extension = path.extension().string();
    std::transform(extension.begin(), extension.end(), extension.begin(), [](unsigned char letter)
    {
        return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(letter));
    });
    if (extension == ".material")
    {
        return AssetType::Material;
    }
    for (const char* texture : {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".dds", ".tga", ".bmp", ".tif", ".tiff", ".hdr"})
    {
        if (extension == texture)
        {
            return AssetType::Texture;
        }
    }
    for (const char* mesh : {".obj", ".fbx", ".gltf", ".glb", ".vgmesh", ".vgp2"})
    {
        if (extension == mesh) return AssetType::Mesh;
    }
    return AssetType::Unknown;
}

AssetHandle AssetRegistry::Register(const std::filesystem::path& path, AssetType type, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    const auto absolute = std::filesystem::absolute(path).lexically_normal();
    std::error_code filesystemError;
    if (!Contains(absolute) || !std::filesystem::is_regular_file(absolute, filesystemError) ||
        type == AssetType::Unknown || Classify(absolute) != type)
    {
        error = "Asset must be a supported file inside the project asset directory";
        return 0;
    }
    const auto metadata = std::filesystem::path(absolute.wstring() + L".meta");
    AssetHandle handle = 0;
    if (std::filesystem::exists(metadata, filesystemError))
    {
        std::string reference;
        std::ifstream stream(metadata);
        stream >> reference;
        handle = ParseAssetHandle(reference);
        if (handle == 0)
        {
            error = "Invalid asset metadata: " + metadata.generic_string();
            return 0;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        do
        {
            handle = GenerateAssetHandle();
        } while (handle == 0 || m_Entries.contains(handle) || m_Collisions.contains(handle));
        if (!WriteAssetFile(metadata, FormatAssetHandle(handle) + "\n", error))
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    const auto existing = m_Entries.find(handle);
    if (m_Collisions.contains(handle) || (existing != m_Entries.end() && existing->second.Path != absolute))
    {
        m_Entries.erase(handle);
        m_Collisions.insert(handle);
        error = "Duplicate asset GUID: " + FormatAssetHandle(handle);
        return 0;
    }
    m_Entries[handle] = {absolute, type};
    return handle;
}

std::filesystem::path AssetRegistry::Resolve(AssetHandle handle) const
{
    const auto found = m_Entries.find(handle);
    std::error_code error;
    if (found == m_Entries.end() || !std::filesystem::is_regular_file(found->second.Path, error))
    {
        return {};
    }
    return found->second.Path;
}

AssetType AssetRegistry::TypeOf(AssetHandle handle) const
{
    const auto found = m_Entries.find(handle);
    if (found == m_Entries.end())
    {
        return AssetType::Unknown;
    }
    return found->second.Type;
}

bool AssetRegistry::Refresh(std::string& error)
{
    m_Entries.clear();
    m_Collisions.clear();
    error.clear();
    std::error_code filesystemError;
    std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator iterator(Root(), filesystemError);
    for (const auto end = std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator(); iterator != end && !filesystemError; iterator.increment(filesystemError))
    {
        const auto type = Classify(iterator->path());
        if (type == AssetType::Unknown || !iterator->is_regular_file(filesystemError))
        {
            continue;
        }
        // Texture IDs are assigned when used or dragged. Scanning the project should
        // not create metadata for every imported texture that no material references.
        if ((type == AssetType::Texture || type == AssetType::Mesh) &&
            !std::filesystem::exists(iterator->path().wstring() + L".meta", filesystemError))
        {
            continue;
        }
        std::string assetError;
        if (!Register(iterator->path(), type, assetError))
        {
            error += assetError + "\n";
        }
    }
    if (filesystemError)
    {
        error += filesystemError.message();
    }
    return error.empty();
}

bool AssetRegistry::Move(AssetHandle handle, const std::filesystem::path& destination, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    const auto source = Resolve(handle);
    const auto target = std::filesystem::absolute(destination).lexically_normal();
    std::error_code filesystemError;
    if (source.empty() || !Contains(target) || Classify(target) != TypeOf(handle) ||
        std::filesystem::exists(target, filesystemError) || std::filesystem::exists(target.wstring() + L".meta", filesystemError))
    {
        error = "Invalid or occupied asset destination";
        return false;
    }
    std::filesystem::create_directories(target.parent_path(), filesystemError);
    if (!filesystemError)
    {
        std::filesystem::rename(source, target, filesystemError);
    }
    if (filesystemError)
    {
        error = filesystemError.message();
        return false;
    }
    std::filesystem::rename(source.wstring() + L".meta", target.wstring() + L".meta", filesystemError);
    if (filesystemError)
    {
        error = filesystemError.message();
        std::error_code rollbackError;
        std::filesystem::rename(target, source, rollbackError);
        return false;
    }
    m_Entries.at(handle).Path = target;
    return true;
}

AssetHandle AssetRegistry::Duplicate(AssetHandle handle, const std::filesystem::path& destination, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    const auto source = Resolve(handle);
    const auto target = std::filesystem::absolute(destination).lexically_normal();
    const auto type = TypeOf(handle);
    std::error_code filesystemError;
    if (source.empty() || !Contains(target) || Classify(target) != type ||
        std::filesystem::exists(target.wstring() + L".meta", filesystemError))
    {
        error = "Invalid duplicate destination";
        return 0;
    }
    if (!std::filesystem::copy_file(source, target, std::filesystem::copy_options::none, filesystemError))
    {
        error = filesystemError.message();
        return 0;
    }
    const auto copy = Register(target, type, error);
    if (!copy)
    {
        std::filesystem::remove(target, filesystemError);
    }
    return copy;
}

#pragma once
#include "materialasset.h"
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

class AssetRegistry
{
public:
    struct Entry
    {
        std::filesystem::path Path;
        AssetType Type = AssetType::Unknown;
    };
    explicit AssetRegistry(const std::filesystem::path& root = "asset");
    AssetHandle Register(const std::filesystem::path& path, AssetType type, std::string& error);
    std::filesystem::path Resolve(AssetHandle handle) const;
    AssetType TypeOf(AssetHandle handle) const;
    bool Refresh(std::string& error);
    bool Move(AssetHandle handle, const std::filesystem::path& destination, std::string& error);
    AssetHandle Duplicate(AssetHandle handle, const std::filesystem::path& destination, std::string& error);
    static AssetType Classify(const std::filesystem::path& path);
    // ルート（asset フォルダ）の絶対パス。作業フォルダが変わったら取り直す。
    const std::filesystem::path& Root() const;
private:
    // グローバル変数として WinMain より前に構築されるため、構築時点の作業フォルダで
    // ルートを固定すると、main.cpp の SetCurrentDirectoryW 後に別フォルダを指してしまう。
    // 指定値だけ保持し、絶対パスは使用時に解決する。
    std::filesystem::path m_RootSpec;
    mutable std::filesystem::path m_Root;
    mutable std::filesystem::path m_RootBase;
    std::unordered_map<AssetHandle, Entry> m_Entries;
    std::unordered_set<AssetHandle> m_Collisions;
    bool Contains(const std::filesystem::path& path) const;
};

#include "materialasset.h"
#include <json/json.h>
#include <charconv>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>
#include <windows.h>

std::string FormatAssetHandle(AssetHandle handle)
{
    std::ostringstream output;
    output << "guid:" << std::hex << std::setw(16) << std::setfill('0') << handle;
    return output.str();
}

AssetHandle ParseAssetHandle(const std::string& text)
{
    if (text.size() != 21 || text.substr(0, 5) != "guid:")
    {
        return 0;
    }
    AssetHandle handle = 0;
    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data() + 5, text.data() + text.size(), handle, 16);
    if (result.ec != std::errc{} || result.ptr != text.data() + text.size())
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return handle;
}

bool WriteAssetFile(const std::filesystem::path& path, const std::string& contents, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    auto temporary = path;
    temporary += ".tmp";
    {
        std::ofstream stream(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        stream.write(contents.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(contents.size()));
        stream.flush();
        if (!stream)
        {
            error = "Failed to write " + path.generic_string();
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(), path.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))
    {
        error = "Failed to replace " + path.generic_string() + " (" + std::to_string(GetLastError()) + ")";
        std::error_code ignored;
        std::filesystem::remove(temporary, ignored);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool MaterialSerializer::Validate(const MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    auto range = [&](float value, float minimum, float maximum, const char* property)
    {
        if (!std::isfinite(value) || value < minimum || value > maximum)
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid ") + property;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    };
    for (float channel : material.BaseColor)
    {
        if (!range(channel, 0, 1, "baseColor"))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    for (float channel : material.EmissiveColor)
    {
        if (!range(channel, 0, 65504, "emissiveColor"))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!range(material.Metallic, 0, 1, "metallic") ||
        !range(material.Roughness, 0, 1, "roughness") ||
        !range(material.NormalScale, 0, 8, "normalScale") ||
        !range(material.AOStrength, 0, 1, "aoStrength") ||
        !range(material.EmissiveIntensity, 0, 65504, "emissiveIntensity") ||
        !range(material.AlphaCutoff, 0, 1, "alphaCutoff") ||
        !range(material.ShadowCutoff, 0, 1, "shadowCutoff") ||
        !range(material.IOR, 1, 10, "ior") || !range(material.Transmission, 0, 1, "transmission") ||
        !range(material.TransmissionRoughness, 0, 1, "transmissionRoughness") ||
        !range(material.Thickness, 0, 65504, "thickness") ||
        !range(material.ShadingStrength, 0, 1, "shadingStrength"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    for (float channel : material.AbsorptionCoefficient)
        if (!range(channel, 0, 65504, "absorptionCoefficient")) return false;
    if (material.Surface > MaterialSurface::Transparent || material.Cull > MaterialCull::Front ||
        material.ShadowMode > MaterialShadowMode::Auto)
    {
        error = "Unsupported render state";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

namespace
{
constexpr const char* textureNames[] = {"baseColor", "normal", "metallicRoughness", "ao", "emissive"};
bool ReadFloat(const Json::Value& object, const char* name, float& value, std::string& error)
{
    if (!object.isMember(name))
    {
        return true;
    }
    if (!object[name].isNumeric())
    {
        error = std::string("Invalid ") + name + " property";
        return false;
    }
    value = object[name].asFloat();
    return true;
}
template<size_t Count>
bool ReadColor(const Json::Value& object, const char* name, std::array<float, Count>& color, std::string& error)
{
    if (!object.isMember(name))
    {
        return true;
    }
    const auto& array = object[name];
    if (!array.isArray() || array.size() != Count)
    {
        error = std::string("Invalid ") + name + " array";
        return false;
    }
    for (Json::ArrayIndex i = 0; i < Count; ++i)
    {
        if (!array[i].isNumeric())
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid ") + name + " channel";
            return false;
        }
        color[i] = array[i].asFloat();
    }
    return true;
}
}

bool MaterialSerializer::Load(const std::filesystem::path& path, MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    std::ifstream stream(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!stream)
    {
        error = "Failed to open " + path.generic_string();
        return false;
    }
    Json::Value root;
    Json::CharReaderBuilder reader;
    reader["rejectDupKeys"] = true;
    reader["failIfExtra"] = true;
    if (!Json::parseFromStream(reader, stream, &root, &error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!root.isObject() || !root["version"].isInt() || root["version"].asInt() != 1)
    {
        error = "Unsupported material version (expected 1)";
        return false;
    }
    if (root.isMember("shader") && root["shader"] != "PBR")
    {
        error = "Only the PBR shader is supported";
        return false;
    }
    MaterialAssetData result;
    const auto& parameters = root["parameters"];
    const auto& renderState = root["renderState"];
    const auto& textures = root["textures"];
    for (const char* object : {"parameters", "renderState", "textures"})
    {
        if (root.isMember(object) && !root[object].isObject())
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid ") + object + " object";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!ReadColor(parameters, "baseColor", result.BaseColor, error) ||
        !ReadColor(parameters, "emissiveColor", result.EmissiveColor, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "metallic", result.Metallic, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "roughness", result.Roughness, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "normalScale", result.NormalScale, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "aoStrength", result.AOStrength, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "emissiveIntensity", result.EmissiveIntensity, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(renderState, "alphaCutoff", result.AlphaCutoff, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(renderState, "shadowCutoff", result.ShadowCutoff, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "ior", result.IOR, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "transmission", result.Transmission, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "transmissionRoughness", result.TransmissionRoughness, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "thickness", result.Thickness, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "shadingStrength", result.ShadingStrength, error) ||
        !ReadColor(parameters, "absorptionCoefficient", result.AbsorptionCoefficient, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (parameters.isMember("shadingModel"))
    {
        if (!parameters["shadingModel"].isUInt() || parameters["shadingModel"].asUInt() > 5u)
        {
            error = "Invalid shadingModel property";
            return false;
        }
        result.ShadingModel = parameters["shadingModel"].asUInt();
    }
    if (root.isMember("surfaceType"))
    {
        const auto& surface = root["surfaceType"];
        if (surface == "Masked")
        {
            result.Surface = MaterialSurface::Masked;
        }
        else if (surface == "Transparent")
        {
            result.Surface = MaterialSurface::Transparent;
        }
        else if (surface != "Opaque")
        {
            error = "Unsupported surfaceType";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (renderState.isMember("shadowMode"))
    {
        const auto& mode = renderState["shadowMode"];
        if (mode == "None")
        {
            result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::None;
        }
        else if (mode == "AlphaTest")
        {
            result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::AlphaTest;
        }
        else if (mode == "Opaque") result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Opaque;
        else if (mode == "Transmittance") result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Transmittance;
        else if (mode != "Auto")
        {
            error = "Invalid shadowMode";
            return false;
        }
    }
    else if (result.Surface == MaterialSurface::Masked)
    {
        result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::AlphaTest;
        result.ShadowCutoff = result.AlphaCutoff;
    }
    if (renderState.isMember("cullMode"))
    {
        const auto& cull = renderState["cullMode"];
        if (cull == "None")
        {
            result.Cull = MaterialCull::None;
        }
        else if (cull == "Front")
        {
            result.Cull = MaterialCull::Front;
        }
        else if (cull != "Back")
        {
            error = "Invalid cullMode";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (renderState.isMember("depthWrite"))
    {
        if (!renderState["depthWrite"].isBool())
        {
            error = "Invalid depthWrite";
            return false;
        }
        result.DepthWrite = renderState["depthWrite"].asBool();
    }
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < result.Textures.size(); ++slot)
    {
        const auto& reference = textures[textureNames[slot]];
        if (reference.isNull())
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (!reference.isString())
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid texture reference: ") + textureNames[slot];
            return false;
        }
        const auto text = reference.asString();
        result.Textures[slot] = ParseAssetHandle(text);
        if (result.Textures[slot] == 0 && text != FormatAssetHandle(0) && !text.empty())
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid texture GUID: ") + textureNames[slot];
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!Validate(result, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    material = result;
    return true;
}

bool MaterialSerializer::Save(const std::filesystem::path& path, const MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error)
{
    if (!Validate(material, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    Json::Value root(Json::objectValue);
    root["version"] = 1;
    root["shader"] = "PBR";
    root["surfaceType"] = "Opaque";
    if (material.Surface == MaterialSurface::Masked)
    {
        root["surfaceType"] = "Masked";
    }
    else if (material.Surface == MaterialSurface::Transparent)
    {
        root["surfaceType"] = "Transparent";
    }
    const char* cullNames[] = {"Back", "None", "Front"};
    auto& state = root["renderState"];
    state["cullMode"] = cullNames[static_cast<size_t>(material.Cull)];
    state["depthWrite"] = material.DepthWrite;
    state["alphaCutoff"] = material.AlphaCutoff;
    const char* shadowNames[] = {"None", "Opaque", "AlphaTest", "Transmittance", "Auto"};
    state["shadowMode"] = shadowNames[static_cast<size_t>(material.ShadowMode)];
    state["shadowCutoff"] = material.ShadowCutoff;
    auto& parameters = root["parameters"];
    for (float value : material.BaseColor)
    {
        parameters["baseColor"].append(value);
    }
    for (float value : material.EmissiveColor)
    {
        parameters["emissiveColor"].append(value);
    }
    parameters["metallic"] = material.Metallic;
    parameters["ior"] = material.IOR;
    parameters["transmission"] = material.Transmission;
    parameters["transmissionRoughness"] = material.TransmissionRoughness;
    parameters["thickness"] = material.Thickness;
    parameters["shadingModel"] = material.ShadingModel;
    parameters["shadingStrength"] = material.ShadingStrength;
    for (float value : material.AbsorptionCoefficient) parameters["absorptionCoefficient"].append(value);
    parameters["roughness"] = material.Roughness;
    parameters["normalScale"] = material.NormalScale;
    parameters["aoStrength"] = material.AOStrength;
    parameters["emissiveIntensity"] = material.EmissiveIntensity;
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < material.Textures.size(); ++slot)
    {
        root["textures"][textureNames[slot]] = FormatAssetHandle(material.Textures[slot]);
    }
    Json::StreamWriterBuilder writer;
    writer["indentation"] = "  ";
    return WriteAssetFile(path, Json::writeString(writer, root), error);
}

#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

using AssetHandle = uint64_t;
enum class AssetType : uint32_t { Unknown, Material, Texture, Mesh };
struct AssetDragPayload
{
    AssetHandle Handle = 0;
    AssetType Type = AssetType::Unknown;
};
inline constexpr char AssetPayloadType[] = "ASSET_HANDLE";
std::string FormatAssetHandle(AssetHandle handle);
AssetHandle GenerateAssetHandle();
AssetHandle ParseAssetHandle(const std::string& text);
bool SceneHasMaterialAssets();

enum class MaterialSurface : uint32_t { Opaque, Masked, Transparent };
enum class MaterialShadowMode : uint32_t { None, Opaque, AlphaTest, Transmittance, Auto };
enum class MaterialCull : uint32_t { Back, None, Front };
enum class MaterialTextureSlot : uint32_t { BaseColor, Normal, MetallicRoughness, AO, Emissive, Count };

struct MaterialAssetData
{
    std::array<float, 4> BaseColor{1, 1, 1, 1};
    float Metallic = 0.0f;
    float Roughness = 0.5f;
    float NormalScale = 1.0f;
    float AOStrength = 1.0f;
    std::array<float, 3> EmissiveColor{0, 0, 0};
    float EmissiveIntensity = 0.0f;
    std::array<AssetHandle, 5> Textures{};
    MaterialSurface Surface = MaterialSurface::Opaque;
    MaterialCull Cull = MaterialCull::Back;
    bool DepthWrite = true;
    float AlphaCutoff = 0.5f;
    MaterialShadowMode ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Auto;
    float ShadowCutoff = 0.5f;
    float IOR = 1.5f;
    float Transmission = 0.0f;
    float TransmissionRoughness = 0.02f;
    float Thickness = 0.1f;
    std::array<float, 3> AbsorptionCoefficient{0, 0, 0};
    // Extended shading model: 0 Standard, 1 ClearCoat, 2 Sheen (cloth), 3 Skin, 4 Hair, 5 Anisotropic.
    uint32_t ShadingModel = 0;
    float ShadingStrength = 1.0f;
    bool operator==(const MaterialAssetData&) const = default;
};

class MaterialSerializer
{
public:
    static bool Validate(const MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error);
    static bool Load(const std::filesystem::path& path, MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error);
    static bool Save(const std::filesystem::path& path, const MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error);
};

// Atomically replaces a file in the same directory; an unsuccessful write leaves its destination intact.
bool WriteAssetFile(const std::filesystem::path& path, const std::string& contents, std::string& error);

void MaterialManager::Refresh()
{
    string error;
    registry.Refresh(error);
    if (!error.empty())
    {
        Debug::Log("Asset registry: %s\n", error.c_str());
    }
    for (auto& [handle, runtime] : runtimes)
    {
        const bool missing = registry.Resolve(handle).empty();
        if (missing != runtime->Missing)
        {
            runtime->Missing = missing;
            if (missing)
            {
                runtime->Error = "Missing material: " + FormatAssetHandle(handle);
                UpdateBinding(*runtime, MaterialAssetData{});
            }
            else
            {
                Revert(handle);
            }
        }
        // Texture deletion/move changes the binding without changing authored GUIDs.
        if (!missing)
        {
            UpdateBinding(*runtime, runtime->Editing);
        }
    }
}

MaterialRuntime& MaterialManager::GetRuntime(AssetHandle handle)
{
    const auto found = runtimes.find(handle);
    if (found != runtimes.end())
    {
        return *found->second;
    }
    auto runtime = make_unique<MaterialRuntime>();
    runtime->Handle = handle;
    const auto path = registry.Resolve(handle);
    if (handle != 0 && !path.empty() && registry.TypeOf(handle) == AssetType::Material)
    {
        MaterialSerializer::Load(path, runtime->Saved, runtime->Error);
    }
    else if (handle != 0)
    {
        runtime->Missing = true;
        runtime->Error = "Missing material: " + FormatAssetHandle(handle);
    }
    runtime->Editing = runtime->Saved;
    UpdateBinding(*runtime, runtime->Editing);
    auto& result = *runtime;
    runtimes.emplace(handle, move(runtime));
    return result;
}

const MaterialRuntime* MaterialManager::FindRuntime(AssetHandle handle)
{
    const auto found = runtimes.find(handle);
    return found == runtimes.end() ? nullptr : found->second.get();
}

MaterialComponent MaterialManager::BuildPreviewBinding(const MaterialAssetData& material, const array<int, 5>& descriptors)
{
    MaterialComponent binding;
    binding.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
    binding.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
    binding.BaseColor = XMFLOAT4(material.BaseColor.data());
    binding.Metallic = material.Metallic;
    binding.Roughness = material.Roughness;
    binding.NormalScale = material.NormalScale;
    binding.AOStrength = material.AOStrength;
    binding.EmissiveColor = XMFLOAT3(material.EmissiveColor.data());
    binding.EmissiveIntensity = material.EmissiveIntensity;
    // Optical transmission selects the transparent render path even when an
    // older asset still stores Opaque. Alpha remains independent coverage.
    const bool opticalTransmission = material.Transmission > 0.0f;
    binding.AssetSurface = opticalTransmission ? MaterialSurface::Transparent : material.Surface;
    binding.IsTransparent = binding.AssetSurface == MaterialSurface::Transparent;
    binding.AssetCull = material.Cull;
    binding.AssetDepthWrite = binding.IsTransparent ? false : material.DepthWrite;
    binding.AlphaCutoff = material.AlphaCutoff;
    binding.ShadowMode = material.ShadowMode;
    binding.ShadowCutoff = material.ShadowCutoff;
    binding.IOR = material.IOR;
    binding.Transmission = material.Transmission;
    binding.TransmissionRoughness = material.TransmissionRoughness;
    const float dielectric = (material.IOR - 1.0f) / (material.IOR + 1.0f);
    binding.Fresnel = dielectric * dielectric;
    binding.Thickness = material.Thickness;
    binding.ShadingModel = material.ShadingModel;
    binding.ShadingStrength = material.ShadingStrength;
    binding.AbsorptionCoefficient = {material.AbsorptionCoefficient[0], material.AbsorptionCoefficient[1], material.AbsorptionCoefficient[2]};
    binding.DoubleSided = material.Cull == MaterialCull::None;
    binding.BaseSaturation = 1.0f;
    binding.TextureID = descriptors[0];
    binding.UseTexture = binding.TextureID >= 0;
    binding.NormalMapID = descriptors[1];
    binding.MetallicRoughnessID = descriptors[2];
    binding.AOTextureID = descriptors[3];
    binding.EmissiveTextureID = descriptors[4];
    return binding;
}

void MaterialManager::UpdateBinding(MaterialRuntime& runtime, const MaterialAssetData& material)
{
    array<int, 5> descriptors;
    descriptors.fill(-1);
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < descriptors.size(); ++slot)
    {
        const auto path = registry.Resolve(material.Textures[slot]);
        if (!path.empty() && registry.TypeOf(material.Textures[slot]) == AssetType::Texture)
        {
            const auto previousHandle = runtime.Editing.Textures[slot];
            const auto previousPath = runtime.TexturePaths[slot];
            if (previousHandle == material.Textures[slot] && previousPath == path && runtime.TextureDescriptors[slot] >= 0)
            {
                descriptors[slot] = runtime.TextureDescriptors[slot];
            }
            else if (slot == static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::Normal))
            {
                descriptors[slot] = TextureManager::LoadNormalTexture(path.generic_string().c_str());
            }
            else
            {
                descriptors[slot] = TextureManager::LoadTexture(path);
            }
            runtime.TexturePaths[slot] = path;
        }
        else
        {
            runtime.TexturePaths[slot].clear();
        }
    }
    auto binding = BuildPreviewBinding(material, descriptors);
    binding.RuntimeHandle = runtime.Handle;
    // Revision changes invalidate only a shared material record and its frame constant buffers.
    if (runtime.Revision == 0 || runtime.Binding.BaseColor.x != binding.BaseColor.x ||
        runtime.BoundData != material || runtime.TextureDescriptors != descriptors)
    {
        if (runtime.Revision == 0 || runtime.BoundData.Cull != material.Cull ||
            runtime.BoundData.Surface != material.Surface || runtime.BoundData.DepthWrite != material.DepthWrite ||
            runtime.Binding.IsTransparent != binding.IsTransparent ||
            (material.Surface == MaterialSurface::Masked && (runtime.BoundData.AlphaCutoff != material.AlphaCutoff ||
                runtime.BoundData.BaseColor[3] != material.BaseColor[3] || runtime.BoundData.Textures[0] != material.Textures[0] ||
                runtime.TextureDescriptors[0] != descriptors[0])))
        {
            ++runtime.PipelineRevision;
        }
        runtime.Binding = move(binding);
        runtime.BoundData = material;
        runtime.TextureDescriptors = descriptors;
        ++runtime.Revision;
    }
}

AssetHandle MaterialManager::SlotHandle(const MaterialComponent& material, size_t slot)
{
    if (slot >= material.MaterialSlots.size())
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return material.MaterialSlots[slot];
}

const MaterialComponent& MaterialManager::Resolve(const MaterialComponent& legacy, size_t slot)
{
    const auto handle = SlotHandle(legacy, slot);
    if (handle == 0)
    {
        return legacy;
    }
    return GetRuntime(handle).Binding;
}

bool MaterialManager::SetEditing(AssetHandle handle, const MaterialAssetData& editing)
{
    auto& runtime = GetRuntime(handle);
    if (!MaterialSerializer::Validate(editing, runtime.Error) || runtime.Missing)
    {
        return false;
    }
    UpdateBinding(runtime, editing);
    runtime.Editing = editing;
    runtime.Dirty = runtime.Editing != runtime.Saved;
    AssetThumbnailManager::MarkDirty(handle);
    return true;
}

bool MaterialManager::Save(AssetHandle handle)
{
    auto& runtime = GetRuntime(handle);
    const auto path = registry.Resolve(handle);
    if (path.empty())
    {
        runtime.Error = "Cannot save a missing material";
        return false;
    }
    if (!MaterialSerializer::Save(path, runtime.Editing, runtime.Error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    runtime.Saved = runtime.Editing;
    runtime.Dirty = false;
    AssetThumbnailManager::MarkDirty(handle);
    return true;
}

bool MaterialManager::Revert(AssetHandle handle)
{
    auto& runtime = GetRuntime(handle);
    MaterialAssetData loaded;
    if (!MaterialSerializer::Load(registry.Resolve(handle), loaded, runtime.Error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    runtime.Saved = loaded;
    runtime.Missing = false;
    return SetEditing(handle, loaded);
}

bool MaterialManager::IsRenderable(EntityID entity)
{
    return ::Registry::IsAlive(entity) && ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity) &&
        (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity) ||
         ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity) ||
         ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity) ||
         (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity) &&
          ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity).Is3D));
}

void MaterialManager::Discard(AssetHandle handle)
{
    auto& runtime = GetRuntime(handle);
    runtime.Editing = runtime.Saved;
    runtime.Dirty = false;
    if (!runtime.Missing)
    {
        UpdateBinding(runtime, runtime.Saved);
    }
}

bool MaterialManager::HasSurfaceForPass(EntityID entity, bool transparent)
{
    if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity))
    {
        return !transparent;
    }
    const auto& source = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
    const auto count = max<size_t>(1, SlotCount(entity));
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < count; ++slot)
    {
        if (MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(Resolve(source, slot)) == transparent)
        {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

size_t MaterialManager::SlotCount(EntityID entity)
{
    if (!IsRenderable(entity))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto* model = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId);
        if (model)
        {
            return model->GetMeshCount();
        }
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto* model = ModelManager::GetAnimModel(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity).ModelId);
        if (model)
        {
            return model->GetMeshCount();
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

bool MaterialManager::Assign(EntityID entity, size_t slot, AssetHandle handle)
{
    if (!IsRenderable(entity) || slot >= SlotCount(entity) ||
        (handle != 0 && registry.TypeOf(handle) != AssetType::Material))
    {
        return false;
    }
    auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
    component.MaterialSlots.resize(SlotCount(entity));
    component.MaterialSlots[slot] = handle;
    if (all_of(component.MaterialSlots.begin(), component.MaterialSlots.end(), [](AssetHandle assigned)
        { return assigned == 0; }))
    {
        component.MaterialSlots.clear();
    }
    NotifyAssignmentsChanged();
    GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Material);
    return true;
}

void MaterialManager::NotifyAssignmentsChanged()
{
    sceneHasAssets = false;
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
    {
        const auto& slots = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity).MaterialSlots;
        if (any_of(slots.begin(), slots.end(), [](AssetHandle handle) { return handle != 0; }))
        {
            sceneHasAssets = true;
            return;
        }
    }
}

#pragma once
#include "assetregistry.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include <functional>

struct MaterialRuntime
{
    AssetHandle Handle = 0;
    MaterialAssetData Saved;
    MaterialAssetData Editing;
    MaterialAssetData BoundData;
    array<filesystem::path, 5> TexturePaths;
    array<int, 5> TextureDescriptors{-1, -1, -1, -1, -1};
    MaterialComponent Binding;
    uint64_t Revision = 0;
    uint64_t PipelineRevision = 0;
    bool Dirty = false;
    bool Missing = false;
    string Error;
    // Kept alive until shutdown after the graphics fences have completed.
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Constants;
    uint8_t* MappedConstants = nullptr;
    array<uint64_t, 3> UploadedRevision{};
};

class MaterialManager
{
public:
    static AssetRegistry& Registry();
    static void Init();
    static void Shutdown();
    static void Refresh();
    static MaterialRuntime& GetRuntime(AssetHandle handle);
    static const MaterialRuntime* FindRuntime(AssetHandle handle);
    static MaterialComponent BuildPreviewBinding(const MaterialAssetData& material, const array<int, 5>& descriptors);
    static const MaterialComponent& Resolve(const MaterialComponent& legacy, size_t slot = 0);
    static AssetHandle SlotHandle(const MaterialComponent& material, size_t slot);
    static bool SetEditing(AssetHandle handle, const MaterialAssetData& editing);
    static bool Save(AssetHandle handle);
    static bool Revert(AssetHandle handle);
    static void Discard(AssetHandle handle);
    static bool HasSurfaceForPass(EntityID entity, bool transparent);
    static size_t SlotCount(EntityID entity);
    static bool IsRenderable(EntityID entity);
    static bool Assign(EntityID entity, size_t slot, AssetHandle handle);
    static void NotifyAssignmentsChanged();
    static bool SaveSceneReferences(const filesystem::path& path, string& error);
    static bool LoadSceneReferences(const filesystem::path& path, string& error);
private:
    static void UpdateBinding(MaterialRuntime& runtime, const MaterialAssetData& material);
};


===== FILE: source\assets\materialscenereferences.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "modelmanager.h"
#include "primitivegeometry.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "gpuscene/gpuscenechanges.h"
#include <json/json.h>
#include <fstream>
#include <cmath>

namespace
{
Json::Value WriteVector(const XMFLOAT3& vector)
{
    Json::Value result(Json::arrayValue);
    result.append(vector.x);
    result.append(vector.y);
    result.append(vector.z);
    return result;
}

bool IsFiniteArray(const Json::Value& array, Json::ArrayIndex length)
{
    if (!array.isArray() || array.size() != length)
    {
        return false;
    }
    for (const auto& value : array)
    {
        if (!value.isNumeric() || !isfinite(value.asFloat()))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

XMFLOAT3 ReadVector(const Json::Value& vector)
{
    return {vector[0].asFloat(), vector[1].asFloat(), vector[2].asFloat()};
}

bool ValidHandle(const Json::Value& reference)
{
    return reference.isString() &&
        (ParseAssetHandle(reference.asString()) != 0 || reference.asString() == FormatAssetHandle(0));
}

bool ValidateRecord(const Json::Value& record)
{
    if (!record.isObject() || !record["entity"].isUInt() || !record["materialSlots"].isArray() ||
        record["materialSlots"].size() > 4096 || (record.isMember("name") && !record["name"].isString()))
    {
        return false;
    }
    for (const auto& reference : record["materialSlots"])
    {
        if (!ValidHandle(reference))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (record.isMember("identity") && !ValidHandle(record["identity"]))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (record.isMember("transform"))
    {
        for (const char* property : {"position", "rotation", "scale"})
        {
            if (!IsFiniteArray(record["transform"][property], 3))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    if (record.isMember("modelPath") && (!record["modelPath"].isString() || !record["animated"].isBool() ||
        !record["convert"].isBool()))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (record.isMember("vertices"))
    {
        if (!record["vertices"].isArray() || record["vertices"].size() > 1000000)
        {
            return false;
        }
        for (const auto& vertex : record["vertices"])
        {
            if (!IsFiniteArray(vertex, 12))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool MatchesSavedSource(const Json::Value& record, EntityID entity)
{
    if (!MaterialManager::IsRenderable(entity) || !record["name"].isString() ||
        !ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(entity) ||
        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<NameComponent>(entity).Name != record["name"].asString())
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (record["modelPath"].isString())
    {
        if (record["animated"].asBool())
        {
            return ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity) &&
                ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity).ModelPath == record["modelPath"].asString();
        }
        return ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity) &&
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelPath == record["modelPath"].asString();
    }
    if (!record["meshSignature"].isString() || !ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
    {
        return false;
    }
    return FormatAssetHandle(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity).GeometryHash) == record["meshSignature"].asString();
}
}

bool MaterialManager::SaveSceneReferences(const filesystem::path& path, string& error)
{
    Json::Value root;
    root["version"] = 1;
    root["entities"] = Json::Value(Json::arrayValue);
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
    {
        auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
        if (component.MaterialSlots.empty())
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (component.MaterialSceneIdentity == 0)
        {
            component.MaterialSceneIdentity = GenerateAssetHandle();
        }
        Json::Value record;
        record["entity"] = entity;
        record["identity"] = FormatAssetHandle(component.MaterialSceneIdentity);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(entity))
        {
            record["name"] = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<NameComponent>(entity).Name;
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
            record["transform"]["position"] = WriteVector(transform.Position);
            record["transform"]["rotation"] = WriteVector(transform.Rotation);
            record["transform"]["scale"] = WriteVector(transform.Scale);
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& model = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity);
            record["modelPath"] = model.ModelPath;
            record["animated"] = false;
            record["convert"] = model.IsConvert;
        }
        else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& model = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity);
            record["modelPath"] = model.ModelPath;
            record["animated"] = true;
            record["convert"] = model.IsConvert;
        }
        else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
            record["meshSignature"] = FormatAssetHandle(mesh.GeometryHash);
            if (mesh.NaniteMesh)
            {
                record["vertices"] = Json::Value(Json::arrayValue);
                for (const auto& vertex : mesh.NaniteMesh->CpuVertices)
                {
                    Json::Value encoded(Json::arrayValue);
                    for (float number : {vertex.Position.x, vertex.Position.y, vertex.Position.z,
                        vertex.Normal.x, vertex.Normal.y, vertex.Normal.z, vertex.TexCoord.x, vertex.TexCoord.y,
                        vertex.Diffuse.x, vertex.Diffuse.y, vertex.Diffuse.z, vertex.Diffuse.w})
                    {
                        encoded.append(number);
                    }
                    record["vertices"].append(encoded);
                }
            }
        }
        record["materialSlots"] = Json::Value(Json::arrayValue);
        for (const auto handle : component.MaterialSlots)
        {
            record["materialSlots"].append(FormatAssetHandle(handle));
        }
        root["entities"].append(record);
    }
    Json::StreamWriterBuilder writer;
    return WriteAssetFile(path, Json::writeString(writer, root), error);
}

bool MaterialManager::LoadSceneReferences(const filesystem::path& path, string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    ifstream stream(path);
    if (!stream)
    {
        return true;
    }
    Json::Value root;
    Json::CharReaderBuilder reader;
    reader["rejectDupKeys"] = true;
    if (!Json::parseFromStream(reader, stream, &root, &error) || root["version"] != 1 ||
        !root["entities"].isArray() || root["entities"].size() > g_kMAX_ENTITIES)
    {
        error = "Invalid scene material reference file: " + error;
        return false;
    }
    // Validate the complete document before changing any entity.
    for (const auto& record : root["entities"])
    {
        if (!ValidateRecord(record))
        {
            error = "Invalid scene material record";
            return false;
        }
    }
    for (const auto& record : root["entities"])
    {
        EntityID entity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
        const auto identity = ParseAssetHandle(record["identity"].asString());
        if (identity != 0)
        {
            for (EntityID candidate : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
            {
                if (ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(candidate).MaterialSceneIdentity == identity)
                {
                    entity = candidate;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (entity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            EntityID match = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
            bool ambiguous = false;
            for (EntityID candidate : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
            {
                const auto& existing = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(candidate);
                if (existing.MaterialSceneIdentity == 0 && MatchesSavedSource(record, candidate))
                {
                    if (match != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
                    {
                        ambiguous = true;
                    }
                    match = candidate;
                }
            }
            if (!ambiguous)
            {
                entity = match;
            }
        }
        if (entity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            auto restored = World::CreateEntity().Add<TransformComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>().Add<NameComponent>();
            if (!restored.IsValid())
            {
                error = "Scene entity capacity exceeded";
                return false;
            }
            entity = restored.GetID();
            if (record.isMember("modelPath") && !record["modelPath"].asString().empty())
            {
                const auto modelPath = record["modelPath"].asString();
                const bool convert = record["convert"].asBool();
                if (record["animated"].asBool())
                {
                    restored.Add<AnimationModelComponent>();
                    auto& model = restored.Get<AnimationModelComponent>();
                    model.ModelId = ModelManager::LoadAnimModel(modelPath.c_str(), convert);
                    model.ModelPath = modelPath;
                    model.IsConvert = convert;
                }
                else
                {
                    restored.Add<StaticModelComponent>();
                    auto& model = restored.Get<StaticModelComponent>();
                    model.ModelId = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel(modelPath.c_str(), convert);
                    model.ModelPath = modelPath;
                    model.IsConvert = convert;
                }
            }
            else if (record.isMember("vertices") && !record["vertices"].empty())
            {
                restored.Add<MeshComponent>();
                vector<Vertex> vertices;
                for (const auto& encoded : record["vertices"])
                {
                    vertices.push_back({{encoded[0].asFloat(), encoded[1].asFloat(), encoded[2].asFloat()},
                        {encoded[3].asFloat(), encoded[4].asFloat(), encoded[5].asFloat()},
                        {encoded[6].asFloat(), encoded[7].asFloat()},
                        {encoded[8].asFloat(), encoded[9].asFloat(), encoded[10].asFloat(), encoded[11].asFloat()}});
                }
                if (!PrimitiveGeometry::UploadVertices(entity, vertices))
                {
                    error = "Failed to restore scene mesh";
                    World::DestroyEntity(restored);
                    return false;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                World::DestroyEntity(restored);
                error = "Scene material entity is missing its mesh source";
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (record.isMember("name") && ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<NameComponent>(entity).Name = record["name"].asString();
        }
        if (record.isMember("transform") && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity))
        {
            auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
            transform.Position = ReadVector(record["transform"]["position"]);
            transform.Rotation = ReadVector(record["transform"]["rotation"]);
            transform.Scale = ReadVector(record["transform"]["scale"]);
            transform.IsDirty = true;
        }
        auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
        component.MaterialSceneIdentity = identity;
        component.MaterialSlots.clear();
        for (const auto& reference : record["materialSlots"])
        {
            component.MaterialSlots.push_back(ParseAssetHandle(reference.asString()));
        }
        GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::All);
    }
    NotifyAssignmentsChanged();
    return true;
}
