===== FILE: source\procedural\terrainediting.cpp =====
#include "terrainediting.h"

namespace Procedural
{
bool TerrainEditState::SynchronizeSelection(uint32_t target, const TerrainSettings* appliedSettings)
{
    const bool selectionChanged = target != m_Target;
    const bool settingsChangedExternally = appliedSettings && !TerrainSettingsEqual(*appliedSettings, m_AppliedSettings);
    if (!selectionChanged && !settingsChangedExternally)
    {
        return false;
    }
    m_Target = target;
    m_PendingChanges = false;
    m_NextApplyTime = 0.0;
    if (appliedSettings)
    {
        m_Settings = *appliedSettings;
        m_AppliedSettings = *appliedSettings;
    }
    return true;
}

void TerrainEditState::SetSettings(const TerrainSettings& settings)
{
    m_Settings = settings;
    m_PendingChanges = m_Target != InvalidTarget && !TerrainSettingsEqual(m_Settings, m_AppliedSettings);
}

bool TerrainEditState::ShouldApply(double now, bool editingControl) const
{
    return m_PendingChanges && (!editingControl || now >= m_NextApplyTime);
}

void TerrainEditState::MarkApplied(double now)
{
    m_AppliedSettings = m_Settings;
    m_PendingChanges = false;
    double interval = 0.1;
    if (m_Settings.Resolution > 128)
    {
        interval = 0.25;
    }
    m_NextApplyTime = now + interval;
}
}


===== FILE: source\procedural\terrainediting.h =====
#pragma once

#include "proceduralmath.h"
#include <limits>

namespace Procedural
{
// CPU-only editor state: selection changes and undo reload settings without applying to another entity.
class TerrainEditState
{
public:
    static constexpr uint32_t InvalidTarget = (std::numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max)();

    bool SynchronizeSelection(uint32_t target, const TerrainSettings* appliedSettings);
    void SetSettings(const TerrainSettings& settings);
    bool ShouldApply(double now, bool editingControl) const;
    void MarkApplied(double now);
    const TerrainSettings& GetSettings() const { return m_Settings; }
    bool HasPendingChanges() const { return m_PendingChanges; }
    uint32_t GetTarget() const { return m_Target; }

private:
    uint32_t m_Target = InvalidTarget;
    TerrainSettings m_Settings;
    TerrainSettings m_AppliedSettings;
    double m_NextApplyTime = 0.0;
    bool m_PendingChanges = false;
};
}


===== FILE: source\procedural\vertexdeformation.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "vertexdeformation.h"
#include "vertexdeformationmath.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "modelmanager.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <tuple>
#include <cmath>

namespace
{
using GeometryKey = tuple<EntityID, UINT, int>;
constexpr UINT kPrimitiveMesh = UINT_MAX;
constexpr UINT kFrameCount = 3;
constexpr UINT kConstantSize = 256;

struct MotionConstants
{
    XMFLOAT4 AmplitudeAndPhase{};
    XMFLOAT4 Parameters{}; // spatial frequency, noise time, method, seed bits
};
struct Constants
{
    MotionConstants Current;
    MotionConstants Previous;
    XMUINT4 Geometry{};
};
static_assert(sizeof(Constants) <= kConstantSize);

struct FrameGeometry
{
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Base;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Current;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Previous;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> ConstantBuffer;
    D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW View{};
    UINT64 Revision = 0;
};
struct History
{
    UINT64 BaseAddress = 0;
    MotionConstants Motion{};
    double Time = 0;
    bool Valid = false;
};

array<map<GeometryKey, FrameGeometry>, kFrameCount> g_Frames;
map<GeometryKey, History> g_History;
ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_Root;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_Pipeline;
UINT g_FrameIndex = 0;
UINT g_Dispatches = 0;
UINT64 g_Revision = 0;

bool Initialize()
{
    if (g_Pipeline) return true;
    ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    if (!device) return false;
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[4];
    parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
    parameters[1].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0);
    parameters[2].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(1);
    parameters[3].InitAsConstantBufferView(0);
    const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description(4, parameters);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized, errors;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&description, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Root))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
    if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/VertexDeformationCS.hlsl", nullptr,
        D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE, "main", "cs_6_0", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &shader, &errors)))
    {
        if (errors) Debug::Log("Vertex deformation: %s\n", static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()));
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipeline{};
    pipeline.pRootSignature = g_Root.Get();
    pipeline.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
    return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipeline, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Pipeline)));
}

bool Allocate(FrameGeometry& geometry, ID3D12Resource* base, const D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW& view)
{
    if (geometry.Base.Get() == base && geometry.View.SizeInBytes == view.SizeInBytes && geometry.Current) return true;
    FrameGeometry created;
    created.Base = base;
    created.View = view;
    const auto defaultHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    const auto vertexDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(view.SizeInBytes, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    const array<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>*, 2> outputs = { addressof(created.Current), addressof(created.Previous) };
    for (auto* output : outputs)
    {
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &vertexDescription,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(output->ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())))) return false;
    }
    created.Current->SetName(L"Procedural Current Vertices");
    created.Previous->SetName(L"Procedural Previous Vertices");
    const auto uploadHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto constantDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(kConstantSize);
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &constantDescription,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&created.ConstantBuffer)))) return false;
    geometry = move(created);
    return true;
}

MotionConstants PackMotion(const ProceduralMotionComponent& motion)
{
    MotionConstants result;
    const double cycles = motion.Time * motion.Speed;
    const float phase = isfinite(cycles) ? static_cast<float>(remainder(cycles, 1.0) * XM_2PI) : 0;
    const float noiseTime = isfinite(cycles) ? static_cast<float>(remainder(cycles, 8192.0)) : 0;
    const auto amplitude = [](float value) { return isfinite(value) ? clamp(value, -100.0f, 100.0f) : 0.0f; };
    result.AmplitudeAndPhase = { amplitude(motion.Amplitude.x), amplitude(motion.Amplitude.y), amplitude(motion.Amplitude.z), phase };
    float seedBits;
    memcpy(&seedBits, &motion.Seed, sizeof(seedBits));
    result.Parameters = { isfinite(motion.SpatialFrequency) ? clamp(motion.SpatialFrequency, 0.001f, 4.0f) : 0.3f, noiseTime,
        static_cast<float>(motion.Method), seedBits };
    return result;
}

void DispatchGeometry(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, const GeometryKey& key,
    ID3D12Resource* base, const D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW& view, const ProceduralMotionComponent& motion)
{
    if (!base || view.StrideInBytes != sizeof(Vertex) || view.SizeInBytes == 0) return;
    FrameGeometry& geometry = g_Frames[g_FrameIndex][key];
    if (!Allocate(geometry, base, view)) return;
    History& history = g_History[key];
    Constants constants;
    constants.Current = PackMotion(motion);
    const bool reset = !history.Valid || history.BaseAddress != view.BufferLocation || motion.Time < history.Time;
    constants.Previous = reset ? constants.Current : history.Motion;
    constants.Geometry = { view.SizeInBytes / view.StrideInBytes, view.StrideInBytes, 0, 0 };
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    const CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
    if (FAILED(geometry.ConstantBuffer->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped))) return;
    memcpy(mapped, &constants, sizeof(constants));
    geometry.ConstantBuffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);

    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES heapProperties{};
    base->GetHeapProperties(&heapProperties, nullptr);
    const bool uploadBase = heapProperties.Type == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD;
    vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> barriers;
    if (!uploadBase)
    {
        barriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(base,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE));
    }
    barriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(geometry.Current.Get(),
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS));
    barriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(geometry.Previous.Get(),
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS));
    commandList->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());
    commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_Root.Get());
    commandList->SetPipelineState(g_Pipeline.Get());
    commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, view.BufferLocation);
    commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(1, geometry.Current->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(2, geometry.Previous->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commandList->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(3, geometry.ConstantBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    const UINT groups = (constants.Geometry.x + 63u) / 64u;
    commandList->Dispatch((min)(groups, 65535u), (groups + 65534u) / 65535u, 1);
    for (auto& barrier : barriers) swap(barrier.Transition.StateBefore, barrier.Transition.StateAfter);
    commandList->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());
    history = { view.BufferLocation, constants.Current, motion.Time, true };
    geometry.Revision = g_Revision;
    ++g_Dispatches;
}

bool Resolve(const GeometryKey& key, VertexDeformationView& output)
{
    if (!VertexDeformation::IsRequested(get<0>(key))) return false;
    const auto found = g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].find(key);
    if (found == g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].end() || found->second.Revision != g_Revision) return false;
    const auto& geometry = found->second;
    output.CurrentResource = geometry.Current.Get();
    output.PreviousResource = geometry.Previous.Get();
    output.CurrentView = geometry.View;
    output.PreviousView = geometry.View;
    output.CurrentView.BufferLocation = geometry.Current->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    output.PreviousView.BufferLocation = geometry.Previous->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    output.GeometryRevision = geometry.Revision;
    return true;
}
}

bool VertexDeformation::IsRequested(EntityID entity)
{
    if (!Registry::IsAlive(entity) || !ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity) ||
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity)) return false;
    const auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity);
    return motion.Enabled && motion.Target == Procedural::MotionTarget::MeshVertices;
}

void VertexDeformation::PrepareFrame(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, UINT frameIndex)
{
    g_FrameIndex = frameIndex % kFrameCount;
    g_Dispatches = 0;
    ++g_Revision;
    if (!commandList || !Initialize()) return;
    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Procedural Vertices", commandList);
    set<GeometryKey> live;
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<ProceduralMotionComponent>())
    {
        if (!IsRequested(entity)) continue;
        const auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& modelComponent = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity);
            const auto* model = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(modelComponent.ModelId);
            if (!model) continue;
            for (UINT meshIndex = 0; meshIndex < model->GetMeshCount(); ++meshIndex)
            {
                const auto& mesh = model->GetMeshData(meshIndex);
                GeometryKey key(entity, meshIndex, -1);
                live.insert(key);
                DispatchGeometry(commandList, key, mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), mesh.VertexBufferView, motion);
                for (int outlineMode = 0; outlineMode < kToonOutlineModeCount; ++outlineMode)
                {
                    if (!mesh.TeoVertexBuffers[outlineMode]) continue;
                    key = { entity, meshIndex, outlineMode };
                    live.insert(key);
                    DispatchGeometry(commandList, key, mesh.TeoVertexBuffers[outlineMode].Get(), mesh.TeoVertexBufferViews[outlineMode], motion);
                }
            }
        }
        else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
            const GeometryKey key(entity, kPrimitiveMesh, -1);
            live.insert(key);
            DispatchGeometry(commandList, key, mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), mesh.VertexBufferView, motion);
        }
    }
    // Only this frame slot has completed its fence. Other slots retain their old buffers until safe.
    for (auto it = g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].begin(); it != g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].end();)
    {
        if (!live.count(it->first)) it = g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].erase(it);
        else ++it;
    }
    for (auto it = g_History.begin(); it != g_History.end();)
    {
        if (!live.count(it->first)) it = g_History.erase(it);
        else ++it;
    }
}

bool VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(EntityID entity, VertexDeformationView& output)
{
    return Resolve({ entity, kPrimitiveMesh, -1 }, output);
}
bool VertexDeformation::TryResolveStaticMesh(EntityID entity, UINT meshIndex, VertexDeformationView& output, int outlineMode)
{
    return Resolve({ entity, meshIndex, outlineMode }, output);
}
bool VertexDeformation::TryGetLocalBounds(EntityID entity, XMFLOAT3& center, XMFLOAT3& extents)
{
    if (!IsRequested(entity)) return false;
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto* model = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId);
        if (!model) return false;
        center = model->GetAabbCenter();
        extents = model->GetAabbExtents();
    }
    else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
        if (!mesh.HasLocalBounds) return false;
        center = mesh.LocalBoundsCenter;
        extents = mesh.LocalBoundsExtents;
    }
    else return false;
    const auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity);
    const auto padding = Procedural::GetDeformationBoundsPadding({ motion.Method,
        { motion.Amplitude.x, motion.Amplitude.y, motion.Amplitude.z }, motion.Speed, motion.SpatialFrequency, motion.Seed });
    extents.x += padding.X;
    extents.y += padding.Y;
    extents.z += padding.Z;
    return true;
}
void VertexDeformation::ResetHistory(EntityID entity)
{
    for (auto& [key, history] : g_History)
    {
        if (get<0>(key) == entity) history.Valid = false;
    }
}
void VertexDeformation::Shutdown()
{
    g_Frames = {};
    g_History.clear();
    g_Pipeline.Reset();
    g_Root.Reset();
    g_Dispatches = 0;
    g_Revision = 0;
}
UINT VertexDeformation::GetDispatchCount() { return g_Dispatches; }

===== FILE: source\procedural\vertexdeformationmath.cpp =====
#include "vertexdeformationmath.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace Procedural
{
namespace
{
constexpr double kTwoPi = 6.28318530717958647692;

Vector3 Subtract(const Vector3& first, const Vector3& second)
{
    return { first.X - second.X, first.Y - second.Y, first.Z - second.Z };
}

Vector3 AddScaled(const Vector3& position, const Vector3& direction, float distance)
{
    return { position.X + direction.X * distance, position.Y + direction.Y * distance,
        position.Z + direction.Z * distance };
}

Vector3 Cross(const Vector3& first, const Vector3& second)
{
    return { first.Y * second.Z - first.Z * second.Y,
        first.Z * second.X - first.X * second.Z,
        first.X * second.Y - first.Y * second.X };
}

Vector3 Normalize(const Vector3& normal, const Vector3& fallback)
{
    const float lengthSquared = normal.X * normal.X + normal.Y * normal.Y + normal.Z * normal.Z;
    if (!std::isfinite(lengthSquared) || lengthSquared <= 1e-16f)
    {
        return fallback;
    }
    const float inverseLength = 1.0f / std::sqrt(lengthSquared);
    return { normal.X * inverseLength, normal.Y * inverseLength, normal.Z * inverseLength };
}

float FiniteAmplitude(float amplitude)
{
    if (!std::isfinite(amplitude))
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    return std::clamp(amplitude, -100.0f, 100.0f);
}

float SpatialFrequency(const VertexMotionSettings& settings)
{
    if (!std::isfinite(settings.SpatialFrequency))
    {
        return 0.3f;
    }
    return std::clamp(settings.SpatialFrequency, 0.001f, 4.0f);
}

Vector3 SampleSpatialOffset(const Vector3& position, const VertexMotionSettings& settings, double time)
{
    const double cycles = time * settings.Speed;
    if (!std::isfinite(cycles))
    {
        return {};
    }
    const double phase = std::remainder(cycles, 1.0) * kTwoPi;
    const double frequency = SpatialFrequency(settings);
    const double phaseX = (position.Y * 0.73 + position.Z) * frequency;
    const double phaseY = (position.X + position.Z * 0.61) * frequency;
    const double phaseZ = (position.X * 0.83 + position.Y) * frequency;
    switch (settings.Method)
    {
    case MotionMethod::Wave:
        return { static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseX + phase)),
            static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseY + phase)), static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseZ + phase)) };
    case MotionMethod::Orbit:
        return { static_cast<float>(std::cos(phaseY + phase)),
            static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseX + phase)), static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseZ + phase)) };
    case MotionMethod::Noise:
    {
        NoiseSettings noise;
        noise.Method = NoiseMethod::Perlin;
        noise.Seed = settings.Seed;
        noise.Frequency = static_cast<float>(frequency);
        const float coordinate = static_cast<float>(std::remainder(cycles, 8192.0));
        return { SampleNoise(position.Y + coordinate, position.Z + 11.2f, noise),
            SampleNoise(position.X + coordinate, position.Z + 37.9f, noise),
            SampleNoise(position.X + 93.1f, position.Y + coordinate, noise) };
    }
    default:
        return {};
    }
}
}

Vector3 DeformPosition(const Vector3& basePosition, const VertexMotionSettings& settings, double time)
{
    if (!std::isfinite(time) || !std::isfinite(settings.Speed))
    {
        return basePosition;
    }
    // Subtract the spatial rest field so time zero restores every authored vertex exactly.
    const Vector3 currentOffset = SampleSpatialOffset(basePosition, settings, time);
    const Vector3 restOffset = SampleSpatialOffset(basePosition, settings, 0.0);
    return { basePosition.X + FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.X) * (currentOffset.X - restOffset.X),
        basePosition.Y + FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.Y) * (currentOffset.Y - restOffset.Y),
        basePosition.Z + FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.Z) * (currentOffset.Z - restOffset.Z) };
}

Vector3 DeformNormal(const Vector3& basePosition, const Vector3& baseNormal,
    const VertexMotionSettings& settings, double time)
{
    const Vector3 unitNormal = Normalize(baseNormal, { 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f });
    Vector3 reference = { 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f };
    if (std::abs(unitNormal.Y) > 0.9f)
    {
        reference = { 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
    }
    const Vector3 tangent = Normalize(Cross(reference, unitNormal), { 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f });
    const Vector3 bitangent = Cross(unitNormal, tangent);
    // Sampling both sides estimates the deformation Jacobian and preserves smooth authored normals.
    const float sampleDistance = 0.001f / (std::max)(1.0f, SpatialFrequency(settings));
    const Vector3 deformedTangent = Subtract(
        DeformPosition(AddScaled(basePosition, tangent, sampleDistance), settings, time),
        DeformPosition(AddScaled(basePosition, tangent, -sampleDistance), settings, time));
    const Vector3 deformedBitangent = Subtract(
        DeformPosition(AddScaled(basePosition, bitangent, sampleDistance), settings, time),
        DeformPosition(AddScaled(basePosition, bitangent, -sampleDistance), settings, time));
    return Normalize(Cross(deformedTangent, deformedBitangent), unitNormal);
}

Vector3 GetDeformationBoundsPadding(const VertexMotionSettings& settings)
{
    // Every field sample is in [-1, 1], so a sample minus its rest sample is bounded by two.
    return { std::abs(FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.X)) * 2.0f,
        std::abs(FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.Y)) * 2.0f,
        std::abs(FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.Z)) * 2.0f };
}

bool VertexMotionSettingsEqual(const VertexMotionSettings& first, const VertexMotionSettings& second)
{
    return first.Method == second.Method && first.Amplitude.X == second.Amplitude.X &&
        first.Amplitude.Y == second.Amplitude.Y && first.Amplitude.Z == second.Amplitude.Z &&
        first.Speed == second.Speed && first.SpatialFrequency == second.SpatialFrequency && first.Seed == second.Seed;
}
}

#pragma once

    Vector3 Amplitude = { 0.0f, 2.0f, 0.0f };

    float SpatialFrequency = 0.3f;
    uint32_t Seed = 42;

Vector3 DeformPosition(const Vector3& basePosition, const VertexMotionSettings& settings, double time);

    const VertexMotionSettings& settings, double time);

===== FILE: source\rendering\advancedeffects.h =====
#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// AdvancedEffects
//   ・フロクセル（3Dグリッド）方式のボリュームフォグ（大気 + 局所フォグ + ライトシャフト）
//   ・ヒストグラム方式の自動露出（Eye Adaptation）
//   ・モーションブラー
//   ・被写界深度（DOF）
//   線形HDRシーン（ブルーム・トーンマップ前）に対して実行する。
//   ヘッダーのみで完結（.vcxproj への追加不要）。シェーダーは実行時に DXC でコンパイルする。
// =============================================================================================
#include "pch.h"
#include "rendergraph.h"
#include "envflags.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "raytracing.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "atmosphere.h"
#include "daynightcycle.h"
#include "localheightfog.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "renderquality.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "light.h"
#include "megalights.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

class AdvancedEffects final
{
public:
	struct Settings
	{
		// ボリュームフォグ（有効時は従来のピクセル単位レイマーチ大気パスを置き換える）
		bool FroxelFog = false;
		int FroxelSliceCount = 64;      // 奥行き方向の分割数
		int FroxelTileSize = 8;         // 画面方向のタイルサイズ（ピクセル）
		float FogNear = 0.5f;
		float FogFar = 100.0f;          // 従来の大気レイマーチ距離と同じ
		float FogHistoryWeight = 0.9f;  // 時間方向の蓄積
		float FogScattering = 1.0f;     // 散乱強度（大気設定の光芒強度に乗算）
		float FogAmbient = 1.0f;        // 多重散乱近似（空の環境光）
		// 自動露出
		bool AutoExposure = false;
		float ExposureCompensation = 0.0f; // EV
		float ExposureMinEv = -6.0f;
		float ExposureMaxEv = 8.0f;
		float ExposureSpeed = 2.5f;
		float ExposureLowPercent = 0.50f;
		float ExposureHighPercent = 0.95f;
		// モーションブラー
		bool MotionBlur = false;
        bool HalfResolutionLens = false;
		float MotionBlurShutter = 0.5f;   // シャッター角 180度 = 0.5
		float MotionBlurMaxPixels = 32.0f;
		int MotionBlurSamples = 8;
		// 被写界深度
		bool DepthOfField = false;
		float FocusDistance = 5.0f;
		float FocusRange = 2.0f;
		float MaxBlurPixels = 12.0f;
	};

	static Settings& GetSettings() { return s_Settings; }
	static bool IsAvailable() { return s_Available; }
	// The dual filter bloom replaces the legacy Bloom post process while it is enabled.
	static bool IsDualBloomActive() { return s_Available && s_BloomAvailable && RenderQuality::Get().DualBloom; }
	// Bloom follows the camera post process selection (PostProcessType::BLOOM), like the legacy pass.
	static void SetBloomRequested(bool requested) { s_BloomRequested = requested; }
	static bool IsFroxelFogActive() { return s_Available && s_Settings.FroxelFog; }
	static float GetLastExposure() { return s_LastExposureShown; }
    static bool IsHalfResolutionLensActive() { return s_HalfActive; }

	static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* engineHeap)
	{
		Shutdown();
		if (!device || !engineHeap) return false;
		s_Device = device;
		s_EngineHeap = engineHeap;
		s_Increment = device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV);

		CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[4];
		ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, kSrvCount, 0);
		ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, kUavCount, 0);
		// 5〜8：MegaLights（M6）のグリッド定数 / ライト / セル / セル内ライト（フロクセルのローカルライト）
		ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV,2,0,11);
        ranges[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV,2,0,11);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[12];
		parameters[0].InitAsConstantBufferView(0);
		parameters[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0]);
		parameters[2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1]);
		parameters[3].InitAsShaderResourceView(10);
		parameters[4].InitAsShaderResourceView(11);
		parameters[5].InitAsConstantBufferView(1);
		parameters[6].InitAsShaderResourceView(12);
		parameters[7].InitAsShaderResourceView(13);
		parameters[8].InitAsShaderResourceView(14);
        parameters[9].InitAsDescriptorTable(1,&ranges[2]); parameters[10].InitAsDescriptorTable(1,&ranges[3]);
        parameters[11].InitAsConstants(4,2);
		CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC samplers[2] = {
			CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
				D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP),
			CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(1, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_POINT,
				D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP) };
		const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC root(_countof(parameters), parameters, 2, samplers);
		ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, errors;
		if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&root, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &blob, &errors)) ||
			FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Root))))
		{
			WriteGraphicsLog("AdvancedEffects: root signature failed\n");
			return false;
		}
		const struct { const char* Entry; ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>* Pipeline; } entries[] = {
			{ "FogInject", &s_FogInject }, { "FogIntegrate", &s_FogIntegrate }, { "Composite", &s_Composite },
			{ "HistogramClear", &s_HistogramClear }, { "HistogramBuild", &s_HistogramBuild },
			{ "ExposureAdapt", &s_ExposureAdapt }, { "Resolve", &s_Resolve }, { "DepthOfField", &s_DepthOfField } };
		for (const auto& entry : entries)
		{
			blob.Reset(); errors.Reset();
			if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/AdvancedEffectsCS.hlsl", nullptr, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
				entry.Entry, "cs_6_5", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &blob, &errors)))
			{
				WriteGraphicsLog("AdvancedEffects: %s compile failed: %s\n", entry.Entry,
					errors ? static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()) : "");
				Shutdown();
				return false;
			}
			D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
			desc.pRootSignature = s_Root.Get();
			desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(blob.Get());
			if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(entry.Pipeline->ReleaseAndGetAddressOf()))))
			{
				Shutdown();
				return false;
			}
		}
		D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC heap{};
		heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
		heap.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
		heap.NumDescriptors = kDescriptorsPerFrame * kFrames;
		if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Heap))) ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_Constants, kConstantStride * kFrames, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, L"AdvancedEffects Constants") ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_Lights, kLightStride * kFrames, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, L"AdvancedEffects Fog Lights") ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_Histogram, 64 * sizeof(UINT), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, L"AdvancedEffects Histogram") ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_Exposure, 4 * sizeof(float), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, L"AdvancedEffects Exposure"))
		{
			Shutdown();
			return false;
		}
		s_Available = true;
		s_BloomAvailable = InitializeBloom(device);
		WriteGraphicsLog("AdvancedEffects: initialized (froxel fog, auto exposure, motion blur, DOF, bloom=%d)\n",
			s_BloomAvailable ? 1 : 0);
		return true;
	}

	static void Shutdown()
    {
        s_HalfLens[0].Reset(); s_HalfLens[1].Reset(); s_ResolveHalf.Reset(); s_DofHalf.Reset(); s_UpsampleLens.Reset();
        s_HalfWidth=s_HalfHeight=0; s_HalfFormat=DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN; s_HalfTried=s_HalfActive=false; s_Transient.Reset(); s_AliasActive=false;
		s_Available = false;
		s_Root.Reset(); s_Heap.Reset();
		s_FogInject.Reset(); s_FogIntegrate.Reset(); s_Composite.Reset(); s_HistogramClear.Reset();
		s_HistogramBuild.Reset(); s_ExposureAdapt.Reset(); s_Resolve.Reset(); s_DepthOfField.Reset();
		s_Constants.Reset(); s_Lights.Reset(); s_Histogram.Reset(); s_Exposure.Reset();
		s_Froxels[0].Reset(); s_Froxels[1].Reset(); s_Integrated.Reset(); s_PostA.Reset(); s_PostB.Reset();
		s_BloomAvailable = false;
		s_BloomRoot.Reset(); s_BloomDownPso.Reset(); s_BloomUpPso.Reset(); s_BloomCombinePso.Reset(); s_BloomHeap.Reset();
		s_BloomDown.Reset(); s_BloomUp.Reset(); s_BloomLevels = 0;
		s_Device.Reset(); s_EngineHeap.Reset();
		s_Width = s_Height = 0; s_FroxelExtent = {};
		s_FogHistoryValid = false; s_ExposureReset = true;
	}

	// Scene: linear HDR, PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE on entry and exit.
	// Depth / velocity: GBuffer targets in PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE on entry and exit.
	static void Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* scene, ID3D12Resource* depth,
		ID3D12Resource* velocity, UINT frameIndex)
	{
		const Settings& settings = s_Settings;
		const bool fog = settings.FroxelFog;
		const bool exposure = settings.AutoExposure;
		const bool motionBlur = settings.MotionBlur && velocity;
		const bool dof = settings.DepthOfField;
		if (!fog) s_FogHistoryValid = false;
		if (!exposure) s_ExposureReset = true;
		const auto& quality = RenderQuality::Get();
		const bool weather = quality.WeatherEnabled;
		const bool dualBloom = quality.DualBloom && s_BloomRequested;
		const bool bloomPass = s_BloomAvailable && (dualBloom || quality.LensFlare ||
			(weather && (quality.RainIntensity > 0.001f || quality.SnowFall > 0.001f)));
		if (!s_Available || !commands || !scene || !depth || !(fog || exposure || motionBlur || dof || bloomPass)) return;
		RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Advanced Effects (Fog / Exposure / MB / DOF / Bloom)", commands);
		const auto sceneDesc = scene->GetDesc();
		if (!EnsureTargets(static_cast<UINT>(sceneDesc.Width), sceneDesc.Height, sceneDesc.Format)) return;

        const bool halfLens=s_Settings.HalfResolutionLens && (motionBlur||dof) && EnsureHalfLens();
        s_HalfActive=halfLens;
		const UINT slot = frameIndex % kFrames;
		++s_Frame;
		const UINT current = s_Frame & 1u;
		// M6：グリッドがフォグ用に構築されていれば、グリッドのライトはフォグでも MegaLights が受け持つ
		s_MegaLightsFog = fog && MegaLights::IsVolumetricGridActive();
		const UINT lightCount = UploadLights(slot);
		UploadConstants(slot, lightCount, fog, exposure, motionBlur, dof);
		WriteDescriptors(slot, scene, depth, velocity ? velocity : depth, current);

		ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { s_Heap.Get() };
		commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
		commands->SetComputeRootSignature(s_Root.Get());
		commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(0, s_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + slot * kConstantStride);
		commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, Gpu(slot * kDescriptorsPerFrame));
		commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, Gpu(slot * kDescriptorsPerFrame + kSrvCount));
		const D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS lights = s_Lights->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + slot * kLightStride;
		const D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS tlas = Raytracing::GetSceneAddress();
		// The TLAS slot is only read when FogMieColor.w (shadows available) is set.
		commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(3, tlas ? tlas : lights);
		commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(4, lights);
		MegaLights::BindFogCompute(commands, 5, 6, 7, 8, s_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + slot * kConstantStride, lights);

		constexpr D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES kRead = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
		vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> begin;
		for (ID3D12Resource* input : { scene, depth, velocity })
			if (input) begin.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(input, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, kRead));
		commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(begin.size()), begin.data());

		const UINT groupsX = (s_Width + 7) / 8, groupsY = (s_Height + 7) / 8;
		if (fog)
		{
			ID3D12Resource* froxel = s_Froxels[current].Get();
			Barrier(commands, froxel, kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			commands->SetPipelineState(s_FogInject.Get());
			commands->Dispatch((s_FroxelExtent.x + 7) / 8, (s_FroxelExtent.y + 7) / 8, s_FroxelExtent.z);
			Barrier(commands, froxel, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead);
			Barrier(commands, s_Integrated.Get(), kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			commands->SetPipelineState(s_FogIntegrate.Get());
			commands->Dispatch((s_FroxelExtent.x + 7) / 8, (s_FroxelExtent.y + 7) / 8, 1);
			Barrier(commands, s_Integrated.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead);
			s_FogHistoryValid = true;
		}
		Barrier(commands, s_PostA.Get(), kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		commands->SetPipelineState(s_Composite.Get());
		commands->Dispatch(groupsX, groupsY, 1);
		Barrier(commands, s_PostA.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead);
		if (exposure)
		{
            if(s_AliasActive)s_Transient.Activate(0,commands);
			commands->SetPipelineState(s_HistogramClear.Get());
			commands->Dispatch(1, 1, 1);
			UavBarrier(commands, s_Histogram.Get());
			commands->SetPipelineState(s_HistogramBuild.Get());
			commands->Dispatch((s_Width / 2 + 15) / 16, (s_Height / 2 + 15) / 16, 1);
			UavBarrier(commands, s_Histogram.Get());
			commands->SetPipelineState(s_ExposureAdapt.Get());
			commands->Dispatch(1, 1, 1);
			UavBarrier(commands, s_Exposure.Get());
			s_ExposureReset = false;
		}
        if(s_AliasActive)s_Transient.Activate(1,commands);
        ID3D12Resource* result=s_PostB.Get();
        if(halfLens)
        {
            RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Half resolution MB / DOF",commands);
            const UINT parameters[]={s_HalfWidth,s_HalfHeight,dof?1u:0u,0};
            commands->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(11,4,parameters,0);
            commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(9,Gpu(slot*kDescriptorsPerFrame+kHalfSrvOffset));
            commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(10,Gpu(slot*kDescriptorsPerFrame+kHalfUavOffset));
            Barrier(commands,s_HalfLens[0].Get(),kRead,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            commands->SetPipelineState(s_ResolveHalf.Get()); commands->Dispatch((s_HalfWidth+7)/8,(s_HalfHeight+7)/8,1);
            Barrier(commands,s_HalfLens[0].Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,kRead);
            if(dof)
            {
                Barrier(commands,s_HalfLens[1].Get(),kRead,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
                commands->SetPipelineState(s_DofHalf.Get()); commands->Dispatch((s_HalfWidth+7)/8,(s_HalfHeight+7)/8,1);
                Barrier(commands,s_HalfLens[1].Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,kRead);
            }
            Barrier(commands,s_PostB.Get(),kRead,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            commands->SetPipelineState(s_UpsampleLens.Get()); commands->Dispatch(groupsX,groupsY,1);
            Barrier(commands,s_PostB.Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,kRead);
        }
        else
        {
		Barrier(commands, s_PostB.Get(), kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		commands->SetPipelineState(s_Resolve.Get());
		commands->Dispatch(groupsX, groupsY, 1);
		Barrier(commands, s_PostB.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead);
		result = s_PostB.Get();
		if (dof)
		{
			Barrier(commands, s_PostA.Get(), kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			commands->SetPipelineState(s_DepthOfField.Get());
			commands->Dispatch(groupsX, groupsY, 1);
			Barrier(commands, s_PostA.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead);
			result = s_PostA.Get();
		}
        }

		if (bloomPass && EnsureBloomTargets())
		{
			result = ExecuteBloom(commands, slot, result, depth, dualBloom);
		}

		// The scene target has no UAV flag; copy the result back.
		vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> copy = {
			CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(result, kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE),
			CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(scene, kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST) };
		commands->ResourceBarrier(2, copy.data());
		commands->CopyResource(scene, result);
		vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> end = {
			CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(result, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE, kRead),
			CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(scene, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE) };
		for (ID3D12Resource* input : { depth, velocity })
			if (input) end.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(input, kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE));
		commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(end.size()), end.data());

		ID3D12DescriptorHeap* engine[] = { s_EngineHeap.Get() };
		commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, engine);
	}

private:
	static constexpr UINT kFrames = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
	static constexpr UINT kSrvCount = 10;  // t0..t9 (t8, t9 reserved)
	static constexpr UINT kUavCount = 6;   // u0..u5
	static constexpr UINT kHalfSrvOffset=kSrvCount+kUavCount,kHalfUavOffset=kHalfSrvOffset+2;
    static constexpr UINT kDescriptorsPerFrame=kHalfUavOffset+2;
	static constexpr UINT kMaxLights = 32;
	static constexpr UINT kMaxLocalFog = 16;

	struct alignas(16) FogLight
	{
		XMFLOAT4 PositionType, DirectionRange, Color, Extras;
	};
	struct alignas(16) Constants
	{
		XMFLOAT4X4 InvViewProjection, PrevViewProjection;
		XMFLOAT4 CameraPosition, PrevCameraPosition;
		XMUINT4 Extent, FroxelExtent;
		XMFLOAT4 FogDepth, FogMedium0, FogMedium1, FogRayleighColor, FogMieColor, FogAmbientColor;
		XMFLOAT4 ExposureParams, ExposureLimits, MotionBlurParams, DofParams;
		XMUINT4 Features;
		XMFLOAT4 LocalFogData0[kMaxLocalFog], LocalFogData1[kMaxLocalFog], LocalFogColor[kMaxLocalFog];
		XMUINT4 MegaLightsFog; // x: MegaLights のグリッドを使う, y: フロクセルあたりのサンプル数
	};
	static constexpr UINT kConstantStride = (sizeof(Constants) + 255u) & ~255u;
	static constexpr UINT kLightStride = (sizeof(FogLight) * kMaxLights + 255u) & ~255u;

	static inline Settings s_Settings{};
	static inline bool s_Available = false;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Device> s_Device;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> s_EngineHeap, s_Heap;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> s_Root;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> s_FogInject, s_FogIntegrate, s_Composite, s_HistogramClear,
		s_HistogramBuild, s_ExposureAdapt, s_Resolve, s_DepthOfField;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> s_Constants, s_Lights, s_Histogram, s_Exposure;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> s_Froxels[2], s_Integrated, s_PostA, s_PostB;
	static inline UINT s_Increment = 0, s_Width = 0, s_Height = 0, s_Frame = 0;
	static inline DXGI_FORMAT s_Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
	static inline XMUINT3 s_FroxelExtent{};
	static inline bool s_MegaLightsFog = false;
	static inline bool s_FogHistoryValid = false, s_ExposureReset = true;
	static inline XMFLOAT4X4 s_PrevViewProjection{};
	static inline XMFLOAT3 s_PrevCamera{};
	static inline float s_LastExposureShown = 1.0f;
	// --- Dual filter bloom / lens flare / weather overlay ---
	static constexpr UINT kMaxBloomLevels = 8;
	static constexpr UINT kBloomTablesPerFrame = kMaxBloomLevels * 2 + 1;
	static constexpr UINT kBloomTableSize = 5; // t0..t3, u0
	static inline bool s_BloomAvailable = false;
	static inline bool s_BloomRequested = false;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> s_BloomRoot;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> s_BloomDownPso, s_BloomUpPso, s_BloomCombinePso;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> s_BloomHeap;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> s_BloomDown, s_BloomUp;
	static inline UINT s_BloomLevels = 0, s_BloomWidth = 0, s_BloomHeight = 0;

	struct BloomConstants
	{
		UINT DestinationWidth, DestinationHeight, SourceWidth, SourceHeight;
		float Threshold, Radius, Intensity, Normalization;
		float FlareIntensity, FlareHalo, RainIntensity, SnowIntensity;
		float Time, WindX;
		UINT FirstLevel, Flags;
	};
	static_assert(sizeof(BloomConstants) == 64);

	static bool InitializeBloom(ID3D12Device* device)
	{
		CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[2];
		ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 4, 0, 0, 0);
		ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 1, 0, 0, 4);
		CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[2];
		parameters[0].InitAsConstants(sizeof(BloomConstants) / 4, 0);
		parameters[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(2, ranges);
		const CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC sampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
			D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP);
		const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC root(2, parameters, 1, &sampler);
		ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, errors;
		if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&root, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &blob, &errors)) ||
			FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_BloomRoot))))
			return false;
		const struct { const char* Entry; ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>* Pipeline; } entries[] = {
			{ "BloomDownsample", &s_BloomDownPso }, { "BloomUpsample", &s_BloomUpPso }, { "BloomCombine", &s_BloomCombinePso } };
		for (const auto& entry : entries)
		{
			blob.Reset(); errors.Reset();
			if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/BloomCS.hlsl", nullptr, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
				entry.Entry, "cs_6_0", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &blob, &errors)))
			{
				WriteGraphicsLog("Bloom: %s compile failed: %s\n", entry.Entry, errors ? static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()) : "");
				return false;
			}
			D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
			desc.pRootSignature = s_BloomRoot.Get();
			desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(blob.Get());
			if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(entry.Pipeline->ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())))) return false;
		}
		D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC heap{};
		heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
		heap.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
		heap.NumDescriptors = kBloomTablesPerFrame * kBloomTableSize * kFrames;
		return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_BloomHeap)));
	}

	static bool EnsureBloomTargets()
	{
		const UINT width = (std::max)(1u, s_Width / 2), height = (std::max)(1u, s_Height / 2);
		UINT levels = static_cast<UINT>(std::clamp(RenderQuality::Get().BloomLevels, 2, static_cast<int>(kMaxBloomLevels)));
		while (levels > 1 && ((width >> (levels - 1)) < 4 || (height >> (levels - 1)) < 4)) --levels;
		if (s_BloomDown && s_BloomWidth == width && s_BloomHeight == height && s_BloomLevels == levels) return true;
		if (s_BloomDown && !GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle()) return false;
		const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, width, height, 1, static_cast<UINT16>(levels));
		if (!CreateTexture(s_BloomDown, desc, L"Bloom Downsample Chain") || !CreateTexture(s_BloomUp, desc, L"Bloom Upsample Chain"))
		{
			s_BloomDown.Reset(); s_BloomUp.Reset();
			return false;
		}
		s_BloomWidth = width; s_BloomHeight = height; s_BloomLevels = levels;
		return true;
	}

	static D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE BloomCpu(UINT index)
	{
		return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_BloomHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, s_Increment);
	}
	static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE BloomGpu(UINT index)
	{
		return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_BloomHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, s_Increment);
	}

	// srvs: up to 4 (resource, mip; nullptr = null descriptor). Returns the GPU table handle.
	static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE WriteBloomTable(UINT table, std::initializer_list<std::pair<ID3D12Resource*, UINT>> srvs,
		ID3D12Resource* uav, UINT uavMip)
	{
		const UINT base = table * kBloomTableSize;
		UINT index = 0;
		for (const auto& srv : srvs)
		{
			D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
			desc.Format = srv.first ? srv.first->GetDesc().Format : DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
			if (desc.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS) desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
			desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
			desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
			desc.Texture2D.MostDetailedMip = srv.first ? srv.second : 0;
			desc.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
			s_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(srv.first, &desc, BloomCpu(base + index));
			++index;
		}
		for (; index < 4; ++index)
		{
			D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
			desc.Format = index == 3 ? DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT : DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
			desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
			desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
			desc.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
			s_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(nullptr, &desc, BloomCpu(base + index));
		}
		D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC desc{};
		desc.Format = uav->GetDesc().Format;
		desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
		desc.Texture2D.MipSlice = uavMip;
		s_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(uav, nullptr, &desc, BloomCpu(base + 4));
		return BloomGpu(base);
	}

	// Mip chain bloom, lens flare and rain / snow overlay. Returns the texture holding the result
	// (the Post texture that was not the input). All textures are left in shader read state.
	static ID3D12Resource* ExecuteBloom(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT slot, ID3D12Resource* input, ID3D12Resource* depth,
		bool dualBloom)
	{
		constexpr D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES kRead = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
		const auto& quality = RenderQuality::Get();
		ID3D12Resource* output = input == s_PostA.Get() ? s_PostB.Get() : s_PostA.Get();
		const UINT tableBase = slot * kBloomTablesPerFrame;
		ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { s_BloomHeap.Get() };
		commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
		commands->SetComputeRootSignature(s_BloomRoot.Get());
		BloomConstants constants{};
		constants.Threshold = (std::max)(0.0f, quality.BloomThreshold);
		constants.Radius = std::clamp(quality.BloomRadius, 0.0f, 1.0f);
		const auto mipSize = [](UINT size, UINT mip) { return (std::max)(1u, size >> mip); };
		// Downsample chain.
		commands->SetPipelineState(s_BloomDownPso.Get());
		Barrier(commands, s_BloomDown.Get(), kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		for (UINT level = 0; level < s_BloomLevels; ++level)
		{
			// Each mip transitions independently: source mip -> read, destination mip stays UAV.
			const bool first = level == 0;
			if (!first)
			{
				const auto toRead = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s_BloomDown.Get(),
					D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead, level - 1);
				commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &toRead);
			}
			constants.DestinationWidth = mipSize(s_BloomWidth, level);
			constants.DestinationHeight = mipSize(s_BloomHeight, level);
			constants.SourceWidth = first ? s_Width : mipSize(s_BloomWidth, level - 1);
			constants.SourceHeight = first ? s_Height : mipSize(s_BloomHeight, level - 1);
			constants.FirstLevel = first ? 1u : 0u;
			commands->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(0, sizeof(constants) / 4, &constants, 0);
			commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, WriteBloomTable(tableBase + level,
				{ { first ? input : s_BloomDown.Get(), first ? 0u : level - 1 } }, s_BloomDown.Get(), level));
			commands->Dispatch((constants.DestinationWidth + 7) / 8, (constants.DestinationHeight + 7) / 8, 1);
		}
		const auto lastToRead = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s_BloomDown.Get(),
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead, s_BloomLevels - 1);
		commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &lastToRead);
		// Upsample chain: up[i] = down[i] + tent(up[i + 1]) * radius (coarsest uses down).
		commands->SetPipelineState(s_BloomUpPso.Get());
		Barrier(commands, s_BloomUp.Get(), kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		float normalization = 1.0f, weight = 1.0f;
		for (int level = static_cast<int>(s_BloomLevels) - 2; level >= 0; --level)
		{
			const bool coarsest = level == static_cast<int>(s_BloomLevels) - 2;
			if (!coarsest)
			{
				const auto toRead = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s_BloomUp.Get(),
					D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead, level + 1);
				commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &toRead);
			}
			constants.DestinationWidth = mipSize(s_BloomWidth, level);
			constants.DestinationHeight = mipSize(s_BloomHeight, level);
			constants.SourceWidth = mipSize(s_BloomWidth, level + 1);
			constants.SourceHeight = mipSize(s_BloomHeight, level + 1);
			commands->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(0, sizeof(constants) / 4, &constants, 0);
			commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, WriteBloomTable(tableBase + kMaxBloomLevels + level,
				{ { s_BloomDown.Get(), static_cast<UINT>(level) }, { coarsest ? s_BloomDown.Get() : s_BloomUp.Get(), static_cast<UINT>(level + 1) } },
				s_BloomUp.Get(), level));
			commands->Dispatch((constants.DestinationWidth + 7) / 8, (constants.DestinationHeight + 7) / 8, 1);
			weight *= constants.Radius;
			normalization += weight;
		}
		// Every up mip except the last coarsest one (never written) is now read; make the whole
		// resource uniformly readable again.
		for (UINT level = 0; level < s_BloomLevels; ++level)
		{
			if (level == 0 || level == s_BloomLevels - 1)
			{
				// mip 0 still UAV; the coarsest up mip was never written but is in UAV state.
				const auto toRead = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s_BloomUp.Get(),
					D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead, level);
				commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &toRead);
			}
		}
		// Combine.
		const bool weather = quality.WeatherEnabled;
		constants.DestinationWidth = s_Width;
		constants.DestinationHeight = s_Height;
		constants.SourceWidth = s_BloomWidth;
		constants.SourceHeight = s_BloomHeight;
		constants.Intensity = dualBloom ? std::clamp(quality.BloomIntensity, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.0f;
		constants.Normalization = 1.0f / normalization;
		constants.FlareIntensity = (std::max)(0.0f, quality.LensFlareIntensity);
		constants.FlareHalo = (std::max)(0.0f, quality.LensFlareHalo);
		constants.RainIntensity = weather ? std::clamp(quality.RainIntensity, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.0f;
		constants.SnowIntensity = weather ? std::clamp(quality.SnowFall, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.0f;
		static float s_Time = 0.0f;
		s_Time = fmodf(s_Time + std::clamp(World::GetRawDeltaTime(), 0.0f, 0.25f), 3600.0f);
		constants.Time = s_Time;
		constants.WindX = quality.WindX;
		constants.FirstLevel = 0;
		constants.Flags = (dualBloom ? 1u : 0u) | (quality.LensFlare ? 2u : 0u) |
			(constants.RainIntensity > 0.001f ? 4u : 0u) | (constants.SnowIntensity > 0.001f ? 8u : 0u);
		commands->SetPipelineState(s_BloomCombinePso.Get());
		commands->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(0, sizeof(constants) / 4, &constants, 0);
		const UINT flareMip = (std::min)(2u, s_BloomLevels - 1);
		commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, WriteBloomTable(tableBase + 2 * kMaxBloomLevels,
			{ { input, 0u }, { s_BloomUp.Get(), 0u }, { s_BloomDown.Get(), flareMip }, { depth, 0u } }, output, 0));
		Barrier(commands, output, kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		commands->Dispatch((s_Width + 7) / 8, (s_Height + 7) / 8, 1);
		Barrier(commands, output, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead);
		return output;
	}

	static D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Cpu(UINT index)
	{
		return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_Heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, s_Increment);
	}
	static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Gpu(UINT index)
	{
		return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_Heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, s_Increment);
	}
	static void Barrier(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource,
		D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
	{
		const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, before, after);
		commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
	}
	static void UavBarrier(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource)
	{
		const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(resource);
		commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
	}

	static bool CreateBuffer(ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& buffer, UINT64 bytes, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE type, const wchar_t* name)
	{
		const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(type);
		const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes,
			type == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT ? D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS : D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE);
		const auto state = type == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD ? D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ : D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
		if (FAILED(s_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc, state, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&buffer))))
			return false;
		buffer->SetName(name);
		return true;
	}

	static bool CreateTexture(ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& texture, D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC desc, const wchar_t* name)
	{
		desc.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
		const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
		if (FAILED(s_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
			nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(texture.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())))) return false;
		texture->SetName(name);
		return true;
	}

	static inline TransientArena s_Transient;
    static inline bool s_AliasActive=false;
    static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> s_HalfLens[2];
    static inline ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> s_ResolveHalf,s_DofHalf,s_UpsampleLens;
    static inline UINT s_HalfWidth=0,s_HalfHeight=0;
    static inline DXGI_FORMAT s_HalfFormat=DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
    static inline bool s_HalfTried=false,s_HalfActive=false;
    static bool EnsureHalfLens()
    {
        if(!s_HalfTried)
        {
            s_HalfTried=true;
            auto compile=[](const char* entry,ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pso)
            {
                ComPtr<ID3DBlob> code,errors;
                if(FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/AdvancedEffectsCS.hlsl",nullptr,D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
                    entry,"cs_6_5",D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3,0,&code,&errors)))
                { WriteGraphicsLog("Half lens %s: %s\n",entry,errors?static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()):""); return false; }
                D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC d{}; d.pRootSignature=s_Root.Get(); d.CS={code->GetBufferPointer(),code->GetBufferSize()};
                return SUCCEEDED(s_Device->CreateComputePipelineState(&d,IID_PPV_ARGS(&pso)));
            };
            if(!compile("ResolveHalf",s_ResolveHalf)||!compile("DofHalf",s_DofHalf)||!compile("UpsampleLens",s_UpsampleLens))
            { s_ResolveHalf.Reset(); s_DofHalf.Reset(); s_UpsampleLens.Reset(); }
        }
        if(!s_ResolveHalf||!s_DofHalf||!s_UpsampleLens) return false;
        const UINT width=(s_Width+1)/2,height=(s_Height+1)/2;
        if(s_HalfLens[0]&&s_HalfLens[1]&&s_HalfWidth==width&&s_HalfHeight==height&&s_HalfFormat==s_Format) return true;
        if(!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle()) return false;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> a,b;
        const auto desc=CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(s_Format,width,height,1,1);
        if(!CreateTexture(a,desc,L"Half Motion Blur")||!CreateTexture(b,desc,L"Half DOF")) return false;
        s_HalfLens[0]=a; s_HalfLens[1]=b; s_HalfWidth=width; s_HalfHeight=height; s_HalfFormat=s_Format; return true;
    }
    static bool EnsureTargets(UINT width, UINT height, DXGI_FORMAT format)
	{
		const UINT tile = static_cast<UINT>(std::clamp(s_Settings.FroxelTileSize, 4, 32));
		const XMUINT3 froxels = { (std::max)(1u, (width + tile - 1) / tile), (std::max)(1u, (height + tile - 1) / tile),
			static_cast<UINT>(std::clamp(s_Settings.FroxelSliceCount, 16, 128)) };
		const bool sceneChanged = width != s_Width || height != s_Height || format != s_Format;
		const bool froxelChanged = froxels.x != s_FroxelExtent.x || froxels.y != s_FroxelExtent.y || froxels.z != s_FroxelExtent.z;
		if (!sceneChanged && !froxelChanged) return true;
		// Earlier frames may still reference the old textures.
		if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle()) return false;
		if (sceneChanged)
		{
			const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(format, width, height, 1, 1);
			if (!CreateTexture(s_PostA, desc, L"AdvancedEffects Post A") ||
				!CreateTexture(s_PostB, desc, L"AdvancedEffects Post B")) return false;
            static const bool alias=ReadEnvironmentFlagOnce("DX12_TRANSIENT_ALIAS");
            s_AliasActive=false;s_Transient.Reset();
            if(alias)
            {
                RenderGraph graph;
                auto histogramDesc=CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(64*sizeof(UINT),D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
                auto postDesc=desc;postDesc.Flags=D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
                const auto histogram=graph.CreateTransientResource("Exposure histogram",histogramDesc,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
                const auto post=graph.CreateTransientResource("Lens post output",postDesc,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE|D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                graph.AddPass("Histogram",[&](auto& b){b.Write(histogram,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);},[](auto*){});
                graph.AddPass("Exposure",[&](auto& b){b.Read(histogram,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);},[](auto*){});
                graph.AddPass("Lens output",[&](auto& b){b.Write(post,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);},[](auto*){});
                if(graph.Compile()&&graph.AllocateTransients(s_Device.Get(),s_Transient))
                {s_Histogram=graph.GetResource(histogram);s_PostB=graph.GetResource(post);s_AliasActive=true;}
            }
			s_Width = width; s_Height = height; s_Format = format;
		}
		if (froxelChanged)
		{
			const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex3D(DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, froxels.x, froxels.y,
				static_cast<UINT16>(froxels.z), 1);
			if (!CreateTexture(s_Froxels[0], desc, L"Froxel Fog Medium 0") ||
				!CreateTexture(s_Froxels[1], desc, L"Froxel Fog Medium 1") ||
				!CreateTexture(s_Integrated, desc, L"Froxel Fog Integrated")) return false;
			s_FroxelExtent = froxels;
			s_FogHistoryValid = false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	static void WriteDescriptors(UINT slot, ID3D12Resource* scene, ID3D12Resource* depth, ID3D12Resource* velocity, UINT current)
	{
		const UINT base = slot * kDescriptorsPerFrame;
		const auto srv2D = [&](ID3D12Resource* resource, UINT index)
		{
			D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
			desc.Format = resource->GetDesc().Format;
			if (desc.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS) desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
			if (desc.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R24G8_TYPELESS) desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R24_UNORM_X8_TYPELESS;
			if (desc.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32G8X24_TYPELESS) desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT_X8X24_TYPELESS;
			desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
			desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
			desc.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
			s_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &desc, Cpu(base + index));
		};
        for(UINT index=0;index<2;++index)
        {
            auto* resource=s_HalfActive?s_HalfLens[index].Get():nullptr;
            D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{}; srv.Format=s_Format; srv.ViewDimension=D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            srv.Shader4ComponentMapping=D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING; srv.Texture2D.MipLevels=1;
            s_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource,&srv,Cpu(base+kHalfSrvOffset+index));
            D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{}; uav.Format=s_Format; uav.ViewDimension=D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            s_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(resource,nullptr,&uav,Cpu(base+kHalfUavOffset+index));
        }
		const auto srv3D = [&](ID3D12Resource* resource, UINT index)
		{
			D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
			desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
			desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE3D;
			desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
			desc.Texture3D.MipLevels = 1;
			s_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &desc, Cpu(base + index));
		};
		const auto uavTexture = [&](ID3D12Resource* resource, UINT index, bool volume)
		{
			D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC desc{};
			desc.Format = resource->GetDesc().Format;
			if (volume)
			{
				desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE3D;
				desc.Texture3D.WSize = resource->GetDesc().DepthOrArraySize;
			}
			else desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
			s_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(resource, nullptr, &desc, Cpu(base + kSrvCount + index));
		};
		const auto uavBuffer = [&](ID3D12Resource* resource, UINT index, UINT elements)
		{
			D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC desc{};
			desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
			desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
			desc.Buffer.NumElements = elements;
			desc.Buffer.StructureByteStride = 4;
			s_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(resource, nullptr, &desc, Cpu(base + kSrvCount + index));
		};
		srv2D(scene, 0);
		srv2D(depth, 1);
		srv2D(velocity, 2);
		srv3D(s_Froxels[current ^ 1u].Get(), 3);
		srv3D(s_Froxels[current].Get(), 4);
		srv3D(s_Integrated.Get(), 5);
		srv2D(s_PostA.Get(), 6);
		srv2D(s_PostB.Get(), 7);
		srv2D(s_PostA.Get(), 8); // reserved
		srv2D(s_PostB.Get(), 9); // reserved
		uavTexture(s_Froxels[current].Get(), 0, true);
		uavTexture(s_Integrated.Get(), 1, true);
		uavTexture(s_PostA.Get(), 2, false);
		uavTexture(s_PostB.Get(), 3, false);
		uavBuffer(s_Histogram.Get(), 4, 64);
		uavBuffer(s_Exposure.Get(), 5, 4);
	}

	static UINT UploadLights(UINT slot)
	{
		FogLight lights[kMaxLights]{};
		UINT count = 0;
		for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<LightComponent, TransformComponent>())
		{
			if (count >= kMaxLights) break;
			const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
			if (!light.IsActive || light.RenderMode != LightRenderMode::Physical || light.Intensity <= 0.0f) continue;
			if (s_MegaLightsFog && MegaLights::IsEntityInGrid(entity)) continue; // M6：MegaLights 側で評価
			const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
			XMFLOAT3 direction;
			XMStoreFloat3(&direction, XMVector3Normalize(XMLoadFloat3(&light.Direction)));
			FogLight& entry = lights[count++];
			entry.PositionType = { transform.Position.x, transform.Position.y, transform.Position.z, static_cast<float>(light.Type) };
			entry.DirectionRange = { direction.x, direction.y, direction.z, light.Range };
			entry.Color = { light.Color.x * light.Intensity, light.Color.y * light.Intensity,
				light.Color.z * light.Intensity, (std::max)(light.VolumeDensity, 0.0f) };
			entry.Extras = { cosf(XMConvertToRadians(light.InnerAngle)), cosf(XMConvertToRadians(light.OuterAngle)),
				static_cast<float>(light.CastShadow), 0.0f };
		}
		void* mapped = nullptr;
		const D3D12_RANGE noRead{ 0, 0 };
		if (SUCCEEDED(s_Lights->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
		{
			memcpy(static_cast<BYTE*>(mapped) + slot * kLightStride, lights, sizeof(lights));
			s_Lights->Unmap(0, nullptr);
		}
		return count;
	}

	static void UploadConstants(UINT slot, UINT lightCount, bool fog, bool exposure, bool motionBlur, bool dof)
	{
		const Settings& settings = s_Settings;
		Constants constants{};
		const EntityID camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
		XMFLOAT3 position = { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
		if (camera != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(camera))
			position = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(camera).Position;
		XMMATRIX view, projection;
		Camera::GetCameraMatrices(camera, view, projection);
		const XMMATRIX viewProjection = view * projection;
		XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.InvViewProjection, XMMatrixTranspose(XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, viewProjection)));
		constants.PrevViewProjection = s_FogHistoryValid ? s_PrevViewProjection : XMFLOAT4X4{};
		const float deltaTime = std::clamp(World::GetRawDeltaTime(), 0.0f, 0.25f);
		constants.CameraPosition = { position.x, position.y, position.z, deltaTime };
		constants.PrevCameraPosition = { s_PrevCamera.x, s_PrevCamera.y, s_PrevCamera.z, s_FogHistoryValid ? 1.0f : 0.0f };
		XMStoreFloat4x4(&s_PrevViewProjection, XMMatrixTranspose(viewProjection));
		s_PrevCamera = position;

		const float nearDistance = (std::max)(0.05f, settings.FogNear);
		const float farDistance = (std::max)(nearDistance + 1.0f, settings.FogFar);
		const auto& air = Atmosphere::GetParameters();
		const auto& fogVolumes = LocalHeightFog::GetVolumes();
		const UINT fogCount = static_cast<UINT>((std::min)(fogVolumes.size(), static_cast<size_t>(kMaxLocalFog)));
		constants.Extent = { s_Width, s_Height, s_Frame, lightCount };
		constants.FroxelExtent = { s_FroxelExtent.x, s_FroxelExtent.y, s_FroxelExtent.z, fogCount };
		constants.FogDepth = { nearDistance, farDistance, log2f(farDistance / nearDistance), std::clamp(settings.FogHistoryWeight, 0.0f, 0.97f) };
		const float density = air.Enabled ? (std::max)(0.0f, air.Density) : 0.0f;
		constants.FogMedium0 = { density, (std::max)(0.0f, air.HeightFalloff), (std::max)(0.0f, air.Extinction), (std::max)(0.0001f, air.DistanceScale) };
		constants.FogMedium1 = { (std::max)(0.0f, air.RayleighStrength), (std::max)(0.0f, air.MieStrength),
			std::clamp(air.MieG, -0.95f, 0.95f), (std::max)(0.0f, air.LightShaftStrength) * (std::max)(0.0f, settings.FogScattering) };
		constants.FogRayleighColor = { air.RayleighColor.x, air.RayleighColor.y, air.RayleighColor.z,
			(std::max)(0.0f, air.AmbientStrength) * (std::max)(0.0f, settings.FogAmbient) };
		constants.FogMieColor = { air.MieColor.x, air.MieColor.y, air.MieColor.z, Raytracing::GetSceneAddress() ? 1.0f : 0.0f };
		const float daylight = DayNightCycle::GetDaylight();
		constants.FogAmbientColor = { 0.35f * daylight + 0.01f, 0.45f * daylight + 0.012f, 0.6f * daylight + 0.02f, 0.0f };
		for (UINT index = 0; index < fogCount; ++index)
		{
			const auto& volume = fogVolumes[index];
			constants.LocalFogData0[index] = { volume.Position.x, volume.Position.y, volume.Position.z, (std::max)(volume.Radius, 0.01f) };
			constants.LocalFogData1[index] = { (std::max)(volume.HeightFalloff, 0.0f), (std::max)(volume.Density, 0.0f),
				static_cast<float>(volume.Shape), static_cast<float>(volume.Enabled) };
			constants.LocalFogColor[index] = { volume.Color.x, volume.Color.y, volume.Color.z, 0.0f };
		}
		constants.MegaLightsFog = { s_MegaLightsFog ? 1u : 0u, static_cast<UINT>(MegaLights::GetFogSamples()), 0u, 0u };
		const float minLog = -10.0f, maxLog = 6.0f;
		constants.ExposureParams = { minLog, maxLog - minLog, settings.ExposureCompensation, (std::max)(0.01f, settings.ExposureSpeed) };
		const float lowPercent = std::clamp(settings.ExposureLowPercent, 0.0f, 0.99f);
		constants.ExposureLimits = { exp2f(settings.ExposureMinEv), exp2f((std::max)(settings.ExposureMinEv, settings.ExposureMaxEv)),
			lowPercent, std::clamp(settings.ExposureHighPercent, lowPercent + 0.01f, 1.0f) };
		constants.MotionBlurParams = { std::clamp(settings.MotionBlurShutter, 0.0f, 2.0f), std::clamp(settings.MotionBlurMaxPixels, 1.0f, 128.0f),
			static_cast<float>(std::clamp(settings.MotionBlurSamples, 2, 32)), motionBlur ? 1.0f : 0.0f };
		constants.DofParams = { (std::max)(0.05f, settings.FocusDistance), (std::max)(0.0f, settings.FocusRange),
			std::clamp(settings.MaxBlurPixels, 1.0f, 48.0f), dof ? 1.0f : 0.0f };
		// Bit 1: the physical sky already integrates its own atmosphere; like the former
		// atmosphere pass, the background then receives no additional fog.
		const UINT fogFlags = fog ? (1u | (air.Enabled && air.PhysicalSky ? 2u : 0u)) : 0u;
		constants.Features = { fogFlags, exposure ? 1u : 0u, motionBlur ? 1u : 0u, dof ? 1u : 0u };
		// w = 1: ExposureAdapt ignores the stored state (uninitialised buffer, re-enable).
		constants.FogAmbientColor.w = exposure && s_ExposureReset ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
		void* mapped = nullptr;
		const D3D12_RANGE noRead{ 0, 0 };
		if (SUCCEEDED(s_Constants->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
		{
			memcpy(static_cast<BYTE*>(mapped) + slot * kConstantStride, &constants, sizeof(constants));
			s_Constants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
		}
	}
};




===== FILE: source\rendering\asynccompute.h =====
#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// AsyncCompute
//   専用の COMPUTE コマンドキューで、グラフィックスと並行して実行できる処理を流す仕組み。
//   ・フレームスロットごとのアロケーター（スロット再利用時は前回の GPU 処理が完了済み）
//   ・Submit() で compute キューに投入して Signal し、グラフィックスキューに GPU 側の Wait を挿入
//     （CPU は待たない）。以降にグラフィックスキューへ投入されたコマンドは compute 完了後に実行される。
//   ・キューを作成できない環境では IsAvailable() が false になり、呼び出し側はグラフィックス
//     コマンドリストに記録する（フォールバック）。
//   ヘッダーのみで完結（.vcxproj への追加不要）。
// =============================================================================================
#include "pch.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"

class AsyncCompute final
{
public:
	static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device)
	{
		Shutdown();
		if (!device) return false;
		D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC desc{};
		desc.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COMPUTE;
		desc.Priority = D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_PRIORITY_NORMAL;
		if (FAILED(device->CreateCommandQueue(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Queue))))
		{
			WriteGraphicsLog("AsyncCompute: compute queue unavailable, using the graphics queue\n");
			return false;
		}
		s_Queue->SetName(L"Async Compute Queue");
		for (auto& allocator : s_Allocators)
		{
			if (FAILED(device->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COMPUTE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&allocator))))
			{
				Shutdown();
				return false;
			}
		}
		if (FAILED(device->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COMPUTE, s_Allocators[0].Get(), nullptr,
				IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_List))) ||
			FAILED(s_List->Close()) ||
			FAILED(device->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Fence))))
		{
			Shutdown();
			return false;
		}
		s_List->SetName(L"Async Compute List");
		s_Event = CreateEvent(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
		s_FenceValue = 0;
		s_Available = s_Event != nullptr;
		if (s_Available) WriteGraphicsLog("AsyncCompute: dedicated compute queue ready\n");
		return s_Available;
	}

	static void Shutdown()
	{
		WaitIdle();
		s_Available = false;
		s_Recording = false;
		s_List.Reset();
		for (auto& allocator : s_Allocators) allocator.Reset();
		s_Fence.Reset();
		s_Queue.Reset();
		if (s_Event)
		{
			CloseHandle(s_Event);
			s_Event = nullptr;
		}
	}

	// Usable this frame (queue exists and the user has not disabled it).
	static bool IsActive() { return s_Available && s_Enabled; }
	static bool IsAvailable() { return s_Available; }
	static bool& Enabled() { return s_Enabled; }
	static UINT64 GetSubmittedCount() { return s_FenceValue; }

	// The slot's allocator is reused only after RenderFrame waited for that slot's graphics
	// fence, and that graphics frame waited for its compute work: the allocator is idle.
	static ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* Begin(UINT frameSlot)
	{
		if (!IsActive() || s_Recording) return nullptr;
		auto& allocator = s_Allocators[frameSlot % kFrames];
		if (FAILED(allocator->Reset()) || FAILED(s_List->Reset(allocator.Get(), nullptr))) return nullptr;
		s_Recording = true;
		return s_List.Get();
	}

	// Executes the recorded work on the compute queue and makes the graphics queue wait for it
	// on the GPU timeline. Returns false if nothing was submitted.
	static bool Submit(ID3D12CommandQueue* graphicsQueue)
	{
		if (!s_Recording) return false;
		s_Recording = false;
		if (FAILED(s_List->Close())) return false;
		ID3D12CommandList* lists[] = { s_List.Get() };
		s_Queue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, lists);
		++s_FenceValue;
		if (FAILED(s_Queue->Signal(s_Fence.Get(), s_FenceValue))) return false;
		if (graphicsQueue) graphicsQueue->Wait(s_Fence.Get(), s_FenceValue);
		return true;
	}

	static void WaitIdle()
	{
		if (!s_Fence || !s_Event || s_Fence->GetCompletedValue() >= s_FenceValue) return;
		if (SUCCEEDED(s_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(s_FenceValue, s_Event)))
			WaitForSingleObject(s_Event, INFINITE);
	}

private:
	static constexpr UINT kFrames = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12CommandQueue> s_Queue;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12CommandAllocator> s_Allocators[kFrames];
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12GraphicsCommandList> s_List;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Fence> s_Fence;
	static inline HANDLE s_Event = nullptr;
	static inline UINT64 s_FenceValue = 0;
	static inline bool s_Available = false;
	static inline bool s_Enabled = true;
	static inline bool s_Recording = false;
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\atmospherelut.h =====
#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// AtmosphereLut
//   物理スカイの LUT 化（Hillaire 2020 方式）。
//   ・Transmittance LUT（光学的厚さ, 256x64）: 惑星形状のみに依存するため初回のみ生成
//   ・MultiScattering LUT（32x32）           : 大気係数が変わった時だけ再生成（多重散乱）
//   ・SkyView LUT（192x108, 散乱 + 透過率）   : 毎フレーム（カメラ高度・太陽方向）
//   生成は AsyncCompute のキューで行い、グラフィックス側は GPU 上で完了を待つ。
//   SkyView はフレームスロットごとに 3 組持ち、前フレームの読み取りと次フレームの書き込みが
//   重ならないようにする。テクスチャは SIMULTANEOUS_ACCESS で作成し、キュー間の状態遷移は
//   暗黙の昇格／減衰（COMMON）に任せる。
//   ヘッダーのみで完結（.vcxproj への追加不要）。
// =============================================================================================
#include "pch.h"
#include "rendergraphqueueexecutor.h"
#include "envflags.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "asynccompute.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "atmosphere.h"
#include "daynightcycle.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "light.h"
#include "world.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

class AtmosphereLut final
{
public:
	struct Settings
	{
		bool Enabled = true;
		float MultipleScattering = 1.0f; // 0 = 従来と同じ単一散乱のみ
		float GroundAlbedo = 0.1f;       // 多重散乱で地表から返る光
	};

	static Settings& GetSettings() { return s_Settings; }
	static bool IsAvailable() { return s_Available; }
	static bool WasBuiltAsync() { return s_LastAsync; }

	static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* engineHeap)
	{
		Shutdown();
		if (!device || !engineHeap) return false;
		s_Device = device;
		s_EngineHeap = engineHeap;
		s_Increment = device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV);
		// The null pair is written first: the deferred lighting pass always binds this table,
		// so it must be valid even if the LUT cannot be created.
		WriteSrv(nullptr, EngineCpu(kFrames * 2));
		WriteSrv(nullptr, EngineCpu(kFrames * 2 + 1));

		CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[2];
		ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 2, 0);
		ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 3, 0);
		CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[3];
		parameters[0].InitAsConstantBufferView(0);
		parameters[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0]);
		parameters[2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1]);
		const CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC sampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
			D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP);
		const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC root(3, parameters, 1, &sampler);
		ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, errors;
		if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&root, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &blob, &errors)) ||
			FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Root))))
		{
			return Fail("root signature");
		}
		const struct { const char* Entry; ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>* Pipeline; } entries[] = {
			{ "BuildTransmittance", &s_Transmittance }, { "BuildMultiScatter", &s_MultiScatter }, { "BuildSkyView", &s_SkyView } };
		for (const auto& entry : entries)
		{
			blob.Reset(); errors.Reset();
			if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/AtmosphereLutCS.hlsl", nullptr, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
				entry.Entry, "cs_6_0", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &blob, &errors)))
			{
				WriteGraphicsLog("AtmosphereLut: %s: %s\n", entry.Entry, errors ? static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()) : "");
				return Fail("shader compile");
			}
			D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
			desc.pRootSignature = s_Root.Get();
			desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(blob.Get());
			if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(entry.Pipeline->ReleaseAndGetAddressOf()))))
				return Fail("pipeline");
		}

		if (!CreateLut(s_TransmittanceLut, 256, 64, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, L"Atmosphere Transmittance LUT") ||
			!CreateLut(s_MultiScatterLut, 32, 32, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, L"Atmosphere MultiScattering LUT"))
			return Fail("LUT textures");
		for (UINT slot = 0; slot < kFrames; ++slot)
		{
			if (!CreateLut(s_SkyScatter[slot], 192, 108, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, L"Atmosphere SkyView Scatter LUT") ||
				!CreateLut(s_SkyTransmission[slot], 192, 108, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, L"Atmosphere SkyView Transmission LUT"))
				return Fail("LUT textures");
		}

		D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC heap{};
		heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
		heap.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
		heap.NumDescriptors = kRegionSize * kRegionCount;
		if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Heap)))) return Fail("descriptor heap");
		const auto upload = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
		const auto buffer = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(256ull * kFrames);
		if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&upload, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &buffer,
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Constants)))) return Fail("constants");

		// Region 0: transmittance build, region 1: multi scattering build, region 2+slot: sky view.
		WriteRegion(0, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, s_TransmittanceLut.Get());
		WriteRegion(1, s_TransmittanceLut.Get(), nullptr, s_MultiScatterLut.Get(), nullptr, nullptr);
		for (UINT slot = 0; slot < kFrames; ++slot)
			WriteRegion(2 + slot, s_TransmittanceLut.Get(), s_MultiScatterLut.Get(), s_SkyScatter[slot].Get(), s_SkyTransmission[slot].Get(), nullptr);

		// Engine heap: (scatter, transmission) per slot, plus a null pair for "disabled".
		// Freshly created committed textures are zero (alpha 0) -> consumers fall back to the
		// analytic sky until the slot has been built once.
		for (UINT slot = 0; slot < kFrames; ++slot)
		{
			WriteSrv(s_SkyScatter[slot].Get(), EngineCpu(slot * 2));
			WriteSrv(s_SkyTransmission[slot].Get(), EngineCpu(slot * 2 + 1));
		}
		WriteSrv(nullptr, EngineCpu(kFrames * 2));
		WriteSrv(nullptr, EngineCpu(kFrames * 2 + 1));
		s_TransmittanceBuilt = false;
		s_LastSignature = 0;
		s_Available = true;
