		WriteGraphicsLog("AtmosphereLut: initialized (transmittance 256x64, multiple scattering 32x32, sky view 192x108)\n");
		return true;
	}

	static void Shutdown()
	{
		ReleaseResources();
		s_EngineHeap.Reset(); s_Device.Reset();
	}

	static void ReleaseResources()
	{
        s_GraphExecutor.reset();
		AsyncCompute::WaitIdle();
		s_Available = false;
		s_Valid = false;
		s_Root.Reset(); s_Transmittance.Reset(); s_MultiScatter.Reset(); s_SkyView.Reset();
		s_TransmittanceLut.Reset(); s_MultiScatterLut.Reset();
		for (auto& texture : s_SkyScatter) texture.Reset();
		for (auto& texture : s_SkyTransmission) texture.Reset();
		s_Heap.Reset(); s_Constants.Reset();
	}

	// Called once per frame at the start of recording (RenderFrame::BeginDraw).
	// graphicsList is the fallback when no async compute queue is active.
	static void Update(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* graphicsList, ID3D12CommandQueue* graphicsQueue, UINT frameSlot)
	{
		s_Valid = false;
		if (!s_Available || !s_Settings.Enabled) return;
		const UINT slot = frameSlot % kFrames;
		const auto& air = Atmosphere::GetParameters();
		if (!air.Enabled || !air.PhysicalSky) return;

		struct alignas(16) Constants
		{
			XMFLOAT4 SunDirection, Coefficients, Parameters;
		} constants{};
		const XMFLOAT3 sun = ResolveSkySunDirection();
		constants.SunDirection = { sun.x, sun.y, sun.z, 0.0f };
		constants.Coefficients = { (std::max)(0.0f, air.RayleighStrength), (std::max)(0.0f, air.MieStrength),
			(std::max)(0.0f, air.Density), std::clamp(air.MieG, -0.95f, 0.95f) };
		constants.Parameters = { CameraAltitude(), (std::max)(0.0f, s_Settings.MultipleScattering),
			std::clamp(s_Settings.GroundAlbedo, 0.0f, 1.0f), 0.0f };
		void* mapped = nullptr;
		const D3D12_RANGE noRead{ 0, 0 };
		if (FAILED(s_Constants->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped))) return;
		memcpy(static_cast<BYTE*>(mapped) + slot * 256, &constants, sizeof(constants));
		s_Constants->Unmap(0, nullptr);

		// Multiple scattering depends on the coefficients and the ground albedo only.
		uint64_t signature = 1469598103934665603ull;
		const float keys[] = { constants.Coefficients.x, constants.Coefficients.y, constants.Coefficients.z, constants.Parameters.z };
		for (float key : keys)
		{
			uint32_t bits; memcpy(&bits, &key, 4);
			signature = (signature ^ bits) * 1099511628211ull;
		}
		const bool buildTransmittance = !s_TransmittanceBuilt;
		const bool buildMultiScatter = buildTransmittance || signature != s_LastSignature;

        auto recordLuts=[&](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list,bool async)
        {
		ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { s_Heap.Get() };
		list->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
		list->SetComputeRootSignature(s_Root.Get());
		list->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(0, s_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + slot * 256);
		constexpr auto kRead = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
		// All LUTs are SIMULTANEOUS_ACCESS: at the start of every ExecuteCommandLists they are
		// in COMMON (decayed), so explicit transitions start from COMMON.
		if (buildTransmittance)
		{
			Barrier(list, s_TransmittanceLut.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			BindRegion(list, 0);
			list->SetPipelineState(s_Transmittance.Get());
			list->Dispatch(256 / 8, 64 / 8, 1);
			Barrier(list, s_TransmittanceLut.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead);
		}
		if (buildMultiScatter)
		{
			Barrier(list, s_MultiScatterLut.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			BindRegion(list, 1);
			list->SetPipelineState(s_MultiScatter.Get());
			list->Dispatch(32 / 8, 32 / 8, 1);
			Barrier(list, s_MultiScatterLut.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead);
		}
		D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER toWrite[] = {
			CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s_SkyScatter[slot].Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS),
			CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s_SkyTransmission[slot].Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS) };
		list->ResourceBarrier(2, toWrite);
		BindRegion(list, 2 + slot);
		list->SetPipelineState(s_SkyView.Get());
		list->Dispatch((192 + 7) / 8, (108 + 7) / 8, 1);
		// Graphics queue (fallback): make the LUT readable by pixel and compute shaders now.
		// Compute queue: leave it in UAV; it decays to COMMON when the list completes and the
		// graphics queue promotes it implicitly on first read.
		if (!async)
		{
			constexpr auto kShaderRead = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
			D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER toRead[] = {
				CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s_SkyScatter[slot].Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kShaderRead),
				CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s_SkyTransmission[slot].Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kShaderRead) };
			list->ResourceBarrier(2, toRead);
		}

        };
        static const bool graphQueue=ReadEnvironmentFlagOnce("DX12_RENDERGRAPH_ASYNC");
        if(graphQueue)
        {
            if(!s_GraphExecutor)
            {
                s_GraphExecutor=std::make_unique<RenderGraphQueueExecutor>();
                if(!s_GraphExecutor->Initialize(s_Device.Get(),graphicsQueue)){s_GraphExecutor.reset();return;}
            }
            RenderGraph graph;
            graph.AddPass("Atmosphere LUT compute",[](RenderGraph::PassBuilder&){},[&](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list){recordLuts(list,true);});
            graph.SetLastPassQueue(RenderGraph::Queue::Compute);
            if(!graph.Compile()||!s_GraphExecutor->Execute(graph,slot)){s_Valid=false;return;}
            s_TransmittanceBuilt=true;s_LastSignature=signature;s_Slot=slot;s_Valid=true;s_LastAsync=true;return;
        }
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list=AsyncCompute::Begin(slot);
        const bool async=list!=nullptr;if(!async)list=graphicsList;if(!list)return;
        recordLuts(list,async);

		if (async)
		{
			if (!AsyncCompute::Submit(graphicsQueue)) return;
		}
		else
		{
			// Restore the engine heap for the rest of the graphics frame.
			ID3D12DescriptorHeap* engine[] = { s_EngineHeap.Get() };
			graphicsList->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, engine);
		}
		s_TransmittanceBuilt = true;
		s_LastSignature = signature;
		s_Slot = slot;
		s_Valid = true;
		s_LastAsync = async;
	}

	// Descriptor table (t40/t41) for the post process root signature.
	static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GetGraphicsSrv()
	{
		if (!s_EngineHeap) return D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE{ 0 };
		return EngineGpu(s_Valid ? s_Slot * 2 : kFrames * 2);
	}

	// Writes the current sky view LUT (or null descriptors) into another shader-visible heap.
	static void WriteSrvs(ID3D12Device* device, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE scatter, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE transmission)
	{
		const bool valid = s_Valid && s_Available;
		WriteSrv(valid ? s_SkyScatter[s_Slot].Get() : nullptr, scatter, device);
		WriteSrv(valid ? s_SkyTransmission[s_Slot].Get() : nullptr, transmission, device);
	}

	// Same selection as LightingResources (SkySunDirection): the first SunComponent's physical
	// directional light, otherwise the day/night cycle direction.
	static XMFLOAT3 ResolveSkySunDirection()
	{
		const XMFLOAT4 cycle = DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection();
		XMFLOAT3 result = { cycle.x, cycle.y, cycle.z };
		const auto suns = World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>();
		if (!suns.empty())
		{
			const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(*suns.begin());
			if (light.IsActive && light.Type == LightType::Directional && light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::Physical)
				result = light.Direction;
		}
		XMVECTOR direction = XMLoadFloat3(&result);
		if (XMVectorGetX(XMVector3LengthSq(direction)) < 1e-8f) direction = XMVectorSet(0.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f);
		XMStoreFloat3(&result, XMVector3Normalize(direction));
		return result;
	}

private:
    static inline std::unique_ptr<RenderGraphQueueExecutor> s_GraphExecutor;
	static constexpr UINT kFrames = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
	static constexpr UINT kRegionSize = 5;   // t0, t1, u0, u1, u2
	static constexpr UINT kRegionCount = 2 + kFrames;

	static inline Settings s_Settings{};
	static inline bool s_Available = false, s_Valid = false, s_TransmittanceBuilt = false, s_LastAsync = false;
	static inline UINT s_Slot = 0, s_Increment = 0;
	static inline uint64_t s_LastSignature = 0;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Device> s_Device;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> s_EngineHeap, s_Heap;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> s_Root;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> s_Transmittance, s_MultiScatter, s_SkyView;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> s_TransmittanceLut, s_MultiScatterLut, s_Constants;
	static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> s_SkyScatter[kFrames], s_SkyTransmission[kFrames];

	static bool Fail(const char* what)
	{
		WriteGraphicsLog("AtmosphereLut: %s failed, using the analytic sky\n", what);
		ReleaseResources(); // keeps the engine heap so the null descriptors stay bindable
		return false;
	}

	static float CameraAltitude()
	{
		const EntityID camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
		if (camera != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(camera))
			return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(camera).Position.y;
		return 0.0f; // LightingResources falls back to (0, 0, -5)
	}

	static bool CreateLut(ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& texture, UINT width, UINT height, DXGI_FORMAT format, const wchar_t* name)
	{
		const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
		const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(format, width, height, 1, 1, 1, 0,
			D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS | D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_SIMULTANEOUS_ACCESS);
		if (FAILED(s_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON,
			nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(texture.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())))) return false;
		texture->SetName(name);
		return true;
	}

	static D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE LocalCpu(UINT index)
	{
		return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_Heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, s_Increment);
	}
	static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE LocalGpu(UINT index)
	{
		return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_Heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, s_Increment);
	}
	static D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE EngineCpu(UINT index)
	{
		return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_EngineHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
			RendererState::g_kATMOSPHERE_LUT_DESCRIPTOR_START + index, s_Increment);
	}
	static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE EngineGpu(UINT index)
	{
		return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_EngineHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
			RendererState::g_kATMOSPHERE_LUT_DESCRIPTOR_START + index, s_Increment);
	}

	static void WriteSrv(ID3D12Resource* resource, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE handle, ID3D12Device* device = nullptr)
	{
		D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
		desc.Format = resource ? resource->GetDesc().Format : DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
		desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
		desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
		desc.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
		(device ? device : s_Device.Get())->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &desc, handle);
	}

	static void WriteUav(ID3D12Resource* resource, DXGI_FORMAT nullFormat, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE handle)
	{
		D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC desc{};
		desc.Format = resource ? resource->GetDesc().Format : nullFormat;
		desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
		s_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(resource, nullptr, &desc, handle);
	}

	static void WriteRegion(UINT region, ID3D12Resource* srv0, ID3D12Resource* srv1, ID3D12Resource* uav0,
		ID3D12Resource* uav1, ID3D12Resource* uavDepth)
	{
		const UINT base = region * kRegionSize;
		D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
		desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
		desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
		desc.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
		desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT;
		s_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(srv0, &desc, LocalCpu(base + 0));
		desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
		s_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(srv1, &desc, LocalCpu(base + 1));
		WriteUav(uav0, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, LocalCpu(base + 2));
		WriteUav(uav1, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, LocalCpu(base + 3));
		WriteUav(uavDepth, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, LocalCpu(base + 4));
	}

	static void BindRegion(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list, UINT region)
	{
		list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, LocalGpu(region * kRegionSize));
		list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, LocalGpu(region * kRegionSize + 2));
	}

	static void Barrier(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list, ID3D12Resource* resource,
		D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
	{
		const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, before, after);
		list->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
	}
};


===== FILE: source\rendering\cloud\cloudrenderer.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "cloudrenderer.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include <cstddef>

namespace
{
constexpr UINT kFrames = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
static_assert(kFrames * 2 == CloudRenderer::kRtvCount);
constexpr UINT kDescriptorStart = RendererState::g_kCLOUD_DESCRIPTOR_START;
constexpr UINT kBaseSrv = kDescriptorStart;
constexpr UINT kBaseUav = kDescriptorStart + 1;
constexpr UINT kDetailSrv = kDescriptorStart + 2;
constexpr UINT kDetailUav = kDescriptorStart + 3;
constexpr UINT kFrameSrv = kDescriptorStart + 4;
constexpr D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES kRead = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;

struct LayerConstants
{
    XMFLOAT4 Layer;
    XMFLOAT4 Shape;
    XMFLOAT4 Wind;
};
static_assert(sizeof(LayerConstants) == 48);

struct alignas(16) Constants
{
    XMFLOAT4 Layer;
    XMFLOAT4 Shape;
    XMFLOAT4 Lighting;
    XMFLOAT4 Wind;
    XMUINT4 Quality;
    XMFLOAT4 Extent;
    XMFLOAT4 Trace;
    LayerConstants AdditionalLayers[CloudSettings::MaxLayers - 1];
};
static_assert(sizeof(Constants) == 256 && offsetof(Constants, Quality) == 64 && offsetof(Constants, Trace) == 96);
static_assert(offsetof(Constants, AdditionalLayers) == 112);
constexpr UINT kConstantStride = (sizeof(Constants) + 255) & ~255u;

struct FrameResources
{
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Color;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Depth;
    UINT Width = 0;
    UINT Height = 0;
};
CloudSettings g_Settings;
ComPtr<ID3D12Device> g_Device;
ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> g_Heap;
ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_DrawRoot;
ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_NoiseRoot;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_RaymarchPso;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_CompositeHdrPso;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_CompositeLdrPso;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_BasePso;
ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_DetailPso;
ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_BaseNoise;
ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_DetailNoise;
ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_Constants;
array<FrameResources, kFrames> g_Frames;
UINT8* g_Mapped = nullptr;
UINT g_Increment = 0;
UINT g_RtvIncrement = 0;
D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE g_RtvStart{};
bool g_NoiseDirty = true;
bool g_Available = false;
uint32_t g_GeneratedSeed = 0;
UINT g_GenerationCount = 0;
// Double precision offset avoids loss of frame-sized increments during long sessions.
double g_WindX = 0;
double g_WindZ = 0;

D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Cpu(UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);
}
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Gpu(UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);
}
D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Rtv(UINT frame, UINT target)
{
    return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_RtvStart, frame * 2 + target, g_RtvIncrement);
}
void Transition(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource,
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
{
    const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, before, after);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
}
bool CreateRoot(const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC& desc, ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature>& root)
{
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, errors;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&desc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &blob, &errors)))
    {
        if (errors) WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud root signature: %s\n", static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()));
        return false;
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&root)));
}
bool LoadCompute(const wchar_t* path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pso)
{
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
    if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(path, &shader))) return false;
    D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
    desc.pRootSignature = g_NoiseRoot.Get();
    desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
    return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&pso)));
}
bool LoadGraphics(const wchar_t* path, DXGI_FORMAT format, bool composite, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pso)
{
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> vertex, pixel;
    if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(L"shader/hlsl/build/postProcessVS.cso", &vertex)) ||
        FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(path, &pixel))) return false;
    D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
    desc.pRootSignature = g_DrawRoot.Get();
    desc.VS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(vertex.Get());
    desc.PS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(pixel.Get());
    desc.RasterizerState = CD3DX12_RASTERIZER_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    desc.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
    desc.BlendState = CD3DX12_BLEND_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    desc.DepthStencilState = CD3DX12_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    desc.DepthStencilState.DepthEnable = FALSE;
    desc.DepthStencilState.StencilEnable = FALSE;
    desc.SampleMask = UINT_MAX;
    desc.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
    desc.NumRenderTargets = composite ? 1 : 2;
    desc.RTVFormats[0] = format;
    if (!composite) desc.RTVFormats[1] = DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT;
    desc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    if (composite)
    {
        auto& blend = desc.BlendState.RenderTarget[0];
        blend.BlendEnable = TRUE;
        blend.SrcBlend = D3D12_BLEND_ONE;
        blend.DestBlend = D3D12_BLEND_SRC_ALPHA;
        blend.SrcBlendAlpha = D3D12_BLEND_ZERO;
        blend.DestBlendAlpha = D3D12_BLEND_ONE;
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&pso)));
}
bool CreateNoise(UINT extent, UINT srvIndex, UINT uavIndex, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource)
{
    // Prefer the compact noise format; fall back when typed R8 UAV stores are unavailable.
    DXGI_FORMAT format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT;
    D3D12_FEATURE_DATA_FORMAT_SUPPORT support{ DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM };
    if (SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CheckFeatureSupport(D3D12_FEATURE_FORMAT_SUPPORT, &support, sizeof(support))) &&
        (support.Support1 & D3D12_FORMAT_SUPPORT1_SHADER_SAMPLE) &&
        (support.Support2 & D3D12_FORMAT_SUPPORT2_UAV_TYPED_STORE)) format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex3D(format, extent, extent,
        static_cast<UINT16>(extent), 1, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
        kRead, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&resource)))) return false;
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
    srv.Format = desc.Format;
    srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE3D;
    srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    srv.Texture3D.MipLevels = 1;
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource.Get(), &srv, Cpu(srvIndex));
    D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
    uav.Format = desc.Format;
    uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE3D;
    uav.Texture3D.WSize = extent;
    g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(resource.Get(), nullptr, &uav, Cpu(uavIndex));
    WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud noise: %ux%ux%u format=%s\n", extent, extent, extent,
        format == DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM ? "R8_UNORM" : "R16_FLOAT");
    return true;
}
bool CreateTarget(UINT width, UINT height, DXGI_FORMAT format, UINT srvIndex,
    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtv, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource)
{
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(format, width, height, 1, 1, 1, 0,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET);
    if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
        kRead, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&resource)))) return false;
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
    srv.Format = format;
    srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource.Get(), &srv, Cpu(srvIndex));
    g_Device->CreateRenderTargetView(resource.Get(), nullptr, rtv);
    return true;
}
bool EnsureFrame(UINT index, UINT width, UINT height)
{
    auto& frame = g_Frames[index];
    if (frame.Color && frame.Depth && frame.Width == width && frame.Height == height) return true;
    // The renderer waited for this frame's fence before recording its command list.
    frame = {};
    if (!CreateTarget(width, height, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, kFrameSrv + index * 2,
        Rtv(index, 0), frame.Color) || !CreateTarget(width, height, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT,
        kFrameSrv + index * 2 + 1, Rtv(index, 1), frame.Depth)) return false;
    frame.Width = width;
    frame.Height = height;
    frame.Color->SetName(L"Cloud Scattering / Transmittance");
    frame.Depth->SetName(L"Cloud Scene / Weighted Depth");
    return true;
}
void DispatchNoise(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource,
    ID3D12PipelineState* pso, UINT uavIndex, UINT extent)
{
    Transition(commands, resource, kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    commands->SetPipelineState(pso);
    commands->SetComputeRootSignature(g_NoiseRoot.Get());
    commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, Gpu(uavIndex));
    const UINT constants[] = { g_Settings.Seed, extent };
    commands->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(1, 2, constants, 0);
    commands->Dispatch((extent + 3) / 4, (extent + 3) / 4, (extent + 3) / 4);
    Transition(commands, resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, kRead);
}
}

bool CloudRenderer::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap, UINT increment)
{
    Shutdown();
    if (!device || !heap || !increment) return false;
    g_Device = device;
    g_Heap = heap;
    g_Increment = increment;
    // Valid null volumes keep the deferred pipeline usable if cloud initialization fails.
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC nullVolume{};
    nullVolume.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
    nullVolume.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE3D;
    nullVolume.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    nullVolume.Texture3D.MipLevels = 1;
    device->CreateShaderResourceView(nullptr, &nullVolume, Cpu(kBaseSrv));
    device->CreateShaderResourceView(nullptr, &nullVolume, Cpu(kDetailSrv));

    // A zeroed CBV remains valid when a later cloud pipeline or noise allocation fails.
    const auto upload = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto buffer = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(kConstantStride * kFrames);
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&upload, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &buffer,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Constants)))) return false;
    const D3D12_RANGE noReads{ 0, 0 };
    if (FAILED(g_Constants->Map(0, &noReads, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_Mapped)))) return false;
    memset(g_Mapped, 0, kConstantStride * kFrames);

    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[6];
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER params[9];
    for (UINT i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
    {
        ranges[i].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 30 + i);
        params[i].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[i], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    }
    params[6].InitAsConstantBufferView(0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[7].InitAsConstantBufferView(1, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[8].InitAsConstantBufferView(9, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC sampler(3, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
        D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP);
    sampler.ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL;
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC drawDesc(9, params, 1, &sampler,
        D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT);
    if (!CreateRoot(drawDesc, g_DrawRoot)) return false;
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE noiseRange(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 1, 0);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER noiseParams[2];
    noiseParams[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &noiseRange);
    noiseParams[1].InitAsConstants(2, 0);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC noiseDesc(2, noiseParams);
    if (!CreateRoot(noiseDesc, g_NoiseRoot)) return false;
    if (!LoadCompute(L"shader/hlsl/build/GenerateCloudBaseNoiseCS.cso", g_BasePso) ||
        !LoadCompute(L"shader/hlsl/build/GenerateCloudDetailNoiseCS.cso", g_DetailPso) ||
        !LoadGraphics(L"shader/hlsl/build/CloudRaymarchPS.cso", DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, false, g_RaymarchPso) ||
        !LoadGraphics(L"shader/hlsl/build/CloudCompositePS.cso", DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, true, g_CompositeHdrPso) ||
        !LoadGraphics(L"shader/hlsl/build/CloudCompositePS.cso", DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, true, g_CompositeLdrPso) ||
        !CreateNoise(128, kBaseSrv, kBaseUav, g_BaseNoise) || !CreateNoise(32, kDetailSrv, kDetailUav, g_DetailNoise))
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud: initialization failed; rendering disabled.\n");
        return false;
    }
    g_BaseNoise->SetName(L"Periodic Cloud Base Noise");
    g_DetailNoise->SetName(L"Periodic Cloud Detail Noise");
    g_Available = true;
    return true;
}
void CloudRenderer::Shutdown()
{
    g_Available = false;
    if (g_Constants && g_Mapped) g_Constants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    g_Mapped = nullptr;
    g_Frames = {};
    g_Constants.Reset(); g_BaseNoise.Reset(); g_DetailNoise.Reset();
    g_RaymarchPso.Reset(); g_CompositeHdrPso.Reset(); g_CompositeLdrPso.Reset();
    g_BasePso.Reset(); g_DetailPso.Reset(); g_DrawRoot.Reset(); g_NoiseRoot.Reset();
    g_Device.Reset(); g_Heap.Reset();
    g_RtvStart = {};
    g_NoiseDirty = true;
    g_GenerationCount = 0;
    g_WindX = g_WindZ = 0;
}
void CloudRenderer::Resize(D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE start, UINT increment)
{
    g_Frames = {};
    g_RtvStart = start;
    g_RtvIncrement = increment;
}
CloudSettings& CloudRenderer::GetSettings() { return g_Settings; }
void CloudRenderer::GenerateNoise(uint32_t seed) { g_Settings.Seed = seed; g_NoiseDirty = true; }
bool CloudRenderer::IsAvailable() { return g_Available; }
UINT CloudRenderer::GetNoiseGenerationCount() { return g_GenerationCount; }
ID3D12Resource* CloudRenderer::GetCloudResource(UINT frame) { return g_Frames[frame % kFrames].Color.Get(); }
ID3D12Resource* CloudRenderer::GetBaseNoiseResource() { return g_BaseNoise.Get(); }

void CloudRenderer::PrepareLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex,
    UINT width, UINT height, float deltaTime)
{
    if (!g_Available || !commands) return;
    g_Settings.Validate();
    const UINT index = frameIndex % kFrames;
    const UINT cloudWidth = max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(width * g_Settings.ResolutionScale)));
    const UINT cloudHeight = max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(height * g_Settings.ResolutionScale)));
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { g_Heap.Get() };
    commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
    if (g_Settings.Enabled && (g_NoiseDirty || g_GeneratedSeed != g_Settings.Seed))
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Cloud Noise Generation", commands);
        DispatchNoise(commands, g_BaseNoise.Get(), g_BasePso.Get(), kBaseUav, 128);
        DispatchNoise(commands, g_DetailNoise.Get(), g_DetailPso.Get(), kDetailUav, 32);
        g_GeneratedSeed = g_Settings.Seed;
        g_NoiseDirty = false;
        ++g_GenerationCount;
    }
    const double length = sqrt(static_cast<double>(g_Settings.WindX) * g_Settings.WindX +
        static_cast<double>(g_Settings.WindZ) * g_Settings.WindZ);
    const double delta = isfinite(deltaTime) ? clamp(deltaTime, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0;
    if (length > 0.000001)
    {
        g_WindX += g_Settings.WindX / length * g_Settings.WindSpeed * delta;
        g_WindZ += g_Settings.WindZ / length * g_Settings.WindSpeed * delta;
    }
    Constants constants{};
    float firstCoverage = 0;
    if (g_Settings.LayerEnabled)
    {
        firstCoverage = g_Settings.Coverage;
    }
    constants.Layer = { g_Settings.BottomHeight, g_Settings.TopHeight, firstCoverage, g_Settings.Density };
    constants.Shape = { g_Settings.BaseScale, g_Settings.DetailScale, g_Settings.DetailStrength, g_Settings.Extinction };
    constants.Lighting = { g_Settings.PhaseG, g_Settings.AmbientStrength, g_Settings.PowderStrength, g_Settings.JitterStrength };
    auto wrapped = [](double offset) { return static_cast<float>(offset - floor(offset)); };
    constants.Wind = { wrapped(g_WindX * g_Settings.BaseScale), wrapped(g_WindZ * g_Settings.BaseScale),
        wrapped(g_WindX * g_Settings.DetailScale * 1.15), wrapped(g_WindZ * g_Settings.DetailScale * 1.15) };
    for (int index = 1; index < g_Settings.LayerCount; ++index)
    {
        const auto& layer = g_Settings.Layer(index);
        if (!layer.LayerEnabled)
        {
            continue;
        }
        auto& target = constants.AdditionalLayers[index - 1];
        target.Layer = { layer.BottomHeight, layer.TopHeight, layer.Coverage, layer.Density };
        target.Shape = { layer.BaseScale, layer.DetailScale, layer.DetailStrength, 0 };
        target.Wind = { wrapped(g_WindX * layer.BaseScale), wrapped(g_WindZ * layer.BaseScale),
            wrapped(g_WindX * layer.DetailScale * 1.15), wrapped(g_WindZ * layer.DetailScale * 1.15) };
    }
    constants.Quality = { static_cast<UINT>(g_Settings.ViewSteps), static_cast<UINT>(g_Settings.LightSteps),
        static_cast<UINT>(g_Settings.Debug), static_cast<UINT>(g_Settings.LayerCount) };
    constants.Extent = { static_cast<float>(width), static_cast<float>(height), static_cast<float>(cloudWidth), static_cast<float>(cloudHeight) };
    constants.Trace = { g_Settings.MaxTraceDistance, g_Settings.NoiseSlice, static_cast<float>(g_Settings.Enabled), static_cast<float>(g_Settings.CastShadows) };
    memcpy(g_Mapped + index * kConstantStride, &constants, sizeof(constants));
}

void CloudRenderer::BindLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex)
{
    if (!commands || !g_Heap) return;
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(20, Gpu(kBaseSrv));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(21, Gpu(kDetailSrv));
    if (g_Constants)
    {
        commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(22,
            g_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + (frameIndex % kFrames) * kConstantStride);
    }
}

void CloudRenderer::BindForwardLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex)
{
    if (!commands || !g_Heap || !g_Constants)
    {
        return;
    }
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(24, Gpu(kBaseSrv));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(25, Gpu(kDetailSrv));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(27,
        g_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + (frameIndex % kFrames) * kConstantStride);
}

void CloudRenderer::Render(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex, UINT width, UINT height,
    D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE depth, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE material,
    D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS camera, D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS light,
    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE sceneRtv, DXGI_FORMAT sceneFormat)
{
    if (!g_Available || !g_Settings.Enabled || !commands || !width || !height || !camera || !light || !g_RtvStart.ptr) return;
    if (sceneFormat != DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT && sceneFormat != DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) return;
    const UINT index = frameIndex % kFrames;
    const UINT cloudWidth = max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(width * g_Settings.ResolutionScale)));
    const UINT cloudHeight = max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(height * g_Settings.ResolutionScale)));
    if (!EnsureFrame(index, cloudWidth, cloudHeight)) return;
    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent total("Cloud Total", commands);
    auto& frame = g_Frames[index];
    commands->SetGraphicsRootSignature(g_DrawRoot.Get());
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, depth);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(1, Gpu(kBaseSrv));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(2, Gpu(kDetailSrv));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(3, Gpu(kFrameSrv + index * 2));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(4, Gpu(kFrameSrv + index * 2 + 1));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(5, material);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(6, camera);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(7, light);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(8, g_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + index * kConstantStride);
    commands->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Cloud Raymarch", commands);
        Transition(commands, frame.Color.Get(), kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
        Transition(commands, frame.Depth.Get(), kRead, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
        const D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE targets[] = { Rtv(index, 0), Rtv(index, 1) };
        commands->OMSetRenderTargets(2, targets, FALSE, nullptr);
        const CD3DX12_VIEWPORT viewport(0.0f, 0.0f, static_cast<float>(cloudWidth), static_cast<float>(cloudHeight));
        const CD3DX12_RECT scissor(0, 0, cloudWidth, cloudHeight);
        commands->RSSetViewports(1, &viewport);
        commands->RSSetScissorRects(1, &scissor);
        commands->SetPipelineState(g_RaymarchPso.Get());
        commands->DrawInstanced(3, 1, 0, 0);
        Transition(commands, frame.Color.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, kRead);
        Transition(commands, frame.Depth.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, kRead);
    }
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Cloud Composite", commands);
        commands->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &sceneRtv, FALSE, nullptr);
        const CD3DX12_VIEWPORT viewport(0.0f, 0.0f, static_cast<float>(width), static_cast<float>(height));
        const CD3DX12_RECT scissor(0, 0, width, height);
        commands->RSSetViewports(1, &viewport);
        commands->RSSetScissorRects(1, &scissor);
        commands->SetPipelineState(sceneFormat == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT ? g_CompositeHdrPso.Get() : g_CompositeLdrPso.Get());
        commands->DrawInstanced(3, 1, 0, 0);
    }
}

void CloudRenderer::DrawDebugUI()
{
    ImGui::Checkbox("Enable clouds", &g_Settings.Enabled);
    ImGui::Checkbox("Cloud shadows", &g_Settings.CastShadows);
    if (!g_Available) ImGui::TextUnformatted("Cloud pipelines unavailable");
    if (ImGui::TreeNodeEx("Layers", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        int removeIndex = -1;
        for (int index = 0; index < g_Settings.LayerCount; ++index)
        {
            auto& layer = g_Settings.Layer(index);
            ImGui::PushID(index);
            if (ImGui::TreeNodeEx("Layer", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen, "Layer %d", index + 1))
            {
                ImGui::Checkbox("Enabled", &layer.LayerEnabled);
                ImGui::DragFloat("Bottom Height", &layer.BottomHeight, 0.5f);
                ImGui::DragFloat("Top Height", &layer.TopHeight, 0.5f);
                ImGui::SliderFloat("Coverage", &layer.Coverage, 0, 1);
                ImGui::SliderFloat("Density", &layer.Density, 0, 10);
                ImGui::DragFloat("Base Scale", &layer.BaseScale, 0.0001f, 0.00001f, 1, "%.5f");
                ImGui::DragFloat("Detail Scale", &layer.DetailScale, 0.0001f, 0.00001f, 4, "%.5f");
                ImGui::SliderFloat("Detail Strength", &layer.DetailStrength, 0, 1);
                ImGui::BeginDisabled(g_Settings.LayerCount <= 1);
                if (ImGui::Button("Remove layer"))
                {
                    removeIndex = index;
                }
                ImGui::EndDisabled();
                ImGui::TreePop();
            }
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        if (removeIndex >= 0)
        {
            g_Settings.RemoveLayer(removeIndex);
        }
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(g_Settings.LayerCount >= CloudSettings::MaxLayers);
        if (ImGui::Button("Add layer"))
        {
            g_Settings.AddLayer();
        }
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        ImGui::TextWrapped("Height sets thickness; density sets transparency. Wind and lighting are shared.");
        ImGui::TreePop();
    }
    if (ImGui::TreeNode("Wind"))
    {
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Direction X", &g_Settings.WindX, -1, 1);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Direction Z", &g_Settings.WindZ, -1, 1);
        ImGui::DragFloat("Speed", &g_Settings.WindSpeed, 0.1f, 0, 1000);
        ImGui::TreePop();
    }
    if (ImGui::TreeNode("Lighting"))
    {
        ImGui::DragFloat("Extinction", &g_Settings.Extinction, 0.001f, 0, 10, "%.4f");
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Phase G", &g_Settings.PhaseG, -0.9f, 0.9f);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Ambient Strength", &g_Settings.AmbientStrength, 0, 10);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Powder Strength", &g_Settings.PowderStrength, 0, 2);
        ImGui::TreePop();
    }
    if (ImGui::TreeNode("Quality"))
    {
        if (ImGui::Button("Low")) g_Settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Low);
        ImGui::SameLine(); if (ImGui::Button("Medium")) g_Settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Medium);
        ImGui::SameLine(); if (ImGui::Button("High")) g_Settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::High);
        ImGui::SliderInt("View Steps", &g_Settings.ViewSteps, 1, 192);
        ImGui::SliderInt("Light Steps", &g_Settings.LightSteps, 1, 16);
        ImGui::DragFloat("Max Trace Distance", &g_Settings.MaxTraceDistance, 10, 0.1f, 100000);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Resolution Scale", &g_Settings.ResolutionScale, 0.25f, 1);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Jitter Strength", &g_Settings.JitterStrength, 0, 1);
        ImGui::TreePop();
    }
    if (ImGui::TreeNode("Noise"))
    {
        ImGui::InputScalar("Seed", ImGuiDataType_U32, &g_Settings.Seed);
        if (ImGui::Button("Regenerate")) GenerateNoise(g_Settings.Seed);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Noise Slice", &g_Settings.NoiseSlice, 0, 1);
        ImGui::Text("Generations: %u", g_GenerationCount);
        ImGui::TreePop();
    }
    int debug = static_cast<int>(g_Settings.Debug);
    if (ImGui::Combo("Debug View", &debug, "Normal\0Density\0Transmittance\0Lighting\0Cloud Depth\0Step Count\0Base Noise Slice\0Detail Noise Slice\0"))
        g_Settings.Debug = static_cast<CloudDebug>(debug);
    int preset = -1;
    if (ImGui::Combo("Layer 1 preset", &preset, "Clear\0Fair\0Cloudy\0Overcast\0Storm\0")) g_Settings.ApplyPreset(static_cast<CloudPreset>(preset));
    const auto& timing = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
    if (!timing.GpuTimingValid) ImGui::TextUnformatted("GPU timing pending");
    else for (const auto& pass : timing.Passes)
        if (pass.Name == "Cloud Raymarch" || pass.Name == "Cloud Composite" || pass.Name == "Cloud Total")
            ImGui::Text("%s: %.3f ms", pass.Name.c_str(), pass.GpuMs);
    g_Settings.Validate();
}

// Uses the renderer's camera/light buffers and descriptor heaps; owns no scene state.
class CloudRenderer
{
public:
    static constexpr UINT kRtvCount = 2 * 3;
    static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* engineHeap, UINT increment);
    static void Shutdown();
    // Called after the renderer has waited for all in-flight frames during resize.
    static void Resize(D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtvStart, UINT rtvIncrement);
    // Prepare once per frame before deferred lighting; Render reuses the same density/wind state.
    static void PrepareLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex,
        UINT width, UINT height, float deltaTime);
    static void BindLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex);
    static void BindForwardLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex);
    static void Render(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT frameIndex,
        UINT width, UINT height, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE depth, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE material,
        D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS cameraConstants, D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS lightConstants,
        D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE sceneRtv, DXGI_FORMAT sceneFormat);
    static CloudSettings& GetSettings();
    static void GenerateNoise(uint32_t seed);
    static void DrawDebugUI();
    static bool IsAvailable();
    static ID3D12Resource* GetCloudResource(UINT frameIndex);
    static ID3D12Resource* GetBaseNoiseResource();
    static UINT GetNoiseGenerationCount();
};


===== FILE: source\rendering\cloud\cloudsettings.h =====
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>

enum class CloudQuality { Low, Medium, High };
enum class CloudPreset { Clear, Fair, Cloudy, Overcast, Storm };
enum class CloudDebug { Normal, Density, Transmittance, Lighting, Depth, Steps, BaseNoise, DetailNoise };

// The inherited first layer preserves the existing settings and validation API.
struct CloudLayerSettings
{
    bool LayerEnabled = true;
    float BottomHeight = 20.0f;
    float TopHeight = 40.0f;
    float Coverage = 0.55f;
    float Density = 1.0f;
    float BaseScale = 0.006f;
    float DetailScale = 0.04f;
    float DetailStrength = 0.18f;

    void ValidateLayer()
    {
        auto bounded = [](float value, float fallback, float low, float high)
        {
            return std::clamp(std::isfinite(value) ? value : fallback, low, high);
        };
        BottomHeight = bounded(BottomHeight, 20, -10000, 10000);
        TopHeight = bounded(TopHeight, 40, BottomHeight + 0.01f, 20000);
        Coverage = bounded(Coverage, 0.55f, 0, 1);
        Density = bounded(Density, 1, 0, 10);
        BaseScale = bounded(BaseScale, 0.006f, 0.00001f, 1);
        DetailScale = bounded(DetailScale, 0.04f, 0.00001f, 4);
        DetailStrength = bounded(DetailStrength, 0.18f, 0, 1);
    }
};

struct CloudSettings : CloudLayerSettings
{
    static constexpr int MaxLayers = 4;
    int LayerCount = 1;
    CloudLayerSettings AdditionalLayers[MaxLayers - 1];
    bool Enabled = false;
    bool CastShadows = true;
    float Extinction = 0.12f;
    float PhaseG = 0.65f;
    float AmbientStrength = 0.5f;
    float PowderStrength = 0.0f;
    float JitterStrength = 1.0f;
    float WindX = 1.0f;
    float WindZ = 0.25f;
    float WindSpeed = 1.0f;
    float MaxTraceDistance = 2000.0f;
    float ResolutionScale = 0.5f;
    float NoiseSlice = 0.5f;
    int ViewSteps = 64;
    int LightSteps = 6;
    uint32_t Seed = 1337;
    CloudDebug Debug = CloudDebug::Normal;

    CloudLayerSettings& Layer(int index)
    {
        if (index == 0)
        {
            return *this;
        }
        return AdditionalLayers[index - 1];
    }

    bool AddLayer()
    {
        if (LayerCount >= MaxLayers)
        {
            return false;
        }
        const float previousTop = Layer(LayerCount - 1).TopHeight;
        auto& layer = Layer(LayerCount);
        layer = CloudLayerSettings{};
        layer.BottomHeight = previousTop + 10.0f;
        layer.TopHeight = layer.BottomHeight + 10.0f;
        ++LayerCount;
        Validate();
        return true;
    }

    bool RemoveLayer(int index)
    {
        if (LayerCount <= 1 || index < 0 || index >= LayerCount)
        {
            return false;
        }
        for (int next = index + 1; next < LayerCount; ++next)
        {
            Layer(next - 1) = Layer(next);
        }
        --LayerCount;
        Layer(LayerCount) = CloudLayerSettings{};
        return true;
    }

    void ApplyQuality(CloudQuality quality)
    {
        ViewSteps = quality == CloudQuality::Low ? 40 : quality == CloudQuality::Medium ? 64 : 96;
        LightSteps = quality == CloudQuality::Low ? 4 : quality == CloudQuality::Medium ? 6 : 8;
        ResolutionScale = 0.5f;
    }

    void ApplyPreset(CloudPreset preset)
    {
        constexpr float coverage[] = { 0.0f, 0.35f, 0.6f, 0.95f, 1.0f };
        constexpr float density[] = { 1.0f, 0.7f, 1.0f, 1.4f, 2.0f };
        const int index = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(preset), 0, 4);
        Coverage = coverage[index];
        Density = density[index];
    }

    void Validate()
    {
        auto bounded = [](float value, float fallback, float low, float high)
        {
            return std::clamp(std::isfinite(value) ? value : fallback, low, high);
        };
        LayerCount = std::clamp(LayerCount, 1, MaxLayers);
        ValidateLayer();
        for (auto& layer : AdditionalLayers)
        {
            layer.ValidateLayer();
        }
        Extinction = bounded(Extinction, 0.12f, 0, 10);
        PhaseG = bounded(PhaseG, 0.65f, -0.9f, 0.9f);
        AmbientStrength = bounded(AmbientStrength, 0.5f, 0, 10);
        PowderStrength = bounded(PowderStrength, 0, 0, 2);
        JitterStrength = bounded(JitterStrength, 1, 0, 1);
        WindX = bounded(WindX, 1, -1, 1);
        WindZ = bounded(WindZ, 0.25f, -1, 1);
        WindSpeed = bounded(WindSpeed, 1, 0, 1000);
        MaxTraceDistance = bounded(MaxTraceDistance, 2000, 0.1f, 100000);
        ResolutionScale = bounded(ResolutionScale, 0.5f, 0.25f, 1);
        NoiseSlice = bounded(NoiseSlice, 0.5f, 0, 1);
        ViewSteps = std::clamp(ViewSteps, 1, 192);
        LightSteps = std::clamp(LightSteps, 1, 16);
        Debug = static_cast<CloudDebug>(std::clamp(static_cast<int>(Debug), 0, 7));
    }
};

UINT g_Failures = 0;
UINT g_LastFrame = 0;
uint64_t g_NoiseHash = 0;
double g_InitialOpacity = 0;
double g_InitialRadiance = 0;
double g_LowerLayerOpacity = 0;
double g_UpperLayerOpacity = 0;
double g_TwoLayerOpacity = 0;
double g_ShadowedReceiverRadiance = 0;
double g_ShadowedCloudOpacity = 0;

EntityID g_UnrelatedDirectional = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;

void Check(bool condition, const char* message)
{
    WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation: %s %s\n", condition ? "PASS" : "FAIL", message);
    if (!condition) ++g_Failures;
}
uint64_t NoiseHash()
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData noise;
    if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(CloudRenderer::GetBaseNoiseResource(), noise)) return 0;
    uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
    const UINT depth = CloudRenderer::GetBaseNoiseResource()->GetDesc().DepthOrArraySize;
    const UINT bytesPerVoxel = noise.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM ? 1 : 2;
    for (UINT z = 0; z < depth; ++z)
        for (UINT y = 0; y < noise.Height; ++y)
            for (UINT x = 0; x < noise.Width * bytesPerVoxel; ++x)
            {
                hash ^= noise.Bytes[(z * noise.Height + y) * noise.RowPitch + x];
                hash *= 1099511628211ull;
            }
    return hash;
}
void ValidateSceneOcclusion(const RenderCapture::TextureData& cloud)
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData depth, material;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::DEPTH), depth) &&
        RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::MATERIAL), material);
    Check(read && depth.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT, "read scene depth for occlusion oracle");
    if (!read) return;
    XMMATRIX view, projection;
    const auto camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(camera, view, projection);
    const XMMATRIX inverse = XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view * projection);
    const auto position = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(camera).Position;
    const auto& settings = CloudRenderer::GetSettings();
    UINT tested = 0;
    bool occluded = true;
    for (UINT y = 0; y < cloud.Height; ++y)
    {
        const UINT fullY = min(depth.Height - 1, static_cast<UINT>((y + 0.5f) / cloud.Height * depth.Height));
        const auto* depthRow = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(depth.Bytes.data() + fullY * depth.RowPitch);
        const auto* materialRow = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + fullY * material.RowPitch);
        const auto* cloudRow = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
        {
            const UINT fullX = min(depth.Width - 1, static_cast<UINT>((x + 0.5f) / cloud.Width * depth.Width));
            if (RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materialRow[fullX * 4 + 3]) < -0.5f || depthRow[fullX] >= 0.999999f) continue;
            const float uvX = (x + 0.5f) / cloud.Width;
            const float uvY = (y + 0.5f) / cloud.Height;
            XMFLOAT3 world;
            XMStoreFloat3(&world, XMVector3TransformCoord(XMVectorSet(uvX * 2 - 1, 1 - uvY * 2, depthRow[fullX], 1), inverse));
            // The camera is below the cloud slab: geometry below its bottom cannot contain cloud.
            if (position.y < settings.BottomHeight && world.y < settings.BottomHeight - 0.01f)
            {
                // Raster interpolation and CPU UV division can choose adjacent full-res
                // texels at exact integer boundaries. Test interior footprints here;
                // the final HDR comparison below includes every silhouette pixel.
                bool interior = fullX > 0 && fullY > 0 && fullX + 1 < depth.Width && fullY + 1 < depth.Height;
                for (int row = -1; row <= 1 && interior; ++row)
                    for (int column = -1; column <= 1 && interior; ++column)
                    {
                        const UINT nearX = fullX + column;
                        const UINT nearY = fullY + row;
                        const auto* nearDepth = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(depth.Bytes.data() + nearY * depth.RowPitch);
                        const auto* nearMaterial = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + nearY * material.RowPitch);
                        const float ndcX = (nearX + 0.5f) / depth.Width * 2 - 1;
                        const float ndcY = 1 - (nearY + 0.5f) / depth.Height * 2;
                        const float nearWorldY = XMVectorGetY(XMVector3TransformCoord(XMVectorSet(ndcX, ndcY, nearDepth[nearX], 1), inverse));
                        interior &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(nearMaterial[nearX * 4 + 3]) >= -0.5f && nearWorldY < settings.BottomHeight - 0.1f;
                    }
                if (!interior) continue;
                ++tested;
                occluded &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(cloudRow[x * 4 + 3]) == 1;
                for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                    occluded &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(cloudRow[x * 4 + channel]) == 0;
            }
        }
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud occlusion: checked foreground pixels=%u\n", tested);
    Check(tested > 100 && occluded, "foreground geometry clips cloud ray before layer entry");
    Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), g_CloudHdr), "read final HDR composite");
    g_ForegroundMask.assign(static_cast<size_t>(depth.Width) * depth.Height, 0);
    for (UINT y = 0; y < depth.Height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* depths = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(depth.Bytes.data() + y * depth.RowPitch);
        const auto* materials = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + y * material.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 0; x < depth.Width; ++x)
        {
            if (RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materials[x * 4 + 3]) < -0.5f || depths[x] >= 0.999999f) continue;
            const float uvX = (x + 0.5f) / depth.Width;
            const float uvY = (y + 0.5f) / depth.Height;
            const float worldY = XMVectorGetY(XMVector3TransformCoord(XMVectorSet(uvX * 2 - 1, 1 - uvY * 2, depths[x], 1), inverse));
            g_ForegroundMask[y * depth.Width + x] = worldY < settings.BottomHeight - 0.01f;
        }
    }
}
void ValidateCompositeForeground()
{
    RenderCapture::TextureData clearHdr;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), clearHdr);
    const bool compatible = read && clearHdr.Width == g_CloudHdr.Width && clearHdr.Height == g_CloudHdr.Height &&
        clearHdr.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT && g_CloudHdr.Format == clearHdr.Format &&
        g_ForegroundMask.size() == static_cast<size_t>(clearHdr.Width) * clearHdr.Height &&
        !clearHdr.Bytes.empty() && !g_CloudHdr.Bytes.empty();
    Check(compatible, "read HDR reference without cloud shadows");
    if (!compatible) return;
    UINT tested = 0;
    bool attenuated = true;
    UINT shadowed = 0;
    for (UINT y = 0; y < clearHdr.Height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* actual = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(g_CloudHdr.Bytes.data() + y * g_CloudHdr.RowPitch);
        const auto* reference = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(clearHdr.Bytes.data() + y * clearHdr.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 0; x < clearHdr.Width; ++x)
            if (g_ForegroundMask[y * clearHdr.Width + x])
            {
                ++tested;
                for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                {
                    const float lit = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(reference[x * 4 + channel]);
                    const float shaded = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(actual[x * 4 + channel]);
                    attenuated &= shaded <= lit + 0.002f;
                    if (lit - shaded > 0.005f) ++shadowed;
                }
            }
    }
    Check(tested > 100 && attenuated, "cloud shadow only attenuates foreground illumination");
    Check(shadowed > 100, "clouds cast measurable shadows on foreground receivers");
}
}
bool CloudValidation::Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_CLOUD_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
}
void CloudValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    g_LastFrame = static_cast<UINT>(frame);
    g_RecordedFrameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    if (frame == 52) RenderConfiguration::Resize(1920, 1080);
    if (frame == 64) RenderConfiguration::Resize(1200, 600);
    if (frame == 84) RenderConfiguration::Resize(1920, 1080);
    // Resize may select a new swap-chain index.
    g_RecordedFrameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    RenderConfiguration::SetHdr(true);
    RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
    RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(frame >= 76 && frame < 80 ? 0.67f : 1.0f);
    Raytracing::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
    RendererState::m_AntiAliasingMode = AntiAliasingMode::NONE;
    auto& settings = CloudRenderer::GetSettings();
    settings = CloudSettings{};
    settings.Enabled = true;
    settings.WindSpeed = 0;
    settings.Coverage = 0.55f;
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        for (auto id : World::GetView<MeshComponent>())
        {
            if (ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(id).IsEnvironment) continue;
            auto& tower = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(id);
            tower.Position = { 0, 18, 30 };
            tower.Scale = { 6, 35, 6 };
            tower.IsDirty = true;
        }
    }
    const auto camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(camera);
    auto& view = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(camera);
    transform.Position = { 0, 3, -8 };
    view.Target = { 0, 12, 40 };
    view.AllowUserControl = false;
    transform.IsDirty = true;
    // The selected solar light drives daylight; a shared virtual moon lights night.
    for (auto id : World::GetView<LightComponent>())
    {
        auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id);
        light.IsActive = true;
        light.Intensity = frame >= 44 && frame < 48 ? 0.0f : frame >= 48 && frame < 52 ? 100.0f : 3.0f;
        light.Color = { 1, 0.9f, 0.75f, 1 };
        auto& sun = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(id);
        sun.Position = frame >= 48 && frame < 52 ? XMFLOAT3{ 0, 1, -8 } : XMFLOAT3{ 0, 8, -8 };
        sun.IsDirty = true;
    }
    const UINT scenario = static_cast<UINT>(frame / 4);
    switch (scenario)
    {
    case 1: settings.Coverage = 0; break;
    case 2: settings.Density = 0; break;
    case 3: transform.Position.y = 30; view.Target.y = 31; break;
    case 4: transform.Position.y = 60; view.Target.y = 0; break;
    case 5: view.Target.y = transform.Position.y; break;
    case 6: transform.Position.y = 30; view.Target.y = 30; break;
    case 7: view.Target = { 0.001f, 50, -8 }; break;
    case 8: view.Target = { 0.001f, -50, -8 }; break;
    case 9: settings.TopHeight = settings.BottomHeight + 0.01f; break;
    case 10: settings.TopHeight = 400; settings.Density = 10; settings.Coverage = 1; break;
    case 13: settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Low); break;
    case 14: settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Medium); break;
    case 15: settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::High); break;
    case 16: settings.ResolutionScale = 1; break;
    case 17: settings.Seed = 1338; break;
    case 20: settings.WindSpeed = 1000; break;
    default: break;
    }
    if (frame == 72) CloudRenderer::GenerateNoise(1337);
    if (frame >= 84 && frame < 144) settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Low);
    if (frame >= 204 && frame < 264) settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::High);
    if (frame >= 264 && frame < 292) settings.Debug = static_cast<CloudDebug>(1 + (frame - 264) / 4);
    if (frame >= 292)
    {
        settings.Debug = CloudDebug::Normal;
        settings.CastShadows = frame < 296;
        if (frame == 300)
        {
            Light::CreateDesc desc;
            desc.Name = "Cloud unrelated directional regression";
            desc.Direction = { 0, 1, 0 };
            desc.Color = { 1, 0, 1, 1 };
            desc.Intensity = 100;
            desc.Priority = 100;
            g_UnrelatedDirectional = Light::Create(desc);
        }
        if (Registry::IsAlive(g_UnrelatedDirectional))
        {
            auto& unrelated = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_UnrelatedDirectional);
            unrelated.Intensity = 100;
            unrelated.Color = { 1, 0, 1, 1 };
        }
        if (frame >= 304)
            for (auto id : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
                ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id).IsActive = false;
    }
    if (frame >= 316)
    {
        // Keep these views deterministic and independent of the celestial-lighting cases.
        DayNightCycle::GetSettings().AutomaticLighting = false;
        DayNightCycle::GetSettings().TimeDriven = false;
        for (auto id : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id).IsActive = true;
        }
        if (Registry::IsAlive(g_UnrelatedDirectional))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_UnrelatedDirectional).IsActive = false;
        }
        settings.LayerCount = 2;
        settings.BottomHeight = 10;
        settings.TopHeight = 30;
        settings.Coverage = 1;
        settings.Density = 0.6f;
        settings.DetailStrength = 0;
        settings.JitterStrength = 0;
        auto& upper = settings.Layer(1);
        upper.BottomHeight = 40;
        upper.TopHeight = 50;
        upper.Coverage = 1;
        upper.Density = 0.4f;
        upper.DetailStrength = 0;
        view.Target = { 0.001f, 100, -8 };
        const UINT layerScenario = static_cast<UINT>((frame - 316) / 4);
        if (layerScenario == 0)
        {
            upper.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 1)
        {
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 3)
        {
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
            upper.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 4)
        {
            transform.Position.y = 35;
            view.Target = { 0, 35, 40 };
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 5)
        {
            transform.Position.y = 60;
            view.Target = { 0.001f, 0, -8 };
            // Reverse height order to exercise sorting for downward rays.
            std::swap(settings.Layer(0), settings.Layer(1));
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 6)
        {
            upper.TopHeight = upper.BottomHeight + 0.01f;
            upper.Density = 10;
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 7)
        {
            settings.LayerCount = 4;
            settings.Layer(2) = upper;
            settings.Layer(2).BottomHeight = 20;
            settings.Layer(2).TopHeight = 45;
            settings.Layer(3) = upper;
            settings.Layer(3).BottomHeight = 70;
            settings.Layer(3).TopHeight = 80;
        }
        else if (layerScenario >= 8)
        {
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
            upper.Density = 4;
            settings.Extinction = 0.3f;
            settings.CastShadows = layerScenario == 8;
            view.Target = { 0, 12, 40 };
        }
    }
    if (frame == 0) Check(CloudRenderer::IsAvailable(), "cloud pipelines initialize");
    if (frame >= 308 && frame < 316)
    {
        auto& cycle = DayNightCycle::GetSettings();
        cycle.Running = false;
        cycle.AutomaticLighting = true;
        for (auto id : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id).IsActive = true;
        if (Registry::IsAlive(g_UnrelatedDirectional))
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_UnrelatedDirectional).IsActive = false;
        DayNightCycle::SetTime(frame < 312 ? 17.15f : 0.0f);
        const auto direction = DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection();
        const float sign = frame < 312 ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
        view.Target = { transform.Position.x + direction.x * sign * 100,
            transform.Position.y + (max)(direction.y * sign, 0.15f) * 100,
            transform.Position.z + direction.z * sign * 100 };
    }
    g_Configurations.push_back({ static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetWidth() * settings.ResolutionScale)),
        static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetHeight() * settings.ResolutionScale)), settings.ViewSteps, settings.LightSteps });
}
void CloudValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (auto* rendered = CloudRenderer::GetCloudResource(g_RecordedFrameIndex))
    {
        const auto desc = rendered->GetDesc();
        g_Configurations.back().Width = static_cast<UINT>(desc.Width);
        g_Configurations.back().Height = desc.Height;
    }
    const auto& timing = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
    if (timing.Serial && timing.Serial != g_LastTimingSerial && timing.Serial <= g_Configurations.size())
    {
        g_LastTimingSerial = timing.Serial;
        const auto& config = g_Configurations[timing.Serial - 1];
        for (const auto& pass : timing.Passes)
            if (pass.Name == "Cloud Total" || pass.Name == "Cloud Raymarch" || pass.Name == "Cloud Composite")
            {
                g_SawGpuTiming |= pass.GpuMs > 0;
                WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud profiling: serial=%llu %s %.3f ms resolution=%ux%u steps=%d/%d\n",
                    timing.Serial, pass.Name.c_str(), pass.GpuMs, config.Width, config.Height, config.ViewSteps, config.LightSteps);
                if (timing.Serial >= 85 && timing.Serial <= 264 && config.Width == 960 && config.Height == 540 && pass.Name == "Cloud Total" && pass.GpuMs > 0)
                {
                    const uint64_t benchmarkFrame = timing.Serial - 85;
                    const UINT quality = static_cast<UINT>(benchmarkFrame / 60);
                    if (benchmarkFrame % 60 >= 10) g_BenchmarkMs[quality].push_back(pass.GpuMs);
                }
            }
    }
    if (frame >= 84 && frame < 264) return;
    if (frame % 4 != 3) return;
    RenderCapture::TextureData cloud;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(CloudRenderer::GetCloudResource(g_RecordedFrameIndex), cloud);
    Check(read && cloud.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, "read scattering/transmittance buffer");
    if (!read) return;
    const auto& settings = CloudRenderer::GetSettings();
    Check(cloud.Width == max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth() * settings.ResolutionScale))) &&
        cloud.Height == max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight() * settings.ResolutionScale))),
        "cloud extent follows scene resize and resolution scale");
    bool valid = true;
    double opacity = 0;
    double radiance = 0;
    for (UINT y = 0; y < cloud.Height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
        {
            for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 4; ++channel)
            {
                const float value = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + channel]);
                valid &= isfinite(value) && value >= 0;
                if (channel == 3) { valid &= value <= 1; opacity += 1 - value; }
                else radiance += value;
            }
        }
    }
    Check(valid, "finite nonnegative scattering and transmittance in [0,1]");
    if (frame >= 316)
    {
        const UINT layerScenario = static_cast<UINT>((frame - 316) / 4);
        if (layerScenario == 0)
        {
            g_LowerLayerOpacity = opacity;
            Check(opacity > 1, "lower layer remains visible with upper layer disabled");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 1)
        {
            g_UpperLayerOpacity = opacity;
            Check(opacity > 1, "upper layer renders independently with lower layer disabled");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 2)
        {
            g_TwoLayerOpacity = opacity;
            Check(opacity > g_LowerLayerOpacity && opacity > g_UpperLayerOpacity,
                "two separated layers both contribute optical depth");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 3)
        {
            Check(opacity == 0 && radiance == 0, "all disabled layers transmit scene exactly");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 4)
        {
            bool clearGap = true;
            for (UINT y = cloud.Height / 2 - 1; y <= cloud.Height / 2; ++y)
            {
                const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
                for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
                {
                    clearGap &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + 3]) == 1;
                }
            }
            Check(clearGap, "horizontal rays in gap between layers stay clear");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 5)
        {
            Check(opacity > 1, "unsorted layers render from above");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 6)
        {
            Check(opacity > 0, "isolated extremely thin upper layer is sampled");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 7)
        {
            Check(opacity > g_TwoLayerOpacity, "four layers including overlaps contribute density");
        }
        if (layerScenario >= 8)
        {
            RenderCapture::TextureData scene;
            RenderCapture::TextureData material;
            const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), scene) &&
                RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::MATERIAL), material);
            const bool compatible = read && scene.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
                material.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
                scene.Width == material.Width && scene.Height == material.Height;
            Check(compatible, "read HDR surface receivers for upper-layer shadow comparison");
            double receiverRadiance = 0;
            if (compatible)
            {
                for (UINT y = 0; y < scene.Height; ++y)
                {
                    const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(scene.Bytes.data() + y * scene.RowPitch);
                    const auto* materials = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + y * material.RowPitch);
                    for (UINT x = 0; x < scene.Width; ++x)
                    {
                        if (RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materials[x * 4 + 3]) < -0.5f)
                        {
                            continue;
                        }
                        for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                        {
                            receiverRadiance += RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + channel]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (layerScenario == 8)
            {
                g_ShadowedReceiverRadiance = receiverRadiance;
                g_ShadowedCloudOpacity = opacity;
            }
            else
            {
                Check(receiverRadiance > g_ShadowedReceiverRadiance + 0.01,
                    "upper layer alone casts shadows on surface receivers");
                Check(opacity == g_ShadowedCloudOpacity,
                    "upper-layer shadow toggle preserves cloud optical depth");
            }
        }
        if (layerScenario == 2 || layerScenario == 5 || layerScenario == 7)
        {
            wchar_t path[128]{};
            swprintf_s(path, L"bin/validation/cloud-layers-%u.png", layerScenario);
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(path), "capture layered clouds");
        }
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 308)
    {
        Check(opacity > 1 && radiance > 0, "celestial lighting produces visible cloud scattering");
        if (frame == 311 || frame == 315)
        {
            const wchar_t* path = frame == 311 ? L"bin/validation/cloud-sunset.png" : L"bin/validation/cloud-moon.png";
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(path), "capture sunset or moonlit clouds");
        }
        if (frame == 315)
            Check(DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection().y < 0, "moonlit clouds render with sun below horizon");
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 292)
    {
        if (frame == 295)
        {
            g_ConnectedSunCloud = cloud;
            g_ConnectedSunRadiance = radiance;
            ValidateSceneOcclusion(cloud);
        }
        if (frame == 299 || frame == 303)
        {
            bool identical = cloud.Width == g_ConnectedSunCloud.Width && cloud.Height == g_ConnectedSunCloud.Height;
            if (identical)
                for (UINT y = 0; y < cloud.Height; ++y)
                    identical &= memcmp(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch,
                        g_ConnectedSunCloud.Bytes.data() + y * g_ConnectedSunCloud.RowPitch, cloud.Width * 8) == 0;
            Check(identical, frame == 299 ? "shadow toggle preserves cloud scattering" :
                "bright unrelated directional light does not replace the virtual sun");
            if (frame == 299) ValidateCompositeForeground();
        }
        if (frame == 307)
            Check(radiance < g_ConnectedSunRadiance, "inactive sun removes direct cloud scattering despite unrelated light");
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 264)
    {
        Check(settings.Debug != CloudDebug::Normal, "runtime diagnostic view renders without shader recompile");
        return;
    }
    const UINT scenario = static_cast<UINT>(frame / 4);
    if (scenario == 0)
    {
        Check(opacity > 1 && radiance > 0, "volume is visible and lit");
        g_InitialOpacity = opacity;
        g_InitialRadiance = radiance;
        ValidateSceneOcclusion(cloud);
        g_NoiseHash = NoiseHash();
        Check(g_NoiseHash != 0, "GPU base noise readback");
    }
    if (scenario == 1 || scenario == 2 || scenario == 8)
        Check(opacity == 0 && radiance == 0, "clear/zero-density/nonintersecting rays transmit scene exactly");
    if (scenario == 1) ValidateCompositeForeground();
    if (scenario == 11) Check(radiance < g_InitialRadiance, "zero sun intensity reduces cloud scattering");
    if (scenario == 5)
    {
        bool horizontalClear = true;
        for (UINT y = cloud.Height / 2 - 1; y <= cloud.Height / 2; ++y)
        {
            const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
            for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
                horizontalClear &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + 3]) == 1;
        }
        Check(horizontalClear, "horizontal rays below layer remain clear");
    }
    if (scenario == 17) Check(NoiseHash() != g_NoiseHash, "different seed changes GPU noise");
    if (scenario == 18)
    {
        Check(NoiseHash() == g_NoiseHash, "same seed regenerates identical GPU noise");
        Check(abs(opacity - g_InitialOpacity) < 0.01, "returning camera and seed restores world-space cloud");
        Check(CloudRenderer::GetNoiseGenerationCount() == 3, "noise generated only at startup and seed changes");
    }
    if (scenario == 0 || scenario == 3 || scenario == 4 || scenario == 6 || scenario == 20)
    {
        wchar_t path[128]{};
        swprintf_s(path, L"bin/validation/cloud-%02u.png", scenario);
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(path), "capture cloud scenario");
    }
}
bool CloudValidation::Finish()
{
    Check(g_LastFrame >= 355, "complete cloud validation including four-layer clouds");
    Check(g_SawGpuTiming, "cloud GPU timestamps available");
    const char* qualityNames[] = { "Low", "Medium", "High" };
    array<double, 3> medians{};
    for (UINT quality = 0; quality < 3; ++quality)
    {
        auto& samples = g_BenchmarkMs[quality];
        Check(samples.size() >= 30, "warmed 1920x1080 GPU samples for quality preset");
        if (samples.empty()) continue;
        sort(samples.begin(), samples.end());
        medians[quality] = samples[samples.size() / 2];
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud benchmark: 1920x1080 %s samples=%zu median=%.3f ms p95=%.3f ms\n",
            qualityNames[quality], samples.size(), medians[quality],
            samples[static_cast<size_t>((samples.size() - 1) * 0.95)]);
    }
    Check(medians[0] < medians[1] && medians[1] < medians[2], "quality presets change measured GPU load");
    g_Failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
    ComPtr<ID3D12InfoQueue> info;
    if (SUCCEEDED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&info))))
    {
        UINT warnings = 0;
        UINT legacyWarnings = 0;
        UINT trackingLimitations = 0;
        for (UINT64 index = 0; index < info->GetNumStoredMessagesAllowedByRetrievalFilter(); ++index)
        {
            SIZE_T bytes = 0;
            info->GetMessage(index, nullptr, &bytes);
            vector<BYTE> storage(bytes);
            auto* message = reinterpret_cast<D3D12_MESSAGE*>(storage.data());
            if (SUCCEEDED(info->GetMessage(index, message, &bytes)) && message->Severity == D3D12_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_WARNING)
            {
                // Reproduced with clouds disabled in the existing Sun Lighting test.
                // Report separately: existing indirect VB/IB/root updates limit GBV.
                if (message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_GPU_BASED_VALIDATION_RESOURCE_STATE_IMPRECISE)
                {
                    ++trackingLimitations;
                    continue;
                }
                // Existing readback helpers use COPY_DEST on readback buffers, and
                // legacy scene passes clear with values different from optimized clears.
                // Cloud passes neither create those buffers nor issue clears.
                if (message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_CREATERESOURCE_STATE_IGNORED ||
                    message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_CLEARRENDERTARGETVIEW_MISMATCHINGCLEARVALUE)
                {
                    ++legacyWarnings;
                    continue;
                }
                ++warnings;
                WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation D3D12 warning id=%u: %s\n", static_cast<UINT>(message->ID), message->pDescription);
            }
        }
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation: existing readback/scene-clear warnings = %u\n", legacyWarnings);
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation: existing GBV tracking limitations = %u\n", trackingLimitations);
        Check(warnings == 0, "no additional D3D12 resource/descriptor/barrier warnings");
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: cloud failures = %u\n", g_Failures);
    return g_Failures == 0;
}

#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

class CloudValidation
{
public:
    static bool Enabled();
    static void BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame);
    static void AfterFrame(uint64_t frame);
    static bool Finish();
