===== FILE: source\rendering\gpudriven\indirectcommand.h =====
#pragma once
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <stdexcept>

struct GPUIndirectDrawCommand
{
    uint32_t InstanceID;
    D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS Draw;
};
static_assert(sizeof(GPUIndirectDrawCommand) == 24);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUIndirectDrawCommand, Draw) == 4);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUIndirectDrawCommand, Draw.BaseVertexLocation) == 16);

// Separate from the Phase 2 mesh record: existing geometry addresses remain valid.
struct GPUDrivenGeometryData
{
    uint32_t StartIndex = 0;
    uint32_t IndexCount = 0;
    int32_t BaseVertex = 0;
    uint32_t Ready = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(GPUDrivenGeometryData) == 16);

inline uint32_t GpuDrivenCapacity(uint32_t current, uint32_t required)
{
    uint32_t capacity = current > 1024 ? current : 1024;
    while (capacity < required)
    {
        if (capacity > UINT32_MAX / 2)
            throw overflow_error("GPU driven capacity overflow");
        capacity *= 2;
    }
    return capacity;
}

inline GPUDrivenGeometryData ReserveGpuDrivenGeometry(uint64_t vertices, uint64_t indices,
                                                      uint32_t vertexCount, uint32_t indexCount)
{
    // IA view byte sizes are UINT; vertex format is the existing 48-byte StaticModelVertex.
    if ((vertices + vertexCount) * 48 > UINT32_MAX || (indices + indexCount) * 4 > UINT32_MAX ||
        vertices + vertexCount > INT32_MAX || indices + indexCount > UINT32_MAX)
        throw overflow_error("GPU driven geometry arena exceeds IA limits");
    return {static_cast<uint32_t>(indices), indexCount, static_cast<int32_t>(vertices), 1};
}


===== FILE: source\rendering\gpudrivenindirect.h =====
#pragma once
#include "gpuscene/gpuscene.h"
#include "gpuscene/gpuscenevalidation.h"

#include "pch.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "shaderpipelines.h"
#include "animationmodel.h"
#include "staticmodel.h"
#include "occlusionculling.h"
#include "renderersettings.h"
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>
#include "shaderdescription.h"


class GpuDrivenIndirectDrawCache
{
private:
    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_CULL_DISPATCHES_PER_FRAME = 16384;
    struct ShadowCommand
    {
        D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW VertexBuffer{};
        D3D12_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW IndexBuffer{};
        D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS Draw{};
    };

    struct VelocityCommand
    {
        D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW CurrentVertexBuffer{};
        D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW PreviousVertexBuffer{};
        D3D12_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW IndexBuffer{};
        D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS Draw{};
    };

    struct alignas(256) CullConstants
    {
        XMFLOAT4X4 World{};
        XMFLOAT4X4 ViewProjection{};
        XMFLOAT4 LocalCenter{};
        XMFLOAT4 LocalExtents{};
        UINT CommandStrideBytes = 0;
        UINT CandidateCount = 0;
        UINT EnableFrustumCulling = 0;
		UINT Phase = 0;
		UINT EnableOcclusion = 0;
		UINT HiZWidth = 0;
		UINT HiZHeight = 0;
		UINT HiZMipCount = 0;
		UINT PreviousHiZValid = 0;
		UINT CurrentHiZValid = 0;
		UINT SceneInstanceId = InvalidGPUInstanceID;
        UINT Padding[13]{};
    };
    static_assert(sizeof(CullConstants) == 256);

    struct IndirectBatch
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> CandidateBuffer{};
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> VisibleBuffer{};
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> CountBuffer{};
        UINT CommandCount = 0;
        UINT SourceMeshCount = 0;
        UINT CommandStride = 0;
		bool Initialized = false;
    };

    struct PrimaryBatch
    {
        struct Group
        {
            int TextureIndex = -1;
            IndirectBatch Commands{};
        };
        vector<Group> Groups{};
        UINT SourceMeshCount = 0;
    };

    ComPtr<ID3D12CommandSignature> m_ShadowSignature{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12CommandSignature> m_VelocitySignature{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> m_CullRootSignature{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> m_CullPipelineState{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> m_ZeroCounterUpload{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> m_CullConstantsUpload{};
    UINT8* m_MappedCullConstants = nullptr;
    UINT m_CullConstantFrameIndex = UINT_MAX;
    UINT m_CullConstantCursor = 0;
    bool m_InitializationAttempted = false;

    unordered_map<const AnimationModelResource*, IndirectBatch> m_AnimatedShadowBatches{};
    unordered_map<const StaticModelResource*, IndirectBatch> m_StaticShadowBatches{};
    unordered_map<const AnimationModelResource*, IndirectBatch> m_AnimatedVelocityBatches{};
    unordered_map<const StaticModelResource*, IndirectBatch> m_StaticVelocityBatches{};
    unordered_map<const AnimationModelResource*, PrimaryBatch> m_AnimatedPrimaryBatches{};
    unordered_map<const StaticModelResource*, PrimaryBatch> m_StaticPrimaryBatches{};

    static D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS MakeDrawArguments(UINT indexCount)
    {
        D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS draw{};
        draw.IndexCountPerInstance = indexCount;
        draw.InstanceCount = 1;
        return draw;
    }

    static bool CreateUploadBuffer(const void* data, UINT64 sizeInBytes, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& output)
    {
        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device || sizeInBytes == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(sizeInBytes);
        HRESULT result = device->CreateCommittedResource(
            &heap,
            D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
            &description,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ,
            nullptr,
            IID_PPV_ARGS(&output));
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (data)
        {
            void* mapped = nullptr;
            const D3D12_RANGE noRead{ 0, 0 };
            result = output->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped);
            if (FAILED(result) || !mapped)
            {
                output.Reset();
                return false;
            }
            memcpy(mapped, data, static_cast<size_t>(sizeInBytes));
            output->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        }
        return true;
    }

    static bool CreateUavBuffer(UINT64 sizeInBytes, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& output)
    {
        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device || sizeInBytes == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(
            sizeInBytes,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateCommittedResource(
            &heap,
            D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
            &description,
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON,
            nullptr,
            IID_PPV_ARGS(&output)));
    }

    bool CreateCullPipeline()
    {
        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device)
        {
            return false;
        }

		CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE hiZRanges[2]{};
		hiZRanges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);
		hiZRanges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 2);
		CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[7]{};
        parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0, 0);
        parameters[1].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0, 0);
        parameters[2].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(1, 0);
		parameters[3].InitAsConstantBufferView(0, 0);
		parameters[4].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &hiZRanges[0]);
		parameters[5].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &hiZRanges[1]);
        parameters[6].InitAsShaderResourceView(3, 0);
		CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC hiZSampler(
			0,
			D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_POINT,
			D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
			D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
			D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP);

        CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootDescription{};
		rootDescription.Init(_countof(parameters), parameters, 1, &hiZSampler, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);

        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
        HRESULT result = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(
            &rootDescription,
            D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1,
            &serialized,
            &errors);
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            if (errors)
            {
                Debug::Log("%s\n", static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()));
            }
            return false;
        }

        result = device->CreateRootSignature(
            0,
            serialized->GetBufferPointer(),
            serialized->GetBufferSize(),
            IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_CullRootSignature));
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            return false;
        }

        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> computeShader;
        ShaderDescription shaderResource{};
        shaderResource.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/GpuDrivenCullCS.cso";
        shaderResource.ppBlob = computeShader.GetAddressOf();
        if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shaderResource))
        {
            Debug::Log("GPU culling shader load failed: %s\n", shaderResource.csoPath);
            return false;
        }

        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipelineDescription{};
        pipelineDescription.pRootSignature = m_CullRootSignature.Get();
        pipelineDescription.CS = {
            computeShader->GetBufferPointer(),
            computeShader->GetBufferSize()
        };
        if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(
            &pipelineDescription,
            IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_CullPipelineState))))
        {
            return false;
        }

        const UINT zero = 0;
        if (!CreateUploadBuffer(&zero, sizeof(zero), m_ZeroCounterUpload))
        {
            return false;
        }

        const UINT64 constantsSize =
            static_cast<UINT64>(RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT) *
            g_kMAX_CULL_DISPATCHES_PER_FRAME * sizeof(CullConstants);
        if (!CreateUploadBuffer(nullptr, constantsSize, m_CullConstantsUpload))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const D3D12_RANGE noRead{ 0, 0 };
        return SUCCEEDED(m_CullConstantsUpload->Map(
            0,
            &noRead,
            reinterpret_cast<void**>(&m_MappedCullConstants)));
    }

    bool EnsureInitialized()
    {
        if (m_ShadowSignature && m_VelocitySignature && m_CullPipelineState)
        {
            return true;
        }
        if (m_InitializationAttempted)
        {
            return false;
        }
        m_InitializationAttempted = true;

        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device || !CreateCullPipeline())
        {
            return false;
        }

        D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_DESC shadowArguments[3]{};
        shadowArguments[0].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        shadowArguments[0].VertexBuffer.Slot = 0;
        shadowArguments[1].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        shadowArguments[2].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_DRAW_INDEXED;
        D3D12_COMMAND_SIGNATURE_DESC shadowDescription{};
        shadowDescription.ByteStride = sizeof(ShadowCommand);
        shadowDescription.NumArgumentDescs = _countof(shadowArguments);
        shadowDescription.pArgumentDescs = shadowArguments;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommandSignature(
            &shadowDescription,
            nullptr,
            IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_ShadowSignature))))
        {
            return false;
        }

        D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_DESC velocityArguments[4]{};
        velocityArguments[0].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        velocityArguments[0].VertexBuffer.Slot = 0;
        velocityArguments[1].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        velocityArguments[1].VertexBuffer.Slot = 1;
        velocityArguments[2].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        velocityArguments[3].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_DRAW_INDEXED;
        D3D12_COMMAND_SIGNATURE_DESC velocityDescription{};
        velocityDescription.ByteStride = sizeof(VelocityCommand);
        velocityDescription.NumArgumentDescs = _countof(velocityArguments);
        velocityDescription.pArgumentDescs = velocityArguments;
        return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateCommandSignature(
            &velocityDescription,
            nullptr,
            IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_VelocitySignature)));
    }

    template<typename Command>
    static bool FinalizeBatch(const vector<Command>& commands, UINT sourceMeshCount, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        if (commands.empty())
        {
            return false;
        }

        const UINT64 byteSize = static_cast<UINT64>(commands.size()) * sizeof(Command);
        batch = {};
        batch.CommandCount = static_cast<UINT>(commands.size());
        batch.SourceMeshCount = sourceMeshCount;
        batch.CommandStride = sizeof(Command);
        return CreateUploadBuffer(commands.data(), byteSize, batch.CandidateBuffer) &&
            CreateUavBuffer(byteSize, batch.VisibleBuffer) &&
            CreateUavBuffer(sizeof(UINT), batch.CountBuffer);
    }

    static bool BuildAnimatedShadowBatch(const AnimationModelResource* model, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        vector<ShadowCommand> commands;
        commands.reserve(model->GetMeshCount());
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const MeshData& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (mesh.VertexBuffer && mesh.IndexBuffer && mesh.IndexCount > 0)
            {
                commands.push_back({ mesh.VertexBufferView, mesh.IndexBufferView, MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount) });
            }
        }
        return FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), batch);
    }

    static bool BuildStaticShadowBatch(const StaticModelResource* model, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        vector<ShadowCommand> commands;
        commands.reserve(model->GetMeshCount());
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const StaticMeshData& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (mesh.VertexBuffer && mesh.IndexBuffer && mesh.IndexCount > 0)
            {
                commands.push_back({ mesh.VertexBufferView, mesh.IndexBufferView, MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount) });
            }
        }
        return FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), batch);
    }

    static bool BuildAnimatedVelocityBatch(const AnimationModelResource* model, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        vector<VelocityCommand> commands;
        commands.reserve(model->GetMeshCount());
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const MeshData& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (mesh.VertexBuffer && mesh.PreviousVertexBuffer && mesh.IndexBuffer &&
                mesh.PreviousVertexValid && mesh.IndexCount > 0)
            {
                commands.push_back({
                    mesh.VertexBufferView,
                    mesh.PreviousVertexBufferView,
                    mesh.IndexBufferView,
                    MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount)
                    });
            }
        }
        return FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), batch);
    }

    static bool BuildStaticVelocityBatch(const StaticModelResource* model, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        vector<VelocityCommand> commands;
        commands.reserve(model->GetMeshCount());
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const StaticMeshData& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (mesh.VertexBuffer && mesh.IndexBuffer && mesh.IndexCount > 0)
            {
                commands.push_back({
                    mesh.VertexBufferView,
                    mesh.VertexBufferView,
                    mesh.IndexBufferView,
                    MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount)
                    });
            }
        }
        return FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), batch);
    }

    template<typename Model, typename Mesh>
    static bool BuildPrimaryBatch(const Model* model, PrimaryBatch& batch)
    {
        batch = {};
        batch.SourceMeshCount = model->GetMeshCount();
        vector<pair<int, vector<ShadowCommand>>> groupedCommands;
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const Mesh& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (!mesh.VertexBuffer || !mesh.IndexBuffer || mesh.IndexCount == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            auto group = find_if(
                groupedCommands.begin(),
                groupedCommands.end(),
                [&](const auto& candidate) { return candidate.first == mesh.TextureIndex; });
            if (group == groupedCommands.end())
            {
                groupedCommands.emplace_back(mesh.TextureIndex, vector<ShadowCommand>{});
                group = prev(groupedCommands.end());
            }
            group->second.push_back({
                mesh.VertexBufferView,
                mesh.IndexBufferView,
                MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount)
                });
        }

        for (auto& [textureIndex, commands] : groupedCommands)
        {
            PrimaryBatch::Group group{};
            group.TextureIndex = textureIndex;
            if (!FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), group.Commands))
            {
                return false;
            }
            batch.Groups.push_back(move(group));
        }
        return !batch.Groups.empty();
    }

    template<typename Model, typename Map, typename Mesh>
    static PrimaryBatch* FindOrBuildPrimary(const Model* model, Map& map)
    {
        PrimaryBatch& batch = map[model];
        if (batch.Groups.empty() || batch.SourceMeshCount != model->GetMeshCount())
        {
            if (!BuildPrimaryBatch<Model, Mesh>(model, batch))
            {
                return nullptr;
            }
        }
        return &batch;
    }

    template<typename Model, typename Map, typename Builder>
    static IndirectBatch* FindOrBuild(const Model* model, Map& map, Builder&& builder)
    {
        IndirectBatch& batch = map[model];
        if (!batch.CandidateBuffer || batch.SourceMeshCount != model->GetMeshCount())
        {
            if (!builder(model, batch))
            {
                return nullptr;
            }
        }
        return &batch;
    }

    bool CullAndExecute(
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
        ID3D12CommandSignature* signature,
        IndirectBatch& batch,
        EntityID entity,
        const XMMATRIX& world,
        const XMMATRIX& viewProjection,
        const XMFLOAT3& localCenter,
        const XMFLOAT3& localExtents,
        bool enableFrustumCulling,
		ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState,
		bool enableOcclusion = false)
    {
        if (!commandList || !signature || !graphicsPipelineState ||
            entity >= g_kMAX_ENTITIES || !m_MappedCullConstants)
        {
            return false;
        }

        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES previousState;
        if (batch.Initialized)
        {
            previousState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
        }
        else
        {
            previousState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
        }
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER countToCopy = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            batch.CountBuffer.Get(),
			previousState,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &countToCopy);
        commandList->CopyBufferRegion(batch.CountBuffer.Get(), 0, m_ZeroCounterUpload.Get(), 0, sizeof(UINT));
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER countToUav = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            batch.CountBuffer.Get(),
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &countToUav);

        const UINT frameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() % RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
        if (m_CullConstantFrameIndex != frameIndex)
        {
            m_CullConstantFrameIndex = frameIndex;
            m_CullConstantCursor = 0;
        }
        if (m_CullConstantCursor >= g_kMAX_CULL_DISPATCHES_PER_FRAME)
        {
            Debug::Log("GPU culling constant ring exhausted for frame %u\n", frameIndex);
            return false;
        }
        const UINT64 constantIndex =
            static_cast<UINT64>(frameIndex) * g_kMAX_CULL_DISPATCHES_PER_FRAME +
            m_CullConstantCursor++;
        CullConstants constants{};
        constants.SceneInstanceId = GpuSceneValidation::UseLegacyCulling() ? InvalidGPUInstanceID : GpuScene::GetEntityInstance(entity);
        GpuSceneValidation::RecordModelCull(constants.SceneInstanceId != InvalidGPUInstanceID);
        if (constants.SceneInstanceId == InvalidGPUInstanceID)
        {
            XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.World, world);
            constants.LocalCenter = XMFLOAT4(localCenter.x, localCenter.y, localCenter.z, 1.0f);
            constants.LocalExtents = XMFLOAT4(localExtents.x, localExtents.y, localExtents.z, 0.0f);
        }
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.ViewProjection, viewProjection);
        constants.CommandStrideBytes = batch.CommandStride;
        constants.CandidateCount = batch.CommandCount;
		constants.EnableFrustumCulling = static_cast<UINT>(enableFrustumCulling);
		constants.Phase = OcclusionCulling::GetPhase();
		constants.EnableOcclusion = static_cast<UINT>(enableOcclusion && RendererSettings::GetTwoPhaseOcclusionEnabled());
		constants.HiZWidth = OcclusionCulling::GetWidth();
		constants.HiZHeight = OcclusionCulling::GetHeight();
		constants.HiZMipCount = OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount();
		constants.PreviousHiZValid = static_cast<UINT>(OcclusionCulling::HasPrevious());
		constants.CurrentHiZValid = static_cast<UINT>(OcclusionCulling::HasCurrent());
        memcpy(
            m_MappedCullConstants + constantIndex * sizeof(CullConstants),
            &constants,
            sizeof(constants));

        commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(m_CullRootSignature.Get());
        commandList->SetPipelineState(m_CullPipelineState.Get());
        commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, batch.CandidateBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(1, batch.VisibleBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(2, batch.CountBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
		commandList->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(
            3,
			m_CullConstantsUpload->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + constantIndex * sizeof(CullConstants));
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(4, OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousSrv());
		commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, OcclusionCulling::GetCurrentSrv());
        commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(6, GpuScene::InstanceBuffer()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->Dispatch((batch.CommandCount + 63) / 64, 1, 1);

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER uavBarriers[2] =
        {
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(batch.VisibleBuffer.Get()),
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(batch.CountBuffer.Get())
        };
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(_countof(uavBarriers), uavBarriers);

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER toIndirect[2] =
        {
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
                batch.VisibleBuffer.Get(),
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT),
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
                batch.CountBuffer.Get(),
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT)
        };
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(_countof(toIndirect), toIndirect);

        commandList->SetPipelineState(graphicsPipelineState);
        commandList->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
        commandList->ExecuteIndirect(
            signature,
            batch.CommandCount,
            batch.VisibleBuffer.Get(),
            0,
            batch.CountBuffer.Get(),
            0);

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER toUav[2] =
        {
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
                batch.VisibleBuffer.Get(),
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS),
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
                batch.CountBuffer.Get(),
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
        };
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(_countof(toUav), toUav);
		batch.Initialized = true;
        return true;
    }

    static bool ExecuteCandidatesDirect(
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
        ID3D12CommandSignature* signature,
        const IndirectBatch& batch,
        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        if (!commandList || !signature || !batch.CandidateBuffer ||
            batch.CommandCount == 0 || !graphicsPipelineState)
        {
            return false;
        }

        commandList->SetPipelineState(graphicsPipelineState);
        commandList->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
        commandList->ExecuteIndirect(
            signature,
            batch.CommandCount,
            batch.CandidateBuffer.Get(),
            0,
            nullptr,
            0);
        return true;
    }

public:
    template<typename Model, typename Mesh, typename Map>
    bool ExecutePrimaryImpl(
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
        const Model* model,
        Map& map,
        EntityID entity,
        const XMMATRIX& world,
        const XMMATRIX& viewProjection,
        int fallbackTextureIndex,
        D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptorHeapStart,
        UINT descriptorIncrement,
        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        PrimaryBatch* batch = FindOrBuildPrimary<Model, Map, Mesh>(model, map);
        if (!batch)
        {
            return false;
        }

        bool submitted = false;
        for (auto& group : batch->Groups)
        {
            int textureIndex;
            if (group.TextureIndex >= 0)
            {
                textureIndex = group.TextureIndex;
            }
            else
            {
                textureIndex = fallbackTextureIndex;
            }
            commandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(
                1,
                CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
                    descriptorHeapStart,
                    textureIndex,
                    descriptorIncrement));
            submitted |= CullAndExecute(
                commandList,
                m_ShadowSignature.Get(),
                group.Commands,
                entity,
                world,
                viewProjection,
                model->GetAabbCenter(),
                model->GetAabbExtents(),
                true,
				graphicsPipelineState,
				true);
        }
        return submitted;
    }

    bool ExecutePrimary(
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
        const AnimationModelResource* model,
        EntityID entity,
        const XMMATRIX& world,
        const XMMATRIX& viewProjection,
        int fallbackTextureIndex,
        D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptorHeapStart,
        UINT descriptorIncrement,
        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        return ExecutePrimaryImpl<AnimationModelResource, MeshData>(
            commandList, model, m_AnimatedPrimaryBatches, entity, world,
            viewProjection, fallbackTextureIndex, descriptorHeapStart,
            descriptorIncrement, graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecutePrimary(
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
        const StaticModelResource* model,
        EntityID entity,
        const XMMATRIX& world,
        const XMMATRIX& viewProjection,
        int fallbackTextureIndex,
        D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptorHeapStart,
        UINT descriptorIncrement,
        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        return ExecutePrimaryImpl<StaticModelResource, StaticMeshData>(
            commandList, model, m_StaticPrimaryBatches, entity, world,
            viewProjection, fallbackTextureIndex, descriptorHeapStart,
            descriptorIncrement, graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecuteShadow(
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
        const AnimationModelResource* model,
        EntityID entity,
        const XMMATRIX& world,
        const XMMATRIX& lightViewProjection,
        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState,
        bool cpuCulledVirtualPage)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        IndirectBatch* batch = FindOrBuild(model, m_AnimatedShadowBatches, BuildAnimatedShadowBatch);
        if (!batch)
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (cpuCulledVirtualPage)
        {
            return ExecuteCandidatesDirect(
                commandList, m_ShadowSignature.Get(), *batch, graphicsPipelineState);
        }
        return CullAndExecute(
            commandList,
            m_ShadowSignature.Get(),
            *batch,
            entity,
            world,
            lightViewProjection,
            model->GetAabbCenter(),
            model->GetAabbExtents(),
            true,
            graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecuteShadow(
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
        const StaticModelResource* model,
        EntityID entity,
        const XMMATRIX& world,
        const XMMATRIX& lightViewProjection,
        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState,
        bool cpuCulledVirtualPage)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        IndirectBatch* batch = FindOrBuild(model, m_StaticShadowBatches, BuildStaticShadowBatch);
        if (!batch)
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (cpuCulledVirtualPage)
        {
            return ExecuteCandidatesDirect(
                commandList, m_ShadowSignature.Get(), *batch, graphicsPipelineState);
        }
        return CullAndExecute(
            commandList,
            m_ShadowSignature.Get(),
            *batch,
            entity,
            world,
            lightViewProjection,
            model->GetAabbCenter(),
            model->GetAabbExtents(),
            true,
            graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecuteVelocity(
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
        const AnimationModelResource* model,
        EntityID entity,
        const XMMATRIX& world,
        const XMMATRIX& viewProjection,
        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        IndirectBatch* batch = FindOrBuild(model, m_AnimatedVelocityBatches, BuildAnimatedVelocityBatch);
        return batch && CullAndExecute(
            commandList,
            m_VelocitySignature.Get(),
            *batch,
            entity,
            world,
            viewProjection,
            model->GetAabbCenter(),
            model->GetAabbExtents(),
            true,
            graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecuteVelocity(
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
        const StaticModelResource* model,
        EntityID entity,
        const XMMATRIX& world,
        const XMMATRIX& viewProjection,
        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        IndirectBatch* batch = FindOrBuild(model, m_StaticVelocityBatches, BuildStaticVelocityBatch);
        return batch && CullAndExecute(
            commandList,
            m_VelocitySignature.Get(),
            *batch,
            entity,
            world,
            viewProjection,
            model->GetAabbCenter(),
            model->GetAabbExtents(),
            true,
            graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    void Reset()
    {
        if (m_CullConstantsUpload && m_MappedCullConstants)
        {
            m_CullConstantsUpload->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        }
        m_MappedCullConstants = nullptr;
        m_CullConstantFrameIndex = UINT_MAX;
        m_CullConstantCursor = 0;
        m_AnimatedShadowBatches.clear();
        m_StaticShadowBatches.clear();
        m_AnimatedVelocityBatches.clear();
        m_StaticVelocityBatches.clear();
        m_AnimatedPrimaryBatches.clear();
        m_StaticPrimaryBatches.clear();
        m_ShadowSignature.Reset();
        m_VelocitySignature.Reset();
        m_CullRootSignature.Reset();
        m_CullPipelineState.Reset();
        m_ZeroCounterUpload.Reset();
        m_CullConstantsUpload.Reset();
        m_InitializationAttempted = false;
    }
};

struct SceneState
{
    GpuSceneSlots Instances;
    vector<GPUMeshData> Meshes;
    vector<GPUMaterialData> Materials;
    vector<uint32_t> NewMeshes, NewMaterials;
    vector<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>> GeometryOwners;
    unordered_map<uint32_t,ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>> PrimitiveOwners;
    unordered_map<uint32_t, array<uint32_t, StaticMeshData::LodCount - 1>> PrimitiveLODs;
    array<vector<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>>,GpuSceneBuffer::FrameCount> RetiredPrimitiveOwners;
    vector<uint32_t> FreePrimitiveMeshes;
    unordered_map<uint64_t, vector<uint32_t>> MeshLookup, MaterialLookup;
    struct AssetMaterialRecord
    {
        uint32_t Index = 0;
        uint64_t Revision = 0;
        uint64_t PipelineRevision = 0;
        unordered_set<uint32_t> Users;
    };
    unordered_map<AssetHandle, AssetMaterialRecord> AssetMaterials;
    unordered_map<uint32_t, vector<AssetHandle>> EntityAssets;
    unordered_map<uint32_t, vector<GPUInstanceID>> Entities;
    vector<uint32_t> CpuOpaqueStatic;
    unordered_map<uint32_t, size_t> CpuOpaquePositions;
    GpuSceneBuffer InstanceBuffer, MeshBuffer, MaterialBuffer;
    GpuSceneCulling Culling;
    GpuSceneStatistics Stats;
};
SceneState &Scene()
{
    static SceneState state;
    return state;
}
uint64_t Hash(const void *data, size_t size)
{
    uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
    const auto *bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t *>(data);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
    {
        hash = (hash ^ bytes[i]) * 1099511628211ull;
    }
    return hash;
}
template <typename T>
uint32_t RegisterShared(const T &data, vector<T> &records,
                        unordered_map<uint64_t, vector<uint32_t>> &lookup, vector<uint32_t> &changes)
{
    auto &matches = lookup[Hash(&data, sizeof(data))];
    for (uint32_t id : matches)
    {
        if (memcmp(&records[id], &data, sizeof(data)) == 0)
        {
            return id;
        }
    }
    const uint32_t id = static_cast<uint32_t>(records.size());
    records.push_back(data);
    matches.push_back(id);
    changes.push_back(id);
    return id;
}
void SetCpuOpaqueEntity(uint32_t entity, bool include)
{
    auto& scene = Scene();
    const auto position = scene.CpuOpaquePositions.find(entity);
    if (include && position == scene.CpuOpaquePositions.end())
    {
        scene.CpuOpaquePositions[entity] = scene.CpuOpaqueStatic.size();
        scene.CpuOpaqueStatic.push_back(entity);
    }
    else if (!include && position != scene.CpuOpaquePositions.end())
    {
        const size_t index = position->second;
        const uint32_t moved = scene.CpuOpaqueStatic.back();
        scene.CpuOpaqueStatic[index] = moved;
        scene.CpuOpaquePositions[moved] = index;
        scene.CpuOpaqueStatic.pop_back();
        scene.CpuOpaquePositions.erase(entity);
    }
}
void RemoveEntity(uint32_t entity)
{
    GPUDrivenRenderer::TrackEntityTextures(entity, {});
    SetCpuOpaqueEntity(entity, false);
    auto &scene = Scene();
    const auto assets = scene.EntityAssets.find(entity);
    if (assets != scene.EntityAssets.end())
    {
        for (const auto handle : assets->second)
        {
            scene.AssetMaterials.at(handle).Users.erase(entity);
        }
        scene.EntityAssets.erase(assets);
    }

    const auto found = scene.Entities.find(entity);
    if (found == scene.Entities.end())
    {
        return;
    }
    for (GPUInstanceID id : found->second)
    {
        scene.Instances.Remove(id);
    }
    scene.Entities.erase(found);
}
uint32_t RegisterMesh(ID3D12Resource *vertices, ID3D12Resource *indices, uint32_t vertexCount, uint32_t indexCount,
                      const XMFLOAT3 &center, const XMFLOAT3 &extents, bool retain=true)
{
    auto &scene = Scene();
    GPUMeshData mesh{};
    const uint64_t vertexAddress = vertices ? vertices->GetGPUVirtualAddress() : 0;
    const uint64_t indexAddress = indices ? indices->GetGPUVirtualAddress() : 0;
    mesh.VertexAddressLow = static_cast<uint32_t>(vertexAddress);
    mesh.VertexAddressHigh = static_cast<uint32_t>(vertexAddress >> 32);
    mesh.IndexAddressLow = static_cast<uint32_t>(indexAddress);
    mesh.IndexAddressHigh = static_cast<uint32_t>(indexAddress >> 32);
    mesh.VertexCount = vertexCount;
    mesh.IndexCount = indexCount;
    mesh.BoundsCenter = XMFLOAT4(center.x, center.y, center.z, 1);
    mesh.BoundsExtents = XMFLOAT4(extents.x, extents.y, extents.z, 0);
    const size_t oldCount = scene.Meshes.size();
    const uint32_t id = RegisterShared(mesh, scene.Meshes, scene.MeshLookup, scene.NewMeshes);
    if (retain && scene.Meshes.size() != oldCount)
    {
        if (vertices)
        {
            scene.GeometryOwners.emplace_back(vertices);
        }
        if (indices)
        {
            scene.GeometryOwners.emplace_back(indices);
        }
    }
    return id;
}
void RemoveMeshLookup(uint32_t id)
{
    auto &scene = Scene();
    const auto key = Hash(&scene.Meshes.at(id), sizeof(GPUMeshData));
    auto found = scene.MeshLookup.find(key);
    if (found == scene.MeshLookup.end())
        return;
    erase(found->second, id);
    if (found->second.empty())
        scene.MeshLookup.erase(found);
}
uint32_t RegisterPrimitiveMesh(uint32_t entity, ID3D12Resource *vertices, uint32_t vertexCount,
                               const XMFLOAT3 &center, const XMFLOAT3 &extents)
{
    auto &scene = Scene();
    uint32_t reusable = UINT32_MAX;
    if (const auto previous = scene.Entities.find(entity);
        previous != scene.Entities.end() && !previous->second.empty())
    {
        const auto old = scene.Instances.Data()[previous->second.front()].MeshIndex;
        uint32_t references = 0;
        if (scene.PrimitiveOwners.contains(old))
            for (const auto &instance : scene.Instances.Data())
                if ((instance.Flags & 1u) && instance.MeshIndex == old)
                    ++references;
        if (references == 1)
            reusable = old;
    }
    GPUMeshData record{};
    const auto address = vertices->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    record.VertexAddressLow = uint32_t(address);
    record.VertexAddressHigh = uint32_t(address >> 32);
    record.VertexCount = vertexCount;
    record.BoundsCenter = XMFLOAT4(center.x, center.y, center.z, 1);
    record.BoundsExtents = XMFLOAT4(extents.x, extents.y, extents.z, 0);
    const auto key = Hash(&record, sizeof(record));
    if (const auto existing = scene.MeshLookup.find(key); existing != scene.MeshLookup.end())
        for (auto id : existing->second)
            if (memcmp(&scene.Meshes[id], &record, sizeof(record)) == 0)
                return id;
    if (reusable == UINT32_MAX && !scene.FreePrimitiveMeshes.empty())
    {
        reusable = scene.FreePrimitiveMeshes.back();
        scene.FreePrimitiveMeshes.pop_back();
    }
    if (reusable != UINT32_MAX)
    {
        RemoveMeshLookup(reusable);
        if (auto old = scene.PrimitiveOwners.find(reusable); old != scene.PrimitiveOwners.end())
            scene.RetiredPrimitiveOwners[GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex()].push_back(move(old->second));
        scene.Meshes[reusable] = record;
        scene.MeshLookup[key].push_back(reusable);
        scene.NewMeshes.push_back(reusable);
    }
    else
        reusable = RegisterMesh(vertices, nullptr, vertexCount, 0, center, extents, false);
    scene.PrimitiveOwners[reusable] = vertices;
    return reusable;
}
void RetireUnusedPrimitiveMeshes()
{
    auto &scene = Scene();
    unordered_set<uint32_t> used;
    for (const auto &instance : scene.Instances.Data())
        if (instance.Flags & 1u)
            used.insert(instance.MeshIndex);
    for (auto it = scene.PrimitiveLODs.begin(); it != scene.PrimitiveLODs.end();)
    {
        if (used.contains(it->first))
        {
            for (auto id : it->second) if (id != UINT32_MAX) used.insert(id);
            ++it;
        }
        else it = scene.PrimitiveLODs.erase(it);
    }
    for (auto it = scene.PrimitiveOwners.begin(); it != scene.PrimitiveOwners.end();)
    {
        if (used.contains(it->first))
        {
            ++it;
            continue;
        }
        const auto id = it->first;
        scene.RetiredPrimitiveOwners[GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex()].push_back(move(it->second));
        RemoveMeshLookup(id);
        scene.Meshes[id] = {};
        scene.NewMeshes.push_back(id);
        scene.FreePrimitiveMeshes.push_back(id);
        GPUDrivenRenderer::ReleasePrimitiveGeometry(id);
        it = scene.PrimitiveOwners.erase(it);
    }
}
void UpdateEntity(uint32_t entity, GpuSceneDirtyFlags dirty)
{
    auto &scene = Scene();
    if (!Registry::IsAlive(entity) || !ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity))
    {
        RemoveEntity(entity);
        return;
    }
    const auto &transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
    for (const auto handle : scene.EntityAssets[entity])
    {
        scene.AssetMaterials.at(handle).Users.erase(entity);
    }
    scene.EntityAssets[entity].clear();
    const MaterialComponent defaultMaterial{};
    const auto &material = ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity)
                               ? ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity)
                               : defaultMaterial;
    auto &ids = scene.Entities[entity];
    size_t section = 0;
    auto append = [&](ID3D12Resource *vertices, ID3D12Resource *indices, uint32_t vertexCount, uint32_t indexCount,
                      XMFLOAT3 center, XMFLOAT3 extents, int texture, bool primitive=false) {
        if (!vertices || !vertexCount)
        {
            return;
        }
        const XMFLOAT3 meshCenter = center;
        const XMFLOAT3 meshExtents = extents;
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AABBComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto &bounds = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AABBComponent>(entity);
            center = bounds.Center;
            extents = bounds.Extents;
        }
        GPUInstanceData instance{};
        instance.Entity = entity;
        instance.Flags = 3;
        if (section < ids.size()) instance.Flags |= scene.Instances.Data()[ids[section]].Flags & 4u;
        instance.World = transform.WorldMatrix;
        instance.PreviousWorld = section < ids.size() ? scene.Instances.Data()[ids[section]].World : instance.World;
        // Material-only edits must preserve the temporal state of a moving instance.
        if (section < ids.size() &&
            memcmp(&instance.World, &scene.Instances.Data()[ids[section]].World, sizeof(instance.World)) == 0)
        {
            instance.PreviousWorld = scene.Instances.Data()[ids[section]].PreviousWorld;
        }
        instance.LocalCenter = XMFLOAT4(meshCenter.x, meshCenter.y, meshCenter.z, 1);
        instance.LocalExtents = XMFLOAT4(meshExtents.x, meshExtents.y, meshExtents.z, 0);
        const XMMATRIX world = XMLoadFloat4x4(&instance.World);
        XMFLOAT3 worldCenter;
        XMStoreFloat3(&worldCenter, XMVector3TransformCoord(XMLoadFloat3(&center), world));
        const auto &matrix = instance.World;
        instance.BoundsCenter = XMFLOAT4(worldCenter.x, worldCenter.y, worldCenter.z, 1);
        instance.BoundsExtents = XMFLOAT4(
            abs(matrix._11) * extents.x + abs(matrix._21) * extents.y + abs(matrix._31) * extents.z,
            abs(matrix._12) * extents.x + abs(matrix._22) * extents.y + abs(matrix._32) * extents.z,
            abs(matrix._13) * extents.x + abs(matrix._23) * extents.y + abs(matrix._33) * extents.z, 0);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<InstancingComponent>(entity) &&
            !ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<InstancingComponent>(entity).EnableFrustumCulling)
        {
            instance.Flags &= ~2u;
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<LODComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto &lod = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LODComponent>(entity);
            instance.LodDistances = XMFLOAT4(lod.Lod1Distance, lod.Lod2Distance, lod.UseLOD ? 1.0f : 0.0f, 0);
        }
        const bool existing = section < ids.size();
        const uint32_t flags = static_cast<uint32_t>(dirty);
        if (existing && !(flags & static_cast<uint32_t>(GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Mesh | GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Bounds)))
        {
            instance.MeshIndex = scene.Instances.Data()[ids[section]].MeshIndex;
        }
        else
        {
            instance.MeshIndex = primitive ? RegisterPrimitiveMesh(entity,vertices,vertexCount,meshCenter,meshExtents) :
                RegisterMesh(vertices, indices, vertexCount, indexCount, meshCenter, meshExtents);
        }
        if (existing && !(flags & static_cast<uint32_t>(GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Material | GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Mesh)))
        {
            instance.MaterialIndex = scene.Instances.Data()[ids[section]].MaterialIndex;
        }
        else
        {
            const auto& resolved = MaterialManager::Resolve(material, section);
            auto gpuMaterial = MaterialBindings::BuildGpuSceneMaterial(resolved);
            if (resolved.RuntimeHandle == 0 && material.UseTexture && texture >= 0)
            {
                gpuMaterial.AlbedoTextureIndex = static_cast<uint32_t>(texture);
            }
            if (resolved.RuntimeHandle != 0)
            {
                const auto handle = resolved.RuntimeHandle;
                auto found = scene.AssetMaterials.find(handle);
                if (found == scene.AssetMaterials.end())
                {
                    const auto index = static_cast<uint32_t>(scene.Materials.size());
                    scene.Materials.push_back(gpuMaterial);
                    scene.NewMaterials.push_back(index);
                    const auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle);
                    scene.AssetMaterials.emplace(handle, SceneState::AssetMaterialRecord{index,
                        runtime.Revision, runtime.PipelineRevision, {}});
                    instance.MaterialIndex = index;
                }
                else
                {
                    instance.MaterialIndex = found->second.Index;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                instance.MaterialIndex = RegisterShared(gpuMaterial, scene.Materials, scene.MaterialLookup, scene.NewMaterials);
            }
        }
        const auto assetHandle = MaterialManager::SlotHandle(material, section);
        if (assetHandle != 0)
        {
            scene.AssetMaterials.at(assetHandle).Users.insert(entity);
            scene.EntityAssets[entity].push_back(assetHandle);
        }
        if (section < ids.size())
        {
            scene.Instances.Update(ids[section], instance);
        }
        else
        {
            ids.push_back(scene.Instances.Register(instance));
        }
        ++section;
    };
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        auto *model =
            ModelManager::GetStaticModel(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId);
        if (model)
        {
            for (UINT i = 0; i < model->GetMeshCount(); ++i)
            {
                const auto &mesh = model->GetMeshData(i);
                const size_t before = section;
                append(mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), mesh.IndexBuffer.Get(), mesh.VertexCount, mesh.IndexCount,
                       model->GetAabbCenter(), model->GetAabbExtents(), mesh.TextureIndex);
                if (section > before)
                {
                    const auto slot = ids[section - 1];
                    auto instance = scene.Instances.Data()[slot];
                    GPUDrivenRenderer::RegisterGeometry(instance.MeshIndex, mesh);
                    if (mesh.VirtualGeometrySettings.Enabled && mesh.VirtualGeometryLODs[0])
                    {
                        instance.VirtualGeometryAssetIndex = VirtualGeometryResources::Register(mesh.VirtualGeometryLODs[0]);
                    }
                    // 自動 LOD：LOD コンポーネントが無いモデルも、インポート時に生成した LOD を画面サイズで切り替える
                    const bool hasLodComponent = ComponentManager::HasComponent<LODComponent>(entity);
                    if (hasLodComponent || RenderCulling::GetSettings().AutoLod)
                    {
                        const LODComponent lod = hasLodComponent ? ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LODComponent>(entity) : LODComponent{ true };
                        if (lod.UseLOD)
                        {
                            array<uint32_t, Visibility::MaxLODs> lodMeshes;
                            lodMeshes.fill(Visibility::InvalidID); lodMeshes[0] = instance.MeshIndex;
                            const auto& metadata = lod.UseAssetSettings ? model->GetLODMetadata() : lod.ScreenLOD;
                            for (uint32_t level = 1; level < metadata.Count && level < Visibility::MaxLODs; ++level)
                            {
                                if (!metadata.MeshPaths[level].empty())
                                {
                                    auto* alternative = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(ModelManager::LoadStaticModel(metadata.MeshPaths[level].c_str(), false));
                                    if (!alternative || alternative->GetMeshCount() != model->GetMeshCount()) continue;
                                    // Original bounds must cover every selectable LOD.
                                    const auto c = model->GetAabbCenter(), e = model->GetAabbExtents();
                                    const auto ac = alternative->GetAabbCenter(), ae = alternative->GetAabbExtents();
                                    if (abs(ac.x - c.x) + ae.x > e.x + 0.0001f || abs(ac.y - c.y) + ae.y > e.y + 0.0001f || abs(ac.z - c.z) + ae.z > e.z + 0.0001f) continue;
                                    const auto& alternativeMesh = alternative->GetMeshData(i);
                                    const auto meshID = RegisterMesh(alternativeMesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), alternativeMesh.IndexBuffer.Get(), alternativeMesh.VertexCount, alternativeMesh.IndexCount, ac, ae);
                                    GPUDrivenRenderer::RegisterGeometry(meshID, alternativeMesh);
                                    if (GPUDrivenRenderer::GeometryReady(meshID)) lodMeshes[level] = meshID;
                                    continue;
                                }
                                if (level >= StaticMeshData::LodCount) continue;
                                const auto& indices = mesh.CpuLodIndices[level - 1];
                                if (indices.empty()) continue;
                                const auto meshID = RegisterMesh(mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), mesh.LodIndexBuffers[level - 1].Get(),
                                    mesh.VertexCount, static_cast<uint32_t>(indices.size()), model->GetAabbCenter(), model->GetAabbExtents());
                                GPUDrivenRenderer::RegisterLODGeometry(meshID, instance.MeshIndex, indices, &mesh.MeshletLODs[level]);
                                if (GPUDrivenRenderer::GeometryReady(meshID)) lodMeshes[level] = meshID;
                            }
                            instance.LODGroupIndex = GPUVisibility::RegisterLODGroup(lodMeshes, metadata);
                        }
                    }
                    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity) &&
                        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity).Enabled) instance.Flags |= 8u;
                    scene.Instances.Update(slot, instance);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        auto *model = ModelManager::GetAnimModel(
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity).ModelId);
        if (model)
        {
            for (UINT i = 0; i < model->GetMeshCount(); ++i)
            {
                const auto &mesh = model->GetMeshData(i);
                append(mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), mesh.IndexBuffer.Get(), mesh.VertexCount, mesh.IndexCount,
                       model->GetAabbCenter(), model->GetAabbExtents(), mesh.TextureIndex);
            }
        }
    }
    else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto &mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
        append(mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), nullptr, mesh.VertexCount, 0, mesh.LocalBoundsCenter, mesh.LocalBoundsExtents,
               -1,mesh.NaniteMesh!=nullptr);
        if (mesh.NaniteMesh && !ids.empty())
        {
            const auto slot = ids.back();
            auto instance = scene.Instances.Data()[slot];
            const auto& source = *mesh.NaniteMesh;
            GPUDrivenRenderer::RegisterPrimitiveGeometry(instance.MeshIndex, source);
            if (source.VirtualGeometrySettings.Enabled && source.VirtualGeometryLODs[0])
            {
                instance.VirtualGeometryAssetIndex = VirtualGeometryResources::Register(source.VirtualGeometryLODs[0]);
            }
            const bool hasSettings = ComponentManager::HasComponent<LODComponent>(entity);
            const auto settings = hasSettings ? ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LODComponent>(entity) : LODComponent{};
            // Generated geometry has no imported asset settings. Enable its generated
            // levels by default, while honoring an explicitly attached LOD component.
            if (!hasSettings || settings.UseLOD)
            {
                auto [entry, inserted] = scene.PrimitiveLODs.try_emplace(instance.MeshIndex);
                if (inserted) entry->second.fill(UINT32_MAX);
                array<uint32_t, Visibility::MaxLODs> lodMeshes;
                lodMeshes.fill(UINT32_MAX);
                lodMeshes[0] = instance.MeshIndex;
                const auto metadata = settings.UseAssetSettings ? Visibility::LODMetadata{} : settings.ScreenLOD;
                for (uint32_t level = 1; level < StaticMeshData::LodCount; ++level)
                {
                    const auto& indices = source.CpuLodIndices[level - 1];
                    auto& id = entry->second[level - 1];
                    if (indices.empty())
                    {
                        if (id != UINT32_MAX) GPUDrivenRenderer::ReleasePrimitiveGeometry(id);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (id == UINT32_MAX)
                    {
                        if (!scene.FreePrimitiveMeshes.empty())
                        {
                            id = scene.FreePrimitiveMeshes.back();
                            scene.FreePrimitiveMeshes.pop_back();
                        }
                        else { id = static_cast<uint32_t>(scene.Meshes.size()); scene.Meshes.emplace_back(); }
                    }
                    auto record = scene.Meshes[instance.MeshIndex];
                    record.IndexCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(indices.size());
                    if (memcmp(&scene.Meshes[id], &record, sizeof(record)) != 0)
                    {
                        scene.Meshes[id] = record;
                        scene.NewMeshes.push_back(id);
                    }
                    scene.PrimitiveOwners[id] = mesh.VertexBuffer;
                    GPUDrivenRenderer::RegisterPrimitiveGeometry(id, source, level, instance.MeshIndex);
                    if (GPUDrivenRenderer::GeometryReady(id)) lodMeshes[level] = id;
                }
                instance.LODGroupIndex = GPUVisibility::RegisterLODGroup(lodMeshes, metadata);
            }
            scene.Instances.Update(slot, instance);
        }
    }
    else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto &sprite = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity);
        if (sprite.Is3D)
        {
            append(sprite.VertexBuffer.Get(), nullptr, sprite.VertexCount, 0, sprite.LocalBoundsCenter,
                   sprite.LocalBoundsExtents, -1);
        }
    }
    while (ids.size() > section)
    {
        scene.Instances.Remove(ids.back());
        ids.pop_back();
    }
    if (ids.empty())
    {
        scene.Entities.erase(entity);
        SetCpuOpaqueEntity(entity, ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity));
        GPUDrivenRenderer::TrackEntityTextures(entity, {});
    }
    else
    {
        bool supported = GPUDrivenRenderer::SupportsEntity(entity);
        for (auto id : ids) supported &= GPUDrivenRenderer::GeometryReady(scene.Instances.Data()[id].MeshIndex);
        for (auto id : ids)
        {
            auto instance = scene.Instances.Data()[id];
            instance.Flags = supported ? (instance.Flags | 4u) : (instance.Flags & ~4u);
            instance.Flags &= ~16u;
            const auto& gpuMaterial = scene.Materials.at(instance.MaterialIndex);
            uint32_t surfaceFlags = 0;
            memcpy(&surfaceFlags,&gpuMaterial.ShadingParameters[149].w,sizeof(surfaceFlags));
            if (supported && instance.VirtualGeometryAssetIndex != UINT32_MAX && (instance.Flags & 8u) == 0 &&
                (gpuMaterial.Flags & 6u) == 0 && (surfaceFlags & 15u) == 0)
            {
                instance.Flags |= 16u;
            }
            scene.Instances.Update(id, instance);
        }
        // Auto models still use the CPU outline pass after their base geometry moves to Nanite.
        SetCpuOpaqueEntity(entity, ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity) &&
            (!supported || material.ShaderClassMode == MaterialMode::Auto));
        vector<uint32_t> textures;
        if (supported)
            for (auto id : ids)
            {
                const auto& material = scene.Materials[scene.Instances.Data()[id].MaterialIndex];
                if ((material.Flags & 1u) && material.AlbedoTextureIndex != UINT32_MAX) textures.push_back(material.AlbedoTextureIndex);
                if (material.NormalTextureIndex != UINT32_MAX) textures.push_back(material.NormalTextureIndex);
            }
        GPUDrivenRenderer::TrackEntityTextures(entity, textures);
    }
}
} // namespace

void GpuScene::Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *commands)
{
    ModelManager::UpdateVirtualGeometry();
    GPUDrivenValidation::Trace("GPU Scene begin");
    GpuSceneValidation::BeforeScene();
    const auto start = chrono::steady_clock::now();
    auto &scene = Scene();
    const uint32_t frame = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    scene.RetiredPrimitiveOwners[frame].clear(); // This frame slot's fence completed before Execute.
    auto *device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    scene.Instances.SettlePreviousTransforms();
    for (auto& [handle, record] : scene.AssetMaterials)
    {
        const auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle);
        if (record.PipelineRevision != runtime.PipelineRevision)
        {
            for (const auto entity : record.Users)
            {
                GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Material);
            }
            record.PipelineRevision = runtime.PipelineRevision;
        }
    }
    auto pending = GpuSceneChanges::Take();
    bool occluderChanged = pending.ResetScene || !pending.Destroyed.empty();
    for (const auto& [entity, dirty] : pending.Changed)
        if (scene.Entities.contains(entity) || ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity)) occluderChanged = true;
    if (occluderChanged) GPUVisibility::Invalidate("Scene/occluder changed");
    GPUVisibility::PrepareCamera();
    if (pending.ResetScene)
    {
        for (auto &[entity, ids] : scene.Entities)
        {
            GPUDrivenRenderer::TrackEntityTextures(entity, {});
            for (auto id : ids)
            {
                scene.Instances.Remove(id);
            }
        }
        scene.Entities.clear();
        scene.EntityAssets.clear();
        for (auto& [handle, record] : scene.AssetMaterials)
        {
            record.Users.clear();
        }
        scene.CpuOpaqueStatic.clear();
        scene.CpuOpaquePositions.clear();
    }
    for (uint32_t entity : pending.Destroyed)
    {
        RemoveEntity(entity);
    }
    auto changed = move(pending.Changed);
    for (const auto &[entity, flags] : changed)
    {
        UpdateEntity(entity, flags);
    }
    const bool geometryChanged=any_of(changed.begin(),changed.end(),[](const auto& change) {
        return (static_cast<uint32_t>(change.second)&static_cast<uint32_t>(GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Mesh))!=0;
    });
    if (geometryChanged || pending.ResetScene || !pending.Destroyed.empty()) RetireUnusedPrimitiveMeshes();
    scene.Stats.EntitiesProcessed = static_cast<uint32_t>(changed.size());
    scene.Stats.DirtyInstances = static_cast<uint32_t>(scene.Instances.Updates().size());
    scene.Stats.InstanceSlots = static_cast<uint32_t>(scene.Instances.Data().size());
    scene.Stats.ActiveInstances = scene.Instances.ActiveCount();
    scene.Stats.Meshes = static_cast<uint32_t>(scene.Meshes.size());
    for (auto& [handle, record] : scene.AssetMaterials)
    {
        const auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle);
        for (const auto descriptor : runtime.TextureDescriptors)
        {
            if (descriptor >= 0)
            {
                TextureManager::TouchTexture(descriptor);
            }
        }
        if (runtime.Revision != record.Revision)
        {
            scene.Materials[record.Index] = MaterialBindings::BuildGpuSceneMaterial(runtime.Binding);
            scene.NewMaterials.push_back(record.Index);
            record.Revision = runtime.Revision;
        }
    }
    scene.Stats.Materials = static_cast<uint32_t>(scene.Materials.size());
    scene.InstanceBuffer.BeginFrame(frame);
    scene.MeshBuffer.BeginFrame(frame);
    scene.MaterialBuffer.BeginFrame(frame);
    scene.InstanceBuffer.Ensure(device, scene.Stats.InstanceSlots, sizeof(GPUInstanceData), frame,
                                L"GPU Scene Instances");
    scene.MeshBuffer.Ensure(device, scene.Stats.Meshes, sizeof(GPUMeshData), frame, L"GPU Scene Meshes");
    scene.MaterialBuffer.Ensure(device, scene.Stats.Materials, sizeof(GPUMaterialData), frame, L"GPU Scene Materials");
    scene.Culling.Prepare(device, scene.Stats.InstanceSlots, frame);
    GPUDrivenValidation::Trace("GPU Scene culling pipeline ready");
    const uint64_t instanceBytes = scene.InstanceBuffer.Stage(device, frame, scene.Instances.Data().data(),
                                                              scene.Stats.InstanceSlots, scene.Instances.Updates());
    const uint64_t meshBytes =
        scene.MeshBuffer.Stage(device, frame, scene.Meshes.data(), scene.Stats.Meshes, scene.NewMeshes);
    const uint64_t materialBytes =
        scene.MaterialBuffer.Stage(device, frame, scene.Materials.data(), scene.Stats.Materials, scene.NewMaterials);
    scene.Stats.InstanceUploadedBytes = instanceBytes;
    scene.Stats.UploadedBytes = instanceBytes + meshBytes + materialBytes;
    RenderGraph graph;
    auto import = [&](const char *name, GpuSceneBuffer &buffer) {
        RenderGraph::ImportedResource resource{};
        resource.Name = name;
        resource.Resource = buffer.Resource();
        resource.InitialState = buffer.State;
        resource.FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
        resource.HasFinalState = true;
        return graph.ImportResource(resource);
    };
    const auto instances = import("GPU Scene Instances", scene.InstanceBuffer);
    const auto meshes = import("GPU Scene Meshes", scene.MeshBuffer);
    const auto materials = import("GPU Scene Materials", scene.MaterialBuffer);
    const auto visibility = import("GPU Scene Visibility", scene.Culling.Visibility);
    if (scene.Stats.UploadedBytes)
    {
        graph.AddPass(
            "GPU Scene Update",
            [&](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &builder) {
                if (instanceBytes)
                {
                    builder.Write(instances, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
                }
                if (meshBytes)
                {
                    builder.Write(meshes, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
                }
                if (materialBytes)
                {
                    builder.Write(materials, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
                }
            },
            [&](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) {
                RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("GPU Scene Update", list);
                scene.InstanceBuffer.Copy(list, frame);
                scene.MeshBuffer.Copy(list, frame);
                scene.MaterialBuffer.Copy(list, frame);
            });
    }
    graph.AddPass(
        "GPU Scene Culling",
        [&](RenderGraph::PassBuilder &builder) {
            builder.Read(instances, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(meshes, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Read(materials, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
                .Write(visibility, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        },
        [&](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *list) {
            scene.Culling.ExecuteCulling(list, scene.InstanceBuffer.Resource(), scene.MeshBuffer.Resource(),
                                         scene.MaterialBuffer.Resource(), scene.Stats.InstanceSlots, scene.Stats.Meshes,
                                         scene.Stats.Materials);
        });
    GPUDrivenRenderer::Prepare(graph, instances, visibility, scene.Stats.InstanceSlots,
                               scene.InstanceBuffer.Capacity(), scene.Stats.Meshes);
    GPUDrivenValidation::Trace("indirect pipeline ready");
    if (!graph.Compile() || !graph.Execute(commands))
    {
        throw runtime_error(graph.GetLastError());
    }
    scene.InstanceBuffer.State = scene.MeshBuffer.State = scene.MaterialBuffer.State =
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
    scene.Culling.Visibility.State = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
    scene.Instances.ClearUpdates();
    scene.NewMeshes.clear();
    scene.NewMaterials.clear();
    scene.Stats.InstanceCapacity = scene.InstanceBuffer.Capacity();
    scene.Stats.BufferMemoryBytes = scene.InstanceBuffer.MemoryBytes() + scene.MeshBuffer.MemoryBytes() +
                                    scene.MaterialBuffer.MemoryBytes() + scene.Culling.Visibility.MemoryBytes();
    scene.Stats.UpdateCpuMilliseconds =
        chrono::duration<double, milli>(chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count();
}

void GpuScene::Shutdown()
{
    GPUDrivenRenderer::Shutdown();
    Scene() = {};
}
uint32_t Entity::GetGPUInstanceID() const

}

    static const vector<GPUInstanceID> empty;
    const auto found = Scene().Entities.find(entity);
    return found == Scene().Entities.end() ? empty : found->second;
}

    return Scene().CpuOpaqueStatic;
}

    return ids.empty() ? InvalidGPUInstanceID : ids.front();

const GPUInstanceData *GpuScene::GetInstance(GPUInstanceID id)
{
    return Scene().Instances.IsActive(id) ? &Scene().Instances.Data()[id] : nullptr;
}
uint64_t GpuScene::InstanceHistoryGeneration(GPUInstanceID id)
{
    return Scene().Instances.Generation(id);
}
uint32_t GpuScene::ResolveEntity(GPUInstanceID id, uint64_t generation)
{
    const auto* instance = GetInstance(id);
    if (!instance || InstanceHistoryGeneration(id) != generation || !Registry::IsAlive(instance->Entity))
    {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    const auto& destroyed = GpuSceneChanges::Pending().Destroyed;
    if (std::find(destroyed.begin(),destroyed.end(),instance->Entity) != destroyed.end())
    {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    return instance->Entity;
}
void GpuScene::DrawDebug()
{
    const auto &stats = Statistics();
    ImGui::Text("Instances: %u / Active: %u / Capacity: %u", stats.InstanceSlots, stats.ActiveInstances,
                stats.InstanceCapacity);
    ImGui::Text("Meshes: %u / Materials: %u / Dirty: %u", stats.Meshes, stats.Materials, stats.DirtyInstances);
    ImGui::Text("Changed entities: %u / Upload: %llu bytes", stats.EntitiesProcessed, stats.UploadedBytes);
    ImGui::Text("Instance upload: %llu bytes / Memory: %.2f MiB", stats.InstanceUploadedBytes,
                stats.BufferMemoryBytes / 1048576.0);
    ImGui::Text("CPU update: %.3f ms", stats.UpdateCpuMilliseconds);
    for (const auto &pass : RenderProfiler::GetLatest().Passes)
    {
        if (pass.Name == "GPU Scene Update")
        {
            ImGui::Text("GPU update: %.3f ms", pass.GpuMs);
        }
    }
    if (ImGui::TreeNode("Instance / Entity / Mesh / Material"))
    {
        ImGuiListClipper clipper;
        clipper.Begin(static_cast<int>(stats.InstanceSlots));
        while (clipper.Step())
        {
            for (int i = clipper.DisplayStart; i < clipper.DisplayEnd; ++i)
            {
                if (const auto *data = GetInstance(static_cast<GPUInstanceID>(i)))
                {
                    ImGui::Text("%u / %u / %u / %u", i, data->Entity, data->MeshIndex, data->MaterialIndex);
                }
            }
        }
        ImGui::TreePop();
    }
}
