===== FILE: source\rendering\lightinstancebuilder.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "lightinstancebuilder.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"


	static ComPtr<ID3D12Device> g_Device;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_RootSignature;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_PipelineState;
	static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_Input[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
	static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_TileIndices[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
	static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_VolumetricIndices[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
	static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_Counters[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
	LightInstanceBuilder::Input* g_MappedInput[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT]{};
	static bool g_OutputInShaderRead[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT]{};

	bool CreateBuffer(UINT64 size, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE heapType, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAGS flags,
		D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& output)
	{
		auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(heapType);
		auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(size, flags);
		return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(
			&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc, state, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&output)));
	}


bool LightInstanceBuilder::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device)
{
	Shutdown();
	if (!device) return false;
	g_Device = device;
	CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[5];
	parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
	parameters[1].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0);
	parameters[2].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(1);
	parameters[3].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(2);
	parameters[4].InitAsConstants(8, 0);
	CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootDesc(_countof(parameters), parameters, 0, nullptr, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
	if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rootDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)) ||
		FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(
			0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_RootSignature))))
	{
		return false;
	}
	ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
	if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(L"shader/hlsl/build/LightInstanceBuilderCS.cso", &shader))) return false;
	D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pso{};
	pso.pRootSignature = g_RootSignature.Get();
	pso.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
	if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pso, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_PipelineState)))) return false;

	const UINT64 inputSize = sizeof(Input) * RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS;
	const UINT64 tileSize = static_cast<UINT64>(RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHT_TILE_COUNT) *
		RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE * sizeof(uint32_t);
	const UINT64 volumetricSize = RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS * sizeof(uint32_t);
	for (UINT frame = 0; frame < RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++frame)
	{
		if (!CreateBuffer(inputSize, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE,
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, g_Input[frame]) ||
			!CreateBuffer(tileSize, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, g_TileIndices[frame]) ||
			!CreateBuffer(volumetricSize, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, g_VolumetricIndices[frame]) ||
			!CreateBuffer(sizeof(uint32_t), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, g_Counters[frame])) return false;
		CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
		if (FAILED(g_Input[frame]->Map(0, &noRead, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_MappedInput[frame])))) return false;
	}
	return true;
}

void LightInstanceBuilder::Shutdown()
{
	for (UINT frame = 0; frame < RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++frame)
	{
		if (g_Input[frame] && g_MappedInput[frame]) g_Input[frame]->Unmap(0, nullptr);
		g_MappedInput[frame] = nullptr;
		g_Input[frame].Reset();
		g_TileIndices[frame].Reset();
		g_VolumetricIndices[frame].Reset();
		g_Counters[frame].Reset();
		g_OutputInShaderRead[frame] = false;
	}
	g_PipelineState.Reset();
	g_RootSignature.Reset();
	g_Device.Reset();
}

bool LightInstanceBuilder::IsAvailable()
{
	return g_Device && g_RootSignature && g_PipelineState;
}

bool LightInstanceBuilder::Build(
	ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
	UINT frameIndex,
	const vector<Input>& inputs,
	UINT tileCountX,
	UINT tileCountY,
	UINT slotsPerTile)
{
	if (!commandList || !IsAvailable() || tileCountX == 0 || tileCountY == 0 ||
		tileCountX * tileCountY > RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHT_TILE_COUNT) return false;
	frameIndex %= RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
	const UINT lightCount = min(static_cast<UINT>(inputs.size()), RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
	if (lightCount > 0) memcpy(g_MappedInput[frameIndex], inputs.data(), lightCount * sizeof(Input));
	if (g_OutputInShaderRead[frameIndex])
	{
		D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barriers[2] =
		{
			CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_TileIndices[frameIndex].Get(),
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS),
			CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex].Get(),
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
		};
		commandList->ResourceBarrier(2, barriers);
	}
	commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_RootSignature.Get());
	commandList->SetPipelineState(g_PipelineState.Get());
	commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, g_Input[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
	commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(1, g_TileIndices[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
	commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(2, g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
	commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(3, g_Counters[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
	const UINT clearConstants[8] = { lightCount, tileCountX, tileCountY, slotsPerTile, 0u,
		RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS, RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE, 0u };
	commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, 8, clearConstants, 0);
	const UINT clearCount = max(
		tileCountX * tileCountY * RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE,
		RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
	commandList->Dispatch((clearCount + 63u) / 64u, 1, 1);
	D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER uavBarriers[3] =
	{
		CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_TileIndices[frameIndex].Get()),
		CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex].Get()),
		CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_Counters[frameIndex].Get())
	};
	commandList->ResourceBarrier(3, uavBarriers);
	UINT buildConstants[8];
	memcpy(buildConstants, clearConstants, sizeof(buildConstants));
	buildConstants[4] = 1u;
	commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, 8, buildConstants, 0);
	if (lightCount > 0) commandList->Dispatch((lightCount + 63u) / 64u, 1, 1);
	D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER toRead[2] =
	{
		CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_TileIndices[frameIndex].Get(),
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE),
		CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex].Get(),
			D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
	};
	commandList->ResourceBarrier(2, toRead);
	g_OutputInShaderRead[frameIndex] = true;
	return true;
}

D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS LightInstanceBuilder::GetTileIndexAddress(UINT frameIndex)
{
	frameIndex %= RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
	if (g_TileIndices[frameIndex])
	{
		return g_TileIndices[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
	}
	return 0;
}

D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS LightInstanceBuilder::GetVolumetricIndexAddress(UINT frameIndex)
{
	frameIndex %= RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
	if (g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex])
	{
		return g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
	}
	return 0;
}


===== FILE: source\rendering\lightinstancebuilder.h =====
#pragma once

#include "pch.h"

class LightInstanceBuilder
{
public:
	struct Input
	{
		XMUINT4 TileBounds{};
		XMUINT4 Metadata{};
	};

	static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device);
	static void Shutdown();
	static bool IsAvailable();
	static bool Build(
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList,
		UINT frameIndex,
		const vector<Input>& inputs,
		UINT tileCountX,
		UINT tileCountY,
		UINT slotsPerTile);
	static D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS GetTileIndexAddress(UINT frameIndex);
	static D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS GetVolumetricIndexAddress(UINT frameIndex);

===== FILE: source\rendering\localheightfog.h =====
#pragma once

#include <DirectXMath.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

enum class LocalFogShape : int
{
	Height = 0,
	Sphere = 1
};

struct LocalHeightFogVolume
{
	bool Enabled = true;
	LocalFogShape Shape = LocalFogShape::Height;
	DirectX::XMFLOAT3 Position = { 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f };
	float Radius = 8.0f;
	float HeightFalloff = 1.0f;
	float Density = 0.25f;
	DirectX::XMFLOAT3 Color = { 0.72f, 0.80f, 0.92f };
};

class LocalHeightFog
{
public:
	static constexpr size_t MaxVolumes = 16;
	static const vector<LocalHeightFogVolume>& GetVolumes() { return s_Volumes; }
	static vector<LocalHeightFogVolume>& GetMutableVolumes() { return s_Volumes; }
	static bool Add(LocalFogShape shape = LocalFogShape::Height)
	{
		if (s_Volumes.size() >= MaxVolumes) return false;
		LocalHeightFogVolume volume{};
		volume.Shape = shape;
		s_Volumes.push_back(volume);
		return true;
	}
	static void Remove(size_t index)
	{
		if (index < s_Volumes.size()) s_Volumes.erase(s_Volumes.begin() + index);
	}
	static void Clear() { s_Volumes.clear(); }

private:
	inline static vector<LocalHeightFogVolume> s_Volumes{};
};


===== FILE: source\rendering\ltctables.h =====
#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// LTC tables for isotropic GGX (height-correlated Smith G2), 64 x 64.
// Fitted offline for this engine with the method of Heitz, Dupuy, Hill & Neubelt 2016
// ("Real-Time Polygonal-Light Shading with Linearly Transformed Cosines"):
// Nelder-Mead minimisation of the MIS-weighted L3 error between the LTC and the BRDF.
//   index  = roughnessIndex * 64 + thetaIndex
//   roughness = roughnessIndex / 63 (perceptual, alpha = roughness^2)
//   theta     : sqrt(1 - NdotV) = thetaIndex / 63
//   g_kLtcMatrix : inverse LTC matrix normalised by m11: (m00, m02, m20, m22),
//                  M^-1 = [[m00, 0, m02], [0, 1, 0], [m20, 0, m22]] in the frame (T1, T2, N)
//                  with V = (sin, 0, cos).
//   g_kLtcAmplitude : (integral of BRDF*cos, integral of BRDF*cos*(1 - V.H)^5)
//                     = split-sum DFG: Fss*Ess = F0 * (x - y) + y.
// =============================================================================================
namespace LtcTables
{
constexpr unsigned g_kSize = 64;

	uint64_t HashGeometry(const void* data, size_t size)
	{
		uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
		const auto* bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
		for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
		{
			hash ^= bytes[i];
			hash *= 1099511628211ull;
		}
		return hash;
	}

	struct MaterialPartShaderConstants
	{
		XMFLOAT4 Basic{};
		XMFLOAT4 Base{};
		XMFLOAT4 Shadow0{};
		XMFLOAT4 Shadow1{};
		XMFLOAT4 Highlight{};
		XMFLOAT4 RimStyle{};
		XMFLOAT4 RimLight{};
		XMFLOAT4 Skin0{};
		XMFLOAT4 Skin1{};
	};

	struct PBRConstants
	{
		float Metallic = 0.0f;
		float Roughness = 0.5f;
		float Fresnel = 0.04f;
		float NormalBlend = 0.0f;
		float NormalBias = 0.0f;
		float BaseSaturation = 1.2f;
		float BaseBrightness = 1.0f;
		float ShadowThreshold = 0.44f;
		float ShadowSoftness = 0.045f;
		float ShadowStrength = 1.0f;
		float MidStrength = 1.0f;
		float LitStrength = 1.0f;
		float RimStrength = 0.45f;
		float RimThreshold = 0.70f;
		float RimSoftness = 0.055f;
		float RimPower = 1.0f;
		XMFLOAT3 RimColor = { 0.38f, 0.48f, 0.80f };
		float RimAlbedoBlend = 0.20f;
		float RimLightBlend = 0.35f;
		float SpecularStrength = 0.35f;
		float SpecularThreshold = 0.35f;
		float KawaiiBlend = 1.0f;
		float SkinScatterStrength = 1.0f;
		float SkinScatterWrap = 0.42f;
		float SkinBacklightStrength = 1.0f;
		float SkinRimScatterStrength = 1.0f;
		float SkinOilSpecularStrength = 1.0f;
		float SkinShadowScatter = 0.54f;
		float CastShadowThreshold = 0.28f;
		float CastShadowSoftness = 0.10f;
        // HLSL starts the next float4 at a 16-byte boundary after float3 PBRPadding.
		float Padding[4]{};
		XMFLOAT4 Transparent0 = { 1.50f, 0.98f, 0.02f, 0.035f };
		XMFLOAT4 Transparent1 = { 0.10f, 0.02f, 0.01f, 0.005f };
		MaterialPartShaderConstants PartParams[kMaterialPartParamCount]{};
        XMFLOAT4 AssetBaseColor{1, 1, 1, 1};
        XMFLOAT4 AssetSurface{1, 1, 0, 0.5f}; // Normal scale, AO strength, enabled, alpha cutoff.
        XMFLOAT4 AssetEmission{};
        XMUINT4 AssetTextures{UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, 0}; // MR, AO, emissive, surface/cull flags.
	};

	void WriteMaterialPartConstants(PBRConstants& constants, int index, const MaterialPartParams& params)
	{
		if (index < 0 || index >= kMaterialPartParamCount)
		{
			return;
		}

		constants.PartParams[index].Basic = XMFLOAT4(params.Metallic, params.Roughness, params.Fresnel, params.NormalBlend);
		constants.PartParams[index].Base = XMFLOAT4(params.NormalBias, params.BaseSaturation, params.BaseBrightness, params.KawaiiBlend);
		constants.PartParams[index].Shadow0 = XMFLOAT4(params.ShadowThreshold, params.ShadowSoftness, params.ShadowStrength, params.MidStrength);
		constants.PartParams[index].Shadow1 = XMFLOAT4(params.LitStrength, params.CastShadowThreshold, params.CastShadowSoftness, 0.0f);
		constants.PartParams[index].Highlight = XMFLOAT4(params.RimStrength, params.RimThreshold, params.SpecularStrength, params.SpecularThreshold);
		constants.PartParams[index].RimStyle = XMFLOAT4(params.RimSoftness, params.RimPower, params.RimAlbedoBlend, params.RimLightBlend);
		constants.PartParams[index].RimLight = XMFLOAT4(params.RimColor.x, params.RimColor.y, params.RimColor.z, 1.0f);
		constants.PartParams[index].Skin0 = XMFLOAT4(params.SkinScatterStrength, params.SkinScatterWrap, params.SkinBacklightStrength, params.SkinRimScatterStrength);
		constants.PartParams[index].Skin1 = XMFLOAT4(params.SkinOilSpecularStrength, params.SkinShadowScatter, 0.0f, 0.0f);
	}

	PBRConstants BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(const MaterialComponent& material)
	{
		PBRConstants constants{};
		constants.Metallic = material.Metallic;
		constants.Roughness = material.Roughness;
		constants.Fresnel = material.Fresnel;
		constants.NormalBlend = material.NormalBlend;
		constants.NormalBias = material.NormalBias;
		constants.BaseSaturation = material.BaseSaturation;
		constants.BaseBrightness = material.BaseBrightness;
		constants.ShadowThreshold = material.ShadowThreshold;
		constants.ShadowSoftness = material.ShadowSoftness;
		constants.ShadowStrength = material.ShadowStrength;
		constants.MidStrength = material.MidStrength;
		constants.LitStrength = material.LitStrength;
		constants.RimStrength = material.RimStrength;
		constants.RimThreshold = material.RimThreshold;
		constants.RimSoftness = material.RimSoftness;
		constants.RimPower = material.RimPower;
		constants.RimColor = material.RimColor;
		constants.RimAlbedoBlend = material.RimAlbedoBlend;
		constants.RimLightBlend = material.RimLightBlend;
		constants.SpecularStrength = material.SpecularStrength;
		constants.SpecularThreshold = material.SpecularThreshold;
		constants.KawaiiBlend = material.KawaiiBlend;
		constants.SkinScatterStrength = material.SkinScatterStrength;
		constants.SkinScatterWrap = material.SkinScatterWrap;
		constants.SkinBacklightStrength = material.SkinBacklightStrength;
		constants.SkinRimScatterStrength = material.SkinRimScatterStrength;
		constants.SkinOilSpecularStrength = material.SkinOilSpecularStrength;
		constants.SkinShadowScatter = material.SkinShadowScatter;
		constants.CastShadowThreshold = material.CastShadowThreshold;
		constants.CastShadowSoftness = material.CastShadowSoftness;
        constants.Padding[1] = static_cast<float>(MaterialSystem::ResolveShadowMode(material));
        constants.Padding[2] = material.ShadowCutoff;
		constants.Transparent0 = XMFLOAT4(
			max(material.IOR, 1.0f),
			clamp(material.Transmission, 0.0f, 1.0f),
			clamp(material.TransmissionRoughness, 0.0f, 1.0f),
			max(material.RefractionStrength, 0.0f));
		constants.Transparent1 = XMFLOAT4(
			max(material.Thickness, 0.0f),
			max(material.AbsorptionCoefficient.x, 0.0f),
			max(material.AbsorptionCoefficient.y, 0.0f),
			max(material.AbsorptionCoefficient.z, 0.0f));
		for (int i = 0; i < kMaterialPartParamCount; ++i)
		{
			WriteMaterialPartConstants(constants, i, material.PartParams[i]);
		}
        constants.AssetBaseColor = material.BaseColor;
        constants.AssetSurface = {material.NormalScale, material.AOStrength, 0, material.AlphaCutoff};
        if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0)
        {
            constants.AssetSurface.z = 1.0f;
        }
        constants.AssetEmission = {material.EmissiveColor.x, material.EmissiveColor.y,
            material.EmissiveColor.z, material.EmissiveIntensity};
        auto textureOffset = [](int descriptor)
        {
            if (descriptor < static_cast<int>(FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX))
            {
                return UINT32_MAX;
            }
            return static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor) - FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX;
        };
        constants.AssetTextures = {textureOffset(material.MetallicRoughnessID),
            textureOffset(material.AOTextureID), textureOffset(material.EmissiveTextureID),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(material.AssetSurface) |
            (static_cast<uint32_t>(material.DoubleSided ? MaterialCull::None : material.AssetCull) << 2) |
            // Extended shading model (MaterialSurface.hlsli: EncodeShadingModel): bits 4-6 model, 8-15 strength.
            ((min(material.ShadingModel, 7u) & 7u) << 4) |
            (static_cast<uint32_t>(clamp(material.ShadingStrength, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 255.0f + 0.5f) << 8)};
		return constants;
	}

	const MaterialComponent& GetDeferredLightingMaterial()
	{
		static MaterialComponent defaultMaterial{};
		EntityID fallbackEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
		EntityID litEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
		EntityID selfShadowEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
		EntityID toonEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;

		for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
		{
			const auto& material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
			if (material.ShaderClassMode != MaterialMode::Manual)
			{
				continue;
			}

			if (fallbackEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
			{
				fallbackEntity = entity;
			}
			if (material.ShaderClass == ShaderClass::Lit && litEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
			{
				litEntity = entity;
			}
			if (material.ShaderClass == ShaderClass::SelfShadow && selfShadowEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
			{
				selfShadowEntity = entity;
			}
			if (material.ShaderClass == ShaderClass::Toon && toonEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
			{
				toonEntity = entity;
			}
		}

		if (litEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
		{
			return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(litEntity);
		}

		if (selfShadowEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
		{
			return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(selfShadowEntity);
		}

		if (toonEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
		{
			return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(toonEntity);
		}

		if (fallbackEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
		{
			return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(fallbackEntity);
		}

		return defaultMaterial;
	}

}

GPUMaterialData MaterialBindings::BuildGpuSceneMaterial(const MaterialComponent& material)
{
    GPUMaterialData result{};
    result.BaseColor = material.BaseColor;
    result.BaseColor.w *= material.Alpha;
    result.Surface = XMFLOAT4(material.Metallic, material.Roughness, material.Fresnel, material.NormalBlend);
    result.AlbedoTextureIndex = material.TextureID >= 0 ? static_cast<uint32_t>(material.TextureID) : UINT32_MAX;
    result.NormalTextureIndex = material.NormalMapID >= 0 ? static_cast<uint32_t>(material.NormalMapID) : UINT32_MAX;
    result.Flags = (material.UseTexture ? 1u : 0u) | (MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(material) ? 2u : 0u) |
        (material.DoubleSided ? 4u : 0u);
    result.ShaderClass = static_cast<uint32_t>(material.ShaderClass);
    result.ShaderMode = static_cast<uint32_t>(material.ShaderClassMode);
    const auto constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
    static_assert(sizeof(constants) <= sizeof(result.ShadingParameters));
    result.ParameterVectorCount = (sizeof(constants) + 15) / 16;
    memcpy(result.ShadingParameters.data(), &constants, sizeof(constants));
    return result;
}

D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS MaterialBindings::GetPBRConstantBufferAddress(UINT slot)
{
	if (!m_PBRConstantBuffer)
	{
		return 0;
	}
	UINT safeSlot;
	if (slot < g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT)
	{
		safeSlot = slot;
	}
	else
	{
		safeSlot = 0;
	}
	const UINT frameSlot = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT + safeSlot;
	return m_PBRConstantBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress() +
		frameSlot * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
}

void MaterialBindings::SetMaterial(const EntityID entityID, const MaterialComponent& material)
{
	if (!m_pPBRCbvDataBegin || !m_PBRConstantBuffer || !m_CommandList)
	{
		return;
	}

	UINT slot;
	if (entityID < g_kMAX_ENTITIES)
	{
		slot = entityID + 1;
	}
	else
	{
		slot = 0;
	}
	PBRConstants constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
	static_assert(sizeof(constants) <= g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE,
		"Material constants must fit within one per-entity frame slot");
    static_assert(offsetof(PBRConstants, AssetBaseColor) == 146 * 16);
    const auto textureHeap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
    if (textureHeap)
    {
        m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(18, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
            textureHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX,
            FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    }
    if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0)
    {
        auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(material.RuntimeHandle);
        if (!runtime.Constants)
        {
            const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
            const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
            if (FAILED(m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&runtime.Constants))) ||
                FAILED(runtime.Constants->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&runtime.MappedConstants))))
            {
                runtime.Error = "Failed to create material constant buffer";
                runtime.Constants.Reset();
                return;
            }
        }
        const auto frame = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
        if (runtime.UploadedRevision[frame] != runtime.Revision)
        {
            memcpy(runtime.MappedConstants + frame * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE, &constants, sizeof(constants));
            runtime.UploadedRevision[frame] = runtime.Revision;
        }
        m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(3,
            runtime.Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + frame * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE);
        return;
    }

	const UINT frameSlot = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT + slot;
	auto* dst = static_cast<UINT8*>(m_pPBRCbvDataBegin) + frameSlot * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
	memcpy(dst, &constants, sizeof(constants));
	m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(3, GetPBRConstantBufferAddress(slot));
}

bool MaterialBindings::SetPreviewMaterial(const MaterialComponent& material, ID3D12Resource* buffer, UINT textureBase,
    UINT partIndex, UINT partsPerFrame)
{
    if (!buffer) return false;
    auto constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
    constants.AssetSurface.z = 1.0f;
    auto offset = [textureBase](int descriptor)
    {
        return descriptor >= static_cast<int>(textureBase) ? static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor) - textureBase : UINT32_MAX;
    };
    constants.AssetTextures.x = offset(material.MetallicRoughnessID);
    constants.AssetTextures.y = offset(material.AOTextureID);
    constants.AssetTextures.z = offset(material.EmissiveTextureID);
    uint8_t* mapped = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(buffer->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&mapped)))) return false;
    const auto frameOffset = (GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * partsPerFrame + partIndex) * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
    memcpy(mapped + frameOffset, &constants, sizeof(constants));
    buffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(3, buffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + frameOffset);
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(18, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(
        FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), textureBase, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    return true;
}

uint64_t MaterialBindings::GetMaterialBatchHash(const MaterialComponent& material)
{
	const PBRConstants constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
	uint64_t hash = HashGeometry(&constants, sizeof(constants));
	struct BatchMaterialState
	{
		int ShaderMode = 0;
		int ShaderClassValue = 0;
		float Alpha = 1.0f;
		UINT IsTransparent = 0;
		UINT UseTexture = 0;
		UINT UseNormalMap = 0;
	} state{};
	state.ShaderMode = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClassMode);
	state.ShaderClassValue = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClass);
	state.Alpha = material.Alpha;
	state.IsTransparent = static_cast<UINT>(material.IsTransparent);
	state.UseTexture = static_cast<UINT>(material.UseTexture);
	state.UseNormalMap = static_cast<UINT>(material.NormalMapID >= 0);
	const uint64_t stateHash = HashGeometry(&state, sizeof(state));

	hash ^= stateHash + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull + (hash << 6) + (hash >> 2);
	return hash;
}

void MaterialBindings::BindAssetSlot(EntityID entity, const MaterialComponent& material, int modelTexture)
{
    ConstantBuffer3D constants;
    memcpy(&constants, FrameConstants::GetConstantBufferPtr() + entity * FrameConstants::g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE, sizeof(constants));
    constants.UseTexture = static_cast<int>(material.UseTexture);
    const bool useModelTexture = material.RuntimeHandle == 0 && modelTexture >= 0;
    if (useModelTexture)
    {
        constants.UseTexture = 1;
    }
    constants.UseNormalMap = static_cast<int>(material.NormalMapID >= 0);
    constants.MaterialMode = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClassMode);
    constants.ShaderClass = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClass);
    constants.MaterialMetallic = material.Metallic;
    constants.MaterialRoughness = material.Roughness;
    constants.MaterialFresnel = material.Fresnel;
    constants.MaterialAlpha = material.Alpha;
    constants.MaterialIsTransparent = static_cast<int>(material.IsTransparent);
    if (TransmittanceShadows::IsActive())
    {
        bool thinSheet = false;
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity))
            thinSheet = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity).Is3D;
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
            const auto& extents = mesh.LocalBoundsExtents;
            thinSheet |= mesh.HasLocalBounds && min(extents.x, min(extents.y, extents.z)) < 0.000001f;
        }
        if (thinSheet) constants.MaterialIsTransparent |= 2;
    }
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(constants));
    SetMaterial(entity, material);
    int base = TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex();
    int normal = base;
    if (material.TextureID >= 0)
    {
        base = material.TextureID;
    }
    if (useModelTexture)
    {
        base = modelTexture;
    }
    if (material.NormalMapID >= 0)
    {
        normal = material.NormalMapID;
    }
    const auto heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(1, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, base, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(6, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, normal, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    for (int descriptor : {base, normal, material.MetallicRoughnessID, material.AOTextureID, material.EmissiveTextureID})
    {
        if (descriptor >= 0)
        {
            TextureManager::TouchTexture(descriptor);
        }
    }
}

void MaterialBindings::UpdateDeferredLightingMaterial()
{
	if (m_pPBRCbvDataBegin)
	{
		PBRConstants pbrConstants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(GetDeferredLightingMaterial());
		auto* pbrDst = static_cast<UINT8*>(m_pPBRCbvDataBegin) +
			GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
		memcpy(pbrDst, &pbrConstants, sizeof(pbrConstants));
	}
}

constexpr UINT previewSize = 512;
constexpr UINT constantBytes = 32768; // Matches the production light buffer's reserved size.
struct PreviewState : RendererState
{
    UINT Size = previewSize;
    UINT SrvIndex = g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> PreviewConstants;
    XMFLOAT3 Center{};
    float Near = 0.05f;
    float Far = 100.0f;
    bool Visible = false;
    AssetHandle Material = 0;
    int Shape = 0;
    float Yaw = 0.45f;
    float Pitch = 0.2f;
    float Distance = 4.5f;
    float LightIntensity = 2.0f;
    bool SceneEnvironment = false;
    string Error;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Target;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Depth;
    ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> RTVHeap;
    ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> DSVHeap;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Lights;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> OpticsGlobals;
    uint8_t* MappedOpticsGlobals = nullptr;
    uint8_t* MappedLights = nullptr;
    array<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>, 3> Vertices;
    array<D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW, 3> Views{};
    array<UINT, 3> Counts{};
    array<ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>, 24> Pipelines;
    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE CpuSrv() const
    {
        return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
            SrvIndex, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize());
    }
    D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GpuSrv() const
    {
        return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
            SrvIndex, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize());
    }
    bool Initialize();
    ID3D12PipelineState* Pipeline(const MaterialComponent& material);
};
PreviewState preview;

StaticModelVertex Vertex(float x, float y, float z, float nx, float ny, float nz, float u, float v)
{
    return {{x, y, z}, {nx, ny, nz}, {u, v}, {1, 1, 1, 11}};
}

void Triangle(vector<StaticModelVertex>& vertices, StaticModelVertex first,
    StaticModelVertex second, StaticModelVertex third)
{
    const auto edge1 = XMVectorSubtract(XMLoadFloat3(&second.Position), XMLoadFloat3(&first.Position));
    const auto edge2 = XMVectorSubtract(XMLoadFloat3(&third.Position), XMLoadFloat3(&first.Position));
    if (XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Dot(XMVector3Cross(edge1, edge2), XMLoadFloat3(&first.Normal))) < 0)
    {
        swap(second, third);
    }
    vertices.push_back(first);
    vertices.push_back(second);
    vertices.push_back(third);
}

vector<StaticModelVertex> MakeGeometry(int shape)
{
    vector<StaticModelVertex> vertices;
    if (shape == 0)
    {
        auto sphereVertex = [](int latitude, int longitude)
        {
            const float u = longitude / 32.0f;
            const float v = latitude / 16.0f;
            const float angle = u * XM_2PI;
            const float polar = v * XM_PI;
            const float x = sinf(polar) * cosf(angle);
            const float y = cosf(polar);
            const float z = sinf(polar) * sinf(angle);
            return Vertex(x, y, z, x, y, z, u, v);
        };
        for (int latitude = 0; latitude < 16; ++latitude)
        {
            for (int longitude = 0; longitude < 32; ++longitude)
            {
                const auto first = sphereVertex(latitude, longitude);
                const auto second = sphereVertex(latitude + 1, longitude);
                const auto third = sphereVertex(latitude + 1, longitude + 1);
                const auto fourth = sphereVertex(latitude, longitude + 1);
                Triangle(vertices, first, second, third);
                Triangle(vertices, first, third, fourth);
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        const int faces = 6;
        for (int face = 0; face < faces; ++face)
        {
            if (shape == 2 && face != 4)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const int axis = face / 2;
            float direction = -1.0f;
            if ((face & 1) != 0)
            {
                direction = 1.0f;
            }
            array<StaticModelVertex, 4> corners;
            for (int corner = 0; corner < 4; ++corner)
            {
                float position[3]{};
                float normal[3]{};
                position[axis] = direction;
                normal[axis] = direction;
                position[(axis + 1) % 3] = ((corner & 1) != 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
                position[(axis + 2) % 3] = ((corner & 2) != 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
                if (shape == 2)
                {
                    position[axis] = 0;
                }
                corners[corner] = Vertex(position[0], position[1], position[2], normal[0], normal[1], normal[2],
                    static_cast<float>(corner & 1), static_cast<float>((corner >> 1) & 1));
            }
            Triangle(vertices, corners[0], corners[1], corners[2]);
            Triangle(vertices, corners[1], corners[3], corners[2]);
        }
    }
    return vertices;
}

bool PreviewState::Initialize()
{
    if (Target)
    {
        return true;
    }
    auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    if (!device)
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto defaultHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    auto target = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(GetSceneColorFormat(), Size, Size, 1, 1, 1, 0,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET);
    D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE clear{};
    clear.Format = target.Format;
    clear.Color[0] = 0.12f;
    clear.Color[1] = 0.13f;
    clear.Color[2] = 0.16f;
    clear.Color[3] = 1;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &target,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, &clear, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Target))))
    {
        Error = "Failed to create material preview target";
        return false;
    }
    target.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    target.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL;
    clear.Format = target.Format;
    clear.DepthStencil.Depth = 1;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &target,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE, &clear, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Depth))))
    {
        Error = "Failed to create preview depth";
        Target.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC heap{};
    heap.NumDescriptors = 1;
    heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&RTVHeap))))
    {
        Target.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_DSV;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&DSVHeap))))
    {
        Target.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    device->CreateRenderTargetView(Target.Get(), nullptr, RTVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
    device->CreateDepthStencilView(Depth.Get(), nullptr, DSVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
    srv.Format = Target->GetDesc().Format;
    srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
    device->CreateShaderResourceView(Target.Get(), &srv, CpuSrv());
    const auto uploadHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto lightDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(constantBytes * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &lightDescription,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Lights))) ||
        FAILED(Lights->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&MappedLights))))
    {
        Error = "Failed to create preview lighting constants";
        Target.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    memset(MappedLights, 0, constantBytes * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    // b5 contains flags, parameters and 160 light flags: 2592 bytes, aligned to 2816.
    const auto opticsDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(2816 * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &opticsDescription,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&OpticsGlobals))) ||
        FAILED(OpticsGlobals->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&MappedOpticsGlobals))))
    {
        Error = "Failed to create material optics preview constants";
        Target.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    memset(MappedOpticsGlobals, 0, 2816 * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    const int shapeCount = SrvIndex == g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX ? 3 : 1;
    for (int shape = 0; shape < shapeCount; ++shape)
    {
        const auto vertices = MakeGeometry(shape);
        const UINT bytes = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size() * sizeof(StaticModelVertex));
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Vertices[shape]))))
        {
            Error = "Failed to create preview mesh";
            Target.Reset();
            return false;
        }
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(Vertices[shape]->Map(0, nullptr, &mapped)))
        {
            Target.Reset();
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(mapped, vertices.data(), bytes);
        Vertices[shape]->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        Counts[shape] = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size());
        Views[shape] = {Vertices[shape]->GetGPUVirtualAddress(), bytes, sizeof(StaticModelVertex)};
    }
    return true;
}

ID3D12PipelineState* PreviewState::Pipeline(const MaterialComponent& material)
{
    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(material.AssetCull);
    if (!material.AssetDepthWrite || material.IsTransparent)
    {
        index += 3;
    }
    if (material.IsTransparent)
    {
        index += 6;
    }
    if (SrvIndex == g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX && material.Transmission > 0.0f) index += 12;
    if (Pipelines[index])
    {
        return Pipelines[index].Get();
    }
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> vertex;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> pixel;
    ShaderDescription shader;
    shader.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderVS.cso";
    shader.ppBlob = vertex.GetAddressOf();
    if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shader))
    {
        Error = "Preview failed to load production vertex shader";
        return nullptr;
    }
    shader.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderPS.cso";
    shader.ppBlob = pixel.GetAddressOf();
    if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shader))
    {
        Error = "Preview failed to load production PBR shader";
        return nullptr;
    }
    D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC description{};
    description.pRootSignature = ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature();
    description.VS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(vertex.Get());
    description.PS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(pixel.Get());
    description.RasterizerState = CD3DX12_RASTERIZER_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    if (material.AssetCull == MaterialCull::None)
    {
        description.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
    }
    else if (material.AssetCull == MaterialCull::Front)
    {
        description.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_FRONT;
    }
    description.DepthStencilState = CD3DX12_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    if (!material.AssetDepthWrite || material.IsTransparent)
    {
        description.DepthStencilState.DepthWriteMask = D3D12_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ZERO;
    }
    if (SrvIndex == g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX && material.Transmission > 0.0f)
    {
        description.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_BACK;
        description.DepthStencilState.DepthWriteMask = D3D12_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ALL;
    }
    description.BlendState = CD3DX12_BLEND_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
    if (material.IsTransparent)
    {
        auto& blend = description.BlendState.RenderTarget[0];
        blend.BlendEnable = TRUE;
        blend.SrcBlend = D3D12_BLEND_ONE;
        blend.DestBlend = D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA;
        blend.SrcBlendAlpha = D3D12_BLEND_ONE;
        blend.DestBlendAlpha = D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA;
    }
    description.SampleMask = UINT_MAX;
    description.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
    description.NumRenderTargets = 1;
    description.RTVFormats[0] = Target->GetDesc().Format;
    description.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    description.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    const D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC layout[] = {
        {"POSITION", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, 0, 0, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        {"NORMAL", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, 0, 12, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        {"TEXCOORD", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, 0, 24, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        {"COLOR", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0, 32, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0}};
    description.InputLayout = {layout, 4};
    if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(&description, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Pipelines[index]))))
    {
        Error = "Failed to create production preview PSO";
        return nullptr;
    }
    return Pipelines[index].Get();
}
}

    preview.Visible = visible;

void MaterialPreview::DrawControls()
{
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(95);
    ImGui::Combo("##PreviewMesh", &preview.Shape, "Sphere\0Cube\0Plane\0");
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Reset Camera"))
    {
        preview.Yaw = 0.45f;
        preview.Pitch = 0.2f;
        preview.Distance = 4.5f;
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(95);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("Light", &preview.LightIntensity, 0, 5);
    ImGui::SameLine();
    const bool glassMaterial = preview.Material != 0 &&
        MaterialManager::GetRuntime(preview.Material).Binding.Transmission > 0.0f;
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(glassMaterial);
    ImGui::Checkbox("Scene IBL", &preview.SceneEnvironment);
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if (glassMaterial) ImGui::SetItemTooltip("IBL is disabled for transmissive glass. Direct lighting and refracted background remain enabled.");
}

void MaterialPreview::DrawImage(AssetHandle material)
{
    preview.Material = material;
    preview.Visible = true;
    if (!preview.Initialize())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", preview.Error.c_str());
        return;
    }
    const auto available = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail();
    const float side = min(available.x, available.y);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FramePadding, ImVec2(0, 0));
    ImGui::ImageButton("##PreviewOrbit", reinterpret_cast<ImTextureData*>(preview.GpuSrv().ptr),
        ImVec2(side, side), ImVec2(0, 0), ImVec2(1, 1), ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0));
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    const auto imageMinimum = ImGui::GetItemRectMin();
    const auto imageMaximum = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
    MaterialValidation::CaptureDropTarget("Preview", imageMinimum.x, imageMinimum.y, imageMaximum.x, imageMaximum.y);
    if (ImGui::IsItemActive() && ImGui::IsMouseDragging(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
    {
        const auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        preview.Yaw += input.MouseDelta.x * 0.01f;
        preview.Pitch = clamp(preview.Pitch + input.MouseDelta.y * 0.01f, -1.4f, 1.4f);
    }
    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
    {
        auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        preview.Distance = clamp(preview.Distance - input.MouseWheel * 0.25f, 1.5f, 12.0f);
    }
    if (!preview.Error.empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", preview.Error.c_str());
    }
}

namespace
{
bool RenderPreview(PreviewState& preview, const MaterialComponent& material,
    UINT firstVertex = 0, UINT vertexCount = 0, UINT partIndex = 0, UINT partCount = 1)
{
    auto* pipeline = preview.Pipeline(material);
    if (!pipeline) return false;
    auto* commands = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
    auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(preview.Target.Get(),
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
    if (partIndex == 0) commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    const auto rtv = preview.RTVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    const auto dsv = preview.DSVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    const float background[4] = {0.12f, 0.13f, 0.16f, 1};
    if (partIndex == 0)
    {
        commands->ClearRenderTargetView(rtv, background, 0, nullptr);
        commands->ClearDepthStencilView(dsv, D3D12_CLEAR_FLAG_DEPTH, 1, 0, 0, nullptr);
    }
    commands->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &rtv, FALSE, &dsv);
    const D3D12_VIEWPORT viewport = {0, 0, static_cast<float>(preview.Size), static_cast<float>(preview.Size), 0, 1};
    const D3D12_RECT scissor = {0, 0, static_cast<LONG>(preview.Size), static_cast<LONG>(preview.Size)};
    commands->RSSetViewports(1, &viewport);
    commands->RSSetScissorRects(1, &scissor);
    ScenePasses::BeginPass(ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature(), D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
    commands->SetPipelineState(pipeline);
    auto* lights = reinterpret_cast<XMFLOAT4*>(preview.MappedLights + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * constantBytes);
    memset(lights, 0, constantBytes);
    lights[0] = {-0.5f, 0.7f, -0.8f, 0};
    lights[1] = {1.0f, 0.96f, 0.9f, preview.LightIntensity};
    lights[4] = {1, 0, 0, 0};
    lights[5] = lights[0];
    lights[5 + RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS] = lights[1];
    // Match LightParams in common.hlsl: four vector arrays, then one matrix array.
    constexpr size_t shadowDataOffset = 5 + 8 * RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS;
    constexpr size_t flagsOffset = shadowDataOffset + RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS;
    lights[shadowDataOffset] = {-1, 0, 0, 0}; // The studio light has no scene shadow map.
    lights[flagsOffset] = {1, 1, 0, 0}; // Enable physical lighting in opaque and forward passes.
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(2, preview.Lights->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * constantBytes);
    // Zero shadow and ray flags for this isolated preview scene.
    const auto zeroAddress = preview.Lights->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * constantBytes + constantBytes - 256;
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(5, zeroAddress);
    auto* optics = reinterpret_cast<XMFLOAT4*>(preview.MappedOpticsGlobals + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * 2816);
    memset(optics, 0, 2816);
    if (preview.SrvIndex == RendererState::g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX)
        optics[1] = {preview.SceneEnvironment && material.Transmission <= 0.0f ? 1.0f : 0.0f, preview.LightIntensity,
            static_cast<float>(preview.Shape + 1), 1.0f};
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(17, preview.OpticsGlobals->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * 2816);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(26, zeroAddress);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(27, zeroAddress);
    const XMFLOAT3 eye = {sinf(preview.Yaw) * cosf(preview.Pitch) * preview.Distance + preview.Center.x,
        sinf(preview.Pitch) * preview.Distance + preview.Center.y, -cosf(preview.Yaw) * cosf(preview.Pitch) * preview.Distance + preview.Center.z};
    ConstantBuffer3D constants;
    constants.World = XMMatrixIdentity();
    constants.View = XMMatrixTranspose(XMMatrixLookAtLH(XMLoadFloat3(&eye), XMLoadFloat3(&preview.Center), XMVectorSet(0, 1, 0, 0)));
    constants.Projection = XMMatrixTranspose(XMMatrixPerspectiveFovLH(XM_PIDIV4, 1, preview.Near, preview.Far));
    constants.CameraPos = eye;
    constants.UseTexture = material.UseTexture;
    constants.UseNormalMap = material.NormalMapID >= 0;
    constants.MaterialMode = 1;
    constants.ShaderClass = static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::PBR);
    constants.MaterialMetallic = material.Metallic;
    constants.MaterialRoughness = material.Roughness;
    constants.MaterialFresnel = material.Fresnel;
    constants.MaterialAlpha = material.Alpha;
    constants.ViewportSize = {static_cast<float>(preview.Size), static_cast<float>(preview.Size)};
    constants.MaterialIsTransparent = material.IsTransparent;
    const auto drawConstants = FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(constants);
    if (!drawConstants.ptr)
    {
        preview.Error = "Preview frame constant budget exhausted";
        const auto restore = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(preview.Target.Get(),
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &restore);
        return false;
    }
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, drawConstants);
    if (preview.PreviewConstants)
    {
        if (!MaterialBindings::SetPreviewMaterial(material, preview.PreviewConstants.Get(), RendererState::g_kTHUMBNAIL_DESCRIPTOR_START, partIndex, partCount)) return false;
    }
    else MaterialBindings::SetMaterial(g_kINVALID_ENTITY, material);
    const auto heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    const auto increment = FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize();
    int albedo = TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex();
    int normal = albedo;
    if (material.TextureID >= 0)
    {
        albedo = material.TextureID;
    }
    if (material.NormalMapID >= 0)
    {
        normal = material.NormalMapID;
    }
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(1, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, albedo, increment));
    commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(6, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, normal, increment));
    if (!preview.SceneEnvironment || material.Transmission > 0.0f)
    {
        commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(7, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap,
            TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex(), increment));
    }
    commands->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, &preview.Views[preview.Shape]);
    commands->IASetIndexBuffer(nullptr);
    commands->DrawInstanced(vertexCount ? vertexCount : preview.Counts[preview.Shape], 1, firstVertex, 0);
    barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(preview.Target.Get(),
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    if (partIndex + 1 == partCount) commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    return true;
}

}

void MaterialPreview::Render()
{
    if (!preview.Visible || !preview.Material || !preview.Initialize()) return;
    auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(preview.Material);
    for (int texture : runtime.TextureDescriptors)
    {
        if (texture >= 0) TextureManager::TouchTexture(texture);
    }
    RenderPreview(preview, runtime.Binding);
}

void MaterialPreview::Shutdown()
{
    preview = PreviewState{};
}

ID3D12Resource* MaterialPreview::GetTarget()
{
    return preview.Target.Get();
}

void MaterialPreview::SetMesh(Mesh mesh)
{
    preview.Shape = static_cast<int>(mesh);
}

void MaterialPreview::SetLightIntensity(float intensity)
{
    preview.LightIntensity = clamp(intensity, 0.0f, 5.0f);
}

struct ThumbnailPreviewContext::Impl
{
    PreviewState State;
    bool GeometryUploaded = false;
    UINT MaterialSlots = 1;
};

ThumbnailPreviewContext::ThumbnailPreviewContext() : m_Impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}
ThumbnailPreviewContext::~ThumbnailPreviewContext() = default;

bool ThumbnailPreviewContext::Initialize(UINT size, UINT descriptorIndex)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    state.Size = size;
    state.SrvIndex = descriptorIndex;
    state.SceneEnvironment = false;
    const auto sphereFit = FitThumbnailCamera(1.0f);
    state.Distance = sphereFit.Distance;
    state.Near = sphereFit.Near;
    state.Far = sphereFit.Far;
    if (!state.Initialize()) return false;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(RendererState::g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    return SUCCEEDED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
        &description, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.PreviewConstants)));
}

bool ThumbnailPreviewContext::Render(const MaterialComponent& material, const std::vector<StaticModelVertex>& geometry,
    const std::vector<ThumbnailPreviewPart>& parts)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    if (!geometry.empty() && !m_Impl->GeometryUploaded)
    {
        XMFLOAT3 low = geometry.front().Position;
        XMFLOAT3 high = low;
        for (const auto& vertex : geometry)
        {
            const auto p = vertex.Position;
            if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z)) return false;
            low = {std::min(low.x, p.x), std::min(low.y, p.y), std::min(low.z, p.z)};
            high = {std::max(high.x, p.x), std::max(high.y, p.y), std::max(high.z, p.z)};
        }
        state.Center = {(low.x + high.x) * 0.5f, (low.y + high.y) * 0.5f, (low.z + high.z) * 0.5f};
        const float x = (high.x - low.x) * 0.5f, y = (high.y - low.y) * 0.5f, z = (high.z - low.z) * 0.5f;
        const auto fit = FitThumbnailCamera(std::sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z));
        if (!fit.Valid || geometry.size() > UINT_MAX / sizeof(StaticModelVertex)) return false;
        state.Distance = fit.Distance;
        state.Near = fit.Near;
        state.Far = fit.Far;
        const UINT bytes = static_cast<UINT>(geometry.size() * sizeof(StaticModelVertex));
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
        state.Vertices[0].Reset();
        if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
            &description, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.Vertices[0])))) return false;
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(state.Vertices[0]->Map(0, nullptr, &mapped))) return false;
        memcpy(mapped, geometry.data(), bytes);
        state.Vertices[0]->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        state.Views[0] = {state.Vertices[0]->GetGPUVirtualAddress(), bytes, sizeof(StaticModelVertex)};
        state.Counts[0] = static_cast<UINT>(geometry.size());
        m_Impl->GeometryUploaded = true;
    }
    if (parts.empty()) return RenderPreview(state, material);
    const UINT count = static_cast<UINT>(parts.size());
    if (m_Impl->MaterialSlots != count)
    {
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(RendererState::g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT * static_cast<UINT64>(count));
        state.PreviewConstants.Reset();
        if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
            &description, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.PreviewConstants)))) return false;
        m_Impl->MaterialSlots = count;
    }
    // Resolve pipelines before recording any pass; a failed material cannot leave the target half rendered.
    for (const auto& part : parts) if (!state.Pipeline(part.Material)) return false;
    for (UINT index = 0; index < count; ++index)
    {
        const auto& part = parts[index];
        if (!RenderPreview(state, part.Material, part.FirstVertex, part.VertexCount, index, count)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

ID3D12Resource* ThumbnailPreviewContext::GetTarget() const { return m_Impl->State.Target.Get(); }
uint64_t ThumbnailPreviewContext::MemoryBytes() const
{
    const auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    uint64_t bytes = 0;
    const auto add = [&bytes](const ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource)
    {
        if (!resource) return;
        const auto description = resource->GetDesc();
        bytes += GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->GetResourceAllocationInfo(0, 1, &description).SizeInBytes;
    };
    add(state.Target);
    add(state.Depth);
    add(state.Lights);
    add(state.OpticsGlobals);
    add(state.PreviewConstants);
    for (const auto& buffer : state.Vertices) add(buffer);
    return bytes;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\megalights.h =====
#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// MegaLights
//   M1：ライトバッファ + クラスター（フロクセル）ライトグリッド（ML0 / ML1）
//   M2：確率的ライトサンプリング（ML3）+ 影レイ（ML5）。シェーディング（ML6）は DeferredLightingPS
//       ・検証用：リファレンスモード（全ライト × 面上の複数点の影レイ）、静止時の累積平均、RMSE
//   M3：デノイズ（ML8）。MegaLightsShadePS が ML6 の結果をデモジュレートして書き、
//       時間方向（リプロジェクト + モーメント）→ À-Trous（分散で輝度の許容を決める）→ ディファードで掛け戻す
//   M4：可視ライトハッシュによるガイド（ML7）。8x8 タイルごとに「前フレームに影レイが通ったライト」の
//       128bit ブルームフィルタを持ち、載っていないライトの選択確率を下げる（確率に入れるので不偏のまま）
//   M5：タイル分類（ML2）+ コンパクション + スクリーントレース（ML4）
//       サンプリングは対象タイルだけを間接ディスパッチ、影レイは「必要なサンプルだけ」を詰めたリストで間接ディスパッチ。
//       ワールドトレースの前に深度バッファを短くマーチし、遮蔽が見つかったサンプルはレイを飛ばさない
//   M6：NRD（REBLUR_DIFFUSE）でのデノイズ（自前の SVGF と切り替え）、フロクセルフォグの MegaLights 化
//       フォグはグリッドを「視錐台の手前側も含めて」構築し、フロクセルごとにセルのライトから確率的に選ぶ（上限 32 灯を撤廃）
//   M7：Forward / 半透明（OIT 含む）からのグリッド参照、テクスチャ付き矩形ライト
//   半解像度サンプリング：サンプル空間を画面の 1/2 にし、各サンプルは 2x2 の代表ピクセル（毎フレーム回転）で作る。
//       ディファードは近傍 2x2 のサンプルを深度・法線で重み付けして使う（近似）
//   設計書: MegaLights_Design.md / MegaLights_M2_Design.md
//   ・ローカルライト（Point / Spot / Rect）を StructuredBuffer に載せる（最大 4096 灯）
//   ・16px タイル × 32 スライスのセルごとにライトリストを GPU で構築
//   ・シャドウマップを持つライト / ディレクショナル / Decal / Volume は従来の経路のまま
//   ヘッダーのみ（.vcxproj への追加不要）。シェーダーは実行時に DXC でコンパイルする。
// =============================================================================================
#include "pch.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "raytracing.h"
#include "nrddenoiser.h"
#include <memory>
#include "camera.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

class MegaLights final
{
public:
	enum class Mode : int
	{
		Deterministic = 0, // M1：セル内の全ライトを評価
		Stochastic = 1,    // M2：N 個のサンプル + 影レイ（PBR 面のみ。DXR が必要）
		Reference = 2,     // 検証：全ライト × 面上の複数点の影レイ（PBR 面のみ。DXR が必要）
	};

	struct Settings
	{
		bool Enabled = false;       // ディファード時のローカルライトをクラスターグリッドで評価する
		int DebugView = 0;          // 0: なし, 1: セルのライト数, 2: 奥行きスライス, 3: 選ばれたライト, 4: 可視率, 5: 1/p, 6: 累積平均, 7: リファレンスとの差
		float SliceFar = 500.0f;    // スライス分割の奥行き上限（m）。これより奥は最後のスライスにまとめる
		int HeatmapMax = 32;        // ライト数ヒートマップの上限
		// ---- M2
		int EvaluationMode = static_cast<int>(Mode::Deterministic);
		int SamplesPerPixel = 2;    // 1 / 2 / 4（解像度に応じて自動で下げる）
		bool HalfResolution = false; // 半解像度サンプリング（サンプル数・影レイが 1/4）
		// ---- M7
		bool Translucency = true;   // Forward / 半透明もグリッドで評価する（グリッドを視錐台全体で構築）
		float UniformMix = 0.1f;    // 一様選択の混合率 α（見積もりが外れても確率を 0 にしない）
		int ReferenceRays = 16;     // リファレンスの影レイ数（面光源・球ライト）
		float InvPdfDisplayMax = 64.0f;
		bool Accumulate = false;    // 静止時の累積平均（検証用）
		// ---- M4（可視ライトハッシュ）
		bool Guide = true;
		float GuideMinWeight = 0.1f; // ハッシュに載っていないライトの重み（0 より大きく。遮られがちなライトも時々調べる）
		float GuideKeep = 0.875f;    // 前フレームのハッシュのビットを残す確率（1 - 減衰）
		// ---- M5（スクリーントレース）
		// ---- M6
		int Denoiser = 0;            // 0: 自前（SVGF）, 1: NRD（REBLUR）。NRD が使えなければ自前に戻す
		bool VolumetricFog = true;   // フロクセルフォグのローカルライトを MegaLights で評価する
		int FogSamples = 2;          // フロクセルあたりのライトサンプル数（1〜4）
		bool ScreenTrace = true;
		int ScreenTraceSteps = 12;
		float ScreenTraceMaxPixels = 64.0f; // マーチする最大距離（ピクセル）
		float ScreenTraceThickness = 0.25f; // 深度バッファの面の厚みの仮定（m）
		float ScreenTraceSelfPixels = 1.5f; // 始点からこのピクセル数以内は調べない（自己遮蔽よけ）
		// ---- M3（デノイズ）
		bool Denoise = true;
		int DenoiseIterations = 3;  // À-Trous の回数（間隔 1, 2, 4, ...）
		int MaxHistory = 32;        // 時間方向の履歴の上限（フレーム）
		int AntiLagHistory = 4;     // ライトが変わったフレームの履歴の上限
		bool FireflySuppression = true;
		bool HistoryFeedback = true; // À-Trous の 1 回目を履歴へ書き戻す
		float AlphaMin = 0.05f;
		float MomentsAlphaMin = 0.2f;
		float DepthTolerance = 0.1f;
		float NormalThreshold = 0.9f;
		float PhiNormal = 64.0f;
		float PhiLuminance = 4.0f;
		float PhiPlane = 2.0f;
	};

	struct Stats
	{
		UINT SubmittedLights = 0;   // グリッドに載せたライト
		UINT DroppedLights = 0;     // 上限（4096）を超えて載せられなかったライト
		UINT TilesX = 0, TilesY = 0, Slices = 0;
		UINT CoarseIndices = 0, FineIndices = 0; // 数フレーム前の GPU 実測
		UINT OverflowCells = 0, MaxLightsPerCell = 0;
		bool Built = false;
		// ---- M2
		Mode ActiveMode = Mode::Deterministic; // このフレームに実際に使った評価方式
		const char* FallbackReason = nullptr;   // 要求した方式が使えなかった理由
		UINT SamplesPerPixel = 0;
		double SampleBufferMB = 0.0;
		UINT AccumulatedFrames = 0;
		bool HasReference = false;
		bool ErrorValid = false;
		double RelativeRmse = 0.0;  // sqrt(Σ(acc - ref)² / Σref²)（輝度）
		UINT ErrorFrames = 0;       // RMSE を測ったときの累積フレーム数
		// ---- M3
		bool Denoised = false;
		bool AntiLag = false;
		bool HistoryReset = false;
		double DenoiseBufferMB = 0.0;
		const char* DenoiseFallback = nullptr;
		// ---- M4
		bool Guided = false;        // このフレームのサンプリングでハッシュを使った
		bool HashValid = false;     // 前フレームのハッシュが使える
		UINT HashTilesX = 0, HashTilesY = 0;
		// ---- M5（数フレーム前の GPU 実測）
		UINT ActiveTiles = 0, TotalTiles = 0;
		UINT TraceRequests = 0;   // 影レイが必要だったサンプル
		UINT ScreenHits = 0;      // スクリーントレースで遮蔽が見つかった（ワールドトレース不要）
		UINT WorldTraces = 0;     // ワールドトレースしたサンプル
		bool TraceStatsValid = false;
		// ---- M6
		const char* DenoiserUsed = nullptr; // このフレームに使ったデノイザー
		const char* NrdFallback = nullptr;
		bool VolumetricGrid = false;        // フォグ用にグリッドを視錐台全体で構築した
		// ---- M7 / 半解像度
		bool ForwardGrid = false;           // Forward / 半透明がグリッドを使う
		UINT SampleWidth = 0, SampleHeight = 0, SampleScale = 1;
	};

	// HLSL の MegaLightData と同じ並び（80 byte）
	struct GpuLight
	{
		XMFLOAT4 PositionType;
		XMFLOAT4 DirectionRange;
		XMFLOAT4 Color;
		XMFLOAT4 Extra;
		XMFLOAT4 Flags; // x: 影を落とす, y: ソース半径, z: Entity ID（uint のビット。可視ライトハッシュのキー）
	};
	static_assert(sizeof(GpuLight) == 80, "MegaLightData layout mismatch");

	static constexpr UINT kMaxLights = 4096;
	static constexpr UINT kTileSize = 16;
	static constexpr UINT kSlices = 32;
	static constexpr UINT kCoarseTiles = 4;
	static constexpr UINT kCoarseSlices = 4;
	static constexpr UINT kCoarseCapacity = 1u << 20; // 粗リスト（uint）: 4 MB
	static constexpr UINT kFineCapacity = 1u << 22;   // 細リスト（uint）: 16 MB
	static constexpr UINT kMaxSamplesPerPixel = 4;
	static constexpr UINT64 kSampleBudgetBytes = 160ull << 20; // サンプルバッファの上限（N を自動で下げる）
	static constexpr UINT kFrames = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;

	static Settings& GetSettings() { return s_Settings; }
	static const Stats& GetStats() { return s_Stats; }
	static bool IsAvailable() { return s_Available; }
	static bool IsStochasticAvailable() { return s_Available && s_SampleAvailable; }
	// CPU 側でライトをグリッドへ振り分けるか（このフレームの判断）
	static bool IsEnabled() { return s_Available && s_Settings.Enabled; }

	// 検証の操作（UI から）
	static void RequestAccumulationReset() { s_ResetRequested = true; }
	static void RequestSaveReference() { s_SaveReferenceRequested = true; }
	static void ClearReference() { s_HasReference = false; s_Stats.HasReference = false; s_Stats.ErrorValid = false; }
	static void RequestHistoryReset() { s_DenoiseResetRequested = true; s_HashResetRequested = true; }
	static void RequestHashReset() { s_HashResetRequested = true; }
	static bool IsDenoiseAvailable() { return s_Available && s_DenoiseAvailable && !s_ShadeFailed; }

	static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device)
	{
		Shutdown();
		if (!device) return false;
		s_Device = device;

		// 定数バッファは最初に作る（グラフィックス側は常にこれを b10 にバインドするため、
		// シェーダーのコンパイルに失敗しても「無効」の定数を読ませられるようにする）
		if (!CreateBuffer(s_Constants, kConstantStride * kFrames, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD,
			D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, L"MegaLights Constants") ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_LightUpload, kLightStride * kFrames, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, L"MegaLights Lights") ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_Dummy, 256, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, L"MegaLights Dummy UAV"))
		{
			WriteGraphicsLog("MegaLights: upload buffers failed\n");
			Shutdown();
			return false;
		}
		const CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
		if (FAILED(s_Constants->Map(0, &noRead, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&s_MappedConstants))) ||
			FAILED(s_LightUpload->Map(0, &noRead, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&s_MappedLights))))
		{
			Shutdown();
			return false;
		}
		memset(s_MappedConstants, 0, kConstantStride * kFrames);

		if (!CreateGridPipelines(device)) return false;

		const auto uav = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
		if (!CreateBuffer(s_CoarseIndices, sizeof(UINT) * kCoarseCapacity, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, uav,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, L"MegaLights Coarse Indices") ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_FineIndices, sizeof(UINT) * kFineCapacity, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, uav,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, L"MegaLights Fine Indices") ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_Counters, 16, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, uav,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, L"MegaLights Counters") ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_LightVisible, kLightVisibleBytes, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, uav,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, L"MegaLights Light Visibility") ||
			!CreateBuffer(s_Readback, kReadbackStride * kFrames, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE,
				D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, L"MegaLights Readback"))
		{
			WriteGraphicsLog("MegaLights: grid buffers failed\n");
			ShutdownPipelines();
			return false;
		}
		s_CoarseIndicesState = s_FineIndicesState = s_CountersState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
		s_Available = true;
		// M2 / M3 は失敗しても M1 は使える
		s_SampleAvailable = CreateSamplePipelines(device);
		s_DenoiseAvailable = s_SampleAvailable && CreateDenoisePipelines(device);
		s_NrdAvailable = s_DenoiseAvailable && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() && CreateNrdPipelines(device);
		WriteGraphicsLog("MegaLights: initialized (clustered light grid, max %u lights, stochastic=%d)\n",
			kMaxLights, s_SampleAvailable ? 1 : 0);
		return true;
	}

	static void Shutdown()
	{
		ShutdownPipelines();
		if (s_Constants && s_MappedConstants) s_Constants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
		if (s_LightUpload && s_MappedLights) s_LightUpload->Unmap(0, nullptr);
		s_MappedConstants = nullptr;
		s_MappedLights = nullptr;
		s_Constants.Reset();
		s_LightUpload.Reset();
		s_Dummy.Reset();
		s_ShadePso.Reset();
		s_ShadeFailed = false;
		s_Device.Reset();
	}

	// ---- CPU：ライトの収集（LightingResources::UpdateLightConstantBuffer から 1 フレーム 1 回）
	// 戻り値 false の場合、このフレームはすでに収集済み（同じフレームで再度呼ばれた）
	static bool BeginFrame(UINT frameIndex, uint64_t frameSerial)
	{
		if (frameSerial == s_LastSerial && s_HasSerial) return false;
		s_HasSerial = true;
		s_LastSerial = frameSerial;
		s_Slot = frameIndex % kFrames;
		++s_FrameCounter;
		RetireTick();
		ReadStats();
		s_LightCount = 0;
		s_LightHash = 1469598103934665603ull;
		for (EntityID entity : s_EntityMarked) if (entity < s_EntityInGrid.size()) s_EntityInGrid[entity] = 0;
		s_EntityMarked.clear();
		s_Stats.SubmittedLights = 0;
		s_Stats.DroppedLights = 0;
		s_Stats.Built = false;
		s_SlotBuilt[s_Slot] = false;
		s_SlotForward[s_Slot] = false;
		s_SampleWidth = s_SampleHeight = 0;
		s_SampleScale = 1;
		WriteConstants(false, {}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
		WriteForwardDescriptors(s_Slot, false);
		return true;
	}

	// 追加できたら true（このライトの不透明面ライティングはグリッドが受け持つ）
	// ライトのオクルージョン（GPU の判定を読み戻した結果）：数フレーム続けて「見えている不透明面に届かない」ライト
	static bool IsLightOccluded(EntityID entity)
	{
		return entity < s_OccludedFrames.size() && s_OccludedFrames[entity] >= kOcclusionFrames;
	}
	static UINT GetOccludedLightCount() { return s_OccludedCount; }

	static bool IsEntityInGrid(EntityID entity)
	{
		return s_HasSerial && entity < s_EntityInGrid.size() && s_EntityInGrid[entity] != 0;
	}

	static bool AddLight(EntityID entity, const GpuLight& light)
	{
		if (!s_MappedLights || !IsEnabled()) return false;
		if (s_LightCount >= kMaxLights)
		{
			++s_Stats.DroppedLights;
			return false;
		}
		memcpy(s_MappedLights + s_Slot * kLightStride + s_LightCount * sizeof(GpuLight), &light, sizeof(GpuLight));
		HashBytes(s_LightHash, &light, sizeof(light)); // 累積のリセット判定用（アップロードヒープは読み戻さない）
		if (entity >= s_EntityInGrid.size()) s_EntityInGrid.resize(static_cast<size_t>(entity) + 1, 0);
		s_EntityInGrid[entity] = 1;
		s_EntityMarked.push_back(entity);
		++s_LightCount;
		s_Stats.SubmittedLights = s_LightCount;
		return true;
	}

	// ---- GPU：グリッドの構築 + M2 のサンプリング（GBuffer 完成後・TLAS 構築後・ディファードライティングの前）
	//   gbuffer: BaseColor, Normal, Depth, Material, Shadow, Velocity（PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE で渡す。終了時に同じ状態へ戻す）
	//   gbufferTable: ポストプロセスと同じ GBuffer の SRV テーブル（BaseColor から 8 個連続。Velocity は 8 番目）
	static constexpr UINT kBuildGBufferCount = 6;
	static bool Build(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap,
		ID3D12Resource* const gbuffer[kBuildGBufferCount], D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE gbufferTable, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE depthSrv,
		bool froxelFogActive = false)
	{
		s_Stats.VolumetricGrid = false;
		s_Stats.Built = false;
		s_Stats.ActiveMode = Mode::Deterministic;
		s_Stats.FallbackReason = nullptr;
		ID3D12Resource* depth = gbuffer ? gbuffer[2] : nullptr;
		if (!commands || !heap || !depth || !IsEnabled() || !s_HasSerial || s_SlotBuilt[s_Slot]) return false;
		const D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC depthDesc = depth->GetDesc();
		const UINT width = static_cast<UINT>(depthDesc.Width);
		const UINT height = depthDesc.Height;
		if (width == 0 || height == 0) return false;
		const UINT tilesX = (width + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
		const UINT tilesY = (height + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
		const UINT coarseX = (tilesX + kCoarseTiles - 1) / kCoarseTiles;
		const UINT coarseY = (tilesY + kCoarseTiles - 1) / kCoarseTiles;
		const UINT coarseZ = kSlices / kCoarseSlices;
		if (!EnsureGrid(tilesX, tilesY, coarseX * coarseY * coarseZ)) return false;

		// ---- M2：このフレームの評価方式を決める
		const Mode requested = static_cast<Mode>(std::clamp(s_Settings.EvaluationMode, 0, 2));
		const D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS scene = Raytracing::GetSceneAddress();
		Mode mode = requested;
		UINT samplesPerPixel = 0;
		if (requested != Mode::Deterministic)
		{
			if (!s_SampleAvailable) { mode = Mode::Deterministic; s_Stats.FallbackReason = "M2 シェーダーの初期化に失敗"; }
			else if (scene == 0) { mode = Mode::Deterministic; s_Stats.FallbackReason = "レイトレーシングが無効（TLAS なし）"; }
		}
		if (mode == Mode::Stochastic)
		{
			// 半解像度：サンプル空間は画面の 1/2（切り上げ）
			s_SampleScale = s_Settings.HalfResolution ? 2u : 1u;
			s_SampleWidth = (width + s_SampleScale - 1) / s_SampleScale;
			s_SampleHeight = (height + s_SampleScale - 1) / s_SampleScale;
			samplesPerPixel = ChooseSamplesPerPixel(s_SampleWidth, s_SampleHeight);
			if (samplesPerPixel == 0 || !EnsureSamples(s_SampleWidth, s_SampleHeight, samplesPerPixel))
			{
				mode = Mode::Deterministic;
				s_Stats.FallbackReason = "サンプルバッファを確保できません";
				samplesPerPixel = 0;
			}
		}
		// ---- M3：デノイズするか
		bool denoise = false;
		s_Stats.DenoiseFallback = nullptr;
		if (mode == Mode::Stochastic && s_Settings.Denoise)
		{
			if (!s_DenoiseAvailable || s_ShadeFailed) s_Stats.DenoiseFallback = "デノイズのシェーダーを初期化できません";
			else if (!EnsureDenoise(width, height)) s_Stats.DenoiseFallback = "デノイズのバッファを確保できません";
			else denoise = true;
		}
		// ---- M4：可視ライトハッシュ（前フレームの分を読み、今フレームの分を作る）
		const UINT hashTilesX = (width + 7) / 8, hashTilesY = (height + 7) / 8;
		bool guide = false;
		bool hashBuild = false;
		if (mode == Mode::Stochastic && s_Settings.Guide && s_HashAvailable && EnsureHash(hashTilesX, hashTilesY))
		{
			hashBuild = true;
			const EntityID camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
			// ハッシュはライトの Entity ID で引く（インデックスはフレームごとに並びが変わるため）
			guide = s_HashValid && s_HashLastFrame + 1 == s_FrameCounter && camera == s_HashCamera && !s_HashResetRequested;
			s_HashCamera = camera;
		}
		s_HashResetRequested = false;
		s_Stats.HashValid = guide;
		s_Stats.Guided = guide;
		s_Stats.HashTilesX = hashTilesX;
		s_Stats.HashTilesY = hashTilesY;
		s_Stats.AntiLag = s_LightHash != s_PreviousLightHash;
		s_PreviousLightHash = s_LightHash;
		const bool accumulate = s_Settings.Accumulate && s_SampleAvailable && EnsureAccumulation(width, height);
		if (s_HasReference && (s_ReferenceWidth != width || s_ReferenceHeight != height)) ClearReference();
		UpdateAccumulationState(width, height, mode, samplesPerPixel, accumulate);

		RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("MegaLights", commands);
		// M6 / M7：フォグか Forward（半透明）がグリッドを使うなら、ジオメトリの手前のスライスもすべて埋める
		const bool forwardGrid = s_Settings.Translucency;
		const bool volumetric = (froxelFogActive && s_Settings.VolumetricFog) || forwardGrid;
		WriteConstants(true, depthDesc, tilesX, tilesY, coarseX, coarseY, samplesPerPixel, BuildFlags(mode, accumulate, denoise, guide));
		if (volumetric && s_MappedConstants)
		{
			Constants* written = reinterpret_cast<Constants*>(s_MappedConstants + s_Slot * kConstantStride);
			written->Grid.w |= kGridVolumetric;
			if (forwardGrid) written->Grid.w |= kGridForward;
		}
		const UINT slot = s_Slot;

		// GBuffer：ピクセルシェーダーリソース → コンピュートでも読める状態に
		const D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES gbufferRead = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
		const D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES bothRead = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
		const bool sampling = mode == Mode::Stochastic;
		vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> barriers;
		for (UINT index = 0; index < kBuildGBufferCount; ++index)
		{
			if (!gbuffer[index] || (!sampling && index != 2)) continue;
			barriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(gbuffer[index], gbufferRead, bothRead));
		}
		Transition(barriers, s_TileMasks.Get(), s_TileMasksState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		Transition(barriers, s_CoarseCells.Get(), s_CoarseCellsState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		Transition(barriers, s_CoarseIndices.Get(), s_CoarseIndicesState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		Transition(barriers, s_FineCells.Get(), s_FineCellsState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		Transition(barriers, s_FineIndices.Get(), s_FineIndicesState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		Transition(barriers, s_Counters.Get(), s_CountersState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		Transition(barriers, s_LightVisible.Get(), s_LightVisibleState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());

		ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { heap };
		commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
		commands->SetComputeRootSignature(s_Root.Get());
		commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(0, s_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + slot * kConstantStride);
		commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(1, s_LightUpload->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + slot * kLightStride);
		commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, depthSrv);
		commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(3, s_TileMasks->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
		commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(4, s_CoarseCells->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
		commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(5, s_CoarseIndices->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
		commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(6, s_FineCells->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
		commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(7, s_FineIndices->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
		commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(8, s_Counters->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
		commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(9, s_LightVisible->GetGPUVirtualAddress());

		commands->SetPipelineState(s_ClearCounters.Get());
		commands->Dispatch(1, 1, 1);
		commands->SetPipelineState(s_TileSliceMask.Get());
		commands->Dispatch(tilesX, tilesY, 1);
		UavBarrier(commands, { s_Counters.Get(), s_TileMasks.Get(), s_LightVisible.Get() });
		commands->SetPipelineState(s_CoarseCull.Get());
		commands->Dispatch(coarseX, coarseY, coarseZ);
		UavBarrier(commands, { s_Counters.Get(), s_CoarseCells.Get(), s_CoarseIndices.Get() });
		commands->SetPipelineState(s_FineCull.Get());
		commands->Dispatch(coarseX, coarseY, coarseZ);

		// グリッドはコンピュート（M2）とピクセルシェーダーの両方で読む
		barriers.clear();
		Transition(barriers, s_FineCells.Get(), s_FineCellsState, bothRead);
		Transition(barriers, s_FineIndices.Get(), s_FineIndicesState, bothRead);
		Transition(barriers, s_Counters.Get(), s_CountersState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
		Transition(barriers, s_LightVisible.Get(), s_LightVisibleState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
		if (accumulate) Transition(barriers, s_Accumulation.Get(), s_AccumulationState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
		commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());
		commands->CopyBufferRegion(s_Readback.Get(), slot * kReadbackStride, s_Counters.Get(), 0, 16);
		commands->CopyBufferRegion(s_Readback.Get(), slot * kReadbackStride + 16, s_LightVisible.Get(), 0, kLightVisibleBytes);
		s_SlotLights[slot] = s_EntityMarked; // 読み戻し時にライトの番号 → Entity を引くため
		s_ReadbackPending[slot] = true;

		// ---- M2：ML3 ライトの選択 → ML5 影レイ
		if (sampling)
		{
			RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent sampleProfile("MegaLights Sample + Trace", commands);
			const UINT hashCurrent = s_HashIndex, hashPrevious = s_HashIndex ^ 1u;
			barriers.clear();
			Transition(barriers, s_Samples.Get(), s_SamplesState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			Transition(barriers, s_TileList.Get(), s_TileListState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			Transition(barriers, s_TraceList.Get(), s_TraceListState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			Transition(barriers, s_WorldList.Get(), s_WorldListState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			Transition(barriers, s_TraceCounters.Get(), s_TraceCountersState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			if (hashBuild)
			{
				Transition(barriers, s_Hash[hashPrevious].Get(), s_HashState[hashPrevious], D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
				Transition(barriers, s_Hash[hashCurrent].Get(), s_HashState[hashCurrent], D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
			}
			if (!barriers.empty()) commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());
			BindSampleRoot(commands, slot, scene, gbufferTable,
				hashBuild ? s_Hash[hashPrevious].Get() : nullptr, hashBuild ? s_Hash[hashCurrent].Get() : nullptr);
			const UINT groupsX = (width + 7) / 8, groupsY = (height + 7) / 8;              // 画面の 8x8（ハッシュ）
			const UINT sampleGroupsX = (s_SampleWidth + 7) / 8, sampleGroupsY = (s_SampleHeight + 7) / 8; // サンプル空間の 8x8
			// M5：タイル分類 → 対象タイルだけサンプリング → 影レイが必要なサンプルだけスクリーントレース → 残りをワールドトレース
			auto indirect = [&](ID3D12PipelineState* argsPso, UINT64 argsOffset, ID3D12PipelineState* pso,
				std::initializer_list<ID3D12Resource*> afterward)
			{
				vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> list;
				Transition(list, s_DispatchArgs.Get(), s_DispatchArgsState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
				if (!list.empty()) commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(list.size()), list.data());
				commands->SetPipelineState(argsPso);
				commands->Dispatch(1, 1, 1);
				list.clear();
				Transition(list, s_DispatchArgs.Get(), s_DispatchArgsState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT);
				commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(list.size()), list.data());
				commands->SetPipelineState(pso);
				commands->ExecuteIndirect(s_DispatchSignature.Get(), 1, s_DispatchArgs.Get(), argsOffset, nullptr, 0);
				UavBarrier(commands, afterward);
			};
			commands->SetPipelineState(s_ClearTraceCounters.Get());
			commands->Dispatch(1, 1, 1);
