bool EnsureUpload(ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource, UINT64 bytes)
{
    if (resource && resource->GetDesc().Width >= bytes) return true;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
    return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(resource.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())));
}
bool Upload(ID3D12Resource* resource, const void* data, size_t bytes)
{
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    D3D12_RANGE noRead{ 0, 0 };
    if (FAILED(resource->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped))) return false;
    memcpy(mapped, data, bytes);
    resource->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    return true;
}
void HashEmission(uint64_t& signature, const void* data, size_t bytes)
{
    const auto* values = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
    for (size_t index = 0; index < bytes; ++index)
    {
        signature ^= values[index];
        signature *= 1099511628211ull;
    }
}
void TextureSrv(ID3D12Resource* resource, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE handle, UINT minimumResidentMip = 0)
{
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
    desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    desc.Format = resource ? resource->GetDesc().Format : DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    if (desc.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS) desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
    desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    desc.Texture2D.MipLevels = resource ? resource->GetDesc().MipLevels : 1;
    desc.Texture2D.ResourceMinLODClamp = static_cast<float>(minimumResidentMip);
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &desc, handle);
}
void BufferSrv(ID3D12Resource* resource, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE handle)
{
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
    desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
    desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
    desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    desc.Buffer.NumElements = resource ? static_cast<UINT>(resource->GetDesc().Width / 4) : 1;
    desc.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_SRV_FLAG_RAW;
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &desc, handle);
}
// Radiance signals are produced and consumed inside one command list on the direct queue
// (the same rule the GBuffer already relies on), so a single set replaces the former
// per-frame-slot copies: 4 x RGBA16F full-resolution textures x 3 slots -> x 1.
// Each slot keeps references to the set it last recorded with, so resizing never frees a
// texture that an in-flight frame still samples.
struct SharedSignals
{
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Noisy, Result, GiNoisy, GiResult;
    UINT Width = 0, Height = 0;
};
SharedSignals g_Shared;

bool EnsureFrame(FrameResources& frame, UINT slot, UINT width, UINT height)
{
    if (!frame.Heap)
    {
        D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC desc{};
        desc.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
        desc.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
        desc.NumDescriptors = kEmissionDescriptors + kMaximumMeshes;
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&frame.Heap)))) return false;
        frame.Descriptors.clear(); // 新しいヒープは中身が空
    }
    if (!EnsureUpload(frame.Constants, 512)) return false;
    if (g_Shared.Width != width || g_Shared.Height != height)
    {
        // Drop only the shared references; slots still holding the old textures keep them alive.
        g_Shared = {};
        g_Shared.Width = width;
        g_Shared.Height = height;
        g_GiHistoryValid = false;
    }
    frame.Width = width;
    frame.Height = height;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT,
        width, height, 1, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    const auto ensureSignal = [&](ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& sharedNoisy, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& sharedResult,
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& noisy, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& result,
        UINT firstUav, UINT resultSrv, const wchar_t* name)
    {
        for (auto* resource : {addressof(sharedNoisy), addressof(sharedResult)})
        {
            if (*resource)
            {
                continue;
            }
            if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(resource->ReleaseAndGetAddressOf()))))
            {
                return false;
            }
            (*resource)->SetName(name);
        }
        if (noisy == sharedNoisy && result == sharedResult)
        {
            return true;
        }
        noisy = sharedNoisy;
        result = sharedResult;
        TextureSrv(result.Get(), Cpu(g_EngineHeap.Get(), resultSrv + slot));
        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
        uav.Format = desc.Format;
        uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(noisy.Get(), nullptr, &uav, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), firstUav));
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(result.Get(), nullptr, &uav, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), firstUav + 1));
        return true;
    };
    if (Raytracing::GetSettings().Reflections &&
        !ensureSignal(g_Shared.Noisy, g_Shared.Result, frame.Noisy, frame.Result, 4, kResultSrv, L"Ray Reflection Radiance"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled() &&
        !ensureSignal(g_Shared.GiNoisy, g_Shared.GiResult, frame.GiNoisy, frame.GiResult, 6, kGiSrv, L"Realtime GI Irradiance"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}
bool EnsureReservoirs(UINT width, UINT height)
{
    if (g_Reservoirs[0] && g_ReservoirWidth == width && g_ReservoirHeight == height) return true;
    // Older frames may still read the previous reservoirs.
    if (g_Reservoirs[0] && !GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle()) return false;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(UINT64(width) * height * 32ull, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    for (auto& buffer : g_Reservoirs)
    {
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(buffer.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf()))))
        {
            g_Reservoirs[0].Reset(); g_Reservoirs[1].Reset();
            g_ReservoirWidth = g_ReservoirHeight = 0;
            return false;
        }
        buffer->SetName(L"ReSTIR GI Reservoirs");
    }
    g_ReservoirWidth = width;
    g_ReservoirHeight = height;
    g_ReservoirCurrent = 0;
    g_ReSTIRHistoryValid = false;
    return true;
}
bool CreateRadianceCache()
{
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    const auto create = [&](ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& buffer, UINT64 bytes, const wchar_t* name)
    {
        const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(buffer.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())))) return false;
        buffer->SetName(name);
        return true;
    };
    g_Cache.NeedsClear = true;
    return create(g_Cache.Keys, kCacheCapacity * 4ull, L"GI Radiance Cache Keys") &&
        create(g_Cache.Accumulation, kCacheCapacity * 32ull, L"GI Radiance Cache Accumulation") &&
        create(g_Cache.Resolved, kCacheCapacity * 32ull, L"GI Radiance Cache Resolved") &&
        create(g_Cache.Ages, kCacheCapacity * 4ull, L"GI Radiance Cache Ages");
}
void WriteCacheDescriptors(ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap)
{
    const auto raw = [&](ID3D12Resource* buffer, UINT index)
    {
        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC desc{};
        desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
        desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
        desc.Buffer.NumElements = buffer ? static_cast<UINT>(buffer->GetDesc().Width / 4) : 1;
        desc.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_UAV_FLAG_RAW;
        g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(buffer, nullptr, &desc, Cpu(heap, kCacheDescriptors + index));
    };
    raw(g_Cache.Keys.Get(), 0);
    raw(g_Cache.Accumulation.Get(), 1);
    D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC structured{};
    structured.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
    structured.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
    structured.Buffer.NumElements = kCacheCapacity;
    structured.Buffer.StructureByteStride = 32;
    g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(g_Cache.Resolved.Get(), nullptr, &structured, Cpu(heap, kCacheDescriptors + 2));
    raw(g_Cache.Ages.Get(), 3);
}
void CacheBarrier(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
{
    const D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barriers[] = {
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_Cache.Keys.Get()), CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_Cache.Accumulation.Get()),
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_Cache.Resolved.Get()), CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_Cache.Ages.Get()) };
    commands->ResourceBarrier(4, barriers);
}
bool CompileRadiancePipeline(const char* entry, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pipeline, bool telemetry = false)
{
    const D3D_SHADER_MACRO defines[] = {
        {"USE_NRD", NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() ? "1" : "0"},
        {"ENABLE_RAY_TELEMETRY", telemetry ? "1" : "0"}, {}};
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, errors;
    if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/RayReflectionsCS.hlsl", defines, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
        entry, "cs_6_5", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &blob, &errors)))
    {
        g_LastShaderError = string(entry) + ": " + (errors ? static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()) : "compile failed");
        WriteGraphicsLog("DXR reflection shader failed (telemetry=%u): %s\n", static_cast<UINT>(telemetry), g_LastShaderError.c_str());
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
    desc.pRootSignature = g_Root.Get();
    desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(blob.Get());
    if (SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(pipeline.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())))) return true;
    g_LastShaderError = string(entry) + ": CreateComputePipelineState failed";
    return false;
}

bool EnsureTelemetryPipelines()
{
    if (!g_TelemetryPipelinesTried)
    {
        g_TelemetryPipelinesTried = true;
        if (!CompileRadiancePipeline("main", g_TraceTelemetry, true) ||
            !CompileRadiancePipeline("TraceDiffuse", g_GiTraceTelemetry, true) ||
            (g_ReSTIRSpatial && !CompileRadiancePipeline("ReSTIRSpatial", g_ReSTIRSpatialTelemetry, true)))
        {
            g_TraceTelemetry.Reset();
            g_GiTraceTelemetry.Reset();
            g_ReSTIRSpatialTelemetry.Reset();
            WriteGraphicsLog("Ray telemetry: radiance counter variant unavailable; keeping normal shaders\n");
        }
    }
    return g_TraceTelemetry && g_GiTraceTelemetry;
}

void Transition(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource,
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
{
    if (!resource || before == after) return;
    const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, before, after);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
}
}

bool RayReflections::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* engineHeap, UINT increment)
{
    g_Device = device; g_EngineHeap = engineHeap; g_Increment = increment;
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[12];
    ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 4, 1);
    ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 2, 0);
    for (UINT i = 2; i < 6; ++i) ranges[i].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, kMaximumMeshes, 0, i - 1);
    ranges[6].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 2, 0, 6); // sky view LUT
    ranges[7].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 4, 0, 7); // radiance cache
    ranges[8].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 2, 0, 8, 0); // ReSTIR reservoirs
    ranges[9].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0, 8, 2); // velocity
    ranges[10].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV,2,0,10); ranges[11].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV,1,0,10);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[19];
    parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(25);
    parameters[1].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
    parameters[2].InitAsConstantBufferView(6);
    parameters[3].InitAsConstantBufferView(1);
    parameters[4].InitAsConstantBufferView(5);
    for (UINT i = 0; i < 5; ++i) parameters[5 + i].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[i]);
    parameters[10].InitAsShaderResourceView(5);
    parameters[11].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[5]);
    parameters[12].InitAsShaderResourceView(6);
    parameters[13].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[6]);
    parameters[14].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[7]);
    parameters[15].InitAsDescriptorTable(2, &ranges[8]);
    parameters[16].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0, 9);
    parameters[17].InitAsDescriptorTable(1,&ranges[10]); parameters[18].InitAsDescriptorTable(1,&ranges[11]);
    const CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC samplers[2] = {
        CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
            D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP),
        CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(1, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
            D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP) };
    const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC root(19, parameters, 2, samplers);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, errors;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&root, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &blob, &errors)) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Root))))
    {
        g_Status = "ルートシグネチャ作成失敗（反射 / Realtime GI 無効）";
        if (errors) g_LastShaderError = static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer());
        WriteGraphicsLog("DXR reflection root signature failed: %s\n", g_LastShaderError.c_str());
        return false;
    }
    auto compile = [&](const char* entry, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pipeline)
    {
        return CompileRadiancePipeline(entry, pipeline);
    };
    // Required pipelines first. The optional ones (radiance cache, ReSTIR) only disable their own
    // feature on failure; previously a failure there also skipped Compose / ComposeDiffuse, which
    // left a null pipeline bound in the NRD path while TraceDiffuse kept running.
    compile("CaptureAdaptiveGuide",g_AdaptiveCapture);
    const bool required = compile("main", g_Trace) && compile("TraceDiffuse", g_GiTrace) &&
        compile("FilterDiffuse", g_GiFilter) &&
        (!NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() || (compile("Compose", g_Compose) && compile("ComposeDiffuse", g_GiCompose)));
    if (!required)
    {
        g_Trace.Reset(); g_GiTrace.Reset(); g_GiFilter.Reset(); g_Compose.Reset(); g_GiCompose.Reset();
        g_Status = "RayReflectionsCS のコンパイル失敗（反射 / Realtime GI 無効）。ログを確認してください";
        return false;
    }
    if (!CreateRadianceCache() || !compile("ResolveRadianceCache", g_CacheResolve) || !compile("ClearRadianceCache", g_CacheClear))
    {
        g_CacheResolve.Reset(); g_CacheClear.Reset(); g_Cache = {};
        WriteGraphicsLog("Realtime GI radiance cache unavailable; continuing without it\n");
    }
    if (!compile("ReSTIRTemporal", g_ReSTIRTemporal) || !compile("ReSTIRSpatial", g_ReSTIRSpatial))
    {
        g_ReSTIRTemporal.Reset(); g_ReSTIRSpatial.Reset();
        WriteGraphicsLog("ReSTIR GI unavailable; continuing without it\n");
    }
    g_Status = "準備完了";
    return true;
}

const char* RayReflections::GetStatus() { return g_Status; }
const char* RayReflections::GetLastShaderError() { return g_LastShaderError.c_str(); }

void RayReflections::Shutdown()
{
    g_AdaptiveRadiance.Reset(); g_AdaptiveGuide.Reset(); g_AdaptiveCapture.Reset(); g_AdaptiveValid=g_BudgetValid=false;

    g_TraceTelemetry.Reset();
    g_GiTraceTelemetry.Reset();
    g_ReSTIRSpatialTelemetry.Reset();
    g_TelemetryPipelinesTried = false;
    g_OptixGi.reset();
    g_OptixReflections.reset();
    g_OptixGiActive = g_OptixReflectionActive = false;
    g_GiDenoiser.reset();
    g_GiTrace.Reset();
    g_GiCompose.Reset();
    g_GiFilter.Reset();
    g_CacheResolve.Reset();
    g_Status = "未初期化";
    g_ReSTIRTemporal.Reset();
    g_ReSTIRSpatial.Reset();
    g_Reservoirs[0].Reset();
    g_Reservoirs[1].Reset();
    g_ReservoirWidth = g_ReservoirHeight = 0;
    g_ReSTIRHistoryValid = false;
    g_CacheClear.Reset();
    g_Cache = {};
    g_CacheWasEnabled = false;
    g_GiActive = g_GiHistoryValid = false;
    g_GiEmissionSignature = 0;
    g_GiEmissionStableFrames = kGiEmissionRestartQuietFrames;
    g_GiWidth = g_GiHeight = 0;
    g_Denoiser.reset(); g_Frames = {}; g_Shared = {}; g_Root.Reset(); g_Trace.Reset(); g_Compose.Reset();
    g_Device.Reset(); g_EngineHeap.Reset(); g_Width = g_Height = g_Dispatches = 0; g_HistoryValid = false;
}

bool RayReflections::Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* scene,
    const vector<RaytracingGeometry>& geometry, const NrdFrame& nrdFrame,
    const array<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>, 4>& guides, bool denoise)
{
    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent preparationProfile("DXR Radiance Setup", commands);
    g_Dispatches = 0;
    g_OptixGiActive = g_OptixReflectionActive = false;
    g_GiActive = false;
    if (!g_Trace || !g_GiTrace || !g_GiFilter) { g_Status = "パイプライン未作成（反射 / Realtime GI 無効）"; return false; }
    if (!commands || !scene) { g_Status = "TLAS がありません"; return false; }
    if (geometry.empty()) { g_Status = "レイトレース対象のメッシュがありません"; return false; }
    const UINT slot = nrdFrame.FrameIndex % kFrames;
    g_LastFrame = slot;
    auto* depth = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::DEPTH);
    auto* normal = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::NORMAL);
    auto* material = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::MATERIAL);
    if (!depth || !normal || !material) return false;
    const auto extent = depth->GetDesc();
    auto& frame = g_Frames[slot];
    if (!EnsureFrame(frame, slot, static_cast<UINT>(extent.Width), extent.Height))
    {
        g_Status = "GI / 反射のテクスチャ確保に失敗";
        return false;
    }
    g_Status = RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled() ? "Realtime GI 準備中" : "反射のみ動作中";
    const bool instrumented = RayTelemetry::IsCollecting() && EnsureTelemetryPipelines();
    RayTelemetry::Data().RecordProvider(RayTelemetry::Radiance, instrumented);
    frame.Geometry = geometry;
    const UINT count = static_cast<UINT>((min)(geometry.size(), static_cast<size_t>(kMaximumMeshes)));
    vector<MeshConstants> meshes(count);
    vector<UINT> emitters;
    unordered_map<ID3D12Resource*, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES> sampledResources;
    sampledResources.reserve(count / 2 + 16);
    if (frame.Descriptors.size() < count) frame.Descriptors.resize(count);
    sampledResources.emplace(depth, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    sampledResources.emplace(normal, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    sampledResources.emplace(material, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    ID3D12Resource* velocity = RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::VELOCITY);
    if (velocity) sampledResources.emplace(velocity, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    for (UINT i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        const auto& geometry = frame.Geometry[i];
        auto& mesh = meshes[i];
        const XMMATRIX world = XMLoadFloat4x4(&geometry.World);
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&mesh.World, XMMatrixTranspose(world));
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&mesh.NormalToWorld, XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, world));
        mesh.Layout = { geometry.VertexView.StrideInBytes,
            geometry.Indices ? (geometry.IndexView.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UINT ? 16u : 32u) : 0u,
            static_cast<UINT>(geometry.VertexView.BufferLocation - geometry.Vertices->GetGPUVirtualAddress()),
            geometry.Indices ? static_cast<UINT>(geometry.IndexView.BufferLocation - geometry.Indices->GetGPUVirtualAddress()) : 0u };
        mesh.Material = { geometry.Roughness, geometry.Metallic, static_cast<float>(geometry.Texture != nullptr), 0 };
        mesh.BaseColor = geometry.BaseColor;
        mesh.Emission = geometry.Emission;
        UINT triangleCount = geometry.IndexCount / 3;
        if (!geometry.Indices)
        {
            triangleCount = geometry.VertexView.SizeInBytes / geometry.VertexView.StrideInBytes / 3;
        }
        mesh.Surface = { triangleCount, static_cast<UINT>(geometry.EmissionTexture != nullptr), 0, static_cast<UINT>(geometry.UsesAssetMaterial) };
        if (geometry.Emission.w > 0 && (geometry.Emission.x > 0 || geometry.Emission.y > 0 || geometry.Emission.z > 0))
        {
            emitters.push_back(i);
        }
        auto& record = frame.Descriptors[i];
        const UINT emissionMip = static_cast<UINT>(geometry.EmissionResidentMip);
        const UINT textureMip = static_cast<UINT>(geometry.TextureResidentMip);
        if (!record.Valid || record.Emission.Get() != geometry.EmissionTexture.Get() || record.EmissionMip != emissionMip)
            TextureSrv(geometry.EmissionTexture.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kEmissionDescriptors + i), geometry.EmissionResidentMip);
        if (geometry.EmissionTexture)
        {
            sampledResources.emplace(geometry.EmissionTexture.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        }
        if (!record.Valid || record.Vertices.Get() != geometry.Vertices.Get())
            BufferSrv(geometry.Vertices.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kVertexDescriptors + i));
        if (!record.Valid || record.Indices.Get() != geometry.Indices.Get())
            BufferSrv(geometry.Indices.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kIndexDescriptors + i));
        if (!record.Valid || record.Texture.Get() != geometry.Texture.Get() || record.TextureMip != textureMip)
        {
            if (geometry.Texture) TextureSrv(geometry.Texture.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kTextureDescriptors + i), geometry.TextureResidentMip);
            else TextureSrv(nullptr, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kTextureDescriptors + i));
        }
        if (geometry.Texture) sampledResources.emplace(geometry.Texture.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        record.Vertices = geometry.Vertices;
        record.Indices = geometry.Indices;
        record.Texture = geometry.Texture;
        record.Emission = geometry.EmissionTexture;
        record.TextureMip = textureMip;
        record.EmissionMip = emissionMip;
        record.Valid = true;
        sampledResources.emplace(geometry.Vertices.Get(), geometry.VertexState);
        if (geometry.Indices) sampledResources.emplace(geometry.Indices.Get(), geometry.IndexState);
    }
    if (!EnsureUpload(frame.Meshes, meshes.size() * sizeof(MeshConstants)) ||
        !Upload(frame.Meshes.Get(), meshes.data(), meshes.size() * sizeof(MeshConstants))) return false;
    if (!EnsureUpload(frame.Emitters, (max)(size_t(4), emitters.size() * sizeof(UINT))) ||
        (!emitters.empty() && !Upload(frame.Emitters.Get(), emitters.data(), emitters.size() * sizeof(UINT)))) return false;
    FrameConstants constants;
    vector<ReflectionLight> lights;
    lights.reserve(RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
    // 負荷削減：反射・GI のヒット点で評価するライトは上限 160 灯。以前は ECS の並び順で先頭から取っていたので、
    // ライトが多いシーンでは遠いライトが枠を使い切っていた。カメラから近い（影響範囲の表面までの距離が短い）順に選ぶ
    static vector<pair<float, EntityID>> reflectionCandidates;
    reflectionCandidates.clear();
    {
        const XMVECTOR cameraPosition = XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, XMLoadFloat4x4(&nrdFrame.View)).r[3];
        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<LightComponent, TransformComponent>())
        {
            const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
            if (!light.IsActive || !light.AffectsOpaque || light.RenderMode != LightRenderMode::Physical || light.Intensity <= 0) continue;
            float key = -1.0f;
            if (light.Type != LightType::Directional)
            {
                const auto& position = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity).Position;
                key = (std::max)(XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(XMVectorSubtract(XMLoadFloat3(&position), cameraPosition))) - light.Range, 0.0f);
            }
            reflectionCandidates.emplace_back(key, entity);
        }
        // 負荷削減：ヒット点ではライトをループで全評価するので、灯数がそのまま反射 / GI のコストになる
        const size_t hitLights = static_cast<size_t>(std::clamp(RenderCulling::GetSettings().RayHitLights, 1,
            static_cast<int>(RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS)));
        if (reflectionCandidates.size() > hitLights)
        {
            nth_element(reflectionCandidates.begin(), reflectionCandidates.begin() + hitLights, reflectionCandidates.end());
            reflectionCandidates.resize(hitLights);
        }
    }
    for (const auto& [distanceKey, entity] : reflectionCandidates)
    {
        const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
        const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
        XMFLOAT3 direction;
        XMStoreFloat3(&direction, XMVector3Normalize(XMLoadFloat3(&light.Direction)));
        ReflectionLight entry;
        entry.Direction = { direction.x, direction.y, direction.z, light.Range };
        entry.Color = { light.Color.x, light.Color.y, light.Color.z, light.Intensity * 1.35f };
        entry.PositionType = { transform.Position.x, transform.Position.y, transform.Position.z, static_cast<float>(light.Type) };
        entry.Extras = { cosf(XMConvertToRadians(light.InnerAngle)), cosf(XMConvertToRadians(light.OuterAngle)),
            light.VolumeDensity, static_cast<float>(light.VolumeShape) };
        entry.Flags.x = static_cast<UINT>(light.CastShadow);
        lights.push_back(entry);
    }
    if (!EnsureUpload(frame.Lights, (max)(sizeof(ReflectionLight), lights.size() * sizeof(ReflectionLight))) ||
        (!lights.empty() && !Upload(frame.Lights.Get(), lights.data(), lights.size() * sizeof(ReflectionLight)))) return false;
    const XMMATRIX view = XMLoadFloat4x4(&nrdFrame.View);
    XMMATRIX projection = XMLoadFloat4x4(&nrdFrame.Projection);
    // Restore the jitter used by this frame's GBuffer.
    XMFLOAT4X4 jittered; XMStoreFloat4x4(&jittered, projection);
    jittered._31 = -nrdFrame.Jitter.x * 2 / frame.Width;
    jittered._32 = nrdFrame.Jitter.y * 2 / frame.Height;
    projection = XMLoadFloat4x4(&jittered);
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.InvViewProjection, XMMatrixTranspose(XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view * projection)));
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.View, XMMatrixTranspose(view));
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.ViewProjection, XMMatrixTranspose(view * projection));
    XMStoreFloat4(&constants.Camera, XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view).r[3]);
    constants.Camera.w = nrdFrame.Range;
    constants.Extent = { frame.Width, frame.Height, nrdFrame.Sequence, static_cast<UINT>(lights.size()) };
    constants.Stability = {Raytracing::GetSettings().StableSampling ? 1.f : 0.f, 0, 0, 0};
    // Motion guides cannot detect a change in emitted radiance on a stationary mesh.
    // Restart only this signal when the emissive material or emitter transform changes.
    uint64_t emissionSignature = 14695981039346656037ull;
    for (UINT emitter : emitters)
    {
        const auto& source = frame.Geometry[emitter];
        HashEmission(emissionSignature, &emitter, sizeof(emitter));
        HashEmission(emissionSignature, &source.Emission, sizeof(source.Emission));
        HashEmission(emissionSignature, &source.World, sizeof(source.World));
        const auto texture = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(source.EmissionTexture.Get());
        HashEmission(emissionSignature, &texture, sizeof(texture));
    }
    const float giDistance = RendererSettings::GetGiDistance();
    HashEmission(emissionSignature, &giDistance, sizeof(giDistance));
    if (emissionSignature != g_GiEmissionSignature)
    {
        // A discrete change (toggle, new material, teleport) restarts the history once.
        // Continuous animation changes the signature every frame; restarting each time would
        // leave REBLUR permanently at 0.5 rpp and flicker, so it is left to NRD anti-lag.
        if (g_GiEmissionStableFrames >= kGiEmissionRestartQuietFrames)
        {
            g_GiHistoryValid = false;
        }
        g_GiEmissionSignature = emissionSignature;
        g_GiEmissionStableFrames = 0;
    }
    else if (g_GiEmissionStableFrames < kGiEmissionRestartQuietFrames)
    {
        ++g_GiEmissionStableFrames;
    }
    const bool useOptix = denoise && Raytracing::GetSettings().RadianceDenoiser == Raytracing::DenoiserType::Optix &&
        OptixDenoiser::IsAvailable();
    const bool useGiDenoiser = denoise && !useOptix && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() && guides[0] && guides[1] && guides[2];
    constants.GiParameters = { RendererSettings::GetGiDistance(), RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiIntensity(),
        static_cast<float>(useGiDenoiser), static_cast<float>(emitters.size()) };
    const bool cacheEnabled = RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled() && RendererSettings::GetGiRadianceCacheEnabled() &&
        g_Cache.Keys && g_CacheResolve && g_CacheClear;
    if (cacheEnabled && !g_CacheWasEnabled) g_Cache.NeedsClear = true;
    g_CacheWasEnabled = cacheEnabled;
    const auto& quality = RenderQuality::Get();
    const UINT reservoirWidth = useGiDenoiser ? (frame.Width + 1) / 2 : frame.Width;
    const bool restir = RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled() && quality.ReSTIRGI && velocity &&
        g_ReSTIRTemporal && g_ReSTIRSpatial && EnsureReservoirs(reservoirWidth, frame.Height);
    if (!restir || nrdFrame.ResetHistory) g_ReSTIRHistoryValid = restir && g_ReSTIRHistoryValid && !nrdFrame.ResetHistory;
    constants.ReSTIRParameters = { restir ? 1.0f : 0.0f, static_cast<float>(std::clamp(quality.ReSTIRTemporalMaxM, 1, 64)),
        static_cast<float>(std::clamp(quality.ReSTIRSpatialSamples, 0, 16)), std::clamp(quality.ReSTIRSpatialRadius, 1.0f, 64.0f) };
    // 反射の半解像度（チェッカーボード）：NRD で復元できるときだけ
    const bool reflectionCheckerboard = RenderCulling::GetSettings().ReflectionCheckerboard && !useOptix && denoise &&
        NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() && guides[0] && guides[1] && guides[2];
    g_ReflectionCheckerboard = reflectionCheckerboard;
    g_ReflectionSampling = {frame.Width, frame.Height, nrdFrame.Sequence, reflectionCheckerboard};
    constants.ReSTIRState = { g_ReSTIRHistoryValid ? 1u : 0u, reservoirWidth, quality.ReSTIRSpatialVisibility ? 1u : 0u,
        static_cast<UINT>(std::clamp(RenderCulling::GetSettings().ReflectionRoughnessCutoff, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 1000.0f + 0.5f) |
        (reflectionCheckerboard ? 0x10000u : 0u) };
    constants.CacheParameters = { cacheEnabled ? 1.0f : 0.0f, RendererSettings::GetGiRadianceCacheCellSize(),
        static_cast<float>(kCacheCapacity), static_cast<float>(RendererSettings::GetGiRadianceCacheHistory()) };
    static const bool adaptiveRequested=ReadEnvironmentFlagOnce("DX12_ADAPTIVE_REFLECTIONS");
    static const bool budgetRequested=ReadEnvironmentFlagOnce("DX12_GI_UPDATE_BUDGET");
    const bool adaptive=adaptiveRequested && velocity && g_AdaptiveCapture && Raytracing::GetSettings().Reflections && EnsureAdaptiveHistory(frame.Width,frame.Height);
    uint64_t signature=1469598103934665603ull;
    for(const auto& entry:geometry)
    {
        HashEmission(signature,&entry.World,sizeof(entry.World)); HashEmission(signature,&entry.BaseColor,sizeof(entry.BaseColor));
        HashEmission(signature,&entry.Emission,sizeof(entry.Emission)); HashEmission(signature,&entry.Roughness,sizeof(entry.Roughness)); HashEmission(signature,&entry.Metallic,sizeof(entry.Metallic));
        HashEmission(signature,&entry.VertexView,sizeof(entry.VertexView)); HashEmission(signature,&entry.IndexView,sizeof(entry.IndexView));
        const auto texture=entry.Texture.Get(); const auto emission=entry.EmissionTexture.Get();
        HashEmission(signature,&texture,sizeof(texture)); HashEmission(signature,&emission,sizeof(emission));
        HashEmission(signature,&entry.TextureResidentMip,sizeof(entry.TextureResidentMip));
        if(entry.Deforming) HashEmission(signature,&nrdFrame.Sequence,sizeof(nrdFrame.Sequence));
    }
    if(!lights.empty()) HashEmission(signature,lights.data(),lights.size()*sizeof(ReflectionLight));
    HashEmission(signature,&nrdFrame.LightDirection,sizeof(nrdFrame.LightDirection));
    const bool reuse=adaptive && g_AdaptiveValid && !nrdFrame.ResetHistory && g_AdaptiveSignature==signature && nrdFrame.Sequence==g_AdaptiveSequence+1u;
    const bool budget=budgetRequested && cacheEnabled && !restir && velocity && g_BudgetValid && !nrdFrame.ResetHistory && g_BudgetSignature==signature && nrdFrame.Sequence==g_BudgetSequence+1u;
    if(budgetRequested && cacheEnabled && (!g_BudgetValid || g_BudgetSignature!=signature || nrdFrame.ResetHistory)) g_Cache.NeedsClear=true;
    constants.AdaptiveSampling={adaptive?1.f:0.f,reuse?1.f:0.f,.2f,budget?4.f:1.f};
    g_BudgetSignature=signature; g_BudgetSequence=nrdFrame.Sequence; g_BudgetValid=budgetRequested && cacheEnabled && !restir;
    XMFLOAT4X4 previousProjection=nrdFrame.PreviousProjection;
    previousProjection._31=-nrdFrame.PreviousJitter.x*2/frame.Width; previousProjection._32=nrdFrame.PreviousJitter.y*2/frame.Height;
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.AdaptivePreviousViewProjection,XMMatrixTranspose(XMLoadFloat4x4(&nrdFrame.PreviousView)*XMLoadFloat4x4(&previousProjection)));
    TextureSrv(adaptive?g_AdaptiveRadiance.Get():nullptr,Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(),14)); TextureSrv(adaptive?g_AdaptiveGuide.Get():nullptr,Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(),15));
    D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC guide{}; guide.Format=DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT; guide.ViewDimension=D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(adaptive?g_AdaptiveGuide.Get():nullptr,nullptr,&guide,Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(),23));
    if (!Upload(frame.Constants.Get(), &constants, sizeof(constants))) return false;
    for (auto [resource, state] : sampledResources)
        if ((state & D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE) == 0)
            Transition(commands, resource, state, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    for (UINT i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
    {
        const auto type = i == 0 ? GBufferType::DEPTH : i == 1 ? GBufferType::NORMAL : GBufferType::MATERIAL;
        TextureSrv(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(type), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), i));
        TextureSrv(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(type), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 8 + i));
    }
    TextureSrv(nullptr, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 3));
    AtmosphereLut::WriteSrvs(g_Device.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kSkyLutDescriptors), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kSkyLutDescriptors + 1));
    WriteCacheDescriptors(frame.Heap.Get());
    if (restir)
    {
        const auto rawUav = [&](ID3D12Resource* buffer, UINT index)
        {
            D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC desc{};
            desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
            desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
            desc.Buffer.NumElements = static_cast<UINT>(buffer->GetDesc().Width / 4);
            desc.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_UAV_FLAG_RAW;
            g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(buffer, nullptr, &desc, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), index));
        };
        rawUav(g_Reservoirs[g_ReservoirCurrent].Get(), kReSTIRDescriptors);
        rawUav(g_Reservoirs[g_ReservoirCurrent ^ 1u].Get(), kReSTIRDescriptors + 1);
        TextureSrv(velocity, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kReSTIRDescriptors + 2));
    }
    else
    {
        // Valid null descriptors: the table is part of every bind.
        for (UINT index = 0; index < 2; ++index)
        {
            D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC desc{};
            desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
            desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
            desc.Buffer.NumElements = 1;
            desc.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_UAV_FLAG_RAW;
            g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(nullptr, nullptr, &desc, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kReSTIRDescriptors + index));
        }
        TextureSrv(nullptr, Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kReSTIRDescriptors + 2));
    }
    TextureSrv(velocity,Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(),22));
    if(adaptive)
    {
        Transition(commands,g_AdaptiveRadiance.Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commands,g_AdaptiveGuide.Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    }
    auto bind = [&](ID3D12PipelineState* pipeline)
    {
        ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = { frame.Heap.Get() }; commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
        commands->SetComputeRootSignature(g_Root.Get()); commands->SetPipelineState(pipeline);
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, scene->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(1, frame.Meshes->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(2, frame.Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(3, LightingResources::GetCurrentLightConstantBufferAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(4, Raytracing::GetLightingConstantsAddress(slot));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 0));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(6, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 4));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(7, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kVertexDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(8, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kIndexDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(9, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kTextureDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(10, frame.Lights->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(11, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kEmissionDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(12, frame.Emitters->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(13, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kSkyLutDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(14, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kCacheDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(15, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), kReSTIRDescriptors));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(17,Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(),14)); commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(18,Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(),23));
        if (instrumented) commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(16, RayTelemetry::Data().Address());
    };
    preparationProfile.Finish();
    if (Raytracing::GetSettings().Reflections)
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent reflectionProfile("DXR Reflections", commands);
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent traceProfile("DXR Reflections Trace", commands);
        Transition(commands, frame.Noisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        Transition(commands, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        bind(instrumented ? g_TraceTelemetry.Get() : g_Trace.Get());
        commands->Dispatch(((g_ReflectionCheckerboard ? (frame.Width + 1) / 2 : frame.Width) + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
        Transition(commands, frame.Noisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commands, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        traceProfile.Finish();
        // NRD owns a separate heap and restores these four input states.
        if (useOptix)
        {
            if (!g_OptixReflections)
            {
                g_OptixReflections = make_unique<OptixDenoiser>();
            }
            g_OptixReflectionActive = g_OptixReflections->Execute(commands, frame.Noisy.Get(), depth, normal,
                frame.Result.Get(), nrdFrame, NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled(), true, 1.0f);
            g_HistoryValid = false;
        }
        else if (denoise && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() && guides[0] && guides[1] && guides[2])
        {
            if (!g_Denoiser || g_Width != frame.Width || g_Height != frame.Height || g_DenoiserCheckerboard != g_ReflectionCheckerboard)
            {
                if (GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
                {
                    auto created = make_unique<NrdDenoiser>();
                    if (created->Initialize(g_Device.Get(), g_ReflectionCheckerboard ? NrdSignal::SpecularCheckerboard : NrdSignal::Specular,
                        frame.Width, frame.Height))
                    { g_Denoiser = move(created); g_Width = frame.Width; g_Height = frame.Height; g_HistoryValid = false;
                      g_DenoiserCheckerboard = g_ReflectionCheckerboard; }
                }
            }
            NrdFrame temporalFrame = nrdFrame;
            temporalFrame.ResetHistory = temporalFrame.ResetHistory || !g_HistoryValid;
            NrdInputs inputs{ {guides[0].Get()}, {guides[1].Get()}, {guides[2].Get()}, {frame.Noisy.Get()} };
            bool filtered = false;
            {
                RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent denoiseProfile("DXR Reflections Denoise", commands);
                filtered = g_Denoiser && g_Width == frame.Width && g_Height == frame.Height &&
                    g_Denoiser->Execute(commands, inputs, temporalFrame);
            }
            if (filtered)
            {
                RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent composeProfile("DXR Reflections Compose", commands);
                TextureSrv(g_Denoiser->GetOutput(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 3));
                Transition(commands, g_Denoiser->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                Transition(commands, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
                bind(g_Compose.Get()); commands->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
                Transition(commands, frame.Result.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                Transition(commands, g_Denoiser->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                g_Dispatches = g_Denoiser->GetDispatchCount(); g_HistoryValid = true;
            }
            else g_HistoryValid = false;
        }
        else g_HistoryValid = false;
    }
    if (RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiEnabled())
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Realtime GI", commands);
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent traceProfile("Realtime GI Trace", commands);
        Transition(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        if (cacheEnabled && g_Cache.NeedsClear)
        {
            bind(g_CacheClear.Get());
            commands->Dispatch(kCacheCapacity / 64, 1, 1);
            CacheBarrier(commands);
            g_Cache.NeedsClear = false;
        }
        bind(instrumented ? g_GiTraceTelemetry.Get() : g_GiTrace.Get());
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 8));
        commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(6, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 6));
        UINT traceWidth = frame.Width;
        if (useGiDenoiser)
        {
            traceWidth = (traceWidth + 1) / 2;
        }
        commands->Dispatch((traceWidth + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
        if (restir)
        {
            // Temporal then spatial resampling of the bounce samples (ReSTIR GI).
            const D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER uav[] = {
                CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_Reservoirs[g_ReservoirCurrent].Get()),
                CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(frame.GiNoisy.Get()) };
            commands->ResourceBarrier(2, uav);
            commands->SetPipelineState(g_ReSTIRTemporal.Get());
            commands->Dispatch((reservoirWidth + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
            commands->ResourceBarrier(2, uav);
            commands->SetPipelineState(instrumented ? g_ReSTIRSpatialTelemetry.Get() : g_ReSTIRSpatial.Get());
            commands->Dispatch((reservoirWidth + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
            commands->ResourceBarrier(2, uav);
            // This frame's temporal reservoirs become next frame's history.
            g_ReservoirCurrent ^= 1u;
            g_ReSTIRHistoryValid = true;
        }
        if (cacheEnabled)
        {
            // Average this frame's samples into the cells and age out unused cells.
            CacheBarrier(commands);
            commands->SetPipelineState(g_CacheResolve.Get());
            commands->Dispatch(kCacheCapacity / 64, 1, 1);
            CacheBarrier(commands);
        }
        Transition(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        traceProfile.Finish();
        bool filtered = false;
        bool temporalFiltered = false;
        if (useOptix)
        {
            if (!g_OptixGi)
            {
                g_OptixGi = make_unique<OptixDenoiser>();
            }
            g_OptixGiActive = g_OptixGi->Execute(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), depth, normal,
                frame.GiResult.Get(), nrdFrame, NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled(), false, RendererSettings::GetRealtimeGiIntensity());
            filtered = g_OptixGiActive;
        }
        if (useGiDenoiser)
        {
            if (!g_GiDenoiser || g_GiWidth != frame.Width || g_GiHeight != frame.Height)
            {
                // Resize destroys resources referenced by earlier frames only after their fences complete.
                if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle()) return false;
                auto created = make_unique<NrdDenoiser>();
                if (created->Initialize(g_Device.Get(), NrdSignal::Diffuse, frame.Width, frame.Height))
                {
                    g_GiDenoiser = move(created);
                    g_GiWidth = frame.Width;
                    g_GiHeight = frame.Height;
                    g_GiHistoryValid = false;
                }
            }
            NrdFrame temporalFrame = nrdFrame;
            temporalFrame.ResetHistory |= !g_GiHistoryValid;
            NrdInputs inputs{ {guides[0].Get()}, {guides[1].Get()}, {guides[2].Get()}, {frame.GiNoisy.Get()} };
            bool nrdFiltered = false;
            {
                RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent denoiseProfile("Realtime GI Denoise", commands);
                nrdFiltered = g_GiDenoiser && g_GiWidth == frame.Width && g_GiHeight == frame.Height &&
                    g_GiDenoiser->Execute(commands, inputs, temporalFrame);
            }
            if (nrdFiltered)
            {
                RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent composeProfile("Realtime GI Compose", commands);
                TextureSrv(g_GiDenoiser->GetOutput(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 11));
                Transition(commands, g_GiDenoiser->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
                bind(g_GiCompose.Get());
                commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 8));
                commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(6, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 6));
                commands->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
                Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                Transition(commands, g_GiDenoiser->GetOutput(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                g_Dispatches += g_GiDenoiser->GetDispatchCount();
                filtered = true;
                temporalFiltered = true;
            }
        }
        if (!filtered)
        {
            // The spatial fallback combines filtering and composition in one dispatch.
            RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent spatialProfile("Realtime GI Spatial Denoise / Compose", commands);
            TextureSrv(frame.GiNoisy.Get(), Cpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 11));
            Transition(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            bind(g_GiFilter.Get());
            commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 8));
            commands->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(6, Gpu(frame.Heap.Get(), 6));
            commands->Dispatch((frame.Width + 7) / 8, (frame.Height + 7) / 8, 1);
            Transition(commands, frame.GiResult.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            Transition(commands, frame.GiNoisy.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        }
        g_GiHistoryValid = temporalFiltered;
        g_GiActive = true;
        g_Status = restir ? "Realtime GI 動作中（ReSTIR）" : "Realtime GI 動作中";
    }
    else
    {
        g_GiHistoryValid = false;
    }
    if(adaptive)
    {
        Transition(commands,g_AdaptiveGuide.Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        bind(g_AdaptiveCapture.Get()); commands->Dispatch((frame.Width+7)/8,(frame.Height+7)/8,1);
        Transition(commands,g_AdaptiveGuide.Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commands,g_AdaptiveRadiance.Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
        Transition(commands,frame.Result.Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
        commands->CopyResource(g_AdaptiveRadiance.Get(),frame.Result.Get());
        Transition(commands,frame.Result.Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        Transition(commands,g_AdaptiveRadiance.Get(),D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        g_AdaptiveSignature=signature; g_AdaptiveSequence=nrdFrame.Sequence; g_AdaptiveValid=true;
    }
    else g_AdaptiveValid=false;
    for (auto [resource, state] : sampledResources)
        if ((state & D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE) == 0)
            Transition(commands, resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, state);
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* engine[] = { g_EngineHeap.Get() }; commands->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, engine);
    return true;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\raytelemetry.h =====
#pragma once
#include "raytelemetrydata.h"
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <wrl.h>
#include <cstring>

namespace RayTelemetry
{
class Collector final
{
public:
    static constexpr UINT FrameCount = 3;
    static constexpr UINT Bytes = RAY_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_COUNT * 2 * sizeof(uint32_t);

    bool BeginFrame(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands,
        uint64_t serial, UINT slot, bool requested)
    {
        m_Collecting = false;
        if (slot >= FrameCount || !device || !commands) return false;
        if (m_Device != device)
        {
            m_Frames = {};
            m_Zero.Reset();
            m_Device = device;
        }
        m_Slot = slot;
        auto& frame = m_Frames[slot];
        frame.Serial = serial;
        frame.Requested = requested;
        frame.Submitted = false;
        frame.Active = frame.Measured = 0;
        if (!requested) return false;
        if (!frame.Buffer && !CreateBuffer(device, frame.Buffer, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS)) return false;
        if (!frame.Readback && !CreateBuffer(device, frame.Readback, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST)) return false;
        if (!m_Zero)
        {
            if (!CreateBuffer(device, m_Zero, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ)) return false;
            void* mapped = nullptr;
            const D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
            if (FAILED(m_Zero->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped))) { m_Zero.Reset(); return false; }
            const std::array<uint32_t, RAY_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_COUNT * 2> zero{};
            std::memcpy(mapped, zero.data(), Bytes);
            m_Zero->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        }
        Transition(commands, frame.Buffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
        commands->CopyBufferRegion(frame.Buffer.Get(), 0, m_Zero.Get(), 0, Bytes);
        Transition(commands, frame.Buffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        m_Collecting = true;
        return true;
    }

    bool IsCollecting() const { return m_Collecting; }
    D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS Address() const
    {
        return m_Collecting ? m_Frames[m_Slot].Buffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress() : 0;
    }

    void RecordProvider(uint32_t provider, bool instrumented)
    {
        if (!m_Collecting) return;
        auto& frame = m_Frames[m_Slot];
        frame.Active |= provider;
        if (instrumented) frame.Measured |= provider;
    }

    void EndFrame(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
    {
        if (!m_Collecting || !commands) return;
        auto& frame = m_Frames[m_Slot];
        Transition(commands, frame.Buffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
        commands->CopyBufferRegion(frame.Readback.Get(), 0, frame.Buffer.Get(), 0, Bytes);
        Transition(commands, frame.Buffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        frame.Submitted = true;
        m_Collecting = false;
    }

    // The renderer's frame-slot fence must have completed before this call.
    Counts Consume(UINT slot, uint64_t serial) const
    {
        Counts unavailable;
        unavailable.Serial = serial;
        if (slot >= FrameCount) return unavailable;
        const auto& frame = m_Frames[slot];
        unavailable.Requested = frame.Requested;
        if (!frame.Submitted || !frame.Requested || frame.Serial != serial) return unavailable;
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        const D3D12_RANGE read{0, Bytes};
        if (FAILED(frame.Readback->Map(0, &read, &mapped)) || !mapped) return unavailable;
        std::array<uint32_t, RAY_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_COUNT * 2> words;
        std::memcpy(words.data(), mapped, Bytes);
        const D3D12_RANGE noWrites{0, 0};
        frame.Readback->Unmap(0, &noWrites);
        return Decode(words, frame.Serial, serial, frame.Requested, frame.Active, frame.Measured);
    }

    Counts ConsumeCurrent(uint64_t serial) const { return Consume(m_Slot, serial); }

    void Shutdown()
    {
        m_Frames = {};
        m_Zero.Reset();
        m_Device = nullptr;
        m_Collecting = false;
    }

private:
    struct Frame
    {
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Buffer, Readback;
        uint64_t Serial = 0;
        uint32_t Active = 0, Measured = 0;
        bool Requested = false, Submitted = false;
    };
    std::array<Frame, FrameCount> m_Frames;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> m_Zero;
    ID3D12Device* m_Device = nullptr;
    UINT m_Slot = 0;
    bool m_Collecting = false;

    static bool CreateBuffer(ID3D12Device* device, Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& buffer,
        D3D12_HEAP_TYPE type, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAGS flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE)
    {
        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES heap{};
        heap.Type = type;
        heap.CreationNodeMask = heap.VisibleNodeMask = 1;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC desc{};
        desc.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
        desc.Width = Bytes;
        desc.Height = desc.DepthOrArraySize = desc.MipLevels = 1;
        desc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
        desc.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
        desc.Flags = flags;
        return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc, state,
            nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(buffer.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())));
    }

    static void Transition(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource,
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
    {
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier{};
        barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
        barrier.Transition.pResource = resource;
        barrier.Transition.StateBefore = before;
        barrier.Transition.StateAfter = after;
        barrier.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
        commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    }
};

inline Collector& Data() { static Collector collector; return collector; }
inline bool& Requested() { static bool enabled = false; return enabled; }
inline void SetEnabled(bool enabled) { Requested() = enabled; }
inline bool IsCollecting() { return Data().IsCollecting(); }
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\raytelemetrydata.h =====
#pragma once
#include "raytelemetrylayout.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>

namespace RayTelemetry
{
enum Provider : uint32_t { Radiance = 1u, ShadowAo = 2u };

struct Counts
{
    uint64_t Serial = 0;
    std::array<uint64_t, RAY_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_COUNT> Rays{};
    uint32_t ActiveProviders = 0;
    uint32_t MeasuredProviders = 0;
    bool Requested = false;
    bool Valid = false;
    bool AllSourcesCovered = false;

    bool ProviderKnown(uint32_t provider) const
    {
        return Valid && (ActiveProviders & provider & ~MeasuredProviders) == 0;
    }
};

inline Counts Decode(const std::array<uint32_t, RAY_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_COUNT * 2>& words,
    uint64_t storedSerial, uint64_t expectedSerial, bool requested, uint32_t active, uint32_t measured)
{
    Counts counts;
    counts.Serial = expectedSerial;
    counts.Requested = requested;
    counts.ActiveProviders = active;
    counts.MeasuredProviders = measured;
    counts.Valid = requested && storedSerial == expectedSerial;
    if (counts.Valid)
        for (size_t channel = 0; channel < counts.Rays.size(); ++channel)
            counts.Rays[channel] = uint64_t(words[channel * 2]) | (uint64_t(words[channel * 2 + 1]) << 32);
    return counts;
}
}
