#include "virtualgeometryinternal.h"
#include "../../External/meshoptimizer/src/meshoptimizer.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <unordered_set>

bool ValidateVirtualGeometryConfig(const VirtualGeometryBuildConfig& config, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    if (config.MaxClusterVertices < 3 || config.MaxClusterVertices > VirtualGeometryConfig::MaxClusterVertices ||
        config.MaxClusterTriangles == 0 || config.MaxClusterTriangles > VirtualGeometryConfig::MaxClusterTriangles ||
        config.TargetClustersPerGroup == 0 || config.TargetClustersPerGroup > 1024 ||
        config.MaxHierarchyLevels == 0 || config.MaxHierarchyLevels > VirtualGeometryConfig::MaxHierarchyLevels)
    {
        error = "Invalid virtual geometry cluster/group/level limits";
        return false;
    }
    const float weights[] = {config.NormalWeight, config.TexCoordWeight, config.ColorWeight};
    for (float weight : weights)
    {
        if (!std::isfinite(weight) || weight < 0 || weight > 1000)
        {
            error = "Attribute weights must be finite and within [0, 1000]";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!std::isfinite(config.SimplificationRatio) || config.SimplificationRatio <= 0 || config.SimplificationRatio >= 1 ||
        !std::isfinite(config.ConeWeight) || config.ConeWeight < 0 || config.ConeWeight > 1 ||
        !std::isfinite(config.TargetRelativeError) || config.TargetRelativeError < 0 || config.TargetRelativeError > 1 ||
        !std::isfinite(config.BoundaryEpsilon) || config.BoundaryEpsilon < 0 || config.BoundaryEpsilon > 1)
    {
        error = "Invalid virtual geometry simplification/boundary settings";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

namespace VirtualGeometryInternal
{
    std::array<float, 12> VertexComponents(const VirtualGeometryVertex& vertex)
    {
        return {vertex.Position[0], vertex.Position[1], vertex.Position[2],
            vertex.Normal[0], vertex.Normal[1], vertex.Normal[2],
            vertex.TexCoord[0], vertex.TexCoord[1],
            vertex.Diffuse[0], vertex.Diffuse[1], vertex.Diffuse[2], vertex.Diffuse[3]};
    }

    bool IsFiniteVertex(const VirtualGeometryVertex& vertex)
    {
        auto components = VertexComponents(vertex);
        return std::all_of(components.begin(), components.end(), [](float value)
        {
            return std::isfinite(value);
        });
    }

    namespace
    {
        struct TriangleKey
        {
            std::array<uint32_t, 3> Vertices;
            bool operator==(const TriangleKey&) const = default;
        };
        struct TriangleHash
        {
            size_t operator()(const TriangleKey& key) const
            {
                size_t hash = 0;
                for (uint32_t index : key.Vertices)
                {
                    hash = hash * 16777619u ^ index;
                }
                return hash;
            }
        };

        bool HasZeroArea(const VirtualGeometryVertex& first,
            const VirtualGeometryVertex& second, const VirtualGeometryVertex& third)
        {
            double firstEdge[3];
            double secondEdge[3];
            for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                firstEdge[axis] = double(second.Position[axis]) - first.Position[axis];
                secondEdge[axis] = double(third.Position[axis]) - first.Position[axis];
            }
            double crossX = firstEdge[1] * secondEdge[2] - firstEdge[2] * secondEdge[1];
            double crossY = firstEdge[2] * secondEdge[0] - firstEdge[0] * secondEdge[2];
            double crossZ = firstEdge[0] * secondEdge[1] - firstEdge[1] * secondEdge[0];
            return crossX == 0 && crossY == 0 && crossZ == 0;
        }

        VirtualGeometryNormalCone ComputeCone(std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices,
            const uint32_t* localVertices, const uint8_t* triangles, uint32_t triangleCount,
            const VirtualGeometrySphere& sphere)
        {
            // Double intermediates keep tiny finite triangles from becoming zero normals
            // and large finite triangles from overflowing their squared cross products.
            std::vector<std::array<double, 3>> normals;
            std::vector<std::array<double, 3>> origins;
            std::array<double, 3> axis{};
            for (uint32_t triangle = 0; triangle < triangleCount; ++triangle)
            {
                const auto& first = vertices[localVertices[triangles[triangle * 3]]].Position;
                const auto& second = vertices[localVertices[triangles[triangle * 3 + 1]]].Position;
                const auto& third = vertices[localVertices[triangles[triangle * 3 + 2]]].Position;
                std::array<double, 3> firstEdge;
                std::array<double, 3> secondEdge;
                for (size_t component = 0; component < 3; ++component)
                {
                    firstEdge[component] = double(second[component]) - first[component];
                    secondEdge[component] = double(third[component]) - first[component];
                }
                std::array<double, 3> normal = {
                    firstEdge[1] * secondEdge[2] - firstEdge[2] * secondEdge[1],
                    firstEdge[2] * secondEdge[0] - firstEdge[0] * secondEdge[2],
                    firstEdge[0] * secondEdge[1] - firstEdge[1] * secondEdge[0]};
                double length = std::sqrt(normal[0] * normal[0] + normal[1] * normal[1] + normal[2] * normal[2]);
                if (length == 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                for (size_t component = 0; component < 3; ++component)
                {
                    normal[component] /= length;
                    axis[component] += normal[component];
                }
                normals.push_back(normal);
                origins.push_back({first[0], first[1], first[2]});
            }
            VirtualGeometryNormalCone cone;
            cone.Apex = sphere.Center;
            double axisLength = std::sqrt(axis[0] * axis[0] + axis[1] * axis[1] + axis[2] * axis[2]);
            if (axisLength == 0 || normals.empty())
            {
                return cone; // Cutoff=1 disables rejection for a wide/degenerate cone.
            }
            for (size_t component = 0; component < 3; ++component)
            {
                axis[component] /= axisLength;
            }
            double minimumDot = 1;
            for (const auto& normal : normals)
            {
                minimumDot = std::min(minimumDot, normal[0] * axis[0] + normal[1] * axis[1] + normal[2] * axis[2]);
            }
            constexpr double minimumUsefulConeDot = 0.1;
            if (minimumDot <= minimumUsefulConeDot)
            {
                return cone;
            }
            double apexDistance = 0;
            double axisRoundingError = 0;
            for (size_t component = 0; component < 3; ++component)
            {
                cone.Axis[component] = static_cast<float>(axis[component]);
                axisRoundingError += std::abs(double(cone.Axis[component]) - axis[component]);
            }
            for (size_t triangle = 0; triangle < normals.size(); ++triangle)
            {
                const auto& normal = normals[triangle];
                double distance = 0;
                double dot = 0;
                for (size_t component = 0; component < 3; ++component)
                {
                    distance += (double(sphere.Center[component]) - origins[triangle][component]) * normal[component];
                    dot += cone.Axis[component] * normal[component];
                }
                apexDistance = std::max(apexDistance, distance / dot);
            }
            for (size_t component = 0; component < 3; ++component)
            {
                cone.Apex[component] = static_cast<float>(double(sphere.Center[component]) - cone.Axis[component] * apexDistance);
            }
            double cutoff = std::sqrt(std::max(0.0, 1 - minimumDot * minimumDot)) + axisRoundingError;
            cone.Cutoff = std::min(1.0f, std::nextafter(static_cast<float>(cutoff),
                std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity()));
            return cone;
        }
    }

    std::vector<uint32_t> CleanSource(std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices,
        std::span<const uint32_t> indices, VirtualGeometryBuildStats& stats)
    {
        if (vertices.empty() || indices.empty() || indices.size() % 3 != 0)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Source must contain vertices and complete triangles");
        }
        CheckedIndex(vertices.size());
        CheckedIndex(indices.size());
        // Avoid overflow inside meshoptimizer's float metrics, including unused input vertices.
        constexpr float maximumComponentMagnitude = 1e8f;
        for (const auto& vertex : vertices)
        {
            for (float value : VertexComponents(vertex))
            {
                if (!std::isfinite(value) || std::abs(value) > maximumComponentMagnitude)
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Non-finite or unsupported extreme source vertex component");
                }
            }
        }
        for (uint32_t index : indices)
        {
            if (index >= vertices.size())
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Source triangle index out of bounds");
            }
        }
        // Exact full-attribute remap identifies duplicate vertices without welding UV/normal seams.
        std::vector<uint32_t> remap(vertices.size());
        meshopt_generateVertexRemap(remap.data(), indices.data(), indices.size(),
            vertices.data(), vertices.size(), sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex));
        std::unordered_set<TriangleKey, TriangleHash> seen;
        seen.reserve(indices.size() / 3);
        std::vector<uint32_t> clean;
        clean.reserve(indices.size());
        for (size_t offset = 0; offset < indices.size(); offset += 3)
        {
            uint32_t first = indices[offset];
            uint32_t second = indices[offset + 1];
            uint32_t third = indices[offset + 2];
            if (HasZeroArea(vertices[first], vertices[second], vertices[third]))
            {
                ++stats.RemovedDegenerateTriangles;
                continue;
            }
            // Rotate to canonical winding. Opposite-facing triangles are intentionally retained.
            TriangleKey key{{remap[first], remap[second], remap[third]}};
            auto smallest = std::min_element(key.Vertices.begin(), key.Vertices.end());
            std::rotate(key.Vertices.begin(), smallest, key.Vertices.end());
            if (!seen.insert(key).second)
            {
                ++stats.RemovedDuplicateTriangles;
                continue;
            }
            clean.insert(clean.end(), {first, second, third});
        }
        if (clean.empty())
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Source has no non-degenerate unique triangles");
        }
        stats.FinalLeafTriangles = clean.size() / 3;
        return clean;
    }

    VirtualGeometrySphere SphereFromAabb(const VirtualGeometryAabb& bounds)
    {
        VirtualGeometrySphere sphere;
        double squaredRadius = 0;
        for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            sphere.Center[axis] = static_cast<float>((double(bounds.Min[axis]) + bounds.Max[axis]) * 0.5);
            double extent = std::max(std::abs(double(bounds.Min[axis]) - sphere.Center[axis]),
                std::abs(double(bounds.Max[axis]) - sphere.Center[axis]));
            squaredRadius += extent * extent;
        }
        sphere.Radius = std::nextafter(static_cast<float>(std::sqrt(squaredRadius)),
            std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
        return sphere;
    }

    std::vector<uint32_t> AppendClusters(VirtualGeometryAsset& asset,
        std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices, std::span<const uint32_t> indices,
        uint32_t level, float error)
    {
        const auto& config = asset.Config;
        size_t bound = meshopt_buildMeshletsBound(indices.size(), config.MaxClusterVertices, config.MaxClusterTriangles);
        std::vector<meshopt_Meshlet> meshlets(bound);
        std::vector<uint32_t> meshletVertices(indices.size());
        std::vector<uint8_t> meshletTriangles(indices.size());
        size_t count = meshopt_buildMeshlets(meshlets.data(), meshletVertices.data(), meshletTriangles.data(),
            indices.data(), indices.size(), vertices[0].Position, vertices.size(), sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex),
            config.MaxClusterVertices, config.MaxClusterTriangles, config.ConeWeight);
        std::vector<uint32_t> clusters;
        clusters.reserve(count);
        for (size_t index = 0; index < count; ++index)
        {
            const auto& meshlet = meshlets[index];
            uint32_t* localVertices = meshletVertices.data() + meshlet.vertex_offset;
            uint8_t* triangles = meshletTriangles.data() + meshlet.triangle_offset;
            meshopt_optimizeMeshlet(localVertices, triangles, meshlet.triangle_count, meshlet.vertex_count);
            VirtualGeometryCluster cluster;
            cluster.VertexOffset = CheckedIndex(asset.Vertices.size());
            cluster.TriangleOffset = CheckedIndex(asset.TriangleIndices.size());
            CheckedIndex(asset.Vertices.size() + meshlet.vertex_count);
            CheckedIndex(asset.TriangleIndices.size() + size_t(meshlet.triangle_count) * 3);
            cluster.VertexCount = meshlet.vertex_count;
            cluster.TriangleCount = meshlet.triangle_count;
            cluster.Level = level;
            cluster.MaterialId = asset.SourceMaterialId;
            cluster.LodError = error;
            for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                cluster.Aabb.Min[axis] = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
                cluster.Aabb.Max[axis] = std::numeric_limits<float>::lowest();
            }
            for (uint32_t vertexIndex = 0; vertexIndex < meshlet.vertex_count; ++vertexIndex)
            {
                const auto& vertex = vertices[localVertices[vertexIndex]];
                asset.Vertices.push_back(vertex);
                for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                {
                    cluster.Aabb.Min[axis] = std::min(cluster.Aabb.Min[axis], vertex.Position[axis]);
                    cluster.Aabb.Max[axis] = std::max(cluster.Aabb.Max[axis], vertex.Position[axis]);
                }
            }
            cluster.Bounds = SphereFromAabb(cluster.Aabb);
            cluster.Cone = ComputeCone(vertices, localVertices, triangles, meshlet.triangle_count, cluster.Bounds);
            asset.TriangleIndices.insert(asset.TriangleIndices.end(), triangles, triangles + meshlet.triangle_count * 3);
            clusters.push_back(CheckedIndex(asset.Clusters.size()));
            asset.Clusters.push_back(cluster);
        }
        return clusters;
    }
}

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrygpu.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrygpu.h"
#include "virtualgeometryvalidator.h"
#include "virtualgeometryruntime.h"
#include <exception>
#include <limits>

namespace VirtualGeometryGPU
{
uint32_t AssetRegistry::Register(std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryRuntime::RuntimeAsset> asset, std::string& error)
{
    if (!asset || !asset->Error.empty())
    {
        error = "VirtualGeometry asset is unavailable";
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    const auto existing = m_Ids.find(asset.get());
    if (existing != m_Ids.end())
    {
        error.clear();
        return existing->second;
    }
    PackedAsset packed;
    if (!Pack(asset->Hierarchy, packed, error) || m_Table.size() >= UINT32_MAX)
    {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    try
    {
        uint32_t id = uint32_t(m_Table.size());
        m_Table.reserve(m_Table.size() + 1);
        m_Owners.reserve(m_Owners.size() + 1);
        auto [entry, inserted] = m_Ids.emplace(asset.get(), id);
        VirtualGeometryGPUAsset table;
        if (!Append(packed, m_Geometry, table, error))
        {
            m_Ids.erase(entry);
            return UINT32_MAX;
        }
        m_Table.push_back(table);
        m_Owners.push_back(std::move(asset));
        return id;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
}
namespace
{
std::array<float, 4> Sphere(const VirtualGeometrySphere& sphere)
{
    return {sphere.Center[0], sphere.Center[1], sphere.Center[2], sphere.Radius};
}
template<class T>
bool Fits(const std::vector<T>& existing, const std::vector<T>& added)
{
    return existing.size() <= UINT32_MAX && added.size() <= UINT32_MAX - existing.size();
}
template<class T>
void ReserveAppend(std::vector<T>& destination, size_t added)
{
    size_t required = destination.size()+added;
    if (required <= destination.capacity())
    {
        return;
    }
    size_t grown = destination.capacity()+destination.capacity()/2;
    destination.reserve(std::max(required,std::min(size_t(UINT32_MAX),grown)));
}
}

bool Pack(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, PackedAsset& output, std::string& error)
{
    output = {};
    if (!VirtualGeometryValidator::Validate(asset, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    try
    {
        PackedAsset result;
        result.Clusters.reserve(asset.Clusters.size());
        for (const auto& cluster : asset.Clusters)
        {
            if (cluster.VertexCount > 64 || cluster.TriangleCount > 124 || asset.Vertices.size() > UINT32_MAX/48)
            {
                error = "Native VirtualGeometry exceeds Mesh Shader limits";
                return false;
            }
            VirtualGeometryGPUCluster record;
            record.VertexOffset = cluster.VertexOffset;
            record.VertexCount = cluster.VertexCount;
            record.TriangleOffset = cluster.TriangleOffset;
            record.TriangleCount = cluster.TriangleCount;
            record.Level = cluster.Level;
            record.GroupIndex = cluster.GroupIndex;
            record.GeneratingGroupIndex = cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex;
            record.MaterialId = cluster.MaterialId;
            record.Bounds = Sphere(cluster.Bounds);
            record.Cone = {cluster.Cone.Axis[0], cluster.Cone.Axis[1], cluster.Cone.Axis[2], cluster.Cone.Cutoff};
            record.ConeApex = {cluster.Cone.Apex[0], cluster.Cone.Apex[1], cluster.Cone.Apex[2], 0};
            record.LodError = cluster.LodError;
            result.Clusters.push_back(record);
        }
        for (const auto& group : asset.Groups)
        {
            VirtualGeometryGPUGroup record;
            record.FirstChild = group.FirstChild;
            record.ChildCount = group.ChildCount;
            record.FirstParent = group.FirstParent;
            record.ParentCount = group.ParentCount;
            record.Bounds = Sphere(group.Bounds);
            record.MinError = group.MinError;
            record.MaxError = group.MaxError;
            record.Level = group.Level;
            result.Groups.push_back(record);
        }
        result.HierarchyIndices = asset.HierarchyIndices;
        result.Roots = asset.RootClusters;
        result.Vertices = asset.Vertices;
        result.Triangles = asset.TriangleIndices;
        result.Triangles.resize((result.Triangles.size() + 3) & ~size_t(3), 0);
        output = std::move(result);
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

bool Append(const PackedAsset& asset, PackedAsset& global, VirtualGeometryGPUAsset& table, std::string& error)
{
    if (!Fits(global.Clusters, asset.Clusters) || !Fits(global.Groups, asset.Groups) ||
        !Fits(global.HierarchyIndices, asset.HierarchyIndices) || !Fits(global.Roots, asset.Roots) ||
        !Fits(global.Vertices, asset.Vertices) || !Fits(global.Triangles, asset.Triangles) ||
        global.Triangles.size() % 4 != 0 || asset.Triangles.size() % 4 != 0 ||
        uint64_t(global.Vertices.size())+asset.Vertices.size() > UINT32_MAX/48)
    {
        error = "Native VirtualGeometry global range overflow/alignment failure";
        return false;
    }
    VirtualGeometryGPUAsset entry;
    entry.ClusterOffset = uint32_t(global.Clusters.size());
    entry.ClusterCount = uint32_t(asset.Clusters.size());
    entry.GroupOffset = uint32_t(global.Groups.size());
    entry.GroupCount = uint32_t(asset.Groups.size());
    entry.RootOffset = uint32_t(global.Roots.size());
    entry.RootCount = uint32_t(asset.Roots.size());
    entry.VertexOffset = uint32_t(global.Vertices.size());
    entry.TriangleOffset = uint32_t(global.Triangles.size());
    entry.HierarchyIndexOffset = uint32_t(global.HierarchyIndices.size());
    entry.HierarchyIndexCount = uint32_t(asset.HierarchyIndices.size());
    uint32_t maximumLevel = 0;
    for (const auto& cluster : asset.Clusters)
    {
        maximumLevel = std::max(maximumLevel,cluster.Level);
    }
    entry.Flags = 1u | (maximumLevel << 8);
    try
    {
        // Reserve every allocation before changing logical contents, so a
        // failed registration never exposes a partially appended asset.
        ReserveAppend(global.Clusters,asset.Clusters.size());
        ReserveAppend(global.Groups,asset.Groups.size());
        ReserveAppend(global.HierarchyIndices,asset.HierarchyIndices.size());
        ReserveAppend(global.Roots,asset.Roots.size());
        ReserveAppend(global.Vertices,asset.Vertices.size());
        ReserveAppend(global.Triangles,asset.Triangles.size());
        global.Clusters.insert(global.Clusters.end(), asset.Clusters.begin(), asset.Clusters.end());
        global.Groups.insert(global.Groups.end(), asset.Groups.begin(), asset.Groups.end());
        global.HierarchyIndices.insert(global.HierarchyIndices.end(), asset.HierarchyIndices.begin(), asset.HierarchyIndices.end());
        global.Roots.insert(global.Roots.end(), asset.Roots.begin(), asset.Roots.end());
        global.Vertices.insert(global.Vertices.end(), asset.Vertices.begin(), asset.Vertices.end());
        global.Triangles.insert(global.Triangles.end(), asset.Triangles.begin(), asset.Triangles.end());
        table = entry;
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}
}

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryhierarchy.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometryinternal.h"
#include "../../External/meshoptimizer/src/meshoptimizer.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace VirtualGeometryInternal
{
    namespace
    {
        uint64_t EdgeKey(uint32_t first, uint32_t second)
        {
            return uint64_t(std::min(first, second)) << 32 | std::max(first, second);
        }

        struct EdgeUse
        {
            uint32_t Count = 0;
            uint32_t Partition = 0;
            bool Shared = false;
        };
        using EdgeTable = std::unordered_map<uint64_t, EdgeUse>;
        using EdgeCounts = std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint32_t>;

        struct VertexKey
        {
            std::array<uint32_t, 12> Components{};
            explicit VertexKey(const VirtualGeometryVertex& vertex)
            {
                auto values = VertexComponents(vertex);
                for (size_t component = 0; component < values.size(); ++component)
                {
                    Components[component] = values[component] == 0 ? 0 : std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(values[component]);
                }
            }
            bool operator==(const VertexKey&) const = default;
        };
        struct VertexHash
        {
            size_t operator()(const VertexKey& vertex) const
            {
                size_t hash = 0;
                for (uint32_t component : vertex.Components)
                {
                    hash = hash * 16777619u ^ component;
                }
                return hash;
            }
        };

        struct LevelGeometry
        {
            std::vector<std::array<float, 3>> Positions;
            std::vector<uint32_t> PositionRemap;
            std::vector<uint32_t> VertexOffsets;
            std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> Partitions; // Indices into current clusters.
            EdgeTable Edges;
        };

        LevelGeometry PartitionLevel(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const std::vector<uint32_t>& current)
        {
            LevelGeometry geometry;
            std::vector<uint32_t> counts;
            for (uint32_t clusterIndex : current)
            {
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[clusterIndex];
                geometry.VertexOffsets.push_back(CheckedIndex(geometry.Positions.size()));
                counts.push_back(cluster.VertexCount);
                for (uint32_t vertex = 0; vertex < cluster.VertexCount; ++vertex)
                {
                    const auto& position = asset.Vertices[cluster.VertexOffset + vertex].Position;
                    geometry.Positions.push_back({position[0] == 0 ? 0 : position[0],
                        position[1] == 0 ? 0 : position[1], position[2] == 0 ? 0 : position[2]});
                }
            }
            CheckedIndex(geometry.Positions.size());
            geometry.PositionRemap.resize(geometry.Positions.size());
            meshopt_generatePositionRemap(geometry.PositionRemap.data(), geometry.Positions[0].data(),
                geometry.Positions.size(), sizeof(geometry.Positions[0]));
            std::vector<uint32_t> partitionIds(current.size());
            size_t count = meshopt_partitionClusters(partitionIds.data(), geometry.PositionRemap.data(),
                geometry.PositionRemap.size(), counts.data(), current.size(), geometry.Positions[0].data(),
                geometry.Positions.size(), sizeof(geometry.Positions[0]), asset.Config.TargetClustersPerGroup);
            geometry.Partitions.resize(count);
            for (uint32_t currentIndex = 0; currentIndex < current.size(); ++currentIndex)
            {
                uint32_t partition = partitionIds[currentIndex];
                geometry.Partitions[partition].push_back(currentIndex);
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[current[currentIndex]];
                uint32_t offset = geometry.VertexOffsets[currentIndex];
                for (uint32_t triangle = 0; triangle < cluster.TriangleCount; ++triangle)
                {
                    for (uint32_t corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
                    {
                        uint32_t first = asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + triangle * 3 + corner];
                        uint32_t second = asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + triangle * 3 + (corner + 1) % 3];
                        auto& edge = geometry.Edges[EdgeKey(geometry.PositionRemap[offset + first],
                            geometry.PositionRemap[offset + second])];
                        if (edge.Count == 0)
                        {
                            edge.Partition = partition;
                        }
                        edge.Shared |= edge.Partition != partition;
                        ++edge.Count;
                    }
                }
            }
            return geometry;
        }

        struct GroupGeometry
        {
            std::vector<VirtualGeometryVertex> Vertices;
            std::vector<uint32_t> Indices;
            std::vector<uint32_t> PositionIds;
        };

        GroupGeometry MergeGroup(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const std::vector<uint32_t>& current,
            const LevelGeometry& level, const std::vector<uint32_t>& partition)
        {
            GroupGeometry mesh;
            std::unordered_map<VertexKey, uint32_t, VertexHash> vertices;
            for (uint32_t currentIndex : partition)
            {
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[current[currentIndex]];
                std::vector<uint32_t> localRemap(cluster.VertexCount);
                for (uint32_t vertexIndex = 0; vertexIndex < cluster.VertexCount; ++vertexIndex)
                {
                    const auto& vertex = asset.Vertices[cluster.VertexOffset + vertexIndex];
                    uint32_t destination = CheckedIndex(mesh.Vertices.size());
                    auto [entry, inserted] = vertices.emplace(VertexKey(vertex), destination);
                    if (inserted)
                    {
                        mesh.Vertices.push_back(vertex);
                        mesh.PositionIds.push_back(level.PositionRemap[level.VertexOffsets[currentIndex] + vertexIndex]);
                    }
                    localRemap[vertexIndex] = entry->second;
                }
                for (uint32_t index = 0; index < cluster.TriangleCount * 3; ++index)
                {
                    mesh.Indices.push_back(localRemap[asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + index]]);
                }
            }
            return mesh;
        }

        EdgeCounts CountEdges(const GroupGeometry& mesh, std::span<const uint32_t> indices)
        {
            EdgeCounts edges;
            edges.reserve(indices.size());
            for (size_t triangle = 0; triangle < indices.size(); triangle += 3)
            {
                for (size_t corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
                {
                    ++edges[EdgeKey(mesh.PositionIds[indices[triangle + corner]],
                        mesh.PositionIds[indices[triangle + (corner + 1) % 3]])];
                }
            }
            return edges;
        }

        std::vector<unsigned char> LockBoundary(const GroupGeometry& mesh,
            const LevelGeometry& level, EdgeCounts& protectedEdges)
        {
            auto counts = CountEdges(mesh, mesh.Indices);
            std::unordered_set<uint32_t> lockedPositions;
            for (const auto& [key, count] : counts)
            {
                const auto& global = level.Edges.at(key);
                if (count != 2 || global.Shared || global.Count != 2)
                {
                    protectedEdges.emplace(key, count);
                    lockedPositions.insert(static_cast<uint32_t>(key >> 32));
                    lockedPositions.insert(static_cast<uint32_t>(key));
                }
            }
            std::vector<unsigned char> locks(mesh.Vertices.size());
            for (size_t vertex = 0; vertex < mesh.Vertices.size(); ++vertex)
            {
                if (lockedPositions.contains(mesh.PositionIds[vertex]))
                {
                    // All seam copies sharing this position are locked.
                    locks[vertex] = meshopt_SimplifyVertex_Lock;
                }
            }
            return locks;
        }

        void ValidateBoundary(const GroupGeometry& mesh, std::span<const uint32_t> simplified,
            const EdgeCounts& protectedEdges)
        {
            auto after = CountEdges(mesh, simplified);
            for (const auto& [key, count] : protectedEdges)
            {
                auto entry = after.find(key);
                if (entry == after.end() || entry->second != count)
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Simplification changed a protected boundary edge");
                }
            }
            for (const auto& [key, count] : after)
            {
                if (count != 2 && !protectedEdges.contains(key))
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Simplification introduced a new geometric boundary");
                }
            }
            // simplifyWithAttributes returns original vertex indices and cannot move positions.
            // Exact positional edge comparison above is stronger than an epsilon position check.
        }

        VirtualGeometrySphere GroupBounds(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset,
            const std::vector<uint32_t>& children)
        {
            std::vector<VirtualGeometrySphere> spheres;
            spheres.reserve(children.size());
            for (uint32_t index : children)
            {
                const auto& child = asset.Clusters[index];
                const auto& sphere = child.GeneratingGroupIndex == VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex
                    ? child.Bounds : asset.Groups[child.GeneratingGroupIndex].Bounds;
                spheres.push_back(sphere);
            }
            auto bounds = meshopt_computeSphereBounds(spheres[0].Center.data(), spheres.size(),
                sizeof(VirtualGeometrySphere), &spheres[0].Radius, sizeof(VirtualGeometrySphere));
            VirtualGeometrySphere result;
            std::copy_n(bounds.center, 3, result.Center.begin());
            double radius = 0;
            for (const auto& sphere : spheres)
            {
                double distanceSquared = 0;
                for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                {
                    double difference = double(result.Center[axis]) - sphere.Center[axis];
                    distanceSquared += difference * difference;
                }
                radius = std::max(radius, std::sqrt(distanceSquared) + sphere.Radius);
            }
            result.Radius = std::nextafter(static_cast<float>(radius), std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
            return result;
        }

        std::vector<uint32_t> SimplifyGroup(VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const std::vector<uint32_t>& current,
            const LevelGeometry& level, const std::vector<uint32_t>& partition)
        {
            if (partition.size() < 2)
            {
                return {};
            }
            GroupGeometry mesh = MergeGroup(asset, current, level, partition);
            EdgeCounts protectedEdges;
            auto locks = LockBoundary(mesh, level, protectedEdges);
            std::vector<std::array<float, 9>> attributes;
            attributes.reserve(mesh.Vertices.size());
            for (const auto& vertex : mesh.Vertices)
            {
                attributes.push_back({vertex.Normal[0], vertex.Normal[1], vertex.Normal[2],
                    vertex.TexCoord[0], vertex.TexCoord[1], vertex.Diffuse[0], vertex.Diffuse[1],
                    vertex.Diffuse[2], vertex.Diffuse[3]});
            }
            const auto& config = asset.Config;
            const float weights[] = {config.NormalWeight, config.NormalWeight, config.NormalWeight,
                config.TexCoordWeight, config.TexCoordWeight,
                config.ColorWeight, config.ColorWeight, config.ColorWeight, config.ColorWeight};
            size_t target = std::max(size_t(1), static_cast<size_t>((mesh.Indices.size() / 3) *
                double(config.SimplificationRatio))) * 3;
            std::vector<uint32_t> simplified(mesh.Indices.size());
            float relativeError = 0;
            size_t count = meshopt_simplifyWithAttributes(simplified.data(), mesh.Indices.data(), mesh.Indices.size(),
                mesh.Vertices[0].Position, mesh.Vertices.size(), sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex), attributes[0].data(),
                sizeof(attributes[0]), weights, std::size(weights), locks.data(), target,
                config.TargetRelativeError, 0, &relativeError);
            if (count == 0 || count >= mesh.Indices.size())
            {
                return {};
            }
            simplified.resize(count);
            ValidateBoundary(mesh, simplified, protectedEdges);
            float absoluteError = relativeError * meshopt_simplifyScale(mesh.Vertices[0].Position,
                mesh.Vertices.size(), sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex));
            if (!std::isfinite(absoluteError) || absoluteError < 0)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid simplification error");
            }
            std::vector<uint32_t> children;
            float childError = 0;
            for (uint32_t currentIndex : partition)
            {
                uint32_t index = current[currentIndex];
                children.push_back(index);
                childError = std::max(childError, asset.Clusters[index].LodError);
            }
            uint32_t childLevel = asset.Clusters[children[0]].Level;
            size_t vertexStart = asset.Vertices.size();
            size_t triangleStart = asset.TriangleIndices.size();
            size_t clusterStart = asset.Clusters.size();
            float parentError = std::max(childError, absoluteError);
            auto parents = AppendClusters(asset, mesh.Vertices, simplified, childLevel + 1, parentError);
            if (parents.empty() || parents.size() >= children.size())
            {
                asset.Vertices.resize(vertexStart);
                asset.TriangleIndices.resize(triangleStart);
                asset.Clusters.resize(clusterStart);
                return {};
            }
            uint32_t groupIndex = CheckedIndex(asset.Groups.size());
            VirtualGeometryClusterGroup group;
            group.Level = childLevel;
            group.FirstChild = CheckedIndex(asset.HierarchyIndices.size());
            group.ChildCount = CheckedIndex(children.size());
            group.Bounds = GroupBounds(asset, children);
            group.MinError = childError;
            group.MaxError = parentError;
            asset.HierarchyIndices.insert(asset.HierarchyIndices.end(), children.begin(), children.end());
            group.FirstParent = CheckedIndex(asset.HierarchyIndices.size());
            group.ParentCount = CheckedIndex(parents.size());
            CheckedIndex(asset.HierarchyIndices.size() + parents.size());
            asset.HierarchyIndices.insert(asset.HierarchyIndices.end(), parents.begin(), parents.end());
            asset.Groups.push_back(group);
            for (uint32_t child : children)
            {
                asset.Clusters[child].GroupIndex = groupIndex;
            }
            for (uint32_t parent : parents)
            {
                asset.Clusters[parent].GeneratingGroupIndex = groupIndex;
            }
            return parents;
        }
    }

    void BuildHierarchy(VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::vector<uint32_t> current)
    {
        for (uint32_t level = 0; level + 1 < asset.Config.MaxHierarchyLevels && current.size() > 1; ++level)
        {
            auto geometry = PartitionLevel(asset, current);
            std::vector<uint32_t> next;
            for (const auto& partition : geometry.Partitions)
            {
                auto parents = SimplifyGroup(asset, current, geometry, partition);
                if (parents.empty())
                {
                    for (uint32_t currentIndex : partition)
                    {
                        asset.RootClusters.push_back(current[currentIndex]);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    next.insert(next.end(), parents.begin(), parents.end());
                }
            }
            if (next.empty())
            {
                current.clear();
                break;
            }
            if (next.size() >= current.size())
            {
                current = std::move(next);
                break;
            }
            current = std::move(next);
        }
        asset.RootClusters.insert(asset.RootClusters.end(), current.begin(), current.end());
        std::sort(asset.RootClusters.begin(), asset.RootClusters.end());
    }
}

VirtualGeometryBuildConfig VGImportSettings::BuildConfig() const
{
    auto config = Quality == VGQuality::Custom ? Custom : VGSettings::Production();
    switch (Quality)
    {
    case VGQuality::Low: config.TargetRelativeError = 0.1f; break;
    case VGQuality::Medium: config.TargetRelativeError = 0.05f; break;
    case VGQuality::High: config.TargetRelativeError = 0.02f; break;
    default: break;
    }
    if (LODError > 0)
    {
        config.TargetRelativeError = LODError;
    }
    // Every preset must obey the shipping Mesh Shader output limits.
    config.MaxClusterVertices = std::min(config.MaxClusterVertices, 64u);
    config.MaxClusterTriangles = std::min(config.MaxClusterTriangles, 124u);
    return config;
}
VGCompressionSettings VGImportSettings::Compression(float sourceExtent) const
{
    VGCompressionSettings settings;
    settings.MaxPositionError = PositionError > 0 ? PositionError :
        std::clamp(sourceExtent * 0.00001f, 0.000001f, 0.001f);
    return settings;
}
namespace VirtualGeometryImport
{
namespace
{
std::filesystem::path Sidecar(const std::filesystem::path& source)
{
    auto path = source;
    path += ".vgsettings";
    return path;
}
std::string Encode(const VGImportSettings& settings)
{
    std::ostringstream output;
    output.imbue(std::locale::classic());
    output << std::setprecision(9) << "VGSETTINGS 1\n" << settings.Enabled << ' ' << settings.BackgroundBuild << ' '
        << static_cast<uint32_t>(settings.Quality) << ' ' << settings.PositionError << ' ' << settings.LODError
        << ' ' << settings.StreamingPriority << '\n';
    const auto& c = settings.Custom;
    output << c.MaxClusterTriangles << ' ' << c.MaxClusterVertices << ' ' << c.TargetClustersPerGroup << ' '
        << c.MaxHierarchyLevels << ' ' << c.SimplificationRatio << ' ' << c.ConeWeight << ' ' << c.NormalWeight
        << ' ' << c.TexCoordWeight << ' ' << c.ColorWeight << ' ' << c.TargetRelativeError << ' ' << c.BoundaryEpsilon << '\n';
    return output.str();
}
bool Valid(const VGImportSettings& settings, std::string& error)
{
    if (settings.Quality > VGQuality::Custom || settings.StreamingPriority > 2 ||
        !std::isfinite(settings.PositionError) || settings.PositionError < 0 ||
        !std::isfinite(settings.LODError) || settings.LODError < 0)
    {
        error = "Invalid VirtualGeometry import settings";
        return false;
    }
    return ValidateVirtualGeometryConfig(settings.BuildConfig(), error);
}
}
bool Load(const std::filesystem::path& source, VGImportSettings& settings, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto path = Sidecar(source);
    if (!std::filesystem::exists(path, ec) && !ec)
    {
        settings = {};
        return true;
    }
    std::ifstream input(path);
    input.imbue(std::locale::classic());
    VGImportSettings parsed;
    std::string magic;
    uint32_t version = 0, quality = 0;
    auto& c = parsed.Custom;
    if (!(input >> magic >> version) || magic != "VGSETTINGS" || version != 1 ||
        !(input >> parsed.Enabled >> parsed.BackgroundBuild >> quality >> parsed.PositionError >> parsed.LODError
            >> parsed.StreamingPriority >> c.MaxClusterTriangles >> c.MaxClusterVertices >> c.TargetClustersPerGroup
            >> c.MaxHierarchyLevels >> c.SimplificationRatio >> c.ConeWeight >> c.NormalWeight >> c.TexCoordWeight
            >> c.ColorWeight >> c.TargetRelativeError >> c.BoundaryEpsilon))
    {
        error = "Invalid or truncated VirtualGeometry settings: " + path.generic_string();
        return false;
    }
    parsed.Quality = static_cast<VGQuality>(quality);
    if (!Valid(parsed, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    settings = parsed;
    return true;
}
bool Save(const std::filesystem::path& source, const VGImportSettings& settings, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    if (!Valid(settings, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto target = Sidecar(source);
    auto temporary = target;
    temporary += ".tmp";
    {
        std::ofstream output(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        output << Encode(settings);
        output.flush();
        if (!output)
        {
            error = "Cannot write VirtualGeometry settings";
            return false;
        }
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(), target.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))
    {
        error = "Cannot publish VirtualGeometry settings";
        return false;
    }
#else
    std::error_code ec;
    std::filesystem::rename(temporary, target, ec);
    if (ec)
    {
        error = ec.message();
        return false;
    }
#endif
    return true;
}
uint64_t SettingsKey(const VGImportSettings& settings)
{
    uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
    for (const unsigned char byte : Encode(settings))
    {
        hash = (hash ^ byte) * 1099511628211ull;
    }
    return hash;
}
}

    {
        if (value >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Virtual geometry exceeds 32-bit asset addressing");
        }
        return static_cast<uint32_t>(value);
    }

    inline bool RangeFits(uint64_t offset, uint64_t count, uint64_t size)
    {
        return offset <= size && count <= size - offset;

template<class T>
void WriteRecords(Writer& writer, const std::vector<T>& values)
{
    for (const auto& value : values)
    {
        WriteValue(writer, value);
    }
}
template<class T>
void ReadRecords(Reader& reader, std::vector<T>& values, uint32_t count, uint32_t wireStride)
{
    auto source = reader.Take(size_t(count) * wireStride);
    Reader records(source);
    values.resize(count);
    for (auto& value : values)
    {
        ReadValue(records, value);
    }
    records.RequireEnd();
}

{
    if (!file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes.data()), std::streamsize(bytes.size())))
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Truncated Page cache");
    }

}

bool WriteGenerated(const std::filesystem::path& path, const VirtualGeometryGPU::PackedAsset& geometry,
    std::span<const uint8_t> pinned, const PageGenerator& generate, std::string& error,
    const VirtualGeometryCompression::Metrics& compression, uint64_t sourceTriangles, uint64_t sourceVertices)
{
    static std::atomic<uint64_t> sequence{0};
    auto temporary = path;
#ifdef _WIN32
    temporary += ".tmp." + std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()) + "." + std::to_string(++sequence);
#else
    temporary += ".tmp." + std::to_string(++sequence);
#endif
    try
    {
        if (!VirtualGeometryPages::Validate(geometry, pinned, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        Writer metadata;
        metadata.U32(uint32_t(geometry.Clusters.size()));
        metadata.U32(uint32_t(geometry.Groups.size()));
        metadata.U32(uint32_t(geometry.HierarchyIndices.size()));
        metadata.U32(uint32_t(geometry.Roots.size()));
        WriteRecords(metadata, geometry.Clusters);
        WriteRecords(metadata, geometry.Groups);
        WriteRecords(metadata, geometry.HierarchyIndices);
        WriteRecords(metadata, geometry.Roots);
        bool encoded = std::any_of(geometry.Clusters.begin(), geometry.Clusters.end(), [](const auto& cluster)
        {
            return (cluster.Flags & VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag) != 0;
        });
        if (sourceTriangles == 0 || sourceVertices == 0)
        {
            uint64_t triangles = 0, vertices = 0;
            for (const auto& cluster : geometry.Clusters)
            {
                if (cluster.Level == 0)
                {
                    triangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
                    vertices += cluster.VertexCount;
                }
            }
            if (sourceTriangles == 0) sourceTriangles = triangles;
            if (sourceVertices == 0) sourceVertices = vertices;
        }
        bool extended = true; // Production containers always carry metrics and version metadata.
        if (extended)
        {
            WriteMetrics(metadata, compression);
        }
        uint64_t offset = HeaderBytes + metadata.Bytes.size() + pinned.size() * 24ull;
        std::vector<uint8_t> payload(VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes);
        std::vector<uint64_t> checksums;
        for (uint32_t page = 0; page < pinned.size(); ++page)
        {
            if (!generate(page, payload, error))
            {
                throw std::runtime_error(error);
            }
            metadata.U64(offset);
            metadata.U32(VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes);
            metadata.U32(pinned[page]);
            checksums.push_back(VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(payload));
            metadata.U64(checksums.back());
            offset += VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes;
        }
        if (metadata.Bytes.size() > MaxMetadataBytes)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Page metadata budget exceeded");
        }
        Writer header;
        header.U32(Magic);
        header.U32(uint32_t(FormatVersion::Production));
        header.U32(VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes);
        header.U32(uint32_t(pinned.size()));
        header.U64(offset);
        header.U64(metadata.Bytes.size());
        header.U64(VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(metadata.Bytes));
        header.U32(VirtualGeometryConfig::BuilderVersion);
        header.U32(encoded ? VirtualGeometryCompression::CompressionVersion : 0);
        header.U64(sourceTriangles);
        header.U64(sourceVertices);
        header.Bytes.resize(HeaderBytes, 0);
        if (!path.parent_path().empty())
        {
            std::filesystem::create_directories(path.parent_path());
        }
        std::ofstream file(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        file.exceptions(std::ios::badbit | std::ios::failbit);
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(header.Bytes.data()), header.Bytes.size());
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(metadata.Bytes.data()), metadata.Bytes.size());
        for (uint32_t page = 0; page < pinned.size(); ++page)
        {
            if (!generate(page, payload, error) || VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(payload) != checksums[page])
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Page generator failed or changed between passes: " + error);
            }
            file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(payload.data()), payload.size());
        }
        file.flush();
        file.close();
#ifdef _WIN32
        if (!MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(), path.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Atomic Page cache replacement failed, Win32=" + std::to_string(GetLastError()));
        }
#else
        std::filesystem::rename(temporary, path);
#endif
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        std::error_code ignored;
        std::filesystem::remove(temporary, ignored);
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

bool WriteAtomic(const std::filesystem::path& path, const VirtualGeometryPages::PagedAsset& asset, std::string& error)
{
    if (asset.Payloads.size() != asset.PinnedPages.size())
    {
        error = "Page payload/directory count mismatch";
        return false;
    }
    return WriteGenerated(path, asset.Metadata, asset.PinnedPages,
        [&](uint32_t page, std::span<uint8_t> payload, std::string& message)
        {
            if (asset.Payloads[page].size() != payload.size())
            {
                message = "Invalid Page payload size";
                return false;
            }
            std::copy(asset.Payloads[page].begin(), asset.Payloads[page].end(), payload.begin());
            return true;
        }, error, asset.Compression, asset.SourceTriangles, asset.SourceVertices);
}

bool Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, PageManifest& output, std::string& error)
{
    output = {};
    try
    {
        uint64_t fileBytes = std::filesystem::file_size(path);
        std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
        std::array<uint8_t, HeaderBytes> headerBytes{};
        ReadExact(file, headerBytes);
        Reader header(headerBytes);
        if (header.U32() != Magic)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid VGMesh Page magic");
        }
        uint32_t version = header.U32();
        if (version < uint32_t(FormatVersion::Streaming) || version > uint32_t(FormatVersion::Production))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported VGMesh format version");
        }
        if (header.U32() != VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid VGMesh Streaming Page size");
        }
        uint32_t pageCount = header.U32();
        uint64_t declaredFileBytes = header.U64();
        uint64_t metadataBytes = header.U64();
        uint64_t identity = header.U64();
        const uint32_t builderVersion = header.U32();
        const uint32_t compressionVersion = header.U32();
        const uint64_t sourceTriangles = header.U64();
        const uint64_t sourceVertices = header.U64();
        if (version == uint32_t(FormatVersion::Production) &&
            (builderVersion != VirtualGeometryConfig::BuilderVersion ||
             compressionVersion > VirtualGeometryCompression::CompressionVersion))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("VGMesh builder/codec version requires asset rebuild");
        }
        if (!pageCount || declaredFileBytes != fileBytes || fileBytes < HeaderBytes ||
            metadataBytes < 16 || metadataBytes > MaxMetadataBytes || metadataBytes > fileBytes - HeaderBytes ||
            uint64_t(pageCount) * 24 > metadataBytes ||
            uint64_t(pageCount) * VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes != fileBytes - HeaderBytes - metadataBytes)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid Page cache size/directory");
        }
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(size_t(metadataBytes), 0);
        ReadExact(file, bytes);
        if (VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(bytes) != identity)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Page metadata checksum mismatch");
        }
        Reader metadata(bytes);
        uint32_t clusters = metadata.U32();
        uint32_t groups = metadata.U32();
        uint32_t hierarchy = metadata.U32();
        uint32_t roots = metadata.U32();
        PageManifest result;
        result.Version = FormatVersion(version);
        result.BuilderVersion = builderVersion;
        result.CompressionVersion = compressionVersion;
        result.SourceTriangles = sourceTriangles;
        result.SourceVertices = sourceVertices;
        result.Path = path;
        result.Identity = identity;
        result.FileBytes = fileBytes;
        ReadRecords(metadata, result.Metadata.Clusters, clusters, 96);
        ReadRecords(metadata, result.Metadata.Groups, groups, 64);
        ReadRecords(metadata, result.Metadata.HierarchyIndices, hierarchy, 4);
        ReadRecords(metadata, result.Metadata.Roots, roots, 4);
        if (version >= uint32_t(FormatVersion::GeometryCompression))
        {
            ReadMetrics(metadata, result.Compression);
        }
        result.Pages.resize(pageCount);
        result.PinnedPages.resize(pageCount);
        uint64_t offset = HeaderBytes + metadataBytes;
        for (uint32_t page = 0; page < pageCount; ++page)
        {
            auto& entry = result.Pages[page];
            entry.Offset = metadata.U64();
            entry.Size = metadata.U32();
            uint32_t pinned = metadata.U32();
            entry.Checksum = metadata.U64();
            if (entry.Offset != offset || entry.Size != VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes || pinned > 1)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid Page directory entry");
            }
            result.PinnedPages[page] = uint8_t(pinned);
            offset += entry.Size;
        }
        metadata.RequireEnd();
        if (!VirtualGeometryPages::Validate(result.Metadata, result.PinnedPages, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        result.PageClusters.resize(pageCount);
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < result.Metadata.Clusters.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& cluster = result.Metadata.Clusters[index];
            if (version == uint32_t(FormatVersion::Production) && (cluster.Flags & VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag) &&
                compressionVersion != VirtualGeometryCompression::CompressionVersion)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Compressed VGMesh requires matching codec version");
            }
            if (version == uint32_t(FormatVersion::Streaming) && (cluster.Flags & VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag))
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Compressed cluster in legacy Page format");
            }
            result.PageClusters[cluster.PageIndex].push_back(index);
        }
        output = std::move(result);
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

bool ReadPage(const PageManifest& manifest, uint32_t page, std::span<uint8_t> bytes, std::string& error)
{
    try
    {
        if (page >= manifest.Pages.size() || bytes.size() != VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid Page read range");
        }
        const auto& entry = manifest.Pages[page];
        if (entry.Size != bytes.size() || entry.Offset > manifest.FileBytes || entry.Size > manifest.FileBytes - entry.Offset ||
            entry.Offset > uint64_t(std::numeric_limits<std::streamoff>::max()))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Page file offset overflow");
        }
        std::ifstream file(manifest.Path, std::ios::binary);
        file.seekg(std::streamoff(entry.Offset));
        ReadExact(file, bytes);
        if (VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(bytes) != entry.Checksum)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Page payload checksum mismatch");
        }
        if (manifest.PageClusters.size() != manifest.Pages.size())
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Missing validated Page cluster directory");
        }
        for (uint32_t index : manifest.PageClusters[page])
        {
            const auto& cluster = manifest.Metadata.Clusters.at(index);
            if ((cluster.Flags & VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag) != 0)
            {
                if (cluster.VertexOffset > bytes.size() || cluster.Padding > bytes.size() - cluster.VertexOffset ||
                    !VirtualGeometryCompression::Validate(bytes.subspan(cluster.VertexOffset, cluster.Padding),
                        cluster.VertexCount, cluster.TriangleCount, error))
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error(manifest.Path.string() + " cluster " + std::to_string(index) + ": " + error);
                }
            }
        }
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}
}

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrypageio.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrypageio.h"
#include <algorithm>

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
PageIo::PageIo(Reader reader) : m_Read(std::move(reader))
{
    try
    {
        m_Workers.reserve(4);
        m_Active.reserve(4);
        m_Completed.reserve(1024);
        m_Cancelled.reserve(1024);
        for (uint32_t worker = 0; worker < 4; ++worker)
        {
            m_Workers.emplace_back([this] { Work(); });
        }
    }
    catch (...)
    {
        Shutdown();
        throw;
    }
}
PageIo::~PageIo()
{
    Shutdown();
}
bool PageIo::Submit(std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> manifest, LoadTicket ticket, uint32_t localPage)
{
    std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
    if (m_Stopping || !manifest || localPage >= manifest->Pages.size() || m_ReservedBytes + 65536 > 64ull * 1024 * 1024)
    {
        return false;
    }
    m_Jobs.push_back({std::move(manifest), ticket, localPage});
    m_ReservedBytes += 65536;
    m_Ready.notify_one();
    return true;
}
void PageIo::Cancel(LoadTicket ticket)
{
    std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
    for (auto& result : m_Completed)
    {
        if (result.Ticket == ticket)
        {
            result.Error = "Page read cancelled";
            result.Payload.clear();
            return;
        }
    }
    bool active = std::find(m_Active.begin(),m_Active.end(),ticket) != m_Active.end();
    bool queued = std::any_of(m_Jobs.begin(),m_Jobs.end(),[&](const Job& job) { return job.Ticket == ticket; });
    if ((active || queued) && std::find(m_Cancelled.begin(),m_Cancelled.end(),ticket) == m_Cancelled.end())
    {
        m_Cancelled.push_back(ticket);
    }
}
uint64_t PageIo::StagingBytes() const
{
    std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
    return m_ReservedBytes;
}
std::vector<PageIoCompletion> PageIo::Poll()
{
    std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
    std::vector<PageIoCompletion> result;
    result.swap(m_Completed);
    m_ReservedBytes -= result.size() * 65536ull;
    return result;
}
void PageIo::Work()
{
    while (true)
    {
        Job job;
        {
            std::unique_lock lock(m_Mutex);
            m_Ready.wait(lock, [&] { return m_Stopping || !m_Jobs.empty(); });
            if (m_Jobs.empty())
            {
                return;
            }
            job = std::move(m_Jobs.front());
            m_Jobs.pop_front();
            m_Active.push_back(job.Ticket);
        }
        PageIoCompletion result;
        result.Ticket = job.Ticket;
        auto begin = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        try
        {
            result.Payload.resize(65536);
            if (m_Read(*job.Manifest, job.LocalPage, result.Payload, result.Error))
            {
                result.ReadBytes = 65536;
            }
            else if (result.Error.empty())
            {
                result.Error = "Page read failed";
            }
        }
        catch (const std::exception& exception)
        {
            result.Error = exception.what();
        }
        result.Milliseconds = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - begin).count();
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
            auto active = std::find(m_Active.begin(),m_Active.end(),job.Ticket);
            m_Active.erase(active);
            auto cancelled = std::find(m_Cancelled.begin(), m_Cancelled.end(), job.Ticket);
            if (cancelled != m_Cancelled.end())
            {
                result.Error = "Page read cancelled";
                m_Cancelled.erase(cancelled);
            }
            if (!result.Error.empty())
            {
                result.Payload.clear();
            }
            m_Completed.push_back(std::move(result));
        }
    }
}
void PageIo::Shutdown()
{
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
        m_Stopping = true;
    }
    m_Ready.notify_all();
    for (auto& worker : m_Workers)
    {
        if (worker.joinable())
        {
            worker.join();
        }
    }
    m_Workers.clear();
}
}

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrypageio.h =====
#pragma once
#include "virtualgeometrypagecache.h"
#include "virtualgeometryresidency.h"
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
struct PageIoCompletion
{
    LoadTicket Ticket;
    std::vector<uint8_t> Payload;
    std::string Error;
    uint64_t ReadBytes = 0;
    double Milliseconds = 0;
};
class PageIo
{
public:
    using Reader = std::function<bool(const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest&, uint32_t, std::span<uint8_t>, std::string&)>;
    explicit PageIo(Reader reader = VirtualGeometryPageCache::ReadPage);
    ~PageIo();
    bool Submit(std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> manifest, LoadTicket ticket, uint32_t localPage);
    std::vector<PageIoCompletion> Poll();
    void Cancel(LoadTicket ticket);
    void Shutdown();
    uint64_t StagingBytes() const;
private:
    struct Job
    {
        std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> Manifest;
        LoadTicket Ticket;
        uint32_t LocalPage = 0;
    };
    void Work();
    Reader m_Read;
    mutable std::mutex m_Mutex;
    std::condition_variable m_Ready;
    std::deque<Job> m_Jobs;
    std::vector<PageIoCompletion> m_Completed;
    std::vector<LoadTicket> m_Cancelled;
    std::vector<LoadTicket> m_Active;
    std::vector<std::thread> m_Workers;
    uint64_t m_ReservedBytes = 0;
    bool m_Stopping = false;
};
}

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrypagepool.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrypagepool.h"
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
namespace
{
void Check(HRESULT result)
{
    if (FAILED(result))
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Geometry Page Copy Queue operation failed");
    }
}
Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Buffer(ID3D12Device* device, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE type, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state)
{
    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES heap{};
    heap.Type = type;
    heap.CreationNodeMask = heap.VisibleNodeMask = 1;
    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC description{};
    description.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
    description.Width = 65536;
    description.Height = description.DepthOrArraySize = description.MipLevels = 1;
    description.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    description.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> resource;
    Check(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description, state, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&resource)));
    return resource;
}
}
void PagePool::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptors, uint32_t increment)
{
    if (m_Device)
    {
        return;
    }
    m_Device = device;
    m_Descriptors = descriptors;
    m_Increment = increment;
    D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC description{};
    description.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COPY;
    Check(device->CreateCommandQueue(&description, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Queue)));
    Check(device->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Fence)));
}
uint64_t PagePool::Submit(LoadTicket ticket, std::span<const uint8_t> payload)
{
    if (!m_Device || payload.size() != 65536 || ticket.Slot >= 16384 || ticket.Generation > UINT32_MAX)
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid Geometry Page transfer");
    }
    // The caller owns the residency/fence admission. Replacing the resource,
    // rather than copying into a shader-read resource, isolates queue ownership.
    auto page = Buffer(m_Device.Get(), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
    Transfer transfer;
    transfer.Upload = Buffer(m_Device.Get(), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ);
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
    Check(transfer.Upload->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped));
    std::memcpy(mapped, payload.data(), payload.size());
    transfer.Upload->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    Check(m_Device->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COPY, IID_PPV_ARGS(&transfer.Allocator)));
    Check(m_Device->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COPY, transfer.Allocator.Get(), nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&transfer.Commands)));
    transfer.Commands->CopyBufferRegion(page.Get(), 0, transfer.Upload.Get(), 0, 65536);
    Check(transfer.Commands->Close());
    transfer.Fence = ++m_Submitted;
    if (m_Pages.size() <= ticket.Slot)
    {
        m_Pages.resize(size_t(ticket.Slot) + 1);
    }
    m_Pages[ticket.Slot] = page;
    // Retain everything before submission, including on a failed Signal.
    m_Transfers.push_back(std::move(transfer));
    ID3D12CommandList* list = m_Transfers.back().Commands.Get();
    m_Queue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, &list);
    Check(m_Queue->Signal(m_Fence.Get(), m_Submitted));
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC view{};
    view.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
    view.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
    view.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    view.Buffer.NumElements = 65536 / 4;
    view.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_SRV_FLAG_RAW;
    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptor{m_Descriptors.ptr + SIZE_T(ticket.Slot) * m_Increment};
    m_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(page.Get(), &view, descriptor);
    return m_Submitted;
}
uint64_t PagePool::CompletedCopyFence() const
{
    if (!m_Fence)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    uint64_t completed = m_Fence->GetCompletedValue();
    if (completed == UINT64_MAX)
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Geometry Page Copy device removed");
    }
    return completed;
}
void PagePool::Collect()
{
    uint64_t completed = CompletedCopyFence();
    while (!m_Transfers.empty() && m_Transfers.front().Fence <= completed)
    {
        m_Transfers.pop_front();
    }
}
ID3D12Resource* PagePool::Resource(uint32_t slot) const
{
    if (slot >= m_Pages.size())
    {
        return nullptr;
    }
    return m_Pages[slot].Get();
}
void PagePool::Shutdown()
{
    if (m_Fence && m_Submitted && m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_Submitted)
    {
        HANDLE event = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
        bool waitingOnEvent = event && SUCCEEDED(m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(m_Submitted,event));
        while (m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_Submitted && SUCCEEDED(m_Device->GetDeviceRemovedReason()))
        {
            if (waitingOnEvent)
            {
                WaitForSingleObject(event,500);
            }
            else
            {
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
            }
        }
        if (event)
        {
            CloseHandle(event);
        }
    }
    m_Transfers.clear();
    m_Pages.clear();
    m_Queue.Reset();
    m_Fence.Reset();
    m_Device.Reset();
    m_Submitted = 0;
}
void PagePool::Release(uint32_t slot)
{
    if (slot < m_Pages.size())
    {
        m_Pages[slot].Reset();
    }
}
uint64_t PagePool::MemoryBytes() const
{
    uint64_t bytes = 0;
    for (const auto& page : m_Pages)
    {
        if (page) bytes += 65536;
    }
    return bytes;
}
PagePool::~PagePool()
{
    Shutdown();
}
}

#include "virtualgeometrypages.h"
#include "virtualgeometryserializationinternal.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <numeric>
#include <limits>
#include <iostream>

namespace VirtualGeometryPages
