namespace VirtualGeometryRuntime
{
namespace
{
using VertexKey = std::array<uint32_t, 12>;
VertexKey KeyOf(const VirtualGeometryVertex &vertex)
{
    VertexKey key;
    std::memcpy(key.data(), &vertex, sizeof(vertex));
    return key;
}
struct VertexHash
{
    size_t operator()(const VertexKey &key) const
    {
        uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
        for (auto component : key)
        {
            hash ^= component;
            hash *= 1099511628211ull;
        }
        return static_cast<size_t>(hash);
    }
};
struct State
{
    std::mutex Mutex;
    Statistics Stats;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::weak_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> Assets;
};
State &Data()
{
    static State state;
    return state;
}

uint64_t GeometryKey(std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices, std::span<const uint32_t> indices,
                     uint32_t material, float part, const VGImportSettings& settings)
{
    uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
    auto consume = [&](const void *data, size_t size)
    {
        const auto *bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t *>(data);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        {
            hash ^= bytes[i];
            hash *= 1099511628211ull;
        }
    };
    // Bump integration version when the fixed build settings or remap contract change.
    const uint32_t header[] = {VirtualGeometryConfig::AssetVersion, VirtualGeometryConfig::BuilderVersion, material};
    consume(header, sizeof(header));
    // Hash fields explicitly: compiler padding must never affect derived data identity.
    const auto config = settings.BuildConfig();
    const uint64_t settingsKey = VirtualGeometryImport::SettingsKey(settings);
    consume(&settingsKey, sizeof(settingsKey));
    const uint32_t limits[] = {config.MaxClusterVertices, config.MaxClusterTriangles,
        config.TargetClustersPerGroup, config.MaxHierarchyLevels};
    consume(limits, sizeof(limits));
    const float parameters[] = {config.SimplificationRatio, config.ConeWeight, config.NormalWeight,
        config.TexCoordWeight, config.ColorWeight, config.TargetRelativeError, config.BoundaryEpsilon};
    consume(parameters, sizeof(parameters));
    consume(&part, sizeof(part));
    const uint64_t counts[] = {vertices.size(), indices.size()};
    consume(counts, sizeof(counts));
    consume(vertices.data(), vertices.size_bytes());
    consume(indices.data(), indices.size_bytes());
    return hash;
}

Meshlets::Asset ConvertLeaves(const VirtualGeometryAsset &hierarchy,
                              std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> source)
{
    std::unordered_map<VertexKey, uint32_t, VertexHash> original;
    original.reserve(source.size());
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < source.size(); ++i)
        original.try_emplace(KeyOf(source[i]), i);
    Meshlets::Asset output;
    output.Config = {64, 124, 32};
    for (const auto &cluster : hierarchy.Clusters)
    {
        if (cluster.Level != 0)
            continue; // Parents contain newly simplified vertices.
        if (cluster.VertexCount > 64 || cluster.TriangleCount > 126)
            throw std::runtime_error("VirtualGeometry cluster exceeds Mesh Shader limits");
        Meshlets::Meshlet meshlet{static_cast<uint32_t>(output.Vertices.size()), cluster.VertexCount,
                                  static_cast<uint32_t>(output.Primitives.size()), cluster.TriangleCount};
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cluster.VertexCount; ++i)
        {
            const auto found = original.find(KeyOf(hierarchy.Vertices.at(cluster.VertexOffset + i)));
            if (found == original.end())
                throw std::runtime_error("VirtualGeometry leaf vertex does not match source attributes");
            output.Vertices.push_back(found->second);
        }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cluster.TriangleCount; ++i)
        {
            const size_t start = size_t(cluster.TriangleOffset) + size_t(i) * 3;
            uint32_t packed = 0;
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
                packed |= uint32_t(hierarchy.TriangleIndices.at(start + j)) << (8 * j);
            output.Primitives.push_back(packed);
        }
        output.Meshlets.push_back(meshlet);
        output.Bounds.push_back(
            {{cluster.Bounds.Center[0], cluster.Bounds.Center[1], cluster.Bounds.Center[2]},
             cluster.Bounds.Radius,
             {cluster.Cone.Axis[0], cluster.Cone.Axis[1], cluster.Cone.Axis[2]},
             cluster.Cone.Cutoff});
    }
    std::vector<Meshlets::Position> positions;
    positions.reserve(source.size());
    for (const auto &vertex : source)
        positions.push_back({vertex.Position[0], vertex.Position[1], vertex.Position[2]});
    // Preserve VirtualGeometry's clustering, but compute bounds/cones with the
    // exact float arithmetic and sphere-centered contract of the current GPU culler.
    Meshlets::RefreshMeshletBounds(output, positions);
    // Preserve conservative cluster spheres using union AABBs of child spheres.
    for (uint32_t first = 0; first < output.Meshlets.size(); first += 32)
    {
        const uint32_t count = std::min(32u, static_cast<uint32_t>(output.Meshlets.size()) - first);
        float lower[3] = {INFINITY, INFINITY, INFINITY}, upper[3] = {-INFINITY, -INFINITY, -INFINITY};
        for (uint32_t i = first; i < first + count; ++i)
        {
            const auto &bounds = output.Bounds[i];
            const float center[] = {bounds.Center.X, bounds.Center.Y, bounds.Center.Z};
            for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                lower[axis] = std::min(lower[axis], center[axis] - bounds.Radius);
                upper[axis] = std::max(upper[axis], center[axis] + bounds.Radius);
            }
        }
        Meshlets::Cluster cluster;
        cluster.MeshletOffset = first;
        cluster.MeshletCount = count;
        cluster.Bounds.Center = {(lower[0] + upper[0]) * 0.5f, (lower[1] + upper[1]) * 0.5f,
                                 (lower[2] + upper[2]) * 0.5f};
        const float x = (upper[0] - lower[0]) * 0.5f, y = (upper[1] - lower[1]) * 0.5f,
                    z = (upper[2] - lower[2]) * 0.5f;
        cluster.Bounds.Radius = std::sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z) + 1e-5f;
        output.Clusters.push_back(cluster);
    }
    std::string error;
    if (!Meshlets::Validate(output, positions, error))
        throw std::runtime_error(error);
    return output;
}
} // namespace

std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset> Acquire(std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices,
                                            std::span<const uint32_t> indices, uint32_t materialId,
                                            float materialPartId, const std::filesystem::path &cacheDirectory,
                                            const VGImportSettings& settings)
{
    auto &state = Data();
    std::unique_lock lock(state.Mutex);
    auto asset = std::make_shared<RuntimeAsset>();
    asset->ImportSettings = settings;
    asset->Key = GeometryKey(vertices, indices, materialId, materialPartId, settings);
    std::ostringstream name;
    name << std::hex << asset->Key << ".vgmesh";
    asset->CachePath = cacheDirectory / name.str();
    const std::string identity = asset->CachePath.generic_string();
    if (auto found = state.Assets.find(identity); found != state.Assets.end())
        if (auto shared = found->second.lock())
        {
            ++state.Stats.SharedHits;
            return shared;
        }
    const auto begin = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    lock.unlock(); // Long CPU builds must not block inspector/statistics reads.
    try
    {
        if (!settings.Enabled)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("VirtualGeometry is disabled for this asset");
        }
        auto config = settings.BuildConfig();
        float lower[3] = {INFINITY, INFINITY, INFINITY};
        float upper[3] = {-INFINITY, -INFINITY, -INFINITY};
        for (const auto& vertex : vertices)
        {
            for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                lower[axis] = std::min(lower[axis], vertex.Position[axis]);
                upper[axis] = std::max(upper[axis], vertex.Position[axis]);
            }
        }
        const float extent = std::max({upper[0]-lower[0], upper[1]-lower[1], upper[2]-lower[2]});
        asset->CompressionSettings = settings.Compression(std::isfinite(extent) ? extent : 1.0f);
        std::string error;
        asset->CacheHit = VirtualGeometrySerializer::Load(asset->CachePath, asset->Hierarchy, error);
        if (asset->CacheHit)
        {
            const auto &loaded = asset->Hierarchy;
            asset->CacheHit = loaded.Config.MaxClusterVertices == config.MaxClusterVertices &&
                              loaded.Config.MaxClusterTriangles == config.MaxClusterTriangles && loaded.DebugName == name.str() &&
                              loaded.SourceMaterialId == materialId &&
                              loaded.SourceMaterialPartId == materialPartId &&
                              loaded.Stats.SourceVertices == vertices.size() &&
                              loaded.Stats.SourceTriangles == indices.size() / 3;
            // Validate leaf/source correspondence before accepting a cached asset.
            if (asset->CacheHit)
            {
                try
                {
                    asset->Meshlets = ConvertLeaves(loaded, vertices);
                }
                catch (const std::exception &)
                {
                    asset->CacheHit = false;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!asset->CacheHit)
        {
            auto result = VirtualGeometryBuilder::Build(vertices, indices, config, materialId);
            if (!result)
            {
                // Some imported boundary/seam topologies cannot be simplified safely.
                // Still register their exact finest clusters instead of rejecting Nanite.
                asset->HierarchyWarning = result.Error;
                config.MaxHierarchyLevels = 1;
                result = VirtualGeometryBuilder::Build(vertices, indices, config, materialId);
            }
            if (!result)
                throw std::runtime_error(result.Error);
            asset->Hierarchy = std::move(result.Asset);
            asset->Hierarchy.DebugName = name.str();
            asset->Hierarchy.SourceMaterialPartId = materialPartId;
            asset->Meshlets = ConvertLeaves(asset->Hierarchy, vertices);
            // Cache failure is non-fatal: the validated in-memory asset remains drawable.
            std::error_code directoryError;
            std::filesystem::create_directories(cacheDirectory, directoryError);
            if (!directoryError)
                VirtualGeometrySerializer::Save(asset->CachePath, asset->Hierarchy, error);
        }
        else
        {
            if (asset->Hierarchy.Config.MaxHierarchyLevels == 1)
                asset->HierarchyWarning =
                    "Cached leaf-only hierarchy; protected boundaries prevented simplification";
        }
        // Finish the import product even when the asset has no scene instances yet.
        auto compression = asset->CompressionSettings;
        if (const char* raw = std::getenv("DX12_VG_COMPRESSION_RAW"))
        {
            compression.Enabled = std::atoi(raw) == 0;
        }
        auto pagePath = asset->CachePath;
        pagePath += "."+std::to_string(VirtualGeometryCompression::SettingsKey(compression));
        pagePath += compression.Enabled ? ".encoded.vgmesh" : ".raw.vgmesh";
        auto manifest = std::make_shared<VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest>();
        if (!VirtualGeometryPageCache::Open(pagePath,*manifest,error) ||
            manifest->Version != VirtualGeometryPageCache::FormatVersion::Production)
        {
            if (!VirtualGeometrySerializer::SaveEncoded(pagePath,asset->Hierarchy,error,compression) ||
                !VirtualGeometryPageCache::Open(pagePath,*manifest,error))
            {
                // Preserve validated raw geometry when disk space or page encoding is unavailable.
                asset->HierarchyWarning += " Page preparation deferred: "+error;
                manifest.reset();
            }
        }
        if (manifest)
        {
            manifest->StreamingPriority = settings.StreamingPriority;
            asset->Pages = std::move(manifest);
        }
    }
    catch (const std::exception &error)
    {
        asset->Error = error.what();
        asset->Meshlets = {};
    }
    asset->BuildMilliseconds =
        std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - begin).count();
    lock.lock();
    if (!asset->Error.empty())
    {
        ++state.Stats.Failures;
    }
    else if (asset->CacheHit)
    {
        ++state.Stats.CacheHits;
    }
    else
    {
        ++state.Stats.Builds;
    }
    state.Stats.BuildMilliseconds += asset->BuildMilliseconds;
    for (auto entry = state.Assets.begin(); entry != state.Assets.end();)
        if (entry->second.expired())
            entry = state.Assets.erase(entry);
        else
            ++entry;
    state.Assets[identity] = asset;
    return asset;
}

std::shared_future<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> AcquireAsync(
    std::vector<VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices, std::vector<uint32_t> indices,
    uint32_t materialId, float materialPartId, const VGImportSettings& settings)
{
    // A single worker bounds CPU/memory competition with import and page encoding.
    struct BuildQueue
    {
        struct Job
        {
            uint64_t Bytes = 0;
            std::packaged_task<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>()> Work;
        };
        std::mutex Mutex;
        std::condition_variable Wake;
        std::deque<Job> Jobs;
        uint64_t Bytes = 0;
        bool Stopping = false;
        std::thread Worker;
        BuildQueue() : Worker([this]
        {
            for (;;)
            {
                std::unique_lock guard(Mutex);
                Wake.wait(guard, [this] { return Stopping || !Jobs.empty(); });
                if (Jobs.empty())
                {
                    return;
                }
                auto job = std::move(Jobs.front());
                Jobs.pop_front();
                guard.unlock();
                job.Work();
                guard.lock();
                Bytes -= job.Bytes;
            }
        }) {}
        ~BuildQueue()
        {
            {
                std::lock_guard guard(Mutex);
                Stopping = true;
                Jobs.clear(); // Broken promises are handled by the main-thread publication path.
            }
            Wake.notify_one();
            Worker.join();
        }
    };
    Data(); // Runtime state must outlive the worker during process shutdown.
    static BuildQueue queue;
    const uint64_t bytes = uint64_t(vertices.size())*sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex) + uint64_t(indices.size())*4;
    std::unique_lock guard(queue.Mutex);
    constexpr uint64_t queueBudget = 512ull*1024*1024;
    if (bytes > queueBudget || queue.Bytes > queueBudget-bytes)
    {
        std::promise<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> rejected;
        auto asset = std::make_shared<RuntimeAsset>();
        asset->Error = "VirtualGeometry background queue memory budget exceeded; legacy rendering retained";
        rejected.set_value(asset);
        return rejected.get_future().share();
    }
    BuildQueue::Job job;
    job.Bytes = bytes;
    job.Work = std::packaged_task<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>()>(
        [vertices = std::move(vertices), indices = std::move(indices), materialId, materialPartId, settings]
        {
            return Acquire(vertices, indices, materialId, materialPartId, "asset/virtualgeometry-cache", settings);
        });
    auto future = job.Work.get_future().share();
    queue.Bytes += bytes;
    queue.Jobs.push_back(std::move(job));
    guard.unlock();
    queue.Wake.notify_one();
    return future;
}
Statistics GetStatistics()
{
    auto &state = Data();
    std::lock_guard lock(state.Mutex);
    return state.Stats;
}
std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> LiveAssets()
{
    auto &state = Data();
    std::lock_guard lock(state.Mutex);
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> result;
    for (const auto &[key, entry] : state.Assets)
        if (auto asset = entry.lock())
            result.push_back(std::move(asset));
    std::sort(result.begin(), result.end(), [](const auto &a, const auto &b) { return a->Key < b->Key; });
    return result;
}
} // namespace VirtualGeometryRuntime

#include "virtualgeometryselection.h"
#include "virtualgeometrytemporal.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <numeric>

namespace VirtualGeometrySelection
{
namespace
{
constexpr uint32_t Invalid = VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex;

bool ValidSphere(const VirtualGeometrySphere& sphere)
{
    return std::isfinite(sphere.Radius) && sphere.Radius >= 0 &&
        std::all_of(sphere.Center.begin(), sphere.Center.end(), [](float value) { return std::isfinite(value); });
}

bool ValidateLinks(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset)
{
    if (asset.Clusters.empty() || asset.RootClusters.empty())
    {
        return false;
    }
    std::vector<uint32_t> consumers(asset.Clusters.size(), Invalid);
    std::vector<uint32_t> producers(asset.Clusters.size(), Invalid);
    std::vector<bool> roots(asset.Clusters.size());
    for (uint32_t root : asset.RootClusters)
    {
        if (root >= roots.size() || roots[root])
        {
            return false;
        }
        roots[root] = true;
    }
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < asset.Groups.size(); ++index)
    {
        const auto& group = asset.Groups[index];
        if (group.Level >= 31 || !group.ChildCount || !group.ParentCount ||
            uint64_t(group.FirstChild) + group.ChildCount > asset.HierarchyIndices.size() ||
            uint64_t(group.FirstParent) + group.ParentCount > asset.HierarchyIndices.size() ||
            !ValidSphere(group.Bounds) || !std::isfinite(group.MaxError) || group.MaxError < 0 ||
            !std::isfinite(group.MinError) || group.MinError < 0 || group.MinError > group.MaxError)
        {
            return false;
        }
        for (uint32_t child = 0; child < group.ChildCount; ++child)
        {
            uint32_t cluster = asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstChild + child];
            if (cluster >= consumers.size() || consumers[cluster] != Invalid ||
                asset.Clusters[cluster].Level != group.Level || asset.Clusters[cluster].GroupIndex != index)
            {
                return false;
            }
            consumers[cluster] = index;
        }
        for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
        {
            uint32_t cluster = asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstParent + parent];
            if (cluster >= producers.size() || producers[cluster] != Invalid ||
                asset.Clusters[cluster].Level != group.Level + 1 ||
                asset.Clusters[cluster].GeneratingGroupIndex != index)
            {
                return false;
            }
            producers[cluster] = index;
        }
    }
    for (size_t index = 0; index < asset.Clusters.size(); ++index)
    {
        const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[index];
        if (cluster.Level >= 32 || !std::isfinite(cluster.LodError) || cluster.LodError < 0 ||
            cluster.GroupIndex != consumers[index] || cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex != producers[index] ||
            roots[index] != (consumers[index] == Invalid) ||
            (cluster.Level != 0 && producers[index] == Invalid))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
}

static TemporalResult SelectInternal(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const View& view, const Settings& settings,
    std::span<const uint32_t> clusterPages, std::span<const uint8_t> residentPages,
    std::span<const uint8_t> previousRefine = {}, bool historyValid = false, float fraction = 0)
{
    auto fail = [](const char* error)
    {
        TemporalResult result;
        result.Error = error;
        return result;
    };
    bool streaming = !clusterPages.empty();
    if (historyValid && previousRefine.size() != asset.Groups.size())
    {
        return fail("Invalid LOD history size");
    }
    if (!std::isfinite(view.WorldScale) || view.WorldScale <= 0 ||
        !std::isfinite(view.MinimumWorldScale) || view.MinimumWorldScale <= 0 || view.MinimumWorldScale > view.WorldScale ||
        !std::isfinite(view.ProjectionScalePixels) || view.ProjectionScalePixels <= 0 ||
        !std::all_of(view.Camera.begin(), view.Camera.end(), [](float value) { return std::isfinite(value); }) ||
        !std::isfinite(settings.TargetErrorPixels) || settings.TargetErrorPixels <= 0 ||
        settings.ForceHierarchyLevel < -1 || settings.ForceHierarchyLevel > 31)
    {
        return fail("Invalid hierarchy selection view/settings");
    }
    if (!ValidateLinks(asset))
    {
        return fail("Invalid hierarchy selection graph");
    }
    if (streaming)
    {
        if (clusterPages.size() != asset.Clusters.size())
        {
            return fail("Invalid Cluster to Page mapping");
        }
        for (uint32_t page : clusterPages)
        {
            if (page >= residentPages.size())
            {
                return fail("Page mapping outside Residency Table");
            }
        }
        for (uint32_t root : asset.RootClusters)
        {
            if (!residentPages[clusterPages[root]])
            {
                return fail("Missing resident root");
            }
        }
    }

    std::vector<uint32_t> order(asset.Groups.size());
    std::iota(order.begin(), order.end(), 0u);
    std::stable_sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](uint32_t first, uint32_t second)
    {
        return asset.Groups[first].Level < asset.Groups[second].Level;
    });
    std::vector<bool> refine(asset.Groups.size());
    std::vector<uint8_t> desired(asset.Groups.size());
    for (uint32_t index : order)
    {
        const auto& group = asset.Groups[index];
        double distanceSquared = 0;
        for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            double difference = double(view.Camera[axis]) - group.Bounds.Center[axis];
            distanceSquared += difference * difference;
        }
        // The smallest singular-value bound keeps distance conservative even
        // when scale is below one. Maximum scale bounds geometric error.
        double distance = std::max((std::sqrt(distanceSquared) - group.Bounds.Radius) * view.MinimumWorldScale, 1e-6);
        double errorPixels = double(group.MaxError) * view.WorldScale * view.ProjectionScalePixels / distance;
        bool requested = settings.ForceHierarchyLevel >= 0
            ? group.Level >= uint32_t(settings.ForceHierarchyLevel)
            : VirtualGeometryTemporal::Refine(errorPixels, settings.TargetErrorPixels, fraction,
                historyValid && previousRefine[index] != 0, historyValid);
        desired[index] = uint8_t(requested);
        refine[index] = refine[index] || requested;
        if (!refine[index])
        {
            continue;
        }
        for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
        {
            uint32_t cluster = asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstParent + parent];
            uint32_t consumer = asset.Clusters[cluster].GroupIndex;
            if (consumer != Invalid)
            {
                refine[consumer] = true;
            }
        }
    }

    std::vector<bool> active(asset.Clusters.size());
    for (uint32_t root : asset.RootClusters)
    {
        active[root] = true;
    }
    TemporalResult result;
    result.DesiredRefine = std::move(desired);
    std::vector<uint8_t> requested(residentPages.size());
    for (auto entry = order.rbegin(); entry != order.rend(); ++entry)
    {
        uint32_t index = *entry;
        if (!refine[index])
        {
            continue;
        }
        const auto& group = asset.Groups[index];
        bool parentsActive = true;
        for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
        {
            if (!active[asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstParent + parent]])
            {
                parentsActive = false;
            }
        }
        if (!parentsActive)
        {
            if (streaming)
            {
                continue;
            }
            return fail("Incomplete group parent coverage");
        }
        bool childrenResident = true;
        if (streaming)
        {
            for (uint32_t child = 0; child < group.ChildCount; ++child)
            {
                uint32_t page = clusterPages[asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstChild + child]];
                if (!residentPages[page])
                {
                    childrenResident = false;
                    if (!requested[page])
                    {
                        requested[page] = 1;
                        result.RequestedPages.push_back(page);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (!childrenResident)
        {
            continue;
        }
        for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
        {
            active[asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstParent + parent]] = false;
        }
        for (uint32_t child = 0; child < group.ChildCount; ++child)
        {
            active[asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstChild + child]] = true;
        }
    }
    for (uint32_t cluster = 0; cluster < active.size(); ++cluster)
    {
        if (active[cluster])
        {
            result.Clusters.push_back(cluster);
        }
    }
    return result;
}
Result Select(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const View& view, const Settings& settings)
{
    return SelectInternal(asset, view, settings, {}, {});
}
TemporalResult SelectResidentTemporal(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const View& view, const Settings& settings,
    std::span<const uint32_t> clusterPages, std::span<const uint8_t> residentPages,
    std::span<const uint8_t> previousRefine, bool historyValid, float fraction)
{
    if (clusterPages.empty())
    {
        TemporalResult result;
        result.Error = "Empty Cluster to Page mapping";
        return result;
    }
    return SelectInternal(asset, view, settings, clusterPages, residentPages, previousRefine, historyValid, fraction);
}
ResidentResult SelectResident(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const View& view, const Settings& settings,
    std::span<const uint32_t> clusterPages, std::span<const uint8_t> residentPages)
{
    if (clusterPages.empty())
    {
        ResidentResult result;
        result.Error = "Empty Cluster to Page mapping";
        return result;
    }
    return SelectInternal(asset, view, settings, clusterPages, residentPages);
}
}

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryserializationinternal.h =====
#pragma once
#include "virtualgeometryasset.h"
#include <bit>
#include <span>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace VirtualGeometrySerialization
{
    inline constexpr uint32_t Magic = 0x314d4756; // Little-endian "VGM1".
    inline constexpr uint32_t SectionCount = 8;
    inline constexpr uint32_t HeaderBytes = 32 + SectionCount * 16;
    enum Section : uint32_t { Vertices, Triangles, Clusters, Groups, Hierarchy, Roots, Levels, Metadata };
    inline constexpr uint64_t Strides[SectionCount] = {48, 1, 104, 44, 4, 4, 20, 1};

    class Writer
    {
    public:
        std::vector<uint8_t> Bytes;
        void U32(uint32_t value)
        {
            for (uint32_t byte = 0; byte < 4; ++byte)
            {
                Bytes.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(value >> (byte * 8)));
            }
        }
        void U64(uint64_t value)
        {
            for (uint32_t byte = 0; byte < 8; ++byte)
            {
                Bytes.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(value >> (byte * 8)));
            }
        }
        void F32(float value) { U32(std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(value)); }
        void F64(double value) { U64(std::bit_cast<uint64_t>(value)); }
        void Float3(const std::array<float, 3>& value)
        {
            for (float component : value)
            {
                F32(component);
            }
        }
        void Sphere(const VirtualGeometrySphere& value)
        {
            Float3(value.Center);
            F32(value.Radius);
        }
    };

    class Reader
    {
        std::span<const uint8_t> m_Bytes;
        size_t m_Offset = 0;
    public:
        explicit Reader(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes) : m_Bytes(bytes) {}
        uint32_t U32()
        {
            uint32_t value = 0;
            auto bytes = Take(4);
            for (uint32_t byte = 0; byte < 4; ++byte)
            {
                value |= uint32_t(bytes[byte]) << (byte * 8);
            }
            return value;
        }
        uint64_t U64()
        {
            uint64_t value = 0;
            auto bytes = Take(8);
            for (uint32_t byte = 0; byte < 8; ++byte)
            {
                value |= uint64_t(bytes[byte]) << (byte * 8);
            }
            return value;
        }
        float F32() { return std::bit_cast<float>(U32()); }
        double F64() { return std::bit_cast<double>(U64()); }
        std::span<const uint8_t> Take(size_t count)
        {
            if (count > m_Bytes.size() - m_Offset)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Truncated virtual geometry section");
            }
            auto result = m_Bytes.subspan(m_Offset, count);
            m_Offset += count;
            return result;
        }
        std::array<float, 3> Float3() { return {F32(), F32(), F32()}; }
        VirtualGeometrySphere Sphere()
        {
            VirtualGeometrySphere sphere;
            sphere.Center = Float3();
            sphere.Radius = F32();
            return sphere;
        }
        void RequireEnd() const
        {
            if (m_Offset != m_Bytes.size())
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Unexpected trailing section data");
            }
        }
    };

    void WriteMetadata(Writer& writer, const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset);
    void ReadMetadata(Reader& reader, VirtualGeometryAsset& asset);
}

namespace
{
    using namespace VirtualGeometrySerialization;
    using namespace VirtualGeometryInternal;

    void WriteCluster(Writer& writer, const VirtualGeometryCluster& cluster)
    {
        writer.U32(cluster.VertexOffset);
        writer.U32(cluster.VertexCount);
        writer.U32(cluster.TriangleOffset);
        writer.U32(cluster.TriangleCount);
        writer.U32(cluster.Level);
        writer.U32(cluster.GroupIndex);
        writer.U32(cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex);
        writer.U32(cluster.MaterialId);
        writer.Sphere(cluster.Bounds);
        writer.Float3(cluster.Aabb.Min);
        writer.Float3(cluster.Aabb.Max);
        writer.Float3(cluster.Cone.Axis);
        writer.Float3(cluster.Cone.Apex);
        writer.F32(cluster.Cone.Cutoff);
        writer.F32(cluster.LodError);
    }

    VirtualGeometryCluster ReadCluster(Reader& reader)
    {
        VirtualGeometryCluster cluster;
        cluster.VertexOffset = reader.U32();
        cluster.VertexCount = reader.U32();
        cluster.TriangleOffset = reader.U32();
        cluster.TriangleCount = reader.U32();
        cluster.Level = reader.U32();
        cluster.GroupIndex = reader.U32();
        cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex = reader.U32();
        cluster.MaterialId = reader.U32();
        cluster.Bounds = reader.Sphere();
        cluster.Aabb.Min = reader.Float3();
        cluster.Aabb.Max = reader.Float3();
        cluster.Cone.Axis = reader.Float3();
        cluster.Cone.Apex = reader.Float3();
        cluster.Cone.Cutoff = reader.F32();
        cluster.LodError = reader.F32();
        return cluster;
    }

    struct Directory
    {
        std::array<uint64_t, SectionCount> Offsets{};
        std::array<uint64_t, SectionCount> Counts{};
    };

    Directory ReadDirectory(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, const VirtualGeometryLoadLimits& limits)
    {
        if (bytes.size() < HeaderBytes || bytes.size() > limits.MaxFileBytes)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid file size or file budget exceeded");
        }
        Reader header(bytes.first(HeaderBytes));
        if (header.U32() != Magic)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid VGM1 magic");
        }
        if (header.U32() != VirtualGeometryConfig::AssetVersion)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported VGMesh format version");
        }
        if (header.U64() != bytes.size())
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Virtual geometry file size mismatch");
        }
        uint64_t checksum = header.U64();
        if (header.U32() != SectionCount || header.U32() != HeaderBytes)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid section directory");
        }
        Directory directory;
        uint64_t end = HeaderBytes;
        uint64_t decodedBytes = 0;
        const uint64_t memoryStrides[] = {sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex), 1, sizeof(VirtualGeometryCluster),
            sizeof(VirtualGeometryClusterGroup), 4, 4, sizeof(VirtualGeometryLevelStats), 1};
        for (uint32_t section = 0; section < SectionCount; ++section)
        {
            uint64_t offset = header.U64();
            uint64_t count = header.U64();
            if (offset != end || offset > bytes.size() || count >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
                count > (bytes.size() - offset) / Strides[section])
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid section offset/count/range");
            }
            if (decodedBytes > limits.MaxDecodedBytes || count > (limits.MaxDecodedBytes - decodedBytes) / memoryStrides[section])
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Virtual geometry decoded allocation budget exceeded");
            }
            decodedBytes += count * memoryStrides[section];
            directory.Offsets[section] = offset;
            directory.Counts[section] = count;
            end += count * Strides[section];
        }
        header.RequireEnd();
        if (end != bytes.size() || directory.Counts[Levels] > VirtualGeometryConfig::MaxHierarchyLevels ||
            directory.Counts[Metadata] < 152 || directory.Counts[Clusters] == 0 || directory.Counts[Roots] == 0)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid payload layout/counts");
        }
        // Cover offsets/counts too; hash excludes only the fixed 32-byte header.
        if (checksum != VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(bytes.subspan(32)))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Virtual geometry checksum mismatch");
        }
        return directory;
    }

    void DecodeSections(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, const Directory& directory, VirtualGeometryAsset& asset)
    {
        auto sectionReader = [&](Section section)
        {
            return Reader(bytes.subspan(static_cast<size_t>(directory.Offsets[section]),
                static_cast<size_t>(directory.Counts[section] * Strides[section])));
        };
        auto metadata = sectionReader(Metadata);
        ReadMetadata(metadata, asset);
        std::string error;
        if (!ValidateVirtualGeometryConfig(asset.Config, error))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error(error);
        }
        auto vertices = sectionReader(Vertices);
        asset.Vertices.resize(static_cast<size_t>(directory.Counts[Vertices]));
        for (auto& vertex : asset.Vertices)
        {
            for (float& value : vertex.Position)
            {
                value = vertices.F32();
            }
            for (float& value : vertex.Normal)
            {
                value = vertices.F32();
            }
            for (float& value : vertex.TexCoord)
            {
                value = vertices.F32();
            }
            for (float& value : vertex.Diffuse)
            {
                value = vertices.F32();
            }
        }
        vertices.RequireEnd();
        auto triangles = bytes.subspan(static_cast<size_t>(directory.Offsets[Triangles]),
            static_cast<size_t>(directory.Counts[Triangles]));
        asset.TriangleIndices.assign(triangles.begin(), triangles.end());
        auto clusters = sectionReader(Clusters);
        asset.Clusters.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(directory.Counts[Clusters]));
        for (uint64_t index = 0; index < directory.Counts[Clusters]; ++index)
        {
            asset.Clusters.push_back(ReadCluster(clusters));
        }
        clusters.RequireEnd();
        auto groups = sectionReader(Groups);
        asset.Groups.resize(static_cast<size_t>(directory.Counts[Groups]));
        for (auto& group : asset.Groups)
        {
            group.Level = groups.U32();
            group.FirstChild = groups.U32();
            group.ChildCount = groups.U32();
            group.FirstParent = groups.U32();
            group.ParentCount = groups.U32();
            group.Bounds = groups.Sphere();
            group.MinError = groups.F32();
            group.MaxError = groups.F32();
        }
        groups.RequireEnd();
        auto readIndices = [&](Section section, std::vector<uint32_t>& destination)
        {
            auto reader = sectionReader(section);
            destination.resize(static_cast<size_t>(directory.Counts[section]));
            for (auto& value : destination)
            {
                value = reader.U32();
            }
            reader.RequireEnd();
        };
        readIndices(Hierarchy, asset.HierarchyIndices);
        readIndices(Roots, asset.RootClusters);
        auto levels = sectionReader(Levels);
        asset.Levels.resize(static_cast<size_t>(directory.Counts[Levels]));
        for (auto& level : asset.Levels)
        {
            level.Clusters = levels.U32();
            level.Triangles = levels.U64();
            level.Vertices = levels.U64();
        }
        levels.RequireEnd();
    }
}

uint64_t VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes)
{
    uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
    for (uint8_t byte : bytes)
    {
        hash = (hash ^ byte) * 1099511628211ull;
    }
    return hash;
}

bool VirtualGeometrySerializer::Encode(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    bytes.clear();
    if (!VirtualGeometryValidator::Validate(asset, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    try
    {
        Writer writer;
        writer.Bytes.resize(HeaderBytes);
        Directory directory;
        directory.Counts = {asset.Vertices.size(), asset.TriangleIndices.size(), asset.Clusters.size(),
            asset.Groups.size(), asset.HierarchyIndices.size(), asset.RootClusters.size(), asset.Levels.size(), 0};
        directory.Offsets[Vertices] = writer.Bytes.size();
        for (const auto& vertex : asset.Vertices)
        {
            for (float value : VertexComponents(vertex))
            {
                writer.F32(value);
            }
        }
        directory.Offsets[Triangles] = writer.Bytes.size();
        writer.Bytes.insert(writer.Bytes.end(), asset.TriangleIndices.begin(), asset.TriangleIndices.end());
        directory.Offsets[Clusters] = writer.Bytes.size();
        for (const auto& cluster : asset.Clusters)
        {
            WriteCluster(writer, cluster);
        }
        directory.Offsets[Groups] = writer.Bytes.size();
        for (const auto& group : asset.Groups)
        {
            writer.U32(group.Level);
            writer.U32(group.FirstChild);
            writer.U32(group.ChildCount);
            writer.U32(group.FirstParent);
            writer.U32(group.ParentCount);
            writer.Sphere(group.Bounds);
            writer.F32(group.MinError);
            writer.F32(group.MaxError);
        }
        directory.Offsets[Hierarchy] = writer.Bytes.size();
        for (uint32_t index : asset.HierarchyIndices)
        {
            writer.U32(index);
        }
        directory.Offsets[Roots] = writer.Bytes.size();
        for (uint32_t index : asset.RootClusters)
        {
            writer.U32(index);
        }
        directory.Offsets[Levels] = writer.Bytes.size();
        for (const auto& level : asset.Levels)
        {
            writer.U32(level.Clusters);
            writer.U64(level.Triangles);
            writer.U64(level.Vertices);
        }
        directory.Offsets[Metadata] = writer.Bytes.size();
        WriteMetadata(writer, asset);
        directory.Counts[Metadata] = writer.Bytes.size() - directory.Offsets[Metadata];
        Writer header;
        header.U32(Magic);
        header.U32(asset.Version);
        header.U64(writer.Bytes.size());
        header.U64(0);
        header.U32(SectionCount);
        header.U32(HeaderBytes);
        for (uint32_t section = 0; section < SectionCount; ++section)
        {
            header.U64(directory.Offsets[section]);
            header.U64(directory.Counts[section]);
        }
        std::copy(header.Bytes.begin(), header.Bytes.end(), writer.Bytes.begin());
        uint64_t checksum = Hash(std::span<const uint8_t>(writer.Bytes).subspan(32));
        for (uint32_t byte = 0; byte < 8; ++byte)
        {
            writer.Bytes[16 + byte] = static_cast<uint8_t>(checksum >> (byte * 8));
        }
        bytes = std::move(writer.Bytes);
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

bool VirtualGeometrySerializer::Decode(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, VirtualGeometryAsset& asset,
    std::string& error, const VirtualGeometryLoadLimits& limits)
{
    error.clear();
    try
    {
        Directory directory = ReadDirectory(bytes, limits);
        VirtualGeometryAsset decoded;
        DecodeSections(bytes, directory, decoded);
        if (!VirtualGeometryValidator::Validate(decoded, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        asset = std::move(decoded); // Transactional: retain caller's old asset on failure.
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

bool VirtualGeometrySerializer::Save(const std::filesystem::path& path, const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::string& error)
{
    static std::atomic<uint64_t> sequence{0};
    auto temporary = path;
#ifdef _WIN32
    temporary += ".tmp."+std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId())+"."+std::to_string(++sequence);
#else
    temporary += ".tmp."+std::to_string(++sequence);
#endif
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    if (!Encode(asset, bytes, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    try
    {
        if (bytes.size() > static_cast<uint64_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::streamsize>::max()))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Virtual geometry file exceeds stream addressing");
        }
        std::ofstream file(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        file.exceptions(std::ios::badbit | std::ios::failbit);
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
        file.close();
#ifdef _WIN32
        if (!MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(),path.c_str(),MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Cannot publish VirtualGeometry derived data");
        }
#else
        std::filesystem::rename(temporary,path);
#endif
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        std::error_code ignored;
        std::filesystem::remove(temporary,ignored);
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

bool VirtualGeometrySerializer::Load(const std::filesystem::path& path, VirtualGeometryAsset& asset,
    std::string& error, const VirtualGeometryLoadLimits& limits)
{
    error.clear();
    try
    {
        std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
        file.exceptions(std::ios::badbit | std::ios::failbit);
        auto position = file.tellg();
        if (position < 0)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Cannot determine virtual geometry file size");
        }
        uint64_t size = static_cast<uint64_t>(position);
        if (size < HeaderBytes || size > limits.MaxFileBytes || size > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() ||
            size > static_cast<uint64_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::streamsize>::max()))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid virtual geometry file size or load budget exceeded");
        }
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(size));
        file.seekg(0);
        file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes.data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(size));
        return Decode(bytes, asset, error, limits);
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

#pragma once

class VirtualGeometrySerializer
{
public:
    // GPU-native format: loading returns metadata/directory, never expanded vertices.
    static bool SaveEncoded(const std::filesystem::path& path, const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset,
        std::string& error, const VGCompressionSettings& settings = {},
        const VirtualGeometryCompression::Input& attributes = {});

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrystaticmesh.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "virtualgeometrybuilder.h"
#include "virtualgeometryvalidator.h"
#include "staticmodel.h"
#include <cmath>

bool CanUseVirtualGeometry(const StaticMeshData& source, std::string& reason)
{
    reason.clear();
    if (source.VertexCount == 0 || source.IndexCount < 3 || source.IndexCount % 3 != 0)
    {
        reason = "VirtualGeometry requires a non-empty triangle list";
        return false;
    }
    if (source.CpuIndices.size() != source.IndexCount || source.CpuVertices.size() != source.VertexCount)
    {
        reason = "Static mesh is missing complete CPU LOD0 geometry";
        return false;
    }
    for (const auto index : source.CpuIndices)
    {
        if (index >= source.VertexCount)
        {
            reason = "Static mesh index is outside the source vertex range";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!std::isfinite(source.AppliedMaterialPartId))
    {
        reason = "Static mesh has a non-finite material part ID";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

VirtualGeometryBuildResult VirtualGeometryBuilder::Build(
    const StaticMeshData& source, const VirtualGeometryBuildConfig& config, uint32_t materialId)
{
    std::string reason;
    if (!CanUseVirtualGeometry(source, reason))
    {
        VirtualGeometryBuildResult result;
        result.Error = reason;
        return result;
    }
    if (!isfinite(source.AppliedMaterialPartId))
    {
        VirtualGeometryBuildResult result;
        result.Error = "Static mesh has a non-finite material part ID";
        return result;
    }
    vector<VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices;
    try
    {
        vertices.reserve(source.CpuVertices.size());
        for (const auto& sourceVertex : source.CpuVertices)
        {
            VirtualGeometryVertex vertex;
            vertex.Position[0] = sourceVertex.Position.x;
            vertex.Position[1] = sourceVertex.Position.y;
            vertex.Position[2] = sourceVertex.Position.z;
            vertex.Normal[0] = sourceVertex.Normal.x;
            vertex.Normal[1] = sourceVertex.Normal.y;
            vertex.Normal[2] = sourceVertex.Normal.z;
            vertex.TexCoord[0] = sourceVertex.TexCoord.x;
            vertex.TexCoord[1] = sourceVertex.TexCoord.y;
            vertex.Diffuse[0] = sourceVertex.Diffuse.x;
            vertex.Diffuse[1] = sourceVertex.Diffuse.y;
            vertex.Diffuse[2] = sourceVertex.Diffuse.z;
            vertex.Diffuse[3] = sourceVertex.Diffuse.w;
            vertices.push_back(vertex);
        }
        auto result = Build(vertices, source.CpuIndices, config, materialId);
        if (result)
        {
            result.Asset.DebugName = source.MeshName;
            result.Asset.SourceMaterialPartId = source.AppliedMaterialPartId;
        }
        return result;
    }
    catch (const exception& exception)
    {
        VirtualGeometryBuildResult result;
        result.Error = exception.what();
        return result;
    }
}

#include "pch.h"

#include <numeric>
#include <atomic>

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
namespace
{
using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
struct Source
{
    std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> Manifest;
    uint32_t LocalPage = 0;
    uint32_t Failures = 0;
    Clock::time_point RetryAfter{};
    Clock::time_point SubmittedAt{};
};
struct Frame
{
    GpuSceneBuffer Residency, RequestBits, Requests, Usage;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Readback;
    uint64_t ReadbackBytes = 0, Fence = 0, Serial = 0;
    uint32_t Words = 0, Pages = 0;
};
struct State
{
    Settings Options;
    Statistics Stats;
    ResidencyManager Manager;
    std::unique_ptr<PageIo> Io;
    std::unique_ptr<PagePool> Pool;
    std::vector<Source> Sources;
    std::deque<PageIoCompletion> Ready;
    std::array<Frame, 3> Frames;
    uint64_t Serial = 0;
    uint32_t Outstanding = 0;
    bool Initialized = false, Available = false;
};
State& Data() { static State state; return state; }
Frame& Current() { return Data().Frames.at(GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex()); }
void Initialize()
{
    auto& state = Data();
    if (state.Initialized)
    {
        return;
    }
    state.Initialized = true;
    D3D12_FEATURE_DATA_D3D12_OPTIONS options{};
    auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    if (FAILED(device->CheckFeatureSupport(D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS, &options, sizeof(options))) ||
        options.ResourceBindingTier < D3D12_RESOURCE_BINDING_TIER_2)
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry streaming unavailable: resource binding tier 2 required\n");
        return;
    }
    auto* heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
    uint32_t first = heap->GetDesc().NumDescriptors - MaximumSlots;
    auto descriptor = heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    uint32_t increment = device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV);
    descriptor.ptr += SIZE_T(first) * increment;
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC nullView{};
    nullView.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
    nullView.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
    nullView.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    nullView.Buffer.NumElements = 65536 / 4;
    nullView.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_SRV_FLAG_RAW;
    for (uint32_t slot = 0; slot < MaximumSlots; ++slot)
    {
        D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE target{descriptor.ptr + SIZE_T(slot) * increment};
        device->CreateShaderResourceView(nullptr, &nullView, target);
    }
    state.Pool = std::make_unique<PagePool>();
    state.Pool->Initialize(device, descriptor, increment);
    char delayText[16]{}, failureText[8]{};
    GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VG_STREAMING_IO_DELAY_MS",delayText,sizeof(delayText));
    GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VG_STREAMING_IO_FAIL_ONCE",failureText,sizeof(failureText));
    uint32_t delay = uint32_t(std::clamp(atoi(delayText),0,1000));
    bool injectFailure = atoi(failureText) != 0;
    auto failed = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>>(false);
    state.Io = std::make_unique<PageIo>([delay,injectFailure,failed](const auto& manifest,uint32_t page,std::span<uint8_t> bytes,std::string& error)
    {
        if (delay) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(delay));
        if (injectFailure && !failed->exchange(true))
        {
            error = "Injected transient Page I/O failure";
            return false;
        }
        return VirtualGeometryPageCache::ReadPage(manifest,page,bytes,error);
    });
    state.Available = true;
}
RenderGraph::ResourceHandle Import(RenderGraph& graph, GpuSceneBuffer& buffer, const char* name, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES final)
{
    auto found = graph.FindImportedResource(buffer.Resource());
    if (found.IsValid())
    {
        return found;
    }
    RenderGraph::ImportedResource input{};
    input.Name = name;
    input.Resource = buffer.Resource();
    input.InitialState = buffer.State;
    input.FinalState = final;
    input.HasFinalState = true;
    buffer.State = final;
    return graph.ImportResource(input);
}
void CollectFeedback()
{
    auto& state = Data();
    uint64_t completed = GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence();
    for (auto& frame : state.Frames)
    {
        if (!frame.Fence || frame.Fence > completed)
        {
            continue;
        }
        D3D12_RANGE range{0, SIZE_T(frame.ReadbackBytes)};
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(frame.Readback->Map(0, &range, &mapped)))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Geometry feedback readback Map failed");
        }
        const auto* values = static_cast<const uint32_t*>(mapped);
        uint32_t count = std::min(values[0], RequestCapacity);
        const auto* usage = values + 4 + RequestCapacity;
        state.Stats.GpuRequests += values[0];
        state.Stats.RequestOverflow += values[1];
        for (uint32_t request = 0; request < count; ++request)
        {
            const uint32_t packed = values[4 + request];
            uint32_t page = packed & 0x7fffffffu;
            if (page < frame.Pages)
            {
                const bool predicted = (packed&0x80000000u) != 0 && (usage[page/32]&(1u<<(page%32))) == 0;
                if (predicted) ++state.Stats.PrefetchRequests;
                const auto& record = state.Manager.Pages()[page];
                if (!predicted || (frame.Serial >= record.LastUsed &&
                    (record.State == PageState::Evicted || record.State == PageState::Requested)))
                {
                    state.Manager.MarkPredicted(page,predicted);
                }
                if (state.Manager.Pages()[page].State == PageState::Evicted)
                {
                    ++state.Stats.CpuRequests;
                }
                state.Manager.Request(page, frame.Serial);
            }
        }
        for (uint32_t page = 0; page < frame.Pages; ++page)
        {
            if ((usage[page / 32] & (1u << (page % 32))) != 0)
            {
                state.Manager.MarkUsed(page, frame.Serial);
                state.Manager.MarkPredicted(page,false);
            }
        }
        D3D12_RANGE noWrite{0, 0};
        frame.Readback->Unmap(0, &noWrite);
        frame.Fence = 0;
    }
}
}
Settings& GetSettings() { return Data().Options; }
VGStreamingBudget GetBudget()
{
    const auto& settings = GetSettings();
    return {uint64_t(settings.BudgetMiB)*1024*1024,uint64_t(settings.UploadMiBPerFrame)*1024*1024,
        settings.MaxPageRequestsPerFrame};
}
bool InspectPage(uint32_t page, PageInfo& info)
{
    const auto& pages = Data().Manager.Pages();
    if (page >= pages.size()) return false;
    const auto& record = pages[page];
    info = {static_cast<uint32_t>(record.State),record.Slot,record.Priority,record.LastUsed,record.Pinned,record.Retiring};
    return true;
}
bool SetBudget(const VGStreamingBudget& budget, std::string& error)
{
    constexpr uint64_t mib = 1024*1024;
    error.clear();
    if (budget.MaxResidentMemory < mib || budget.MaxResidentMemory > 1024*mib ||
        budget.MaxResidentMemory%mib || budget.MaxUploadBytesPerFrame > 64*mib ||
        budget.MaxUploadBytesPerFrame%mib || budget.MaxPageRequestsPerFrame > RequestCapacity)
    {
        error = "VG budget exceeds page-pool limits or is not aligned to one MiB";
        return false;
    }
    auto& settings = GetSettings();
    settings.BudgetMiB = static_cast<uint32_t>(budget.MaxResidentMemory/mib);
    settings.UploadMiBPerFrame = static_cast<uint32_t>(budget.MaxUploadBytesPerFrame/mib);
    settings.MaxPageRequestsPerFrame = budget.MaxPageRequestsPerFrame;
    return true;
}
const Statistics& GetStatistics() { return Data().Stats; }
bool Supported() { Initialize(); return Data().Available; }
uint32_t PageCount() { return Data().Manager.PageCount(); }
GpuSceneBuffer& ResidencyBuffer() { return Current().Residency; }
GpuSceneBuffer& RequestBitsBuffer() { return Current().RequestBits; }
GpuSceneBuffer& RequestBuffer() { return Current().Requests; }
GpuSceneBuffer& UsageBuffer() { return Current().Usage; }
uint32_t Register(std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> manifest, uint32_t priority)
{
    auto& state = Data();
    if (!manifest || !Supported())
    {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    uint32_t base = state.Manager.PageCount();
    state.Sources.reserve(state.Sources.size() + manifest->Pages.size());
    const uint32_t effectivePriority = priority == UINT32_MAX ? manifest->StreamingPriority : priority;
    if (!state.Manager.AddPages(manifest->PinnedPages, uint64_t(state.Options.BudgetMiB) * 1024 * 1024, effectivePriority))
    {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    for (uint32_t page = 0; page < manifest->Pages.size(); ++page)
    {
        state.Sources.push_back({manifest, page});
    }
    return base;
}
bool CanRegister(const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest& manifest)
{
    auto& state = Data();
    return Supported() && manifest.Pages.size() == manifest.PinnedPages.size() &&
        state.Manager.CanAddPages(manifest.PinnedPages,uint64_t(state.Options.BudgetMiB)*1024*1024);
}
bool RootsReady(uint32_t pageBase, const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest& manifest)
{
    const auto& snapshot = Data().Manager.Snapshot();
    for (uint32_t page = 0; page < manifest.Pages.size(); ++page)
    {
        if (manifest.PinnedPages[page] && (uint64_t(pageBase) + page >= snapshot.size() || !snapshot[pageBase + page].Flags))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
void Prepare(RenderGraph& graph)
{
    auto& state = Data();
    auto begin = Clock::now();
    Initialize();
    ++state.Serial;
    CollectFeedback();
    if (state.Available)
    {
        uint64_t completedCopy = state.Pool->CompletedCopyFence();
        state.Pool->Collect();
        // 毎フレームの一時配列はstaticで使い回す（Prepareはメインスレッドからのみ呼ばれる）。
        static std::vector<uint32_t> released;
        released.clear();
        for (const auto& page : state.Manager.Pages())
        {
            if (page.Retiring && page.GraphicsFence <= GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence() && page.CopyFence <= completedCopy)
            {
                released.push_back(page.Slot);
            }
        }
        state.Manager.Collect(GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence(), completedCopy);
        for (uint32_t slot : released) state.Pool->Release(slot);
        state.Options.BudgetMiB = std::clamp(state.Options.BudgetMiB, 1u, 1024u);
        state.Options.UploadMiBPerFrame = std::min(state.Options.UploadMiBPerFrame, 64u);
        state.Manager.SetBudget(uint64_t(state.Options.BudgetMiB) * 1024 * 1024);
        for (auto& result : state.Io->Poll())
        {
            --state.Outstanding;
            state.Stats.DiskBytes += result.ReadBytes;
            state.Stats.IoMilliseconds += result.Milliseconds;
            if (!state.Manager.Matches(result.Ticket))
            {
                continue;
            }
            if (!result.Error.empty())
            {
                ++state.Stats.IoErrors;
                auto& source = state.Sources[result.Ticket.Page];
                source.Failures = std::min(source.Failures + 1, 6u);
                source.RetryAfter = Clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(std::min(30u, 1u << (source.Failures - 1)));
                state.Manager.Cancel(result.Ticket);
            }
            else
            {
                state.Ready.push_back(std::move(result));
            }
        }
        uint64_t transferred = 0;
        uint64_t limit = uint64_t(state.Options.UploadMiBPerFrame) * 1024 * 1024;
        while (!state.Ready.empty() && transferred + 65536 <= limit)
        {
            auto& result = state.Ready.front();
            if (state.Manager.Matches(result.Ticket))
            {
                uint64_t fence = state.Pool->Submit(result.Ticket, result.Payload);
                state.Manager.CompleteCopy(result.Ticket, fence);
                state.Sources[result.Ticket.Page].SubmittedAt = Clock::now();
                state.Stats.SubmittedBytes += 65536;
                transferred += 65536;
            }
            state.Ready.pop_front();
        }
        uint64_t previouslyResident = 0;
        for (uint32_t pageId = 0; pageId < state.Manager.PageCount(); ++pageId)
        {
            const auto& page = state.Manager.Pages()[pageId];
            if (page.State == PageState::Loading && page.CopyFence && page.CopyFence <= completedCopy)
            {
                previouslyResident += 65536;
                auto& source = state.Sources[pageId];
                state.Stats.CopyMilliseconds = std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(Clock::now()-source.SubmittedAt).count();
                source.Failures = 0;
            }
        }
        state.Manager.Publish(completedCopy,state.Serial);
        state.Stats.CompletedBytes += previouslyResident;
        bool waiting = state.Manager.ReservedBytes() > state.Manager.Budget();
        uint32_t submittedRequests = 0;
        const uint32_t requestLimit = std::min(state.Options.MaxPageRequestsPerFrame, RequestCapacity);
        static std::vector<uint32_t> requestedPages;
        requestedPages.clear();
        const auto requestNow = Clock::now(); // ページごとのClock::now()呼び出しをやめる
        for (uint32_t page = 0; page < state.Manager.PageCount(); ++page)
        {
            const auto& source = state.Sources[page];
            const auto& record = state.Manager.Pages()[page];
            if (record.Pinned && record.State == PageState::Evicted && source.RetryAfter <= requestNow)
            {
                state.Manager.Request(page,state.Serial);
            }
            if (record.State == PageState::Requested && source.RetryAfter <= requestNow)
            {
                requestedPages.push_back(page);
            }
        }
        // 1フレームに発行できるのは requestLimit 件だけなので、全件ソートせず上位だけ並べる。
        const size_t orderedCount = std::min<size_t>(requestedPages.size(), size_t(requestLimit) + 64);
        std::partial_sort(requestedPages.begin(),requestedPages.begin()+orderedCount,requestedPages.end(),[&](uint32_t left, uint32_t right)
        {
            const auto& a = state.Manager.Pages()[left];
            const auto& b = state.Manager.Pages()[right];
            if (a.Pinned != b.Pinned) return a.Pinned;
            if (a.Predicted != b.Predicted) return !a.Predicted;
            if (a.LastUsed != b.LastUsed) return a.LastUsed > b.LastUsed;
            if (a.Priority != b.Priority) return a.Priority > b.Priority;
            return left < right;
        });
        for (const uint32_t page : requestedPages)
        {
            const auto& source = state.Sources[page];
            if (submittedRequests >= requestLimit || state.Outstanding >= 128 || !state.Ready.empty()) break;
            if (state.Manager.ReservedBytes()+65536 > state.Manager.Budget())
            {
                waiting = true;
                break;
            }
            auto ticket = state.Manager.BeginLoad(page);
            if (!ticket)
            {
                waiting = true;
                continue;
            }
            if (state.Io->Submit(source.Manifest,*ticket,source.LocalPage))
            {
                ++state.Outstanding;
                ++submittedRequests;
            }
            else
            {
                state.Manager.Cancel(*ticket);
            }
        }
        if (waiting)
        {
            const uint64_t protection = std::max(1u, state.Options.RecentlyUsedProtectionFrames);
            auto oldest = state.Manager.OldestEvictable(state.Serial > protection ? state.Serial-protection : 0);
            if (oldest && state.Manager.Retire(*oldest, 0))
            {
                ++state.Stats.Evictions;
            }
        }
    }
    uint32_t frameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    auto& frame = Current();
    // The engine has already waited for reuse of this swap-chain frame slot.
    if (frame.Fence)
    {
        throw std::runtime_error("Geometry feedback slot reused before completion");
    }
    frame.Pages = state.Manager.PageCount();
    frame.Words = std::max(1u, (frame.Pages + 31) / 32);
    frame.Serial = state.Serial;
    auto ensure = [&](GpuSceneBuffer& buffer, uint32_t count, uint32_t stride, bool uav)
    {
        buffer.BeginFrame(frameIndex);
        buffer.Ensure(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), count, stride, frameIndex, L"Geometry streaming frame", uav);
    };
    ensure(frame.Residency, std::max(1u, frame.Pages), 16, false);
    ensure(frame.RequestBits, frame.Words, 4, true);
    ensure(frame.Usage, frame.Words, 4, true);
    ensure(frame.Requests, 4 + RequestCapacity, 4, true);
    std::vector<uint32_t> indices(frame.Pages);
    std::iota(indices.begin(), indices.end(), 0u);
    uint64_t bytes = frame.Residency.Stage(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), frameIndex,
        state.Manager.Snapshot().data(), frame.Pages, indices);
    auto snapshot = Import(graph, frame.Residency, "Geometry Residency Snapshot", D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    if (bytes)
    {
        auto* target = &frame.Residency;
        graph.AddPass("Geometry Residency Upload",
            [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder) { builder.Write(snapshot, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST); },
            [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands) { target->Copy(commands, frameIndex); });
    }
    state.Manager.MarkSnapshotUsed(GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence());
    auto& stats = state.Stats;
    stats.Resident = stats.Requested = stats.Loading = stats.Evicted = stats.Pinned = 0;
    for (const auto& page : state.Manager.Pages())
    {
        stats.Pinned += page.Pinned;
        switch (page.State)
        {
        case PageState::Resident: ++stats.Resident; break;
        case PageState::Requested: ++stats.Requested; break;
        case PageState::Loading: ++stats.Loading; break;
        case PageState::Evicted: ++stats.Evicted; break;
        }
    }
    stats.ReservedBytes = state.Manager.ReservedBytes();
    stats.BudgetBytes = state.Manager.Budget();
    stats.PoolBytes = state.Available ? state.Pool->MemoryBytes() : 0;
    stats.UploadBytes = state.Available ? state.Pool->UploadBytes() : 0;
    stats.StagingBytes = state.Available ? state.Io->StagingBytes() + state.Ready.size() * 65536ull : 0;
    stats.CpuMilliseconds = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(Clock::now() - begin).count();
}
void RecordMetadataBytes(uint64_t bytes)
{
    auto& stats = Data().Stats;
    for (const auto& frame : Data().Frames)
    {
        bytes += frame.Residency.MemoryBytes()+frame.RequestBits.MemoryBytes()+frame.Requests.MemoryBytes()+
            frame.Usage.MemoryBytes()+frame.ReadbackBytes;
    }
    stats.MetadataBytes = bytes;
    RenderProfiler::GeometryStreamingStatistics snapshot;
    snapshot.GpuRequests = stats.GpuRequests;
    snapshot.CpuRequests = stats.CpuRequests;
    snapshot.RequestOverflow = stats.RequestOverflow;
    snapshot.DiskBytes = stats.DiskBytes;
    snapshot.SubmittedBytes = stats.SubmittedBytes;
    snapshot.CompletedBytes = stats.CompletedBytes;
    snapshot.ResidentPages = stats.Resident;
    snapshot.LoadingPages = stats.Loading;
    snapshot.RequestedPages = stats.Requested;
    snapshot.EvictedPages = stats.Evicted;
    snapshot.PoolBytes = stats.PoolBytes;
    snapshot.BudgetBytes = stats.BudgetBytes;
    snapshot.StagingBytes = stats.StagingBytes;
    snapshot.MetadataBytes = stats.MetadataBytes;
    snapshot.UploadBytes = stats.UploadBytes;
    snapshot.CpuMilliseconds = stats.CpuMilliseconds;
    snapshot.IoMilliseconds = stats.IoMilliseconds;
    snapshot.CopyMilliseconds = stats.CopyMilliseconds;
    RenderProfiler::RecordGeometryStreaming(snapshot);
}
void RecordFeedbackCopy(RenderGraph& graph)
{
    auto& frame = Current();
    uint64_t bytes = (4ull + RequestCapacity + frame.Words) * 4;
    if (frame.ReadbackBytes != bytes)
    {
        auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK);
        auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
        frame.Readback.Reset();
        if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&frame.Readback))))
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Geometry feedback readback allocation failed");
        }
        frame.ReadbackBytes = bytes;
    }
    auto requests = Import(graph, frame.Requests, "Geometry Page Requests", D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    auto usage = Import(graph, frame.Usage, "Geometry Page Usage", D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    auto* target = &frame;
    graph.AddPass("Geometry Streaming Feedback",
        [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder)
        {
            builder.Read(requests, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE).Read(usage, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
        },
        [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
        {
            commands->CopyBufferRegion(target->Readback.Get(), 0, target->Requests.Resource(), 0, (4ull + RequestCapacity) * 4);
            commands->CopyBufferRegion(target->Readback.Get(), (4ull + RequestCapacity) * 4, target->Usage.Resource(), 0, uint64_t(target->Words) * 4);
            target->Fence = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence();
        });
}
D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE PageDescriptors()
{
    auto* heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
    auto handle = heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    handle.ptr += uint64_t(heap->GetDesc().NumDescriptors - MaximumSlots) * FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize();
    return handle;
}
std::vector<RenderGraph::ResourceHandle> PageHandles(RenderGraph& graph)
{
    std::vector<RenderGraph::ResourceHandle> handles;
    auto& state = Data();
    for (const auto& page : state.Manager.Pages())
    {
        if (page.State != PageState::Resident)
        {
            continue;
        }
        auto* resource = state.Pool->Resource(page.Slot);
        auto found = graph.FindImportedResource(resource);
        if (!found.IsValid())
        {
            RenderGraph::ImportedResource input{};
            input.Name = "Geometry Resident Page";
            input.Resource = resource;
            input.InitialState = input.FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
            input.HasFinalState = true;
            found = graph.ImportResource(input);
        }
        handles.push_back(found);
    }
    return handles;
}
void Shutdown()
{
    auto& state = Data();
    if (state.Io)
    {
        state.Io->Shutdown();
    }
    if (state.Pool)
    {
        state.Pool->Shutdown();
    }
    state = {};
}
}

#pragma once
#include "virtualgeometrypagecache.h"
#include "rendering/gpuscene/gpuscenebuffer.h"

struct VGStreamingBudget
{
    uint64_t MaxResidentMemory = 256ull*1024*1024;
    uint64_t MaxUploadBytesPerFrame = 8ull*1024*1024;
    uint32_t MaxPageRequestsPerFrame = 128;
};

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
inline constexpr uint32_t MaximumSlots = 16384;
inline constexpr uint32_t RequestCapacity = 65536;
struct Settings
{
    uint32_t BudgetMiB = 256;
    uint32_t UploadMiBPerFrame = 8;
    uint32_t MaxPageRequestsPerFrame = 128;
    uint32_t RecentlyUsedProtectionFrames = 3;
};
struct Statistics
{
    uint64_t Resident = 0, Requested = 0, Loading = 0, Evicted = 0, Pinned = 0;
    uint64_t Evictions = 0, IoErrors = 0, RequestOverflow = 0;
    uint64_t GpuRequests = 0, CpuRequests = 0, DiskBytes = 0;
    uint64_t PrefetchRequests = 0;
    uint64_t SubmittedBytes = 0, CompletedBytes = 0, ReservedBytes = 0, BudgetBytes = 0, StagingBytes = 0;
    uint64_t PoolBytes = 0, UploadBytes = 0;
    uint64_t MetadataBytes = 0;
    double CpuMilliseconds = 0, IoMilliseconds = 0, CopyMilliseconds = 0;
};
struct PageInfo
{
    uint32_t State = 0, Slot = UINT32_MAX, Priority = 1;
    uint64_t LastUsed = 0;
    bool Pinned = false, Retiring = false;
};
bool InspectPage(uint32_t page, PageInfo& info);
Settings& GetSettings();
VGStreamingBudget GetBudget();
// Current pool supports 1..1024 MiB resident, 0..64 MiB uploads, in whole MiB units.
bool SetBudget(const VGStreamingBudget& budget, std::string& error);
const Statistics& GetStatistics();
// Returns a stable global Page base, or UINT32_MAX if pinned admission fails.
