};

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\AdvancedEffectsCS.hlsl =====
// =============================================================================================
// AdvancedEffectsCS.hlsl
//   Froxel volumetric fog (inject / integrate / composite), histogram auto exposure,
//   motion blur and depth of field. Runs on the linear HDR scene before bloom and tone mapping.
//   Compiled at runtime (cs_6_5, DXC) by advancedeffects.h.
// =============================================================================================

cbuffer AdvancedConstants : register(b0)
{
    float4x4 InvViewProjection;      // current, jittered (matches the GBuffer)
    float4x4 PrevViewProjection;     // previous frame, for froxel reprojection
    float4 CameraPosition;           // xyz, w = frame time (s)
    float4 PrevCameraPosition;       // xyz, w = history valid (0/1)
    uint4 Extent;                    // scene width, height, frame index, light count
    uint4 FroxelExtent;              // froxel x, y, z, local fog count
    float4 FogDepth;                 // near, far, log2(far / near), history weight
    float4 FogMedium0;               // global density, height falloff, extinction, dist scale
    float4 FogMedium1;               // rayleigh strength, mie strength, mie g, scattering strength
    float4 FogRayleighColor;         // rgb, w = ambient strength
    float4 FogMieColor;              // rgb, w = 1 if TLAS shadows available
    float4 FogAmbientColor;          // rgb sky ambient (multiple scattering approximation), w = exposure reset
    float4 ExposureParams;           // min log2 lum, log2 lum range, compensation EV, adaptation speed
    float4 ExposureLimits;           // min exposure, max exposure, low percentile, high percentile
    float4 MotionBlurParams;         // shutter scale, max length (px), sample count, enabled
    float4 DofParams;                // focus dist, focus range, max radius (px), enabled
    uint4 Features;                  // fog, auto exposure, motion blur, dof
    float4 LocalFogData0[16];        // position, radius
    float4 LocalFogData1[16];        // height falloff, density, shape (1 sphere), enabled
    float4 LocalFogColor[16];
    uint4 MegaLightsFog;             // x: MegaLights のグリッドを使う, y: フロクセルあたりのサンプル数
};

struct FogLight
{
    float4 PositionType;   // xyz position, w type (0 dir, 1 point, 2 spot, 3 volume)
    float4 DirectionRange; // xyz direction (toward light for directional, forward for spot), w range
    float4 Color;          // rgb * intensity, w volume density
    float4 Extras;         // cos inner, cos outer, cast shadow, reserved
};

Texture2D<float4> SceneColor : register(t0);
Texture2D<float> SceneDepth : register(t1);
Texture2D<float4> SceneVelocity : register(t2);
Texture3D<float4> FroxelHistory : register(t3);
Texture3D<float4> FroxelCurrent : register(t4);
Texture3D<float4> FroxelIntegrated : register(t5);
Texture2D<float4> PostA : register(t6);
Texture2D<float4> PostB : register(t7);
RaytracingAccelerationStructure ShadowScene : register(t10);
StructuredBuffer<FogLight> FogLights : register(t11);

RWTexture3D<float4> FroxelOut : register(u0);
RWTexture3D<float4> IntegratedOut : register(u1);
RWTexture2D<float4> PostAOut : register(u2);
RWTexture2D<float4> PostBOut : register(u3);
RWStructuredBuffer<uint> Histogram : register(u4);
RWStructuredBuffer<float> ExposureState : register(u5); // 0 exposure, 1 average luminance, 2 initialized

// ---- MegaLights M6：フロクセルのローカルライト（グリッドのセルから確率的に選ぶ）
#define MEGALIGHTS_CB_REGISTER b1
#include "MegaLightsCommon.hlsli"
StructuredBuffer<MegaLightData> FogMegaLights : register(t12);
StructuredBuffer<uint2> FogMegaLightCells : register(t13);
StructuredBuffer<uint> FogMegaLightIndices : register(t14);

SamplerState LinearClamp : register(s0);
SamplerState PointClamp : register(s1);

static const float kPi = 3.14159265f;
static const uint kHistogramBins = 64;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float Hash(uint value)
{
    value ^= value >> 16; value *= 0x7feb352du;
    value ^= value >> 15; value *= 0x846ca68bu;
    value ^= value >> 16;
    return (value >> 8) / 16777216.0f;
}

float3 ViewRay(float2 uv)
{
    float4 farPoint = mul(float4(uv.x * 2 - 1, 1 - uv.y * 2, 1, 1), InvViewProjection);
    return normalize(farPoint.xyz / farPoint.w - CameraPosition.xyz);
}

float3 WorldFromDepth(float2 uv, float depth)
{
    float4 world = mul(float4(uv.x * 2 - 1, 1 - uv.y * 2, depth, 1), InvViewProjection);
    return world.xyz / world.w;
}

float SliceToDistance(float slice)
{
    return FogDepth.x * exp2(slice / FroxelExtent.z * FogDepth.z);
}

float DistanceToSliceCoordinate(float dist)
{
    return saturate(log2(max(dist, FogDepth.x) / FogDepth.x) / FogDepth.z);
}

float HenyeyGreenstein(float cosine, float g)
{
    g = clamp(g, -0.95f, 0.95f);
    float g2 = g * g;
    float denominator = max(1 + g2 - 2 * g * cosine, 0.0001f);
    return (1 - g2) / (4 * kPi * denominator * sqrt(denominator));
}

float TraceVisibility(float3 origin, float3 direction, float dist)
{
    if (FogMieColor.w < 0.5f) return 1;
    RayDesc ray;
    ray.Origin = origin;
    ray.Direction = direction;
    ray.TMin = 0.02f;
    ray.TMax = max(dist, 0.03f);
    RayQuery<RAY_FLAG_ACCEPT_FIRST_HIT_AND_END_SEARCH | RAY_FLAG_FORCE_OPAQUE> query;
    query.TraceRayInline(ShadowScene, RAY_FLAG_NONE, 0x01, ray);
    while (query.Proceed()) { }
    return query.CommittedStatus() == COMMITTED_NOTHING ? 1 : 0;
}

// Medium at a world position: rgb = in-scattering emission of local fog, a = extinction (1/m).
void EvaluateMedium(float3 position, out float globalDensity, out float3 localEmission, out float extinction)
{
    globalDensity = FogMedium0.x * exp(-max(position.y, 0) * FogMedium0.y);
    extinction = FogMedium0.z * globalDensity * FogMedium0.w;
    localEmission = 0;
    [loop] for (uint index = 0; index < FroxelExtent.w; ++index)
    {
        float4 data0 = LocalFogData0[index];
        float4 data1 = LocalFogData1[index];
        if (data1.w < 0.5f || data1.y <= 0.00001f) continue;
        float3 delta = position - data0.xyz;
        float radius = max(data0.w, 0.01f);
        float weight = data1.z >= 0.5f ?
            saturate(1 - length(delta) / radius) :
            saturate(1 - length(delta.xz) / radius) * exp(-abs(delta.y) * max(data1.x, 0.0001f));
        // Same optical depth scale (0.08) as the former ray marched local fog.
        float sigma = weight * data1.y * 0.08f;
        extinction += sigma;
        localEmission += LocalFogColor[index].rgb * sigma;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MegaLights M6：フロクセルのローカルライト
//   セル（16px タイル × スライス）のライトから、影なしの寄与（輝度）に比例して N 個選び、
//   影を落とすライトだけ影レイを飛ばして 1/p で重み付けする（不偏）。ノイズはフロクセルの時間方向の履歴で減る。
//   従来の FogLights（上限 32）にはグリッドに載っていないライト（太陽・シャドウマップ持ち・Volume など）だけが入る。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float3 MegaLightFogContribution(MegaLightData light, float3 position, float3 viewToCamera, float globalDensity,
    float3 scatterAlbedo, float3 mieAlbedo, out float3 toLight, out float lightDistance)
{
    float3 offset = light.PositionType.xyz - position;
    lightDistance = length(offset);
    toLight = offset / max(lightDistance, 0.0001f);
    float fade = saturate(1 - lightDistance / max(light.DirectionRange.w, 0.01f));
    float attenuation = fade * fade;
    if ((int)round(light.PositionType.w) == 2)
    {
        float spotCosine = dot(-toLight, normalize(light.DirectionRange.xyz));
        attenuation *= smoothstep(light.Extra.y, light.Extra.x, spotCosine);
    }
    if (attenuation <= 0.00001f) return 0;
    float cosine = dot(toLight, viewToCamera);
    float3 phase = scatterAlbedo * (0.0596831f * (1 + cosine * cosine)) + mieAlbedo * HenyeyGreenstein(cosine, FogMedium1.z);
    // FogInject の従来ライトと同じ式（大気の媒質 + ライト自身のボリューム密度）
    float3 response = phase * globalDensity * FogMedium0.w + 0.16f * max(light.Extra.z, 0.0f) * 0.0795775f;
    return response * max(light.Color.rgb, 0.0f) * max(light.Flags.w, 0.0f) * attenuation;
}

float3 MegaLightsFogScattering(uint3 id, float3 position, float3 viewToCamera, float globalDensity, float3 scatterAlbedo, float3 mieAlbedo)
{
    if (MegaLightsFog.x == 0u || !MLGridActive()) return 0;
    float3 view = mul(float4(position, 1.0f), MLWorldToView).xyz;
    if (view.z <= MLDepth.z) return 0;
    float2 pixel = MLViewToPixel(view);
    if (any(pixel < 0.0f) || any(pixel >= float2(MLScreen.xy))) return 0;
    uint2 tile = min(uint2(pixel) / ML_TILE_SIZE, MLGrid.xy - 1u);
    uint2 cell = FogMegaLightCells[MLCellIndex(tile, MLSliceFromViewZ(view.z))];
    if (cell.y == 0u) return 0;

    const uint sampleCount = clamp(MegaLightsFog.y, 1u, 4u);
    const uint seed = MLSeed(id.xy + uint2(0u, id.z * 4099u), Extent.z, 0x464f47u);
    uint picks[4] = { 0xffffffffu, 0xffffffffu, 0xffffffffu, 0xffffffffu };
    float pickWeights[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
    float weightSum = 0;
    [loop] for (uint i = 0u; i < cell.y; ++i)
    {
        const uint lightIndex = FogMegaLightIndices[cell.x + i];
        float3 toLight;
        float lightDistance;
        const float w = dot(MegaLightFogContribution(FogMegaLights[lightIndex], position, viewToCamera, globalDensity,
            scatterAlbedo, mieAlbedo, toLight, lightDistance), float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f));
        if (w <= 0.0f) continue;
        weightSum += w;
        [unroll] for (uint k = 0u; k < 4u; ++k)
        {
            if (k >= sampleCount) break;
            if (MLRandom(seed + k * 0x9e3779b9u + i * 0x85ebca6bu) * weightSum < w)
            {
                picks[k] = lightIndex;
                pickWeights[k] = w;
            }
        }
    }
    if (weightSum <= 0.0f) return 0;
    float3 result = 0;
    [unroll] for (uint k = 0u; k < 4u; ++k)
    {
        if (k >= sampleCount || picks[k] == 0xffffffffu) continue;
        const MegaLightData light = FogMegaLights[picks[k]];
        float3 toLight;
        float lightDistance;
        float3 contribution = MegaLightFogContribution(light, position, viewToCamera, globalDensity, scatterAlbedo, mieAlbedo,
            toLight, lightDistance);
        float visibility = MLLightCastsShadow(light) ? TraceVisibility(position, toLight, lightDistance - 0.05f) : 1.0f;
        // p = w / Σw（寄与が 0 のライトは選ばれないが、そもそも寄与 0 なので不偏）
        result += contribution * visibility * (weightSum / pickWeights[k]);
    }
    return result / (float)sampleCount;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. Froxel injection: medium + lighting per froxel, temporally reprojected.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void FogInject(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id >= FroxelExtent.xyz)) return;
    uint frame = Extent.z;
    // Per-froxel jitter inside the cell (R2 sequence along depth), resolved by the history.
    float jitter = frac(0.5f + frame * 0.618034f + Hash(id.x + id.y * 977u) * 0.25f);
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / FroxelExtent.xy;
    float3 rayDirection = ViewRay(uv);
    float dist = SliceToDistance(id.z + jitter);
    float3 position = CameraPosition.xyz + rayDirection * dist;

    float globalDensity;
    float3 localEmission;
    float extinction;
    EvaluateMedium(position, globalDensity, localEmission, extinction);

    float3 scattering = localEmission;
    float3 viewToCamera = -rayDirection;
    float3 scatterAlbedo = FogRayleighColor.rgb * FogMedium1.x;
    float3 mieAlbedo = FogMieColor.rgb * FogMedium1.y;
    uint shadowedLocal = 0;
    [loop] for (uint lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < Extent.w; ++lightIndex)
    {
        FogLight light = FogLights[lightIndex];
        int type = (int)round(light.PositionType.w);
        float3 toLight;
        float attenuation = 1;
        float lightDistance = 200.0f;
        if (type == 0)
        {
            toLight = normalize(light.DirectionRange.xyz);
        }
        else
        {
            float3 offset = light.PositionType.xyz - position;
            lightDistance = length(offset);
            toLight = offset / max(lightDistance, 0.0001f);
            float fade = saturate(1 - lightDistance / max(light.DirectionRange.w, 0.01f));
            attenuation = fade * fade;
            if (type == 2 || type == 3)
            {
                float spotCosine = dot(-toLight, normalize(light.DirectionRange.xyz));
                attenuation *= smoothstep(light.Extras.y, light.Extras.x, spotCosine);
            }
        }
        if (attenuation <= 0.00001f) continue;
        float cosine = dot(toLight, viewToCamera);
        float3 phase = scatterAlbedo * (0.0596831f * (1 + cosine * cosine)) +
            mieAlbedo * HenyeyGreenstein(cosine, FogMedium1.z);
        // Atmospheric medium plus the light's own authored volume density (light shafts).
        float3 response = phase * globalDensity * FogMedium0.w +
            (type == 0 ? 0.025f : 0.16f) * light.Color.w * 0.0795775f;
        float3 incident = light.Color.rgb * attenuation;
        if (all(response * incident < 0.0000001f)) continue;
        float visibility = 1;
        bool castShadow = light.Extras.z > 0.5f;
        if (castShadow && (type == 0 || shadowedLocal < 4))
        {
            visibility = TraceVisibility(position, toLight, type == 0 ? 200.0f : lightDistance - 0.05f);
            shadowedLocal += type == 0 ? 0 : 1;
        }
        scattering += response * incident * visibility * FogMedium1.w;
    }
    scattering += MegaLightsFogScattering(id, position, viewToCamera, globalDensity, scatterAlbedo, mieAlbedo) * FogMedium1.w;
    // Cheap multiple scattering / sky ambient so shadowed fog is not pitch black.
    scattering += FogAmbientColor.rgb * FogRayleighColor.w * globalDensity * FogMedium0.w;

    float4 current = float4(scattering, extinction);
    if (PrevCameraPosition.w > 0.5f)
    {
        float4 previousClip = mul(float4(position, 1), PrevViewProjection);
        if (previousClip.w > 0.0001f)
        {
            float2 previousUv = float2(previousClip.x, -previousClip.y) / previousClip.w * 0.5f + 0.5f;
            float previousDistance = length(position - PrevCameraPosition.xyz);
            float previousSlice = DistanceToSliceCoordinate(previousDistance);
            if (all(previousUv > 0) && all(previousUv < 1))
            {
                float4 history = FroxelHistory.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, float3(previousUv, previousSlice), 0);
                current = lerp(current, history, FogDepth.w);
            }
        }
    }
    FroxelOut[id] = current;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. Front to back integration (energy conserving, Hillaire 2015).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void FogIntegrate(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= FroxelExtent.xy)) return;
    float3 accumulated = 0;
    float transmittance = 1;
    float previousDistance = 0;
    [loop] for (uint slice = 0; slice < FroxelExtent.z; ++slice)
    {
        float dist = SliceToDistance(slice + 1);
        float thickness = dist - previousDistance;
        previousDistance = dist;
        float4 medium = FroxelCurrent[uint3(id.xy, slice)];
        float extinction = max(medium.a, 0.0000001f);
        float sliceTransmittance = exp(-extinction * thickness);
        accumulated += transmittance * medium.rgb * (1 - sliceTransmittance) / extinction;
        transmittance *= sliceTransmittance;
        IntegratedOut[uint3(id.xy, slice)] = float4(accumulated, transmittance);
    }
}

float4 SampleIntegratedFog(float2 uv, float dist)
{
    float coordinate = DistanceToSliceCoordinate(dist) * FroxelExtent.z; // in slices
    // Slice z stores the integral up to its far boundary (z + 1).
    float4 fog = FroxelIntegrated.SampleLevel(LinearClamp,
        float3(uv, saturate((coordinate - 0.5f) / FroxelExtent.z)), 0);
    if (coordinate < 1)
    {
        fog = lerp(float4(0, 0, 0, 1), fog, saturate(coordinate));
    }
    return fog;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 3. Composite: scene -> PostA (fog). Background uses the far end of the volume.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void Composite(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= Extent.xy)) return;
    float4 color = SceneColor[id.xy];
    float depth = SceneDepth[id.xy];
    bool physicalSkyPixel = depth >= 0.9999f && (Features.x & 2u) != 0;
    if ((Features.x & 1u) != 0 && !physicalSkyPixel)
    {
        float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / Extent.xy;
        float dist = depth >= 0.9999f ? FogDepth.y : length(WorldFromDepth(uv, depth) - CameraPosition.xyz);
        // Small screen space dither hides the trilinear froxel footprint.
        float dither = (Hash(id.x + id.y * 4099u + Extent.z * 7919u) - 0.5f) / Extent.x;
        float4 fog = SampleIntegratedFog(uv + dither, dist);
        color.rgb = color.rgb * fog.a + fog.rgb;
    }
    PostAOut[id.xy] = color;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 4. Auto exposure: log luminance histogram -> percentile average -> temporal adaptation.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
groupshared uint SharedHistogram[kHistogramBins];

[numthreads(64, 1, 1)]
void HistogramClear(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (id.x < kHistogramBins) Histogram[id.x] = 0;
}

[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]
void HistogramBuild(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID, uint index : SV_GroupIndex)
{
    if (index < kHistogramBins) SharedHistogram[index] = 0;
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    // Half resolution is plenty for an average and halves the atomics.
    uint2 pixel = id.xy * 2;
    if (all(pixel < Extent.xy))
    {
        float luminance = dot(PostA[pixel].rgb, float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f));
        uint bin = 0;
        if (luminance > 0.000001f)
        {
            float normalized = saturate((log2(luminance) - ExposureParams.x) / ExposureParams.y);
            bin = 1 + (uint)(normalized * (kHistogramBins - 2));
        }
        InterlockedAdd(SharedHistogram[bin], 1);
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (index < kHistogramBins && SharedHistogram[index] != 0)
    {
        InterlockedAdd(Histogram[index], SharedHistogram[index]);
    }
}

[numthreads(64, 1, 1)]
void ExposureAdapt(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID, uint index : SV_GroupIndex)
{
    SharedHistogram[index] = Histogram[index];
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (index != 0) return;
    // Black pixels (bin 0) are ignored; average between the low and high percentiles.
    uint total = 0;
    [loop] for (uint bin = 1; bin < kHistogramBins; ++bin) total += SharedHistogram[bin];
    float low = total * ExposureLimits.z;
    float high = total * ExposureLimits.w;
    float sum = 0;
    float weight = 0;
    float cumulative = 0;
    [loop] for (uint bucket = 1; bucket < kHistogramBins; ++bucket)
    {
        float count = SharedHistogram[bucket];
        float begin = cumulative;
        cumulative += count;
        float used = max(min(cumulative, high) - max(begin, low), 0);
        float log2Luminance = ExposureParams.x + (bucket - 0.5f) / (kHistogramBins - 2) * ExposureParams.y;
        sum += log2Luminance * used;
        weight += used;
    }
    float averageLuminance = weight > 0 ? exp2(sum / weight) : 0.18f;
    float target = 0.18f * exp2(ExposureParams.z) / max(averageLuminance, 0.0001f);
    target = clamp(target, ExposureLimits.x, ExposureLimits.y);
    float previous = ExposureState[0];
    bool initialized = FogAmbientColor.w < 0.5f && ExposureState[2] > 0.5f && previous > 0 && !isnan(previous) && !isinf(previous);
    // Adapt in log space; brightening is slower than darkening, like the eye.
    float speed = ExposureParams.w * (target > previous ? 0.6f : 1.0f);
    float blend = 1 - exp(-CameraPosition.w * speed);
    float exposure = initialized ? exp2(lerp(log2(previous), log2(target), blend)) : target;
    ExposureState[0] = exposure;
    ExposureState[1] = averageLuminance;
    ExposureState[2] = 1;
}

float CurrentExposure()
{
    return Features.y != 0 ? max(ExposureState[0], 0.000001f) : 1;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 5. Resolve: motion blur + exposure, PostA -> PostB.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float4 ResolvePixel(uint3 id)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= Extent.xy)) return 0;
    float4 center = PostA[id.xy];
    float3 color = center.rgb;
    if (Features.z != 0)
    {
        float2 velocity = SceneVelocity[id.xy].zw * Extent.xy * MotionBlurParams.x; // pixels
        float velocityLength = sqrt(dot(velocity, velocity));
        if (velocityLength > 0.5f)
        {
            velocity *= min(velocityLength, MotionBlurParams.y) / velocityLength;
            float centerDepth = SceneDepth[id.xy];
            uint samples = (uint)MotionBlurParams.z;
            float offset = Hash(id.x * 3u + id.y * 7919u + Extent.z) - 0.5f;
            float3 sum = color;
            float weightSum = 1;
            [loop] for (uint index = 0; index < samples; ++index)
            {
                float t = ((index + 0.5f + offset) / samples) - 0.5f;
                int2 samplePixel = clamp(int2(id.xy + velocity * t), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
                float sampleDepth = SceneDepth[samplePixel];
                float2 sampleVelocity = SceneVelocity[samplePixel].zw * Extent.xy * MotionBlurParams.x;
                // Background samples always count; foreground samples only if they move
                // enough to reach this pixel. Prevents static foreground from smearing.
                bool behind = sampleDepth >= centerDepth - 0.00002f;
                float reach = sqrt(dot(sampleVelocity, sampleVelocity)) * 0.5f;
                float dist = abs(t) * velocityLength;
                float weight = behind ? 1 : saturate(reach - dist + 1);
                sum += PostA[samplePixel].rgb * weight;
                weightSum += weight;
            }
            color = sum / weightSum;
        }
    }
    return float4(color * CurrentExposure(), center.a);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 6. Depth of field (scatter-as-gather, golden angle disk), PostB -> PostA.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float CircleOfConfusion(float2 uv, float depth)
{
    float dist = depth >= 0.9999f ? 100000.0f : length(WorldFromDepth(uv, depth) - CameraPosition.xyz);
    float focus = max(DofParams.x, 0.05f);
    float blur = saturate((abs(dist - focus) - DofParams.y * 0.5f) / focus);
    return blur * DofParams.z; // pixels
}

Texture2D<float4> HalfResolveInput:register(t0,space11);
Texture2D<float4> HalfDofInput:register(t1,space11);
RWTexture2D<float4> HalfResolveOutput:register(u0,space11);
RWTexture2D<float4> HalfDofOutput:register(u1,space11);
cbuffer HalfLensConstants:register(b2) { uint HalfWidth,HalfHeight,HalfHasDof,HalfPadding; };
static bool UseHalfDofSource=false;
float4 DofSource(int2 pixel)
{
    if(UseHalfDofSource) return HalfResolveInput.Load(int3(clamp(pixel/2,0,int2(HalfWidth,HalfHeight)-1),0));
    return PostB.Load(int3(pixel,0));
}
float4 DepthOfFieldPixel(uint3 id)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= Extent.xy)) return 0;
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / Extent.xy;
    float centerDepth = SceneDepth[id.xy];
    float centerCoc = CircleOfConfusion(uv, centerDepth);
    float4 center = DofSource(int2(id.xy));
    float searchRadius = DofParams.z;
    float centerWeight = 1 / max(centerCoc * centerCoc, 1);
    float3 sum = center.rgb * centerWeight;
    float weightSum = centerWeight;
    const uint kSamples = 32;
    float rotation = Hash(id.x + id.y * 7919u) * 6.2831853f;
    [loop] for (uint index = 0; index < kSamples; ++index)
    {
        float radius = sqrt((index + 0.5f) / kSamples) * searchRadius;
        float angle = index * 2.39996323f + rotation;
        float2 offset = float2(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * radius;
        int2 samplePixel = clamp(int2(id.xy + offset), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
        float sampleDepth = SceneDepth[samplePixel];
        float sampleCoc = CircleOfConfusion((samplePixel + 0.5f) / Extent.xy, sampleDepth);
        // A sample contributes if its own blur disk covers this pixel. Samples behind the
        // centre are limited by the centre's blur so a sharp foreground stays sharp.
        float coverage = sampleDepth > centerDepth ? min(sampleCoc, centerCoc) : sampleCoc;
        float weight = saturate(coverage - radius + 1) / max(coverage * coverage, 1);
        sum += DofSource(samplePixel).rgb * weight;
        weightSum += weight;
    }
    return float4(sum / weightSum, center.a);
}




[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void Resolve(uint3 id:SV_DispatchThreadID) { if(all(id.xy<uint2(Extent.xy))) PostBOut[id.xy]=ResolvePixel(id); }

[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void DepthOfField(uint3 id:SV_DispatchThreadID) { if(all(id.xy<uint2(Extent.xy))) PostAOut[id.xy]=DepthOfFieldPixel(id); }

[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void ResolveHalf(uint3 id:SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if(id.x>=HalfWidth || id.y>=HalfHeight) return;
    HalfResolveOutput[id.xy]=ResolvePixel(uint3(min(id.xy*2+1,uint2(Extent.xy)-1),0));
}
[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void DofHalf(uint3 id:SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if(id.x>=HalfWidth || id.y>=HalfHeight) return;
    UseHalfDofSource=true;
    HalfDofOutput[id.xy]=DepthOfFieldPixel(uint3(min(id.xy*2+1,uint2(Extent.xy)-1),0));
}
[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void UpsampleLens(uint3 id:SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if(any(id.xy>=uint2(Extent.xy))) return;
    float depth=SceneDepth[id.xy]; float2 position=(float2(id.xy)-1)*.5;
    int2 base=int2(floor(position)); float2 fraction=frac(position);
    float4 sum=0; float weights=0;
    [unroll] for(uint y=0;y<2;++y) [unroll] for(uint x=0;x<2;++x)
    {
        int2 low=clamp(base+int2(x,y),0,int2(HalfWidth,HalfHeight)-1);
        uint2 full=min(uint2(low)*2+1,uint2(Extent.xy)-1);
        float geometry=exp2(-abs(SceneDepth[full]-depth)/max(2e-5,abs(1-depth)*.02));
        float2 spatial=lerp(1-fraction,fraction,float2(x,y));
        float weight=spatial.x*spatial.y*geometry;
        float4 color=HalfHasDof!=0?HalfDofInput.Load(int3(low,0)):HalfResolveInput.Load(int3(low,0));
        sum+=color*weight; weights+=weight;
    }
    float4 full=PostA.Load(int3(id.xy,0)); full.rgb*=CurrentExposure();
    float motion=Features.z!=0?length(SceneVelocity[id.xy].zw*Extent.xy*MotionBlurParams.x):0;
    float coc=HalfHasDof!=0?CircleOfConfusion((id.xy+.5)/Extent.xy,depth):0;
    float blend=saturate(max(motion,coc)-.5);
    PostBOut[id.xy]=weights>1e-5?lerp(full,sum/weights,blend):full;
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\AtmosphereGBufferPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_POSTPROCESS
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"

Texture2D<float4> BaseColorTexture : register(t0);
Texture2D<float4> NormalTexture : register(t1);
Texture2D<float> DepthTexture : register(t2);
Texture2D<float4> MaterialTexture : register(t3);
Texture2D<float4> EnvironmentTexture : register(t6);
Texture2DArray<float> ShadowMapTexture : register(t7);

SamplerState TextureSampler : register(s0);
SamplerComparisonState ShadowSampler : register(s1);

struct LocalFogRayResult
{
    float3 Scattering;
    float Transmittance;
};

int GetAtmosphereStepCount(float viewDistance)
{



    float scale = clamp(Flags.w, 0.25f, 1.0f);
    float lowResolutionWeight = saturate((1.0f - scale) / 0.75f);
    int maxSteps = (int)round(lerp(28.0f, 36.0f, lowResolutionWeight));
    int distanceSteps = (int)ceil(viewDistance / 2.5f);
    return clamp(distanceSteps, 12, maxSteps);
}

float SampleAtmosphereShadowFast(
    float3 worldPos,
    Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
    SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler,
    float4x4 lightViewProjection,
    float4 shadowMapParams,
    float shadowLayer)
{
    float4 lightClip = mul(float4(worldPos, 1.0f), lightViewProjection);
    if (lightClip.w <= 0.000001f)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    float3 lightNdc = lightClip.xyz / lightClip.w;
    float2 shadowUv = float2(
        lightNdc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f,
        -lightNdc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);

    if (any(shadowUv < 0.0f) || any(shadowUv > 1.0f) ||
        lightNdc.z < 0.0f || lightNdc.z > 1.0f)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    float bias = max(shadowMapParams.y, shadowMapParams.z);
    float currentDepth = lightNdc.z - bias;
    float texelSize =
        shadowMapParams.x *
        (1.0f + saturate(AtmosphereCamera.w) * 2.0f);

    const float2 offsets[4] =
    {
        float2(-0.5f, -0.5f),
        float2( 0.5f, -0.5f),
        float2(-0.5f,  0.5f),
        float2( 0.5f,  0.5f)
    };

    float visibility = 0.0f;
    [unroll]
    for (int tap = 0; tap < 4; ++tap)
    {
        visibility += shadowMap.SampleCmpLevelZero(
            shadowSampler,
            float3(shadowUv + offsets[tap] * texelSize, shadowLayer),
            currentDepth);
    }

    visibility *= 0.25f;
    return lerp(
        1.0f,
        visibility,
        saturate(abs(shadowMapParams.w)));
}

float ComputeAtmosphereShadow(
    float3 samplePos,
    float3 lightDir,
    float4 lightPositionTypeData,
    float4x4 lightViewProjection,
    float4 shadowParams,
    float shadowLayer,
    bool hasShadow,
    bool directionalMultiLevel,
    Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
    SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler)
{
    if (!hasShadow)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    if (SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f)
    {
        float range = lightPositionTypeData.w < 0.5f ? SceneRayParameters.x :
            min(length(lightPositionTypeData.xyz - samplePos), SceneRayParameters.x);
        return TraceSceneShadow(samplePos, lightDir, lightDir, range);
    }
#endif

    bool directional = lightPositionTypeData.w < 0.5f;

    if (directional &&
        directionalMultiLevel &&
        VirtualShadowGlobal.x > 0.5f &&
        VirtualShadowGlobal.x < 1.5f)
    {
        return SampleVirtualAtmosphereShadowMapCommon(
            samplePos,
            shadowMap,
            shadowSampler);
    }

    if (directional &&
        directionalMultiLevel &&
        VirtualShadowGlobal.x > 1.5f)
    {
        return SampleCascadedAtmosphereShadowMapCommon(
            samplePos,
            shadowMap,
            shadowSampler);
    }

    return SampleAtmosphereShadowFast(
        samplePos,
        shadowMap,
        shadowSampler,
        lightViewProjection,
        shadowParams,
        shadowLayer);
}

float3 EvaluateAtmosphereLight(
    float3 viewToCamera,
    float sampleDensity,
    float3 singleDir,
    float singleAttenuation,
    float singleVolume,
    float4 lightColorData,
    float4 lightPositionTypeData,
    float shadowVisibility)
{
    float3 rawSingleColor =
        max(lightColorData.rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) *
        max(lightColorData.a, 0.0f);
    float3 singleColor = rawSingleColor * singleAttenuation;

    float3 shadowedColor = singleColor * shadowVisibility;
    float localLight = step(0.5f, lightPositionTypeData.w);
    float volumeVisibility = lerp(
        shadowVisibility,
        max(shadowVisibility, 0.45f),
        localLight);
    float3 volumeColor =
        rawSingleColor *
        sqrt(saturate(singleAttenuation)) *
        volumeVisibility;

    float volumeLight =
        step(2.5f, lightPositionTypeData.w) *
        step(lightPositionTypeData.w, 3.5f);

    float localVolumeStepBoost = lerp(
        1.0f,
        0.35f / max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f),
        localLight);





    float cosTheta = clamp(dot(singleDir, viewToCamera), -1.0f, 1.0f);
    float rayleighPhase = RayleighPhaseCommon(cosTheta);
    float miePhase = HenyeyGreensteinCommon(cosTheta, AtmosphereParams1.z);
    float phase = saturate(miePhase * 6.0f);

    float shaftBoost =
        lerp(0.55f, 1.75f, phase) *
        lerp(1.0f, 2.35f, volumeLight);

    float3 atmospherePhase =
        AtmosphereColor0.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.y, 0.0f) * rayleighPhase +
        AtmosphereColor1.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.z, 0.0f) * miePhase;
    float3 result =
        atmospherePhase * sampleDensity * shadowedColor *
        lerp(1.0f, 0.45f, volumeLight);




    float volumeMediumDensity = lerp(
        sampleDensity,
        max(AtmosphereParams0.w, 0.0001f),
        localLight);

    result +=
        volumeColor *
        singleVolume *
        volumeMediumDensity *
        shaftBoost *
        localVolumeStepBoost *
        lerp(
            0.22f,
            lerp(0.82f, 1.05f, volumeLight),
            localLight);

    return result;
}

bool IntersectRaySphereSegment(
    float3 rayOrigin,
    float3 rayDirection,
    float maxDistance,
    float3 sphereCenter,
    float sphereRadius,
    out float segmentStart,
    out float segmentEnd)
{
    float3 offset = rayOrigin - sphereCenter;
    float projected = dot(offset, rayDirection);
    float discriminant =
        projected * projected -
        (dot(offset, offset) - sphereRadius * sphereRadius);

    if (discriminant <= 0.0f)
    {
        segmentStart = 0.0f;
        segmentEnd = 0.0f;
        return false;
    }

    float root = sqrt(discriminant);
    segmentStart = max(-projected - root, 0.0f);
    segmentEnd = min(-projected + root, maxDistance);
    return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
}

bool IntersectRayHorizontalCylinderSegment(
    float3 rayOrigin,
    float3 rayDirection,
    float maxDistance,
    float3 cylinderCenter,
    float cylinderRadius,
    out float segmentStart,
    out float segmentEnd)
{
    float2 offset = rayOrigin.xz - cylinderCenter.xz;
    float2 direction = rayDirection.xz;
    float a = dot(direction, direction);
    float c = dot(offset, offset) - cylinderRadius * cylinderRadius;

    if (a <= 0.000001f)
    {
        segmentStart = 0.0f;
        segmentEnd = c <= 0.0f ? maxDistance : 0.0f;
        return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
    }

    float b = dot(offset, direction);
    float discriminant = b * b - a * c;
    if (discriminant <= 0.0f)
    {
        segmentStart = 0.0f;
        segmentEnd = 0.0f;
        return false;
    }

    float root = sqrt(discriminant);
    segmentStart = max((-b - root) / a, 0.0f);
    segmentEnd = min((-b + root) / a, maxDistance);
    return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
}

bool ClipRayToQuadraticInterior(
    float quadraticA,
    float quadraticB,
    float quadraticC,
    inout float segmentStart,
    inout float segmentEnd)
{
    const float epsilon = 0.000001f;

    if (abs(quadraticA) <= epsilon)
    {
        if (abs(quadraticB) <= epsilon)
        {
            return quadraticC <= 0.0f;
        }

        float root = -quadraticC / quadraticB;
        if (quadraticB > 0.0f)
        {
            segmentEnd = min(segmentEnd, root);
        }
        else
        {
            segmentStart = max(segmentStart, root);
        }
        return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
    }

    float discriminant =
        quadraticB * quadraticB -
        4.0f * quadraticA * quadraticC;
    if (discriminant < 0.0f)
    {
        float midpoint = (segmentStart + segmentEnd) * 0.5f;
        float midpointValue =
            (quadraticA * midpoint + quadraticB) * midpoint +
            quadraticC;
        return midpointValue <= 0.0f;
    }

    float rootTerm = sqrt(max(discriminant, 0.0f));
    float reciprocalDenominator = 0.5f / quadraticA;
    float root0 =
        (-quadraticB - rootTerm) * reciprocalDenominator;
    float root1 =
        (-quadraticB + rootTerm) * reciprocalDenominator;
    if (root0 > root1)
    {
        float swapRoot = root0;
        root0 = root1;
        root1 = swapRoot;
    }

    if (quadraticA > 0.0f)
    {
        segmentStart = max(segmentStart, root0);
        segmentEnd = min(segmentEnd, root1);
        return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
    }




    if (segmentEnd <= root0 || segmentStart >= root1)
    {
        return true;
    }
    if (segmentStart < root0)
    {
        segmentEnd = min(segmentEnd, root0);
    }
    else if (segmentEnd > root1)
    {
        segmentStart = max(segmentStart, root1);
    }
    else
    {
        return false;
    }
    return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
}

bool IntersectRayFiniteConeSegment(
    float3 rayOrigin,
    float3 rayDirection,
    float maxDistance,
    float3 coneOrigin,
    float3 coneAxis,
    float coneLength,
    float rootRadius,
    float endRadius,
    out float segmentStart,
    out float segmentEnd)
{
    float3 offset = rayOrigin - coneOrigin;
    float originAxial = dot(offset, coneAxis);
    float directionAxial = dot(rayDirection, coneAxis);

    segmentStart = 0.0f;
    segmentEnd = maxDistance;

    if (abs(directionAxial) <= 0.000001f)
    {
        if (originAxial < 0.0f || originAxial > coneLength)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        float cap0 = -originAxial / directionAxial;
        float cap1 = (coneLength - originAxial) / directionAxial;
        float axialStart = min(cap0, cap1);
        float axialEnd = max(cap0, cap1);
        segmentStart = max(segmentStart, axialStart);
        segmentEnd = min(segmentEnd, axialEnd);
        if (segmentEnd <= segmentStart + 0.0001f)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    float radiusSlope =
        (endRadius - rootRadius) /
        max(coneLength, 0.0001f);
    float radiusAtRayOrigin =
        rootRadius + radiusSlope * originAxial;
    float radiusAlongRay = radiusSlope * directionAxial;
    float3 offsetRadial = offset - coneAxis * originAxial;
    float3 directionRadial =
        rayDirection - coneAxis * directionAxial;

    float quadraticA =
        dot(directionRadial, directionRadial) -
        radiusAlongRay * radiusAlongRay;
    float quadraticB = 2.0f * (
        dot(offsetRadial, directionRadial) -
        radiusAtRayOrigin * radiusAlongRay);
    float quadraticC =
        dot(offsetRadial, offsetRadial) -
        radiusAtRayOrigin * radiusAtRayOrigin;

    return ClipRayToQuadraticInterior(
        quadraticA,
        quadraticB,
        quadraticC,
        segmentStart,
        segmentEnd);
}

float3 IntegrateVolumeLightRay(
    float3 rayOrigin,
    float3 rayDirection,
    float maxDistance,
    float4 lightDirectionData,
    float4 lightColorData,
    float4 lightPositionTypeData,
    float4 lightExtraData,
    float4x4 lightViewProjection,
    float4 shadowParams,
    float shadowLayer,
    bool hasShadow,
    Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
    SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler)
{
    if ((int)round(lightPositionTypeData.w) != 3 ||
        lightExtraData.z <= 0.0001f ||
        lightColorData.a <= 0.0001f)
    {
        return float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    float lightRange = max(lightDirectionData.w, 0.01f);
    float3 lightForward = SafeNormalizeCommon(
        lightDirectionData.xyz,
        float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f));
    float outerCos = clamp(lightExtraData.y, 0.001f, 0.999f);
    float outerTan =
        sqrt(saturate(1.0f - outerCos * outerCos)) /
        outerCos;
    float coneEndRadius = lightRange * outerTan;
    float coneRootRadius = max(coneEndRadius * 0.04f, 0.05f);
    float cylinderRadius = coneEndRadius * 0.45f;
    bool cylinderVolume = lightExtraData.w >= 0.5f;
    float volumeRootRadius = cylinderVolume
        ? cylinderRadius
        : coneRootRadius;
    float volumeEndRadius = cylinderVolume
        ? cylinderRadius
        : coneEndRadius;

    float segmentStart;
    float segmentEnd;
    if (!IntersectRayFiniteConeSegment(
            rayOrigin,
            rayDirection,
            maxDistance,
            lightPositionTypeData.xyz,
            lightForward,
            lightRange,
            volumeRootRadius,
            volumeEndRadius,
            segmentStart,
            segmentEnd))
    {
        return float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }
    const int stepCount = 64;
    float segmentLength = segmentEnd - segmentStart;
    float stepLength = segmentLength / (float)stepCount;
    float scaledStep =
        stepLength *
        max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f);
    float3 viewToCamera = -rayDirection;
    float3 integratedScatter = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    float3 sampleStep = rayDirection * stepLength;
    float3 samplePos =
        rayOrigin + rayDirection * (segmentStart + 0.5f * stepLength);

    [loop]
    for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < stepCount; ++stepIndex)
    {
        float sampleDistance =
            segmentStart +
            ((float)stepIndex + 0.5f) * stepLength;

        float3 singleDir;
        float singleAttenuation;
        float singleVolume;
        ResolveSingleLightCommon(
            samplePos,
            lightDirectionData,
            lightPositionTypeData,
            lightExtraData,
            singleDir,
            singleAttenuation,
            singleVolume);

        if (singleVolume <= 0.000001f &&
            singleAttenuation <= 0.000001f)
        {
            continue;
        }

        float shadowVisibility = ComputeAtmosphereShadow(
            samplePos,
            singleDir,
            lightPositionTypeData,
            lightViewProjection,
            shadowParams,
            shadowLayer,
            hasShadow,
            false,
            shadowMap,
            shadowSampler);
        float sampleDensity = AtmosphereDensityCommon(samplePos);
        float viewTransmittance = exp(
            -max(AtmosphereParams1.y, 0.0f) *
            sampleDensity *
            sampleDistance *
            max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f));

        integratedScatter +=
            EvaluateAtmosphereLight(
                viewToCamera,
                sampleDensity,
                singleDir,
                singleAttenuation,
                singleVolume,
                lightColorData,
                lightPositionTypeData,
                shadowVisibility) *
            viewTransmittance *
            scaledStep;

        samplePos += sampleStep;
    }

    return integratedScatter;
}

float3 RayMarchAtmosphereViewFixed(
    float3 worldPos,
    Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
    SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler,
    float4x4 lightViewProjection,
    float4 shadowMapParams)
{
    [branch]
    if (AtmosphereParams0.x < 0.5f ||
        AtmosphereColor0.a <= 0.0001f ||
        AtmosphereParams0.w <= 0.0001f)
    {
        return float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    float3 cameraPos = AtmosphereCamera.xyz;
    float3 viewDelta = worldPos - cameraPos;
    float rawViewDistance = length(viewDelta);

    if (rawViewDistance <= 0.0001f)
    {
        return float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    float viewDistance = min(rawViewDistance, 100.0f);
    int stepCount = GetAtmosphereStepCount(viewDistance);
    float3 viewDir = viewDelta / rawViewDistance;
    float3 viewToCamera = -viewDir;
    float stepLength = viewDistance / (float)stepCount;
    float scaledStep =
        stepLength *
        max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f);

    float transmittance = 1.0f;
    float3 result = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    int count = min((int)round(LocalFogGlobal.y), 5);
    float3 sampleStep = viewDir * stepLength;
    float3 samplePos = cameraPos + sampleStep * 0.5f;

    float cachedShadowVisibility[5];
    [unroll]
    for (int cacheIndex = 0; cacheIndex < 5; ++cacheIndex)
    {
        cachedShadowVisibility[cacheIndex] = 1.0f;
    }

    float legacyShadowVisibility = 1.0f;

    [loop]
    for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < stepCount; ++stepIndex)
    {
        float3 stepScatter = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        float sampleDensity =
            AtmosphereDensityCommon(samplePos);




        bool updateShadow = (stepIndex & 3) == 0;

        [loop]
        for (int instanceIndex = 0; instanceIndex < count; ++instanceIndex)
        {
            int lightIndex = (int)VolumetricLightIndices[instanceIndex];
            if (LightFlags[lightIndex].z < 0.5f ||
                LightFlags[lightIndex].w >= 0.5f)
            {
                continue;
            }




            if ((int)round(LightPositionTypes[lightIndex].w) == 3)
            {
                continue;
            }

            float3 singleDir;
            float singleAttenuation;
            float singleVolume;
            ResolveSingleLightCommon(
                samplePos,
                LightDirections[lightIndex],
                LightPositionTypes[lightIndex],
                LightExtras[lightIndex],
                singleDir,
                singleAttenuation,
                singleVolume);

            if (updateShadow)
            {
                bool hasShadow =
                    SceneLightCastsShadowCommon(lightIndex, LightShadowData[lightIndex].x >= -0.5f);
                bool directionalMultiLevel =
                    LightShadowData[lightIndex].w < 0.0f;

                float4 perLightShadowParams = float4(
                    LightShadowData[lightIndex].y,
                    LightShadowData[lightIndex].z,
                    LightShadowData[lightIndex].w,
                    1.0f);

                cachedShadowVisibility[lightIndex] =
                    ComputeAtmosphereShadow(
                        samplePos,
                        singleDir,
                        LightPositionTypes[lightIndex],
                        LightViewProjections[lightIndex],
                        perLightShadowParams,
                        LightShadowData[lightIndex].x,
                        hasShadow,
                        directionalMultiLevel,
                        shadowMap,
                        shadowSampler);
            }

            stepScatter += EvaluateAtmosphereLight(
                viewToCamera,
                sampleDensity,
                singleDir,
                singleAttenuation,
                singleVolume,
                LightColors[lightIndex],
                LightPositionTypes[lightIndex],
                cachedShadowVisibility[lightIndex]);
        }

        if (count <= 0 &&
            (int)round(LightPositionType.w) != 3)
        {
            float3 singleDir;
            float singleAttenuation;
            float singleVolume;
            ResolveSingleLightCommon(
                samplePos,
                LightDirection,
                LightPositionType,
                LightExtra,
                singleDir,
                singleAttenuation,
                singleVolume);

            if (updateShadow)
            {
                legacyShadowVisibility =
                    ComputeAtmosphereShadow(
                        samplePos,
                        singleDir,
                        LightPositionType,
                        lightViewProjection,
                        shadowMapParams,
                        0.0f,
                        true,
                        false,
                        shadowMap,
                        shadowSampler);
            }

            stepScatter += EvaluateAtmosphereLight(
                viewToCamera,
                sampleDensity,
                singleDir,
                singleAttenuation,
                singleVolume,
                LightColor,
                LightPositionType,
                legacyShadowVisibility);
        }

        result +=
            stepScatter *
            transmittance *
            scaledStep;

        transmittance *= exp(
            -max(AtmosphereParams1.y, 0.0f) *
            sampleDensity *
            scaledStep);

        if (transmittance <= 0.01f)
        {
            break;
        }

        samplePos += sampleStep;
    }

    [loop]
    for (int instanceIndex = 0; instanceIndex < count; ++instanceIndex)
    {
        int volumeIndex = (int)VolumetricLightIndices[instanceIndex];
        if (LightFlags[volumeIndex].z < 0.5f ||
            LightFlags[volumeIndex].w >= 0.5f ||
            (int)round(LightPositionTypes[volumeIndex].w) != 3)
        {
            continue;
        }

        float4 perLightShadowParams = float4(
            LightShadowData[volumeIndex].y,
            LightShadowData[volumeIndex].z,
            LightShadowData[volumeIndex].w,
            1.0f);
        result += IntegrateVolumeLightRay(
            cameraPos,
            viewDir,
            viewDistance,
            LightDirections[volumeIndex],
            LightColors[volumeIndex],
            LightPositionTypes[volumeIndex],
            LightExtras[volumeIndex],
            LightViewProjections[volumeIndex],
            perLightShadowParams,
            LightShadowData[volumeIndex].x,
            SceneLightCastsShadowCommon(volumeIndex, LightShadowData[volumeIndex].x >= -0.5f),
            shadowMap,
            shadowSampler);
    }

    if (count <= 0 &&
        (int)round(LightPositionType.w) == 3)
    {
        result += IntegrateVolumeLightRay(
            cameraPos,
            viewDir,
            viewDistance,
            LightDirection,
            LightColor,
            LightPositionType,
            LightExtra,
            lightViewProjection,
            shadowMapParams,
            0.0f,
            true,
            shadowMap,
            shadowSampler);
    }

    return result * max(AtmosphereColor0.a, 0.0f);
}

LocalFogRayResult IntegrateLocalFogRay(float3 rayEnd)
{
    LocalFogRayResult result;
    result.Scattering = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    result.Transmittance = 1.0f;

    int fogCount =
        min((int)round(LocalFogGlobal.x), 16);
    if (fogCount <= 0)
    {
        return result;
    }

    float3 cameraPos = PPCameraPos.xyz;
    float3 viewDelta = rayEnd - cameraPos;
    float rawDistance = length(viewDelta);

    if (rawDistance <= 0.0001f)
    {
        return result;
    }

    float viewDistance = min(rawDistance, 100.0f);
    float3 viewDir = viewDelta / rawDistance;

    float totalOpticalDepth = 0.0f;
    float3 opticalDepthColor = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);

    [loop]
    for (int fogIndex = 0; fogIndex < fogCount; ++fogIndex)
    {
        float4 data0 = LocalFogData0[fogIndex];
        float4 data1 = LocalFogData1[fogIndex];
        if (data1.w < 0.5f || data1.y <= 0.00001f)
        {
            continue;
        }

        float radius = max(data0.w, 0.01f);
        bool sphereFog = data1.z >= 0.5f;
        float segmentStart;
        float segmentEnd;
        bool intersects = sphereFog
            ? IntersectRaySphereSegment(
                cameraPos,
                viewDir,
                viewDistance,
                data0.xyz,
                radius,
                segmentStart,
                segmentEnd)
            : IntersectRayHorizontalCylinderSegment(
                cameraPos,
                viewDir,
                viewDistance,
                data0.xyz,
                radius,
                segmentStart,
                segmentEnd);

        if (!intersects)
        {
            continue;
        }




        const int stepCount = 24;
        float segmentLength = segmentEnd - segmentStart;
        float stepLength = segmentLength / (float)stepCount;
        float densityIntegral = 0.0f;
        float3 sampleStep = viewDir * stepLength;
        float3 samplePos =
            cameraPos + viewDir * (segmentStart + 0.5f * stepLength);

        [loop]
        for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < stepCount; ++stepIndex)
        {
            float3 delta = samplePos - data0.xyz;
            float horizontal = saturate(
                1.0f - length(delta.xz) / radius);
            float heightWeight = exp(
                -abs(delta.y) *
                max(data1.x, 0.0001f));
            float sphereWeight = saturate(
                1.0f - length(delta) / radius);
            float volumeWeight = sphereFog
                ? sphereWeight
                : horizontal * heightWeight;

            densityIntegral +=
                volumeWeight *
                max(data1.y, 0.0f) *
                stepLength;

            samplePos += sampleStep;
        }

        float opticalDepth = densityIntegral * 0.08f;
        totalOpticalDepth += opticalDepth;
        opticalDepthColor +=
            LocalFogColors[fogIndex].rgb *
            opticalDepth;
    }

    result.Transmittance = exp(-totalOpticalDepth);
    if (totalOpticalDepth > 0.00001f)
    {
        float3 fogColor =
            opticalDepthColor /
            totalOpticalDepth;
        result.Scattering =
            fogColor *
            (1.0f - result.Transmittance);
    }

    return result;
}

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_Target
{
    float depth =
        DepthTexture.SampleLevel(
            TextureSampler,
            input.TexCoord,
            0);
    float4 material =
        MaterialTexture.SampleLevel(
            TextureSampler,
            input.TexCoord,
            0);

    bool background =
        material.a < -0.5f ||
        depth >= 0.9999f;

    float3 viewRay =
        ReconstructPostProcessViewRayCommon(
            input.TexCoord);
    float3 rayEnd =
        background
        ? PPCameraPos.xyz +
          viewRay * 100.0f
        : ReconstructPostProcessWorldPositionCommon(input.TexCoord, depth);

    float3 scatter =
        RayMarchAtmosphereViewFixed(
            rayEnd,
            ShadowMapTexture,
            ShadowSampler,
            LightViewProjection,
            ShadowMapParams);

    LocalFogRayResult localFog =
        IntegrateLocalFogRay(rayEnd);




    float3 participatingMedia =
        scatter * localFog.Transmittance +
        localFog.Scattering;
    return float4(
        participatingMedia,
        localFog.Transmittance);
}


===== FILE: shader\hlsl\AtmosphereLutCommon.hlsli =====
#ifndef ATMOSPHERE_LUT_COMMON_HLSLI
#define ATMOSPHERE_LUT_COMMON_HLSLI
// Shared parameterisation of the atmosphere LUTs (Hillaire 2020, "A Scalable and Production
// Ready Sky and Atmosphere Rendering Technique"). Used by AtmosphereLutCS.hlsl (builder) and
// SkyAtmosphere.hlsli (consumers). Must stay identical on both sides.

static const float kLutGroundRadius = 6360000.0f;
static const float kLutAtmosphereRadius = 6460000.0f;
static const float kLutPi = 3.14159265f;
static const uint2 kTransmittanceLutSize = uint2(256, 64);
static const uint2 kMultiScatterLutSize = uint2(32, 32);
static const uint2 kSkyViewLutSize = uint2(192, 108);

// --- Transmittance (optical depth) LUT: Bruneton's (r, mu) mapping --------------------------
float2 TransmittanceLutUv(float radius, float mu)
{
    float H = sqrt(kLutAtmosphereRadius * kLutAtmosphereRadius - kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius);
    float rho = sqrt(max(radius * radius - kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius, 0.0f));
    float discriminant = radius * radius * (mu * mu - 1.0f) + kLutAtmosphereRadius * kLutAtmosphereRadius;
    float d = max(-radius * mu + sqrt(max(discriminant, 0.0f)), 0.0f);
    float dMin = kLutAtmosphereRadius - radius;
    float dMax = rho + H;
    float xMu = (d - dMin) / max(dMax - dMin, 1.0f);
    float xR = rho / H;
    return float2(xMu, xR);
}

void TransmittanceLutParameters(float2 uv, out float radius, out float mu)
{
    float H = sqrt(kLutAtmosphereRadius * kLutAtmosphereRadius - kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius);
    float rho = H * uv.y;
    radius = sqrt(rho * rho + kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius);
    float dMin = kLutAtmosphereRadius - radius;
    float dMax = rho + H;
    float d = dMin + uv.x * (dMax - dMin);
    mu = d == 0.0f ? 1.0f : (H * H - rho * rho - d * d) / (2.0f * radius * d);
    mu = clamp(mu, -1.0f, 1.0f);
}

// --- Sky view LUT: (sqrt relative sun azimuth, non-linear zenith around the horizon) ----------
void SkyViewHorizon(float viewHeight, out float beta, out float zenithHorizonAngle)
{
    float vHorizon = sqrt(max(viewHeight * viewHeight - kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius, 0.0f));
    beta = acos(clamp(vHorizon / viewHeight, -1.0f, 1.0f));
    zenithHorizonAngle = kLutPi - beta;
}

float2 SkyViewLutUv(float3 direction, float3 sun, float viewHeight)
{
    float beta, zenithHorizonAngle;
    SkyViewHorizon(viewHeight, beta, zenithHorizonAngle);
    float viewZenith = acos(clamp(direction.y, -1.0f, 1.0f));
    float v;
    if (viewZenith < zenithHorizonAngle)
    {
        float coord = 1.0f - sqrt(max(1.0f - viewZenith / zenithHorizonAngle, 0.0f));
        v = coord * 0.5f;
    }
    else
    {
        v = sqrt(saturate((viewZenith - zenithHorizonAngle) / max(beta, 0.00001f))) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
    }
    float2 view = direction.xz;
    float2 light = sun.xz;
    float viewLength = length(view);
    float lightLength = length(light);
    float cosAzimuth = viewLength > 0.00001f && lightLength > 0.00001f ?
        dot(view / viewLength, light / lightLength) : 1.0f;
    float u = sqrt(acos(clamp(cosAzimuth, -1.0f, 1.0f)) / kLutPi);
    // Texel centre remap so that [0,1] covers first..last texel centre.
    float2 size = float2(kSkyViewLutSize);
    return (float2(u, v) * (size - 1.0f) + 0.5f) / size;
}

float3 SkyViewLutDirection(float2 texel, float3 sun, float viewHeight)
{
    float2 size = float2(kSkyViewLutSize);
    float2 uv = texel / (size - 1.0f); // texel index -> [0,1] at texel centres
    float beta, zenithHorizonAngle;
    SkyViewHorizon(viewHeight, beta, zenithHorizonAngle);
    float viewZenith;
    if (uv.y < 0.5f)
    {
        float coord = 1.0f - 2.0f * uv.y;
        viewZenith = zenithHorizonAngle * (1.0f - coord * coord);
    }
    else
    {
        float coord = uv.y * 2.0f - 1.0f;
        viewZenith = zenithHorizonAngle + beta * coord * coord;
    }
    float relativeAzimuth = uv.x * uv.x * kLutPi;
    float sunAzimuth = length(sun.xz) > 0.00001f ? atan2(sun.z, sun.x) : 0.0f;
    float azimuth = sunAzimuth + relativeAzimuth;
    float sinZenith = sin(viewZenith);
    return float3(sinZenith * cos(azimuth), cos(viewZenith), sinZenith * sin(azimuth));
}

// --- Multiple scattering LUT: (sun cos zenith, altitude) --------------------------------------
float2 MultiScatterLutUv(float radius, float sunCosZenith)
{
    float2 uv = float2(sunCosZenith * 0.5f + 0.5f,
        saturate((radius - kLutGroundRadius) / (kLutAtmosphereRadius - kLutGroundRadius)));
    float2 size = float2(kMultiScatterLutSize);
    return (uv * (size - 1.0f) + 0.5f) / size;
}

#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\AtmosphereLutCS.hlsl =====
// =============================================================================================
// AtmosphereLutCS.hlsl  -  physical sky LUTs (runs on the async compute queue when available)
//   TransmittanceLut : optical depth (Rayleigh, Mie) from (r, mu) to the top of the atmosphere.
//                      Depends only on the planet geometry -> built once.
//   MultiScatterLut  : Hillaire 2020 isotropic multiple scattering transfer Psi_ms(h, mu_s).
//                      Rebuilt when the atmosphere coefficients change.
//   SkyViewLut       : in-scattered radiance (rgb) and view transmittance (rgb) for the camera
//                      altitude and sun direction of this frame. Built every frame.
//   Density model and coefficients are identical to EvaluatePhysicalSky (SkyAtmosphere.hlsli).
// =============================================================================================
#include "AtmosphereLutCommon.hlsli"

cbuffer AtmosphereLutConstants : register(b0)
{
    float4 SunDirection;      // xyz normalised
    float4 Coefficients;      // x rayleigh strength, y mie strength, z density, w mie g
    float4 Parameters;        // x camera altitude (m), y multiple scattering strength, z ground albedo
};

Texture2D<float2> TransmittanceLut : register(t0);
Texture2D<float4> MultiScatterLut : register(t1);
RWTexture2D<float4> Output0 : register(u0);
RWTexture2D<float4> Output1 : register(u1);
RWTexture2D<float2> OutputDepth : register(u2);
SamplerState LinearClamp : register(s0);

float2 RaySphere(float3 origin, float3 direction, float radius)
{
    float projected = dot(origin, direction);
    float discriminant = projected * projected - dot(origin, origin) + radius * radius;
    if (discriminant < 0.0f) return float2(-1, -1);
    float root = sqrt(discriminant);
    return float2(-projected - root, -projected + root);
}

float2 Density(float3 position)
{
    float altitude = max(length(position) - kLutGroundRadius, 0.0f);
    return exp(-altitude / float2(8000.0f, 1200.0f));
}

void Betas(out float3 betaRayleigh, out float3 betaMie)
{
    float densityScale = max(Coefficients.z, 0.0f) / 0.36f;
    betaRayleigh = float3(5.8e-6f, 13.5e-6f, 33.1e-6f) * max(Coefficients.x, 0.0f) / 0.42f * densityScale;
    betaMie = 21e-6f * max(Coefficients.y, 0.0f) / 0.075f * densityScale;
}

float2 SunOpticalDepth(float3 position, float3 sun)
{
    float radius = length(position);
    float mu = dot(position / radius, sun);
    return TransmittanceLut.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, TransmittanceLutUv(radius, mu), 0);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void BuildTransmittance(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= kTransmittanceLutSize)) return;
    float radius, mu;
    TransmittanceLutParameters((id.xy + 0.5f) / float2(kTransmittanceLutSize), radius, mu);
    float3 origin = float3(0, radius, 0);
    float3 direction = float3(sqrt(saturate(1 - mu * mu)), mu, 0);
    float distance = max(RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutAtmosphereRadius).y, 0.0f);
    const int steps = 64;
    float stepLength = distance / steps;
    float2 depth = 0;
    [loop] for (int index = 0; index < steps; ++index)
    {
        depth += Density(origin + direction * ((index + 0.5f) * stepLength)) * stepLength;
    }
    OutputDepth[id.xy] = depth;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void BuildMultiScatter(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= kMultiScatterLutSize)) return;
    float2 uv = id.xy / (float2(kMultiScatterLutSize) - 1.0f);
    float sunCos = uv.x * 2 - 1;
    float radius = kLutGroundRadius + max(uv.y * (kLutAtmosphereRadius - kLutGroundRadius), 10.0f);
    float3 origin = float3(0, radius, 0);
    float3 sun = float3(sqrt(saturate(1 - sunCos * sunCos)), sunCos, 0);
    float3 betaRayleigh, betaMie;
    Betas(betaRayleigh, betaMie);
    const float isotropicPhase = 1.0f / (4.0f * kLutPi);
    const uint directionsPerAxis = 8;
    const int steps = 20;
    float3 secondOrder = 0;
    float3 transfer = 0;
    [loop] for (uint sample = 0; sample < directionsPerAxis * directionsPerAxis; ++sample)
    {
        // Stratified uniform sphere directions.
        float2 cell = (float2(sample % directionsPerAxis, sample / directionsPerAxis) + 0.5f) / directionsPerAxis;
        float cosTheta = 1 - 2 * cell.y;
        float sinTheta = sqrt(saturate(1 - cosTheta * cosTheta));
        float phi = 2 * kLutPi * cell.x;
        float3 direction = float3(sinTheta * cos(phi), cosTheta, sinTheta * sin(phi));
        float groundDistance = RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutGroundRadius).x;
        bool hitsGround = groundDistance > 0;
        float distance = hitsGround ? groundDistance : max(RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutAtmosphereRadius).y, 0.0f);
        float stepLength = distance / steps;
        float3 throughput = 1;
        float3 luminance = 0;
        float3 multiScatterAsOne = 0;
        [loop] for (int index = 0; index < steps; ++index)
        {
            float3 position = origin + direction * ((index + 0.5f) * stepLength);
            float2 density = Density(position);
            float3 scattering = betaRayleigh * density.x + betaMie * density.y;
            float3 extinction = max(scattering, 1e-9f);
            float3 stepTransmittance = exp(-extinction * stepLength);
            float3 sunTransmittance = 0;
            if (RaySphere(position, sun, kLutGroundRadius).x <= 0)
            {
                float2 sunDepth = SunOpticalDepth(position, sun);
                sunTransmittance = exp(-betaRayleigh * sunDepth.x - betaMie * sunDepth.y);
            }
            float3 source = sunTransmittance * scattering * isotropicPhase;
            float3 integrated = (source - source * stepTransmittance) / extinction;
            luminance += throughput * integrated;
            multiScatterAsOne += throughput * (scattering - scattering * stepTransmittance) / extinction;
            throughput *= stepTransmittance;
        }
        if (hitsGround)
        {
            float3 groundPoint = origin + direction * groundDistance;
            float3 groundNormal = normalize(groundPoint);
            float2 sunDepth = SunOpticalDepth(groundPoint, sun);
            float3 sunTransmittance = exp(-betaRayleigh * sunDepth.x - betaMie * sunDepth.y);
            luminance += throughput * sunTransmittance * saturate(dot(groundNormal, sun)) * Parameters.z / kLutPi;
        }
        secondOrder += luminance;
        transfer += multiScatterAsOne;
    }
    const float sampleWeight = 4.0f * kLutPi / (directionsPerAxis * directionsPerAxis);
    float3 inScattered = secondOrder * sampleWeight * isotropicPhase;
    float3 multiScatterAs1 = transfer * sampleWeight * isotropicPhase;
    float3 psi = inScattered / max(1.0f - multiScatterAs1, 0.001f);
    Output0[id.xy] = float4(psi, 1);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void BuildSkyView(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= kSkyViewLutSize)) return;
    float altitude = max(Parameters.x, 2.0f);
    float3 origin = float3(0, kLutGroundRadius + altitude, 0);
    float3 sun = normalize(SunDirection.xyz);
    float3 direction = SkyViewLutDirection(float2(id.xy), sun, origin.y);
    float endDistance = max(RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutAtmosphereRadius).y, 0.0f);
    float groundDistance = RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutGroundRadius).x;
    if (groundDistance > 0) endDistance = min(endDistance, groundDistance);
    float3 betaRayleigh, betaMie;
    Betas(betaRayleigh, betaMie);

    const int steps = 32;
    float stepDistance = endDistance / steps;
    float2 viewDepth = 0;
    float3 rayleigh = 0, mie = 0, multiple = 0;
    [loop] for (int index = 0; index < steps; ++index)
    {
        float3 position = origin + direction * ((index + 0.5f) * stepDistance);
        float2 localDepth = Density(position) * stepDistance;
        viewDepth += localDepth * 0.5f;
        float3 viewTransmission = exp(-betaRayleigh * viewDepth.x - betaMie * viewDepth.y);
        float radius = length(position);
        if (RaySphere(position, sun, kLutGroundRadius).x <= 0)
        {
            float2 sunDepth = SunOpticalDepth(position, sun);
            float2 totalDepth = viewDepth + sunDepth;
            float3 transmission = exp(-betaRayleigh * totalDepth.x - betaMie * totalDepth.y);
            rayleigh += localDepth.x * transmission;
            mie += localDepth.y * transmission;
        }
        // Multiple scattering is not shadowed by the planet (it arrives from all directions).
        float3 psi = MultiScatterLut.SampleLevel(LinearClamp,
            MultiScatterLutUv(radius, dot(position / radius, sun)), 0).rgb;
        multiple += (betaRayleigh * localDepth.x + betaMie * localDepth.y) * psi * viewTransmission;
        viewDepth += localDepth * 0.5f;
    }
    float cosine = dot(direction, sun);
    float rayleighPhase = 3.0f / (16.0f * kLutPi) * (1.0f + cosine * cosine);
    float g = clamp(Coefficients.w, -0.95f, 0.95f);
    float g2 = g * g;
    float denominator = max(1.0f + g2 - 2.0f * g * cosine, 0.0001f);
    float miePhase = (1.0f - g2) / (4.0f * kLutPi * denominator * sqrt(denominator));
    float3 scatter = rayleigh * betaRayleigh * rayleighPhase + mie * betaMie * miePhase +
        multiple * max(Parameters.y, 0.0f);
    Output0[id.xy] = float4(scatter, 1);
    Output1[id.xy] = float4(exp(-betaRayleigh * viewDepth.x - betaMie * viewDepth.y), 1);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\BloomCS.hlsl =====
// =============================================================================================
// BloomCS.hlsl  -  physically based bloom (dual filter mip chain), lens flare and screen space
// rain / snow. Runs on the linear HDR scene inside AdvancedEffects (before tone mapping).
//   BloomDownsample : 13 tap filter (Jimenez 2014, CoD:AW); level 0 adds a soft threshold and
//                     the Karis average to suppress fireflies.
//   BloomUpsample   : 3x3 tent, up[i] = down[i] + tent(up[i+1]) * radius
//   BloomCombine    : energy conserving blend + lens flare (Chapman ghosts / halo) + weather.
// =============================================================================================
cbuffer BloomConstants : register(b0)
{
    uint2 DestinationSize;
    uint2 SourceSize;
    float Threshold;      // 0 = no threshold
    float Radius;         // upsample scatter
    float Intensity;      // final blend
    float Normalization;  // 1 / (1 + r + r^2 + ...)
    float FlareIntensity;
    float FlareHalo;
    float RainIntensity;
    float SnowIntensity;
    float Time;
    float WindX;
    uint FirstLevel;
    uint Flags;           // bit0 bloom, bit1 flare, bit2 rain, bit3 snow
};

Texture2D<float4> Source0 : register(t0);
Texture2D<float4> Source1 : register(t1);
Texture2D<float4> Source2 : register(t2);
Texture2D<float> SceneDepth : register(t3);
RWTexture2D<float4> Destination : register(u0);
SamplerState LinearClamp : register(s0);

static const float3 kLuma = float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f);

float KarisWeight(float3 color)
{
    return 1.0f / (1.0f + dot(color, kLuma));
}

float3 SoftThreshold(float3 color)
{
    if (Threshold <= 0.0f) return color;
    float brightness = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
    float knee = Threshold * 0.5f;
    float soft = clamp(brightness - Threshold + knee, 0.0f, 2.0f * knee);
    soft = soft * soft / (4.0f * knee + 0.00001f);
    float contribution = max(soft, brightness - Threshold) / max(brightness, 0.00001f);
    return color * contribution;
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void BloomDownsample(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= DestinationSize)) return;
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / DestinationSize;
    float2 t = 1.0f / SourceSize;
    float3 a = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(-2, -2), 0).rgb;
    float3 b = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(0, -2), 0).rgb;
    float3 c = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(2, -2), 0).rgb;
    float3 d = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(-2, 0), 0).rgb;
    float3 e = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv, 0).rgb;
    float3 f = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(2, 0), 0).rgb;
    float3 g = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(-2, 2), 0).rgb;
    float3 h = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(0, 2), 0).rgb;
    float3 i = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(2, 2), 0).rgb;
    float3 j = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(-1, -1), 0).rgb;
    float3 k = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(1, -1), 0).rgb;
    float3 l = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(-1, 1), 0).rgb;
    float3 m = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(1, 1), 0).rgb;
    float3 result;
    if (FirstLevel != 0)
    {
        // Karis average per 2x2 group removes single pixel fireflies from the whole chain.
        float3 g0 = (j + k + l + m) * 0.25f;
        float3 g1 = (a + b + d + e) * 0.25f;
        float3 g2 = (b + c + e + f) * 0.25f;
        float3 g3 = (d + e + g + h) * 0.25f;
        float3 g4 = (e + f + h + i) * 0.25f;
        float w0 = KarisWeight(g0) * 0.5f, w1 = KarisWeight(g1) * 0.125f, w2 = KarisWeight(g2) * 0.125f;
        float w3 = KarisWeight(g3) * 0.125f, w4 = KarisWeight(g4) * 0.125f;
        result = (g0 * w0 + g1 * w1 + g2 * w2 + g3 * w3 + g4 * w4) / max(w0 + w1 + w2 + w3 + w4, 0.0001f);
        result = SoftThreshold(result);
    }
    else
    {
        result = e * 0.125f + (a + c + g + i) * 0.03125f + (b + d + f + h) * 0.0625f + (j + k + l + m) * 0.125f;
    }
    Destination[id.xy] = float4(max(result, 0.0f), 1.0f);
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void BloomUpsample(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= DestinationSize)) return;
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / DestinationSize;
    float2 t = 1.0f / SourceSize; // size of the lower (coarser) level
    float3 tent = Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv, 0).rgb * 4.0f;
    tent += (Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(-1, 0), 0).rgb + Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(1, 0), 0).rgb +
        Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(0, -1), 0).rgb + Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(0, 1), 0).rgb) * 2.0f;
    tent += Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(-1, -1), 0).rgb + Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(1, -1), 0).rgb +
        Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(-1, 1), 0).rgb + Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv + t * float2(1, 1), 0).rgb;
    tent /= 16.0f;
    float3 current = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv, 0).rgb;
    Destination[id.xy] = float4(current + tent * Radius, 1.0f);
}

float Hash21(float2 p)
{
    float3 p3 = frac(float3(p.xyx) * 0.1031f);
    p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33f);
    return frac((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
}

float3 LensFlare(float2 uv)
{
    float2 flipped = 1.0f - uv;
    float2 ghostVector = (0.5f - flipped) * 0.37f;
    float3 result = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (int ghost = 0; ghost < 5; ++ghost)
    {
        float2 offset = frac(flipped + ghostVector * ghost);
        float weight = pow(saturate(1.0f - length(0.5f - offset) / 0.7071f), 8.0f);
        // Chromatic distortion: each channel slightly displaced along the ghost axis.
        float2 shift = normalize(ghostVector + 0.00001f) * 0.006f;
        float3 sample = float3(
            Source2.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, offset + shift, 0).r,
            Source2.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, offset, 0).g,
            Source2.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, offset - shift, 0).b);
        result += max(sample - 1.0f, 0.0f) * weight * (ghost == 0 ? 0.5f : 1.0f);
    }
    float2 haloVector = normalize(ghostVector + 0.00001f) * 0.42f;
    float2 haloUv = frac(flipped + haloVector);
    float haloWeight = pow(saturate(1.0f - length(0.5f - haloUv) / 0.7071f), 5.0f);
    result += max(Source2.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, haloUv, 0).rgb - 1.0f, 0.0f) * haloWeight * FlareHalo * 4.0f;
    // Spectral tint (warm centre, cool edges) like coated optics.
    float radial = length(uv - 0.5f) * 1.4f;
    return result * lerp(float3(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.7f), float3(0.6f, 0.75f, 1.0f), saturate(radial));
}

// Falling streaks in three parallax layers; brighter where the scene is lit.
float RainLayer(float2 uv, float scale, float speed, float slant, float seed)
{
    float2 p = float2(uv.x * scale + uv.y * slant * scale, uv.y * scale * 0.12f - Time * speed);
    float2 cell = floor(p);
    float2 local = frac(p);
    float random = Hash21(cell + seed);
    if (random > 0.35f) return 0.0f;
    float x = abs(local.x - frac(0.2f + random * 1.6f));
    float streak = saturate(1.0f - x * scale * 0.9f);
    float y = frac(local.y + random * 7.0f);
    float lengthMask = smoothstep(0.0f, 0.15f, y) * smoothstep(0.75f, 0.35f, y);
    return streak * streak * lengthMask;
}

float SnowLayer(float2 uv, float scale, float speed, float seed, float aspect)
{
    float2 p = float2(uv.x * aspect, uv.y) * scale;
    p.y -= Time * speed;
    p.x += sin(Time * 0.7f + p.y * 0.8f + seed) * 0.35f + Time * WindX * 0.5f;
    float2 cell = floor(p);
    float2 local = frac(p) - 0.5f;
    float random = Hash21(cell + seed);
    if (random > 0.45f) return 0.0f;
    float2 center = (float2(Hash21(cell + 3.1f + seed), Hash21(cell + 7.7f + seed)) - 0.5f) * 0.6f;
    float radius = 0.06f + random * 0.08f;
    return smoothstep(radius, radius * 0.4f, length(local - center));
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void BloomCombine(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= DestinationSize)) return;
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / DestinationSize;
    float3 color = Source0[id.xy].rgb;
    float3 bloom = 0.0f;
    if ((Flags & 1u) != 0)
    {
        bloom = Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv, 0).rgb * Normalization;
        // Energy conserving: the bloom redistributes light instead of adding it.
        color = lerp(color, bloom, Intensity);
    }
    if ((Flags & 2u) != 0)
    {
        color += LensFlare(uv) * FlareIntensity * 0.05f;
    }
    float ambient = dot(bloom, kLuma) + 0.02f;
    if ((Flags & 4u) != 0)
    {
        float aspect = DestinationSize.x / (float)DestinationSize.y;
        float2 rainUv = float2(uv.x * aspect, uv.y);
        float rain = RainLayer(rainUv, 70.0f, 2.6f, WindX * 0.25f, 1.0f) * 0.5f +
            RainLayer(rainUv, 45.0f, 2.0f, WindX * 0.22f, 2.0f) * 0.35f +
            RainLayer(rainUv, 28.0f, 1.5f, WindX * 0.2f, 3.0f) * 0.25f;
        color += rain * RainIntensity * (0.03f + ambient * 0.6f);
    }
    if ((Flags & 8u) != 0)
    {
        float aspect = DestinationSize.x / (float)DestinationSize.y;
        float snow = SnowLayer(uv, 26.0f, 0.10f, 1.0f, aspect) * 0.6f + SnowLayer(uv, 14.0f, 0.06f, 5.0f, aspect) +
            SnowLayer(uv, 8.0f, 0.04f, 9.0f, aspect) * 1.2f;
        color = lerp(color, max(color, (0.35f + ambient * 2.0f).xxx), saturate(snow * SnowIntensity));
    }
    Destination[id.xy] = float4(color, 1.0f);
}
