{
    return 1.0f / (1.0f + max(ycocg.x, 0.0f));
}

// Catmull-Rom を双線形 5 回で（Jimenez 2016）
float3 SampleHistoryCatmullRom(float2 uv, float2 textureSize)
{
    const float2 position = uv * textureSize;
    const float2 center = floor(position - 0.5f) + 0.5f;
    const float2 f = position - center;
    const float2 f2 = f * f;
    const float2 f3 = f2 * f;
    const float2 w0 = -0.5f * f3 + f2 - 0.5f * f;
    const float2 w1 = 1.5f * f3 - 2.5f * f2 + 1.0f;
    const float2 w2 = -1.5f * f3 + 2.0f * f2 + 0.5f * f;
    const float2 w3 = 0.5f * f3 - 0.5f * f2;
    const float2 w12 = w1 + w2;
    const float2 texel = 1.0f / textureSize;
    const float2 uv0 = (center - 1.0f) * texel;
    const float2 uv3 = (center + 2.0f) * texel;
    const float2 uv12 = (center + w2 / w12) * texel;
    float3 result = 0.0f;
    float weight = 0.0f;
    float w;
    w = w12.x * w0.y;  result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv12.x, uv0.y), 0).rgb * w;  weight += w;
    w = w0.x * w12.y;  result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv0.x, uv12.y), 0).rgb * w;  weight += w;
    w = w12.x * w12.y; result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv12.x, uv12.y), 0).rgb * w; weight += w;
    w = w3.x * w12.y;  result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv3.x, uv12.y), 0).rgb * w;  weight += w;
    w = w12.x * w3.y;  result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv12.x, uv3.y), 0).rgb * w;  weight += w;
    return max(result / max(weight, 1.0e-4f), 0.0f);
}

// 平均へ向かう線分で AABB にクリップ（クランプより色ずれが少ない）
float3 ClipToAabb(float3 history, float3 center, float3 extents)
{
    const float3 offset = history - center;
    const float3 unit = abs(offset / max(extents, 1.0e-4f));
    const float maxUnit = max(unit.x, max(unit.y, unit.z));
    return maxUnit > 1.0f ? center + offset / maxUnit : history;
}

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_TARGET
{
    const int2 pixel = int2(input.Position.xy);
    const float2 uv = input.TexCoord;
    const float2 textureSize = 1.0f / max(RcpFrame, 1.0e-6f);
    const int2 maxPixel = int2(textureSize) - 1;

    // ---- 近傍の統計（YCoCg・輝度重み付き）と、最も手前のピクセル
    const float3 currentRgb = CurrentColor.Load(int3(pixel, 0)).rgb;
    const float3 current = RgbToYCoCg(currentRgb);
    float3 moment1 = 0.0f, moment2 = 0.0f;
    float closestDepth = 2.0f;
    int2 closestPixel = pixel;
    [unroll]
    for (int y = -1; y <= 1; ++y)
    {
        [unroll]
        for (int x = -1; x <= 1; ++x)
        {
            const int2 neighbor = clamp(pixel + int2(x, y), int2(0, 0), maxPixel);
            const float3 sampleColor = RgbToYCoCg(CurrentColor.Load(int3(neighbor, 0)).rgb);
            moment1 += sampleColor;
            moment2 += sampleColor * sampleColor;
            const float depth = DepthBuffer.Load(int3(neighbor, 0));
            if (depth < closestDepth)
            {
                closestDepth = depth;
                closestPixel = neighbor;
            }
        }
    }
    const float3 mean = moment1 / 9.0f;
    const float3 sigma = sqrt(max(moment2 / 9.0f - mean * mean, 0.0f));

    // ---- 履歴
    const float2 velocity = VelocityBuffer.Load(int3(closestPixel, 0)).ba;
    const float2 historyUv = uv - velocity;
    const bool historyInBounds = all(historyUv >= 0.0f) && all(historyUv <= 1.0f);
    float3 history = RgbToYCoCg(SampleHistoryCatmullRom(historyUv, textureSize));

    // 動きが小さい（静止に近い）ほど、クリップの幅 γ を広げて履歴を長く保つ
    const float motionPixels = length(velocity * textureSize);
    const float stillness = saturate(1.0f - motionPixels / 2.0f);
    const float gamma = lerp(1.0f, 1.75f, stillness);
    const float3 boxMin = min(mean - gamma * sigma, current);
    const float3 boxMax = max(mean + gamma * sigma, current);
    const float3 clipped = ClipToAabb(history, (boxMin + boxMax) * 0.5f, (boxMax - boxMin) * 0.5f);
    // クリップで大きく動いた（= 履歴が合っていない）ほど、今のフレームを強く使う
    const float rejection = saturate(length(clipped - history) / max(clipped.x + 0.05f, 0.05f));
    history = clipped;

    // ---- 混合率：基本は BlendFactor。静止なら長い履歴（最大 0.96）、速い動きや不一致では短く
    const float motionConfidence = saturate(1.0f - motionPixels / 32.0f);
    float historyWeight = lerp(BlendFactor, 0.96f, stillness) * motionConfidence * (1.0f - 0.5f * rejection);
    historyWeight *= HistoryValid * (historyInBounds ? 1.0f : 0.0f);

    // 輝度重み付きで混ぜる（明るい点の明滅を抑える）
    const float currentWeight = (1.0f - historyWeight) * LumaWeight(current);
    const float historyWeightL = historyWeight * LumaWeight(history);
    const float3 resolved = (current * currentWeight + history * historyWeightL) / max(currentWeight + historyWeightL, 1.0e-5f);

    float3 rgb = YCoCgToRgb(resolved);
    rgb = all(isfinite(rgb)) ? max(rgb, 0.0f) : currentRgb;
    return float4(rgb, 1.0f);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\TemporalUpscaleCS.hlsl =====
Texture2D<float4> Color : register(t0);
Texture2D<float> Depth : register(t1);
Texture2D<float4> Velocity : register(t2);
Texture2D<float4> History : register(t3);
Texture2D<float> HistoryDepth : register(t4);
Texture2D<float> Revealage : register(t5);
Texture2D<float2> DetailHistory : register(t6);
RWTexture2D<float4> Output : register(u0);
RWTexture2D<float> OutputDepth : register(u1);
RWTexture2D<float2> OutputDetail : register(u2);
SamplerState LinearClamp : register(s0);
cbuffer Constants : register(b0)
{
    float4 Extent; // Input xy, output zw.
    float4 Jitter; // Current xy, previous zw, normalized UV with +Y down.
    float4 Parameters; // History valid, revealage valid, subpixel AA, detail stability.
    float4x4 InvCurrent, Previous;
    float4 Reconstruction; // Planar depth, thin geometry, reserved zw.
};
float3 ToY(float3 c) { return float3(dot(c,float3(.25,.5,.25)),c.r-c.b,c.g-(c.r+c.b)*.5); }
float3 FromY(float3 c) { return float3(c.x+c.y*.5-c.z*.5,c.x+c.z*.5,c.x-c.y*.5-c.z*.5); }
float Cubic(float x) { x=abs(x); return x<1?(1.5*x-2.5)*x*x+1:x<2?((-.5*x+2.5)*x-4)*x+2:0; }
float4 Reconstruct(float2 uv)
{
    float2 position = uv * Extent.xy - .5;
    int2 base = int2(floor(position));
    float2 fraction = frac(position);
    float4 sum = 0;
    float weights = 0;
    [unroll] for (int y = -1; y <= 2; ++y)
    [unroll] for (int x = -1; x <= 2; ++x)
    {
        float weight = Cubic(x - fraction.x) * Cubic(y - fraction.y);
        int2 pixel = clamp(base + int2(x, y), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
        sum += Color.Load(int3(pixel, 0)) * weight;
        weights += weight;
    }
    return max(sum / max(weights, 1e-5), 0);
}
bool HistoryDepthMatches(float2 uv, float expectedDepth, float footprintTolerance)
{
    // History depth is point sampled: filtering foreground and sky creates a
    // fictitious surface and rejects the subpixel coverage needed for edge AA.
    // Cover one input sample's footprint because its coverage moves with jitter.
    const float tolerance = max(max(.0002, abs(1 - expectedDepth) * .01), footprintTolerance);
    const int2 maximumPixel = int2(Extent.zw) - 1;
    const int2 center = clamp(int2(uv * Extent.zw), 0, maximumPixel);
    float difference = abs(HistoryDepth.Load(int3(center, 0)) - expectedDepth);
    [unroll] for (int y = -1; y <= 1; y += 2)
    [unroll] for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x += 2)
    {
        const float2 sampleUv = uv + float2(x, y) / Extent.xy;
        const int2 samplePixel = clamp(int2(sampleUv * Extent.zw), 0, maximumPixel);
        difference = min(difference, abs(HistoryDepth.Load(int3(samplePixel, 0)) - expectedDepth));
    }
    return difference <= tolerance;
}
[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= uint2(Extent.zw))) return;
    float2 uv = (id.xy + .5) / Extent.zw;
    float2 source = uv + Jitter.xy;
    int2 pixel = clamp(int2(source * Extent.xy), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
    float4 current = Reconstruct(source);
    float currentLuma = dot(current.rgb, float3(.2126, .7152, .0722));
    float depth = Depth.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
    OutputDepth[id.xy] = depth;
    OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, 0);
    // Every rejection path below keeps spatial reconstruction as its fallback.
    Output[id.xy] = current;
    if (Parameters.x < .5) return;

    int2 velocityPixel = pixel;
    float nearest = depth;
    float3 minimumColor = 1e20, maximumColor = -1e20, mean = 0, square = 0;
    float4 cardinalLuma = 0; // Left, right, up, down, reused from the 3x3 taps.
    float4 cardinalDepth = depth;
    [unroll] for (int y = -1; y <= 1; ++y)
    [unroll] for (int x = -1; x <= 1; ++x)
    {
        int2 neighbor = clamp(pixel + int2(x, y), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
        float neighborDepth = Depth.Load(int3(neighbor, 0));
        if (x == -1 && y == 0) cardinalDepth.x = neighborDepth;
        if (x == 1 && y == 0) cardinalDepth.y = neighborDepth;
        if (x == 0 && y == -1) cardinalDepth.z = neighborDepth;
        if (x == 0 && y == 1) cardinalDepth.w = neighborDepth;
        if (neighborDepth < nearest)
        {
            nearest = neighborDepth;
            velocityPixel = neighbor;
        }
        float3 color = ToY(Color.Load(int3(neighbor, 0)).rgb);
        if (x == -1 && y == 0) cardinalLuma.x = color.x;
        if (x == 1 && y == 0) cardinalLuma.y = color.x;
        if (x == 0 && y == -1) cardinalLuma.z = color.x;
        if (x == 0 && y == 1) cardinalLuma.w = color.x;
        minimumColor = min(minimumColor, color);
        maximumColor = max(maximumColor, color);
        mean += color;
        square += color * color;
    }
    mean /= 9;
    float3 sigma = sqrt(max(square / 9 - mean * mean, 0));
    minimumColor = max(minimumColor, mean - 1.5 * sigma);
    maximumColor = min(maximumColor, mean + 1.5 * sigma);

    // Velocity includes projection jitter; history is stored without jitter.
    float2 motion = Velocity.Load(int3(velocityPixel, 0)).zw;
    float2 oldUv = uv - motion + Jitter.xy - Jitter.zw;
    if (!all(isfinite(motion)) || any(oldUv <= 0) || any(oldUv >= 1)) return;
    float reactive = Parameters.y > .5 ? 1 - saturate(Revealage.Load(int3(pixel, 0))) : 0;
    float motionPixels = length((motion - Jitter.xy + Jitter.zw) * Extent.zw);
    float separation = max(1e-6, abs(1 - depth) * .02);
    bool thinDepthRidge = depth < .99999 &&
        ((cardinalDepth.x > depth + separation && cardinalDepth.y > depth + separation) ||
         (cardinalDepth.z > depth + separation && cardinalDepth.w > depth + separation));
    bool observedThinGeometry = Reconstruction.y > .5 && Parameters.w > .5 &&
        thinDepthRidge && motionPixels < .25 && reactive == 0;
    // Seed even on a newly revealed sample whose color history cannot be reused.
    if (observedThinGeometry) OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, 1.8);
    float4 world = mul(float4(source * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1), depth, 1), InvCurrent);
    if (abs(world.w) < 1e-8) return;
    world /= world.w;
    float4 previous = mul(world, Previous);
    float expected = previous.z / max(previous.w, 1e-8);
    bool subpixelAA = Parameters.z > .5;
    float footprintTolerance = 0;
    if (Reconstruction.x > .5 && depth < .99999)
    {
        // Perspective NDC depth is affine over a planar surface. Only symmetric,
        // continuous depth gradients may expand the input sample's footprint;
        // silhouettes and narrow foreground objects retain strict rejection.
        float2 curvature = abs(cardinalDepth.xz + cardinalDepth.yw - 2 * depth);
        float2 slope = .5 * abs(cardinalDepth.yw - cardinalDepth.xz);
        float planarityTolerance = max(2e-6, abs(1 - depth) * .0005);
        bool planar = all(curvature < planarityTolerance) && all(cardinalDepth < .99999);
        if (planar && all(slope < abs(1 - depth) * .1))
            footprintTolerance = slope.x + slope.y + planarityTolerance;
    }
    bool depthMatches;
    if (subpixelAA)
        depthMatches = HistoryDepthMatches(oldUv, expected, footprintTolerance);
    else
    {
        float oldDepth = HistoryDepth.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, oldUv, 0);
        depthMatches = abs(oldDepth - expected) <= max(.0002, abs(1 - expected) * .01);
    }
    if (previous.w <= 0) return;
    if (Reconstruction.y > .5 && Parameters.w > .5 && motionPixels < .25 && reactive == 0)
    {
        int2 historyPixel = clamp(int2(oldUv * Extent.zw), 0, int2(Extent.zw) - 1);
        float2 previousDetail = DetailHistory.Load(int3(historyPixel, 0));
        // Values beyond [-1,1] tag a previously observed depth ridge. The
        // fractional confidence decays on every missing observation, bounding
        // retention when a real thin object disappears at unchanged velocity.
        float confidence = max(abs(previousDetail.y) - 1, 0);
        float oldDepth = HistoryDepth.Load(int3(historyPixel, 0));
        if (confidence > .1 && oldDepth < depth - separation && nearest >= oldDepth - separation)
        {
            float4 retained = History.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, oldUv, 0);
            if (all(isfinite(retained)))
            {
                Output[id.xy] = float4(lerp(current.rgb, retained.rgb, .8), current.a);
                OutputDepth[id.xy] = oldDepth;
                OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, sign(previousDetail.y) * (1 + confidence * .6));
                return;
            }
        }
        // A newly observed subpixel ridge needs to accumulate coverage over
        // the previous background instead of restarting at full brightness.
        if (observedThinGeometry && oldDepth > depth + separation) depthMatches = true;
    }
    if (!depthMatches) return;
    float4 history = History.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, oldUv, 0);
    if (!all(isfinite(history))) return;
    float detailProtection = 0;
    float detailLock = 0;
    if (subpixelAA && Parameters.w > .5)
    {
        // Signed instability retains the last change direction. Repeated sign
        // reversals identify undersampled detail; persistent changes decay the lock.
        float2 previousDetail = DetailHistory.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, oldUv, 0);
        if (abs(previousDetail.y) > 1)
            previousDetail.y = sign(previousDetail.y) * (abs(previousDetail.y) - 1);
        float change = currentLuma - previousDetail.x;
        float relativeChange = abs(change) / max(max(currentLuma, previousDetail.x), .05);
        float instability = abs(previousDetail.y) * .93;
        float direction = sign(previousDetail.y);
        if (relativeChange > .05)
        {
            float centerLuma = ToY(Color.Load(int3(pixel, 0)).rgb).x;
            float horizontalRidge = (centerLuma - cardinalLuma.x) * (centerLuma - cardinalLuma.y);
            float verticalRidge = (centerLuma - cardinalLuma.z) * (centerLuma - cardinalLuma.w);
            // Use local contrast so a strand in shadow can seed the same lock as
            // a bright strand. The floor avoids amplifying near-flat quantization.
            float contrast = max(maximumColor.x - minimumColor.x, .01);
            float thinFeature = saturate(max(horizontalRidge, verticalRidge) / (contrast * contrast));
            bool reverses = change * previousDetail.y < 0 && abs(previousDetail.y) > .05;
            instability = reverses ? min(abs(previousDetail.y) + .45, 1) : max(.2 * thinFeature, abs(previousDetail.y) * .85);
            direction = sign(change);
        }
        float stabilityEligibility = saturate(1 - motionPixels) * (1 - reactive);
        OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, direction * instability * stabilityEligibility);
        if (observedThinGeometry)
            OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, (direction == 0 ? 1 : direction) * 1.8);
        // Protect a disappearing strand when its neighborhood collapses to a
        // flat color. A well-sampled silhouette keeps the original sharp resolve.
        float flatNeighborhood = saturate(1 - sigma.x * 8);
        detailLock = saturate((instability - .15) / .5) * stabilityEligibility;
        detailProtection = detailLock * flatNeighborhood;
    }
    // A jittered silhouette legitimately differs from the accumulated coverage.
    // Only color outside the current neighborhood signals an unexplained change.
    bool stablePlane = subpixelAA && Parameters.w > .5 && footprintTolerance > 0 &&
        motionPixels < .25 && reactive == 0 && sigma.x < max(abs(mean.x), .05) * .15;
    if (stablePlane)
    {
        // A flat neighborhood has almost no spatial variance. Clipping to that
        // zero-width box forwards weak GI noise instead of accumulating it.
        // Allow a small absolute/relative tolerance on verified stationary planes.
        // Large lighting changes remain bounded by the current frame's box.
        float3 noiseAllowance = float3(.001, .002, .002) + .003 * abs(mean);
        minimumColor -= noiseAllowance;
        maximumColor += noiseAllowance;
    }
    float3 clippedHistory = clamp(ToY(history.rgb), minimumColor, maximumColor);
    clippedHistory = lerp(clippedHistory, ToY(history.rgb), detailProtection);
    float neighborhoodReaction = saturate(abs(ToY(history.rgb).x - clippedHistory.x) / max(abs(clippedHistory.x), .05));
    float historyLuma = dot(history.rgb, float3(.2126, .7152, .0722));
    float legacyReaction = saturate(abs(currentLuma - historyLuma) / max(max(currentLuma, historyLuma), .05));
    reactive = max(reactive, subpixelAA ? neighborhoodReaction : legacyReaction);
    float stillness = subpixelAA ? exp2(-motionPixels * .25) * (1 - reactive) : 0;
    // At low input resolution, a source sample can be several output pixels
    // away. Accumulate its actual location instead of averaging a 5x magnified
    // cubic edge every frame. Moving/rejected pixels retain spatial reconstruction.
    float2 sampleDistance = ((float2(pixel) + .5) / Extent.xy - source) * Extent.zw;
    float sampleConfidence = exp2(-.5 * dot(sampleDistance, sampleDistance));
    float currentWeight = lerp(.08, .002 + .1 * sampleConfidence, stillness);
    if (stablePlane) currentWeight *= .5;
    currentWeight *= lerp(1, .25, detailLock);
    float weight = (1 - currentWeight) * (1 - reactive) * exp2(-motionPixels * .04);
    float3 temporalSample = lerp(current.rgb, Color.Load(int3(pixel, 0)).rgb, stillness);
    Output[id.xy] = float4(lerp(temporalSample, FromY(clippedHistory), weight), current.a);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\ToneMapping.hlsli =====
#ifndef TONE_MAPPING_HLSLI
#define TONE_MAPPING_HLSLI
// Requires PostProcessParams (GradeParams0/1, GradeLift/Gamma/Gain) from common.hlsl.
// All functions take and return linear Rec.709 values.

static const float3 kLumaWeights = float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f);

// --- AgX (Troy Sobotka), polynomial fit of the default contrast curve ------------------------
float3 AgXContrastApprox(float3 x)
{
    float3 x2 = x * x;
    float3 x4 = x2 * x2;
    return 15.5f * x4 * x2 - 40.14f * x4 * x + 31.96f * x4 - 6.868f * x2 * x + 0.4298f * x2 + 0.1191f * x - 0.00232f;
}

float3 AgXToneMap(float3 color, bool punchy)
{
    // Inset matrix (columns).
    const float3 c0 = float3(0.842479062253094f, 0.0423282422610123f, 0.0423756549057051f);
    const float3 c1 = float3(0.0784335999999992f, 0.878468636469772f, 0.0784336f);
    const float3 c2 = float3(0.0792237451477643f, 0.0791661274605434f, 0.879142973793104f);
    const float minEv = -12.47393f;
    const float maxEv = 4.026069f;
    color = c0 * color.r + c1 * color.g + c2 * color.b;
    color = clamp(log2(max(color, 1e-10f)), minEv, maxEv);
    color = (color - minEv) / (maxEv - minEv);
    color = AgXContrastApprox(color);
    if (punchy)
    {
        color = pow(max(color, 0.0f), 1.35f);
        float luma = dot(color, kLumaWeights);
        color = luma + 1.4f * (color - luma);
    }
    // Outset matrix (columns) back to display encoded Rec.709.
    const float3 d0 = float3(1.19687900512017f, -0.0528968517574562f, -0.0529716355144438f);
    const float3 d1 = float3(-0.0980208811401368f, 1.15190312990417f, -0.0980434501171241f);
    const float3 d2 = float3(-0.0990297440797205f, -0.0989611768448433f, 1.15107367264116f);
    color = d0 * color.r + d1 * color.g + d2 * color.b;
    // The curve targets a 2.2 display; return linear light for the existing output path.
    return pow(saturate(color), 2.2f);
}

// --- ACES fitted (Stephen Hill): RRT + ODT with the sRGB input / output matrices --------------
float3 AcesFittedToneMap(float3 color)
{
    const float3x3 inputMatrix = float3x3(
        0.59719f, 0.35458f, 0.04823f,
        0.07600f, 0.90834f, 0.01566f,
        0.02840f, 0.13383f, 0.83777f);
    const float3x3 outputMatrix = float3x3(
        1.60475f, -0.53108f, -0.07367f,
        -0.10208f, 1.10813f, -0.00605f,
        -0.00327f, -0.07276f, 1.07602f);
    color = mul(inputMatrix, color);
    float3 a = color * (color + 0.0245786f) - 0.000090537f;
    float3 b = color * (0.983729f * color + 0.4329510f) + 0.238081f;
    color = a / b;
    return saturate(mul(outputMatrix, color));
}

// --- Khronos PBR Neutral: preserves base colour hue and saturation (product visualisation) ----
float3 PbrNeutralToneMap(float3 color)
{
    const float startCompression = 0.8f - 0.04f;
    const float desaturation = 0.15f;
    float x = min(color.r, min(color.g, color.b));
    float offset = x < 0.08f ? x - 6.25f * x * x : 0.04f;
    color -= offset;
    float peak = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
    if (peak < startCompression) return saturate(color);
    float d = 1.0f - startCompression;
    float newPeak = 1.0f - d * d / (peak + d - startCompression);
    color *= newPeak / peak;
    float g = 1.0f - 1.0f / (desaturation * (peak - newPeak) + 1.0f);
    return saturate(lerp(color, newPeak.xxx, g));
}

float3 ApplyToneMapper(float3 color)
{
    int mode = (int)round(GradeParams0.x);
    if (mode == 1) return AgXToneMap(color, GradeParams1.z > 0.5f);
    if (mode == 2) return AcesFittedToneMap(color);
    if (mode == 3) return PbrNeutralToneMap(color);
    return ACESToneMap(color);
}

// Scene-referred grading (before the tone mapper): white balance, contrast, saturation, vibrance.
float3 GradeSceneLinear(float3 color)
{
    float temperature = GradeParams1.x;
    float tint = GradeParams1.y;
    // Simple white balance: warm/cool along blue-yellow, tint along green-magenta.
    float3 balance = float3(1.0f + temperature * 0.10f, 1.0f - tint * 0.08f, 1.0f - temperature * 0.10f);
    color *= balance / dot(balance, kLumaWeights);
    float contrast = max(GradeParams0.y, 0.0f);
    if (abs(contrast - 1.0f) > 0.001f)
    {
        // Contrast around middle grey in log space keeps highlights and blacks stable.
        color = 0.18f * pow(max(color, 1e-6f) / 0.18f, contrast);
    }
    float luma = dot(color, kLumaWeights);
    float saturation = max(GradeParams0.z, 0.0f);
    color = max(luma + (color - luma) * saturation, 0.0f);
    float vibrance = GradeParams0.w;
    if (abs(vibrance) > 0.001f)
    {
        float maxChannel = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
        float minChannel = min(color.r, min(color.g, color.b));
        float currentSaturation = (maxChannel - minChannel) / max(maxChannel, 1e-5f);
        luma = dot(color, kLumaWeights);
        color = max(luma + (color - luma) * (1.0f + vibrance * (1.0f - currentSaturation)), 0.0f);
    }
    return color;
}

// Display-referred lift / gamma / gain (ASC CDL style) on the tone mapped image.
float3 GradeDisplay(float3 color)
{
    float3 encoded = pow(saturate(color), 1.0f / 2.2f);
    encoded = GradeGain.rgb * (encoded + GradeLift.rgb * (1.0f - encoded));
    encoded = pow(saturate(encoded), 1.0f / max(GradeGamma.rgb, 0.05f));
    return pow(encoded, 2.2f);
}

// --- Lens effects --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float LensHash(float2 p)
{
    float3 p3 = frac(float3(p.xyx) * 0.1031f);
    p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33f);
    return frac((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
}

// Lateral chromatic aberration: red and blue sampled at radially scaled positions.
float3 SampleWithChromaticAberration(Texture2D<float4> source, SamplerState linearSampler, float2 uv)
{
    float amount = LensParams0.z;
    float3 center = source.SampleLevel(linearSampler, uv, 0).rgb;
    if (amount <= 0.001f) return center;
    float width, height;
    source.GetDimensions(width, height);
    float2 fromCenter = uv - 0.5f;
    float2 offset = fromCenter * dot(fromCenter, fromCenter) * 4.0f * amount / float2(width, height);
    float red = source.SampleLevel(linearSampler, uv - offset, 0).r;
    float blue = source.SampleLevel(linearSampler, uv + offset, 0).b;
    return float3(red, center.g, blue);
}

// Vignette (natural cos^4 style falloff) and luminance dependent film grain, display space.
float3 ApplyLensOutput(float3 color, float2 uv, float2 pixel)
{
    float vignette = LensParams0.x;
    if (vignette > 0.001f)
    {
        float2 d = (uv - 0.5f) * float2(1.0f, 0.75f) * 2.0f;
        float falloff = saturate(1.0f - dot(d, d) * vignette * (1.0f - LensParams0.y * 0.5f));
        color *= lerp(1.0f, falloff * falloff, saturate(vignette * 2.0f));
    }
    float grain = LensParams0.w;
    if (grain > 0.001f)
    {
        float noise = LensHash(pixel + frac(LensParams1.y * 0.6180339f) * 1024.0f) - 0.5f;
        float luma = dot(color, kLumaWeights);
        // Grain is strongest in the mid tones, like film.
        float response = 4.0f * luma * (1.0f - saturate(luma));
        color = max(color + noise * grain * 0.12f * (0.25f + response), 0.0f);
    }
    return color;
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\toonOutlineVS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"

PSInput3D main(VSInput3D input)
{
    PSInput3D output;
    float normalLenSq = dot(input.Normal, input.Normal);
    float3 safeNormal = (normalLenSq > 0.000001f) ? input.Normal : float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    float3 worldNormal = (normalLenSq > 0.000001f) ? normalize(mul(safeNormal, (float3x3)World)) : float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
    float outlineWidth = max(ToonOutlineWidth, 0.0f);
    float useScreenSpace = ToonOutlineUseScreenSpace != 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    float3 worldModePosition = input.Position + safeNormal * outlineWidth;
    float3 baseModePosition = lerp(worldModePosition, input.Position, useScreenSpace);

    float4 worldPos = mul(float4(baseModePosition, 1.0f), World);
    float4 viewPos = mul(worldPos, View);
    float4 clipPos = mul(viewPos, Projection);

    if (ToonOutlineUseScreenSpace != 0)
    {
        float normalProbeWidth = max(outlineWidth, 0.001f);
        float4 probeWorldPos = mul(float4(input.Position + safeNormal * normalProbeWidth, 1.0f), World);
        float4 probeClipPos = mul(mul(probeWorldPos, View), Projection);
        float2 viewport = max(ViewportSize, float2(1.0f, 1.0f));
        float2 baseNdc = clipPos.xy / max(abs(clipPos.w), 0.000001f);
        float2 probeNdc = probeClipPos.xy / max(abs(probeClipPos.w), 0.000001f);
        float2 screenDir = probeNdc - baseNdc;
        float dirLenSq = dot(screenDir, screenDir);
        float2 fallbackDir = normalize(worldNormal.xy + float2(0.0001f, 0.0f));
        screenDir = (dirLenSq > 0.00000001f) ? screenDir * rsqrt(dirLenSq) : fallbackDir;
        float2 ndcOffset = screenDir * (max(ToonOutlineScreenWidth, 0.0f) * 2.0f / viewport);
        clipPos.xy += ndcOffset * clipPos.w;
    }

    output.Position = clipPos;
    output.Normal = worldNormal;
    output.TexCoord = input.TexCoord;


    output.Diffuse = float4(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, saturate(MaterialAlpha));
    output.WorldPos = worldPos.xyz;
    output.ViewPos = viewPos.xyz;
    output.CameraPos = CameraPos;
    return output;
}


===== FILE: shader\hlsl\UpscaleBilateralPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_POSTPROCESS
#include "common.hlsl"

Texture2D<float4> LowResScene : register(t0);
Texture2D<float> LowResDepth : register(t1);
SamplerState LinearSampler : register(s0);

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_TARGET
{
    float depthCenter = LowResDepth.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, input.TexCoord, 0);
    float resolutionScale = max(abs(Flags.w), 0.001f);
    float2 step = float2(ddx(input.TexCoord.x), ddy(input.TexCoord.y)) / resolutionScale;

    float totalWeight = 0.0f;
    float4 result = 0.0f;

    [unroll]
    for (int x = -1; x <= 1; ++x)
    {
        [unroll]
        for (int y = -1; y <= 1; ++y)
        {
            float2 sampleUV = input.TexCoord + float2(x, y) * step;
            float depthSample = LowResDepth.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, sampleUV, 0);
            float depthWeight = rcp(1.0f + abs(depthSample - depthCenter) * 100.0f);
            float4 color = LowResScene.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, sampleUV, 0);
            result += color * depthWeight;
            totalWeight += depthWeight;
        }
    }

	result /= max(totalWeight, 0.001f);
	result.a = 1.0f;
    return result;
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\VelocityGeometryPS.hlsl =====
struct VelocityInput
{
    float4 Position : SV_POSITION;
    float4 CurrentClip : TEXCOORD0;
    float4 PreviousClip : TEXCOORD1;
#ifdef MESHLET_VELOCITY
    nointerpolation uint MaterialFlags : TEXCOORD2;
#endif
};

float4 EncodeVelocity(float2 velocity)
{
    float2 displayVelocity = sign(velocity) * saturate(sqrt(abs(velocity) * 100.0f));
    return float4(displayVelocity * 0.5f + 0.5f, velocity);
}

float4 main(VelocityInput input, bool frontFace : SV_IsFrontFace) : SV_Target
{
#ifdef MESHLET_VELOCITY
    if ((input.MaterialFlags & 4u) == 0 && !frontFace) discard;
#endif
    if (input.CurrentClip.w <= 0.00001f || input.PreviousClip.w <= 0.00001f)
    {
        return EncodeVelocity(0.0f);
    }
    float2 currentNdc = input.CurrentClip.xy / input.CurrentClip.w;
    float2 previousNdc = input.PreviousClip.xy / input.PreviousClip.w;
    float2 currentUv = currentNdc * float2(0.5f, -0.5f) + 0.5f;
    float2 previousUv = previousNdc * float2(0.5f, -0.5f) + 0.5f;
    return EncodeVelocity(currentUv - previousUv);
}


===== FILE: shader\hlsl\VelocityGeometryVS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D

struct VelocityInput
{

    float3 PreviousPosition : PREVPOS;
};

struct VelocityOutput
{

    float4 CurrentClip : TEXCOORD0;
    float4 PreviousClip : TEXCOORD1;
};

VelocityOutput main(VelocityInput input)
{
    VelocityOutput output;
    float4 currentWorld = mul(float4(input.Position, 1.0f), World);
    float4 currentView = mul(currentWorld, View);
    output.CurrentClip = mul(currentView, Projection);
    output.Position = output.CurrentClip;

    float4 previousWorld = mul(float4(input.PreviousPosition, 1.0f), PreviousWorld);
    output.PreviousClip = mul(previousWorld, PreviousViewProjection);
    return output;
}


===== FILE: shader\hlsl\VelocityPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_POSTPROCESS
#include "common.hlsl"

Texture2D<float> DepthTexture : register(t2);
SamplerState PointSampler : register(s0);

cbuffer VelocityConstants : register(b4)
{
    float4x4 PrevViewProjection;
    float2 RcpVelocitySize;
    float2 VelocityPadding;
};

float4 EncodeVelocity(float2 velocity)
{
    float2 displayVelocity = sign(velocity) * saturate(sqrt(abs(velocity) * 100.0f));
    return float4(displayVelocity * 0.5f + 0.5f, velocity);
}

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_Target
{
    float depth = DepthTexture.SampleLevel(PointSampler, input.TexCoord, 0);
    if (depth >= 0.9999f)
    {
        // An infinite sky responds to camera rotation and projection jitter, without translation.
        float3 direction = ReconstructPostProcessViewRayCommon(input.TexCoord);
        float4 previousSky = mul(float4(direction, 0.0f), PrevViewProjection);
        if (previousSky.w <= 0.00001f)
        {
            return EncodeVelocity(0.0f);
        }
        float2 previousSkyUv = previousSky.xy / previousSky.w * float2(0.5f, -0.5f) + 0.5f;
        return EncodeVelocity(input.TexCoord - previousSkyUv);
    }

    float3 worldPosition = ReconstructPostProcessWorldPositionCommon(input.TexCoord, depth);
    float4 previousClip = mul(float4(worldPosition, 1.0f), PrevViewProjection);
    if (previousClip.w <= 0.00001f)
    {
        return EncodeVelocity(0.0f);
    }

    float2 previousNdc = previousClip.xy / previousClip.w;
    float2 previousUv = previousNdc * float2(0.5f, -0.5f) + 0.5f;
    return EncodeVelocity(input.TexCoord - previousUv);
}


===== FILE: shader\hlsl\VertexDeformationCS.hlsl =====
ByteAddressBuffer BaseVertices : register(t0);
RWByteAddressBuffer CurrentVertices : register(u0);
RWByteAddressBuffer PreviousVertices : register(u1);

struct MotionData
{
    float4 AmplitudeAndPhase;
    float4 Parameters;
};
cbuffer DeformationConstants : register(b0)
{
    MotionData Current;
    MotionData Previous;
    uint4 Geometry;
};

uint NoiseHash(int2 cell, uint seed)
{
    uint value = uint(cell.x) * 0x9e3779b9u ^ uint(cell.y) * 0x85ebca6bu ^ seed;
    value ^= value >> 16;
    value *= 0x7feb352du;
    value ^= value >> 15;
    value *= 0x846ca68bu;
    return value ^ (value >> 16);
}

float Gradient(int2 cell, float2 delta, uint seed)
{
    switch (NoiseHash(cell, seed) & 7u)
    {
    case 0: return delta.x;
    case 1: return -delta.x;
    case 2: return delta.y;
    case 3: return -delta.y;
    case 4: return (delta.x + delta.y) * 0.70710678118f;
    case 5: return (delta.x - delta.y) * 0.70710678118f;
    case 6: return (-delta.x + delta.y) * 0.70710678118f;
    default: return (-delta.x - delta.y) * 0.70710678118f;
    }
}

float Perlin(float2 position, float frequency, uint seed)
{
    position = clamp(position * clamp(frequency, 0.0001f, 2.0f), -10000.0f, 10000.0f);
    int2 cell = int2(floor(position));
    float2 local = position - cell;
    float2 weight = local * local * local * (local * (local * 6.0f - 15.0f) + 10.0f);
    float low = lerp(Gradient(cell, local, seed), Gradient(cell + int2(1, 0), local - float2(1, 0), seed), weight.x);
    float high = lerp(Gradient(cell + int2(0, 1), local - float2(0, 1), seed),
        Gradient(cell + int2(1, 1), local - 1.0f, seed), weight.x);
    return clamp(lerp(low, high, weight.y) * 1.41421356237f, -1.0f, 1.0f);
}

float3 SpatialOffset(float3 position, MotionData motion, bool rest)
{
    float phase = rest ? 0 : motion.AmplitudeAndPhase.w;
    float frequency = motion.Parameters.x;
    float3 phases = float3(position.y * 0.73f + position.z, position.x + position.z * 0.61f,
        position.x * 0.83f + position.y) * frequency;
    int method = int(motion.Parameters.z);
    if (method == 0) return sin(phases + phase);
    if (method == 1) return float3(cos(phases.y + phase), sin(phases.x + phase), sin(phases.z + phase));
    float time = rest ? 0 : motion.Parameters.y;
    uint seed = asuint(motion.Parameters.w);
    return float3(Perlin(float2(position.y + time, position.z + 11.2f), frequency, seed),
        Perlin(float2(position.x + time, position.z + 37.9f), frequency, seed),
        Perlin(float2(position.x + 93.1f, position.y + time), frequency, seed));
}

float3 DeformPosition(float3 position, MotionData motion)
{
    return position + motion.AmplitudeAndPhase.xyz * (SpatialOffset(position, motion, false) - SpatialOffset(position, motion, true));
}

float3 DeformNormal(float3 position, float3 normal, MotionData motion)
{
    normal = dot(normal, normal) > 1e-16f ? normalize(normal) : float3(0, 1, 0);
    float3 axis = abs(normal.y) > 0.9f ? float3(1, 0, 0) : float3(0, 1, 0);
    float3 tangent = normalize(cross(axis, normal));
    float3 bitangent = cross(normal, tangent);
    float stepSize = 0.001f / max(1.0f, motion.Parameters.x);
    float3 deltaT = DeformPosition(position + tangent * stepSize, motion) - DeformPosition(position - tangent * stepSize, motion);
    float3 deltaB = DeformPosition(position + bitangent * stepSize, motion) - DeformPosition(position - bitangent * stepSize, motion);
    float3 transformed = cross(deltaT, deltaB);
    return dot(transformed, transformed) > 1e-16f ? normalize(transformed) : normal;
}

[numthreads(64, 1, 1)]
void main(uint3 group : SV_GroupID, uint thread : SV_GroupIndex)
{
    uint vertex = (group.x + group.y * 65535u) * 64u + thread;
    if (vertex >= Geometry.x) return;
    uint address = vertex * Geometry.y;
    float3 position = asfloat(BaseVertices.Load3(address));
    float3 normal = asfloat(BaseVertices.Load3(address + 12));
    CurrentVertices.Store3(address, asuint(DeformPosition(position, Current)));
    CurrentVertices.Store3(address + 12, asuint(DeformNormal(position, normal, Current)));
    PreviousVertices.Store3(address, asuint(DeformPosition(position, Previous)));
    PreviousVertices.Store3(address + 12, asuint(DeformNormal(position, normal, Previous)));
    uint2 texcoord = BaseVertices.Load2(address + 24);
    uint4 color = BaseVertices.Load4(address + 32);
    CurrentVertices.Store2(address + 24, texcoord);
    PreviousVertices.Store2(address + 24, texcoord);
    CurrentVertices.Store4(address + 32, color);
    PreviousVertices.Store4(address + 32, color);
}


===== FILE: shader\hlsl\VGGeometryDecode.hlsli =====
#ifndef VG_GEOMETRY_DECODE
#define VG_GEOMETRY_DECODE
// VGC1 wire layout is defined by virtualgeometrycompression.cpp. Every raw Load is aligned.
uint VGLoadU8(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint address)
{
    return (buffer.Load(address & ~3u) >> ((address & 3u)*8u)) & 255u;
}
uint VGLoadU16(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint address)
{
    // Works even when the half-word crosses a DWORD boundary.
    return VGLoadU8(buffer, address) | (VGLoadU8(buffer, address + 1u) << 8u);
}
float VGSign(float value)
{
    return value < 0 ? -1.0 : 1.0;
}
float3 VGNormalize(float3 value)
{
    float scale = max(abs(value.x), max(abs(value.y), abs(value.z)));
    if (scale <= 1e-30)
    {
        return float3(0, 1, 0);
    }
    return normalize(value / scale);
}
int VGSigned(uint value, uint bits)
{
    uint signBit = 1u << (bits - 1u);
    return int(value & (signBit - 1u)) - int(value & signBit);
}
float3 VGOctDecode(uint packed)
{
    float2 xy = max(-1.0, float2(VGSigned(packed & 65535u, 16), VGSigned(packed >> 16u, 16)) / 32767.0);
    float z = 1.0 - abs(xy.x) - abs(xy.y);
    if (z < 0)
    {
        xy = (1.0 - abs(xy.yx)) * float2(VGSign(xy.x), VGSign(xy.y));
    }
    return VGNormalize(float3(xy, z));
}
// Returns codec, byte offset, stride; absent attributes return codec UINT_MAX.
uint3 VGStream(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint base, uint semantic)
{
    uint count = buffer.Load(base + 28u);
    for (uint stream = 0; stream < count; ++stream)
    {
        uint4 descriptor = buffer.Load4(base + 56u + stream*16u);
        if (descriptor.x == semantic)
        {
            return descriptor.yzw;
        }
    }
    return uint3(0xffffffffu, 0, 0);
}
float3 VGDecodePosition(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint base, uint vertex)
{
    // Position is always descriptor zero, avoiding a directory search on the hot path.
    uint3 stream = buffer.Load3(base + 60u);
    uint address = base + stream.y + vertex*stream.z;
    if (stream.x == 0)
    {
        return asfloat(buffer.Load3(address));
    }
    uint3 quantized = uint3(VGLoadU16(buffer, address), VGLoadU16(buffer, address + 2u), VGLoadU16(buffer, address + 4u));
    precise float3 delta = float3(quantized) * asfloat(buffer.Load3(base + 44u));
    precise float3 position = asfloat(buffer.Load3(base + 32u)) + delta;
    return position;
}
float3 VGDecodeNormal(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint base, uint vertex)
{
    uint3 stream = VGStream(buffer, base, 1);
    if (stream.x == 0xffffffffu)
    {
        return float3(0, 1, 0);
    }
    uint address = base + stream.y + vertex*stream.z;
    if (stream.x == 2)
    {
        return VGOctDecode(buffer.Load(address));
    }
    return VGNormalize(asfloat(buffer.Load3(address)));
}
float4 VGDecodeTangent(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint base, uint vertex, float3 normal)
{
    uint3 stream = VGStream(buffer, base, 2);
    float4 tangent = float4(1, 0, 0, 1);
    uint address = base + stream.y + vertex*stream.z;
    if (stream.x == 0)
    {
        tangent = asfloat(buffer.Load4(address));
    }
    else if (stream.x == 3)
    {
        uint packed = buffer.Load(address);
        tangent.xyz = VGNormalize(float3(VGSigned(packed & 1023u, 10),
            VGSigned((packed >> 10u) & 1023u, 10), VGSigned((packed >> 20u) & 1023u, 10)) / 511.0);
        tangent.w = (packed >> 30u) == 3u ? -1.0 : 1.0;
    }
    tangent.xyz -= normal * dot(normal, tangent.xyz);
    if (dot(abs(tangent.xyz), float3(1, 1, 1)) < 1e-6)
    {
        float3 helper = float3(0, 0, 1);
        if (abs(normal.z) > 0.9)
        {
            helper = float3(0, 1, 0);
        }
        tangent.xyz = cross(helper, normal);
    }
    tangent.xyz = VGNormalize(tangent.xyz);
    return tangent;
}
float2 VGDecodeTexcoord(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint base, uint vertex, uint channel)
{
    uint3 stream = VGStream(buffer, base, 8u + channel);
    if (stream.x == 0xffffffffu)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    uint address = base + stream.y + vertex*stream.z;
    if (stream.x == 4)
    {
        uint packed = buffer.Load(address);
        return float2(f16tof32(packed & 65535u), f16tof32(packed >> 16u));
    }
    return asfloat(buffer.Load2(address));
}
float4 VGDecodeColor(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint base, uint vertex)
{
    uint3 stream = VGStream(buffer, base, 3);
    if (stream.x == 0xffffffffu)
    {
        return 1;
    }
    uint address = base + stream.y + vertex*stream.z;
    if (stream.x == 5)
    {
        uint packed = buffer.Load(address);
        return float4(packed & 255u, (packed >> 8u) & 255u, (packed >> 16u) & 255u, packed >> 24u) / 255.0;
    }
    return asfloat(buffer.Load4(address));
}
uint3 VGLoadTriangle(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint base, uint triangleIndex)
{
    uint width = buffer.Load(base + 20u);
    uint address = base + buffer.Load(base + 24u) + triangleIndex*3u*width;
    if (width == 1u)
    {
        return uint3(VGLoadU8(buffer, address), VGLoadU8(buffer, address + 1u), VGLoadU8(buffer, address + 2u));
    }
    return uint3(VGLoadU16(buffer, address), VGLoadU16(buffer, address + 2u), VGLoadU16(buffer, address + 4u));
}
struct VGDecodedVertex
{
    float3 Position;
    float3 Normal;
    float4 Tangent;
    float2 UV0;
    float4 Color;
};
VGDecodedVertex VGDecodeVertex(ByteAddressBuffer buffer, uint base, uint vertex)
{
    VGDecodedVertex result;
    result.Position = VGDecodePosition(buffer, base, vertex);
    result.Normal = VGDecodeNormal(buffer, base, vertex);
    result.Tangent = VGDecodeTangent(buffer, base, vertex, result.Normal);
    result.UV0 = VGDecodeTexcoord(buffer, base, vertex, 0);
    result.Color = VGDecodeColor(buffer, base, vertex);
    return result;
}
#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\VirtualGeometryBinningCS.hlsl =====
#include "VirtualGeometryCommon.hlsli"

StructuredBuffer<VisibleVirtualCluster> InputClusters : register(t0);
ByteAddressBuffer InputCounters : register(t1);
RWStructuredBuffer<uint4> Bins : register(u0); // offset, count, scatter cursor, material
RWStructuredBuffer<VisibleVirtualCluster> SortedClusters : register(u1);
RWByteAddressBuffer Commands : register(u2);
RWByteAddressBuffer Counters : register(u3);
cbuffer BinningParameters : register(b0)
{
    uint Capacity, ExactMaterialBins, MaterialCount, Padding;
};

uint InputCount()
{
    return min(InputCounters.Load(4),Capacity);
}
uint MaterialBin(uint material)
{
    return material < ExactMaterialBins ? material : ExactMaterialBins;
}

[numthreads(64,1,1)]
void Reset(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (id.x <= ExactMaterialBins) Bins[id.x] = 0;
    if (id.x < 8) Counters.Store(id.x*4,0);
}

[numthreads(64,1,1)]
void Count(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (id.x == 0 && InputCounters.Load(4) > Capacity)
    {
        uint unused;
        Counters.InterlockedAdd(16,InputCounters.Load(4)-Capacity,unused);
    }
    if (id.x >= InputCount()) return;
    uint material = InputClusters[id.x].MaterialIndex;
    uint bin = MaterialBin(material);
    uint unused;
    InterlockedAdd(Bins[bin].y,1,unused);
    if (bin == ExactMaterialBins) Counters.InterlockedAdd(8,1,unused);
    if (material >= MaterialCount) Counters.InterlockedAdd(12,1,unused);
}

// At most 4096 exact bins by default. One ordered scan creates compact commands
// without CPU readback or an entry for every empty material in the scene.
// 負荷削減：以前は 1 スレッドで全ビン（約 4097）を順番に処理しており GPU 1.8ms かかっていた。
// 1 グループ 1024 スレッドの並列スキャン（オフセットとアクティブ数の 2 回）に変更。結果（順序・値）は同じ。
//   クランプ：「クランプ済みの累積」= min(生の累積, Capacity) なので、生の累積から直接求められる
#define PREFIX_THREADS 1024
groupshared uint gs_Scan[PREFIX_THREADS];

uint ExclusiveScan(uint value, uint thread)
{
    gs_Scan[thread] = value;
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    [unroll] for (uint stride = 1; stride < PREFIX_THREADS; stride <<= 1)
    {
        uint add = thread >= stride ? gs_Scan[thread - stride] : 0;
        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
        gs_Scan[thread] += add;
        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    }
    uint inclusive = gs_Scan[thread];
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    return inclusive - value;
}

[numthreads(PREFIX_THREADS,1,1)]
void Prefix(uint thread : SV_GroupIndex)
{
    const uint binCount = ExactMaterialBins + 1;
    const uint perThread = (binCount + PREFIX_THREADS - 1) / PREFIX_THREADS;
    const uint first = min(thread * perThread, binCount);
    const uint last = min(first + perThread, binCount);

    // 1) 生の個数の累積
    uint rawSum = 0;
    for (uint bin = first; bin < last; ++bin) rawSum += Bins[bin].y;
    uint rawOffset = ExclusiveScan(rawSum, thread);

    // 2) クランプ済みの個数と、このスレッドのアクティブ（個数 > 0）なビン数
    uint activeLocal = 0;
    uint running = rawOffset;
    for (uint bin2 = first; bin2 < last; ++bin2)
    {
        uint count = Bins[bin2].y;
        uint clamped = min(running + count, Capacity) - min(running, Capacity);
        activeLocal += clamped != 0 ? 1u : 0u;
        running += count;
    }
    uint activeOffset = ExclusiveScan(activeLocal, thread);

    // 3) 書き込み（以前と同じ並び・同じ値）
    running = rawOffset;
    uint active = activeOffset;
    for (uint bin3 = first; bin3 < last; ++bin3)
    {
        uint raw = Bins[bin3].y;
        uint offset = min(running, Capacity);
        uint count = min(running + raw, Capacity) - offset;
        Bins[bin3] = uint4(offset, count, 0, bin3 < ExactMaterialBins ? bin3 : 0xffffffffu);
        if (count != 0)
        {
            uint address = active * 20;
            uint x = min(count, 65535u);
            Commands.Store2(address, uint2(offset, count));
            Commands.Store3(address + 8, uint3(x, (count + x - 1) / x, 1));
            ++active;
        }
        running += raw;
    }
    if (thread == PREFIX_THREADS - 1)
    {
        Counters.Store(0, active);
        Counters.Store(4, min(running, Capacity));
    }
}

[numthreads(64,1,1)]
void Scatter(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (id.x >= InputCount()) return;
    VisibleVirtualCluster record = InputClusters[id.x];
    uint bin = MaterialBin(record.MaterialIndex);
    uint cursor;
    InterlockedAdd(Bins[bin].z,1,cursor);
    uint destination = Bins[bin].x+cursor;
    if (cursor >= Bins[bin].y || Bins[bin].x >= Capacity || cursor >= Capacity-Bins[bin].x)
    {
        uint unused;
        Counters.InterlockedAdd(24,1,unused);
        return;
    }
    SortedClusters[destination] = record;
}

uint3 TriangleIndices(VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset, VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster, uint primitiveIndex)
{
    if ((asset.Flags&2u) != 0)
    {
        uint slot = Residency[asset.VertexOffset+cluster.PageIndex].x;
        ByteAddressBuffer page = GeometryPages[NonUniformResourceIndex(slot)];
        if ((cluster.Flags & 0x10000u) != 0)
        {
            return VGLoadTriangle(page, cluster.VertexOffset, primitiveIndex);
        }
        uint pageAddress = cluster.TriangleOffset+primitiveIndex*3;
        return uint3(VirtualGeometryByte(page,pageAddress),VirtualGeometryByte(page,pageAddress+1),VirtualGeometryByte(page,pageAddress+2));
    }
    uint address = asset.TriangleOffset + cluster.TriangleOffset + primitiveIndex*3;
    return uint3(VirtualGeometryByte(Triangles,address),VirtualGeometryByte(Triangles,address+1),VirtualGeometryByte(Triangles,address+2));
}
uint VertexAddress(VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset, VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster, uint index)
{
    if ((asset.Flags&2u) != 0) return cluster.VertexOffset+index*48;
    return (asset.VertexOffset+cluster.VertexOffset+index)*48;
}
uint3 VertexLoad3(VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset, VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster, uint address)
{
    if ((asset.Flags&2u) != 0)
    {
        uint slot = Residency[asset.VertexOffset+cluster.PageIndex].x;
        return GeometryPages[NonUniformResourceIndex(slot)].Load3(address);
    }
    return Vertices.Load3(address);
}
float3 NativeNormal(float3 normal, GPUInstanceData instance)
{
    float3 a = instance.World[0].xyz, b = instance.World[1].xyz, c = instance.World[2].xyz;
    float determinant = dot(a,cross(b,c));
    float3 transformed = normal.x*cross(b,c) + normal.y*cross(c,a) + normal.z*cross(a,b);
    if (abs(determinant) <= 1e-8 || dot(transformed,transformed) <= 1e-12) return float3(0,1,0);
    return normalize(transformed*sign(determinant));
}
float3 NativePosition(VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset, VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster, uint index)
{
    if ((asset.Flags & 2u) != 0 && (cluster.Flags & 0x10000u) != 0)
    {
        uint slot = Residency[asset.VertexOffset + cluster.PageIndex].x;
        ByteAddressBuffer page = GeometryPages[NonUniformResourceIndex(slot)];
        return VGDecodePosition(page, cluster.VertexOffset, index);
    }
    return asfloat(VertexLoad3(asset, cluster, VertexAddress(asset, cluster, index)));
}
float3 NativeDebugColor(VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset, VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster,
    VisibleVirtualCluster item, GPUInstanceData instance)
{
    uint id = item.ClusterIndex;
    if (LevelColors == 1) return VirtualGeometryLevelColor(cluster.Level);
    if (LevelColors == 3) id = cluster.GroupIndex;
    if (LevelColors == 4) id = item.MaterialIndex;
    if (LevelColors == 5) return (cluster.Flags & 0x10000u) != 0 ? float3(0.1,0.9,0.3) : float3(0.9,0.3,0.1);
    if (LevelColors == 6)
    {
        if ((asset.Flags&2u) == 0) return float3(0,0.9,0.3);
        uint page = asset.VertexOffset+cluster.PageIndex;
        bool resident = Residency[page].z != 0;
        return resident ? (cluster.Level > 0 ? float3(1,0.6,0) : float3(0,0.9,0.3)) : float3(1,0,0);
    }
    if (LevelColors == 7) return VirtualGeometryLevelColor((asset.Flags>>16)&3u);
    if (LevelColors == 8)
    {
        bool moving = false;
        for (uint row = 0; row < 4; ++row) moving = moving || any(instance.World[row] != instance.PreviousWorld[row]);
        return moving ? float3(1,0.5,0) : float3(0,0.7,1);
    }
    if (LevelColors == 9) return float3(0.04,0.01,0);
    if (LevelColors == 10)
    {
        float error = saturate(cluster.LodError/(cluster.Bounds.w+0.00001));
        return float3(error,1-error,0);
    }
    if (LevelColors == 11) id = instance.Entity;
    id = (id ^ 61u) ^ (id>>16);
    id *= 9u;
    id ^= id>>4;
    id *= 0x27d4eb2du;
    id ^= id>>15;
    return float3(id&255u,(id>>8)&255u,(id>>16)&255u)/255.0;
}
[outputtopology("triangle")]
[numthreads(64,1,1)]
void main(uint3 group : SV_GroupID, uint lane : SV_GroupIndex,
    out vertices MeshVertex outputVertices[64], out indices uint3 outputTriangles[124],
    out primitives PrimitiveOutput primitiveOutput[124])
{
#ifdef VIRTUAL_GEOMETRY_BINNED
    uint count = NativeBinCount;
#else
    uint count = Statistics.Load(4);
#endif
    uint localIndex = group.x + group.y*min(count,65535u);
    uint index = localIndex;
#ifdef VIRTUAL_GEOMETRY_BINNED
    index += NativeBinOffset;
#endif
    VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster = (VirtualGeometryGPUCluster)0;
    VisibleVirtualCluster item = (VisibleVirtualCluster)0;
    if (localIndex < count) { item = Visible[index]; cluster = Clusters[item.ClusterIndex]; }
    SetMeshOutputCounts(cluster.VertexCount,cluster.TriangleCount);
    if (localIndex >= count) return;
    GPUInstanceData instance = Instances[item.InstanceIndex];
    VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset = Assets[item.Flags];
    for (uint vertexIndex = lane; vertexIndex < cluster.VertexCount; vertexIndex += 64)
    {
        uint address = VertexAddress(asset,cluster,vertexIndex);
        float3 position = NativePosition(asset, cluster, vertexIndex);
        MeshVertex vertex = (MeshVertex)0;
        float4 world = mul(float4(position,1),instance.World);
        float4 view = mul(world,View);
        vertex.Position = mul(view,Projection);
#ifdef VIRTUAL_GEOMETRY_VELOCITY
        vertex.CurrentClip = vertex.Position;
        vertex.PreviousClip = mul(mul(float4(position,1),instance.PreviousWorld),PreviousViewProjection);
        vertex.MaterialFlags = Materials.Load(item.MaterialIndex*GPU_SCENE_MATERIAL_STRIDE+40);
#else
        if ((asset.Flags&2u) != 0)
        {
            uint slot = Residency[asset.VertexOffset+cluster.PageIndex].x;
            ByteAddressBuffer page = GeometryPages[NonUniformResourceIndex(slot)];
            if ((cluster.Flags & 0x10000u) != 0)
            {
                // The current PBR shader needs no tangent; decode only consumed attributes.
                vertex.Normal = NativeNormal(VGDecodeNormal(page, cluster.VertexOffset, vertexIndex), instance);
                vertex.TexCoord = VGDecodeTexcoord(page, cluster.VertexOffset, vertexIndex, 0);
                vertex.Diffuse = VGDecodeColor(page, cluster.VertexOffset, vertexIndex);
            }
            else
            {
                vertex.Normal = NativeNormal(asfloat(page.Load3(address+12)), instance);
                vertex.TexCoord = asfloat(page.Load2(address+24));
                vertex.Diffuse = asfloat(page.Load4(address+32));
            }
        }
        else
        {
            vertex.Normal = NativeNormal(asfloat(Vertices.Load3(address+12)), instance);
            vertex.TexCoord = asfloat(Vertices.Load2(address+24));
            vertex.Diffuse = asfloat(Vertices.Load4(address+32));
        }
        if (LevelColors != 0) vertex.Diffuse.rgb = NativeDebugColor(asset,cluster,item,instance);
        vertex.WorldPos = world.xyz;
        vertex.ViewPos = view.xyz;
        vertex.CameraPos = CameraPos;
        vertex.InstanceID = item.InstanceIndex;
#endif
        outputVertices[vertexIndex] = vertex;
    }
    for (uint primitiveIndex = lane; primitiveIndex < cluster.TriangleCount; primitiveIndex += 64)
    {
        uint3 indices = TriangleIndices(asset,cluster,primitiveIndex);
        outputTriangles[primitiveIndex] = indices;
        float3 points[3];
        for (uint corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
        {
            float3 position = NativePosition(asset, cluster, indices[corner]);
            points[corner] = mul(mul(float4(position,1),instance.World),View).xyz;
        }
        primitiveOutput[primitiveIndex].Cull = dot(cross(points[1]-points[0],points[2]-points[0]),points[0]) >= 0;
    }
}

#define main VirtualGeometryMaterialMain

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\VirtualGeometryTraversalCS.hlsl =====
#include "GpuSceneCommon.hlsli"
#include "VirtualGeometryCommon.hlsli"
StructuredBuffer<GPUInstanceData> Instances : register(t0);
StructuredBuffer<uint4> Objects : register(t1);
StructuredBuffer<VirtualGeometryGPUAsset> Assets : register(t2);
StructuredBuffer<VirtualGeometryGPUCluster> Clusters : register(t3);
StructuredBuffer<VirtualGeometryGPUGroup> Groups : register(t4);
StructuredBuffer<uint> Hierarchy : register(t5);
StructuredBuffer<uint> Roots : register(t6);
ByteAddressBuffer ObjectCount : register(t7);
ByteAddressBuffer Materials : register(t8);
Texture2D<float> HiZ : register(t9);
StructuredBuffer<uint4> Residency : register(t10);
globallycoherent RWStructuredBuffer<uint> GroupStates : register(u0);
RWStructuredBuffer<VisibleVirtualCluster> Visible : register(u1);
RWByteAddressBuffer Statistics : register(u2);
RWByteAddressBuffer Arguments : register(u3);
RWStructuredBuffer<uint> Success : register(u4);
RWStructuredBuffer<uint> TraversalQueue : register(u5);
RWByteAddressBuffer PageRequestBits : register(u6);
RWByteAddressBuffer PageRequests : register(u7);
RWByteAddressBuffer PageUsage : register(u8);
RWStructuredBuffer<uint> LodHistory : register(u9);
// Generation low/high, asset, group base, group count, epoch, padding.
StructuredBuffer<uint4> HistoryHeaders : register(t11);
RWStructuredBuffer<VisibleVirtualCluster> FirstVisible : register(u10);
RWStructuredBuffer<VisibleVirtualCluster> Deferred : register(u11);
RWStructuredBuffer<VisibleVirtualCluster> SecondVisible : register(u12);
RWStructuredBuffer<VisibleVirtualCluster> CombinedVisible : register(u13);
RWByteAddressBuffer TemporalCounters : register(u14);
RWByteAddressBuffer TemporalArguments : register(u15);
cbuffer Parameters : register(b0)
{
    row_major float4x4 VP;
    row_major float4x4 PreviousVP;
    float4 Camera;
    uint Capacity, ObjectCapacity, AssetCount, MaterialCount;
    uint EnableFrustum, EnableCone, EnableOcclusion, Enabled;
    float Bias; float2 HiZSize; uint HiZMips;
    float ProjectionPixels, TargetPixels;
    int ForceLevel;
    uint StateCapacity;
    uint PageCount, PageRequestCapacity;
    uint2 StreamingPadding;
    uint HistorySlots, HistoryCapacity, ResetHistory, TwoPass;
    float HysteresisFraction;
    uint HysteresisEnabled, TemporalPhase, TemporalPadding;
};
groupshared uint StateBase, QueueBase, QueueCount, QueueCursor, OutputBase, OutputCount, Accepted;
groupshared uint CurrentClusters[64];
void Stat(uint offset, uint value = 1)
{
    uint unused;
    Statistics.InterlockedAdd(offset, value, unused);
}
float MaximumScale(GPUInstanceData instance)
{
    float3 a = instance.World[0].xyz, b = instance.World[1].xyz, c = instance.World[2].xyz;
    // Gershgorin upper bound on the Gram matrix's largest eigenvalue.
    float ab = abs(dot(a,b)), ac = abs(dot(a,c)), bc = abs(dot(b,c));
    return sqrt(max(dot(a,a)+ab+ac,max(dot(b,b)+ab+bc,dot(c,c)+ac+bc)));
}
float4 WorldSphere(float4 bounds, GPUInstanceData instance)
{
    return float4(mul(float4(bounds.xyz, 1), instance.World).xyz, bounds.w * MaximumScale(instance));
}
bool FrustumCull(float4 sphere)
{
    float4 c0 = float4(VP[0][0], VP[1][0], VP[2][0], VP[3][0]);
    float4 c1 = float4(VP[0][1], VP[1][1], VP[2][1], VP[3][1]);
    float4 c2 = float4(VP[0][2], VP[1][2], VP[2][2], VP[3][2]);
    float4 c3 = float4(VP[0][3], VP[1][3], VP[2][3], VP[3][3]);
    float4 planes[6] = {c3+c0, c3-c0, c3+c1, c3-c1, c2, c3-c2};
    for (uint plane = 0; plane < 6; ++plane)
    {
        if (dot(float4(sphere.xyz, 1), planes[plane]) < -sphere.w * length(planes[plane].xyz)) return true;
    }
    return false;
}
bool OcclusionCull(float4 sphere, GPUInstanceData instance)
{
    if (EnableOcclusion == 0) return false;
    for (uint row = 0; row < 4 && TemporalPhase != 2; ++row)
    {
        if (!all(instance.World[row] == instance.PreviousWorld[row])) return false;
    }
    float2 minimum = 1, maximum = 0;
    float nearest = 1;
    for (uint corner = 0; corner < 8; ++corner)
    {
        float3 sign = float3((corner&1) ? 1 : -1, (corner&2) ? 1 : -1, (corner&4) ? 1 : -1);
        float4 Point = float4(sphere.xyz + sign*sphere.w, 1);
        float4 clip = TemporalPhase == 2 ? mul(Point, VP) : mul(Point,PreviousVP);
        if (!all(isfinite(clip)) || clip.w <= 1e-5 || clip.z <= 0 || clip.z >= clip.w) return false;
        float3 ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
        float2 uv = ndc.xy * float2(0.5, -0.5) + 0.5;
        minimum = min(minimum, uv);
        maximum = max(maximum, uv);
        nearest = min(nearest, ndc.z);
    }
    minimum -= 1 / HiZSize;
    maximum += 1 / HiZSize;
    if (any(minimum < 0) || any(maximum >= 1) || any(maximum < minimum)) return false;
    for (uint mip = 0; mip < HiZMips; ++mip)
    {
        uint width, height, mips;
        HiZ.GetDimensions(mip, width, height, mips);
        uint2 first = min((uint2)floor(minimum*float2(width,height)), uint2(width-1,height-1));
        uint2 last = min((uint2)floor(maximum*float2(width,height)), uint2(width-1,height-1));
        if (any(last-first > 1)) continue;
        float farthest = 0;
        for (uint y = first.y; y <= last.y; ++y)
        {
            for (uint x = first.x; x <= last.x; ++x)
            {
                float depth = HiZ.Load(int3(x,y,mip));
                if (!isfinite(depth)) return false;
                farthest = max(farthest,depth);
            }
        }
        return nearest > farthest + max(Bias,0);
    }
    return false;
}
bool ConeCull(VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster, GPUInstanceData instance)
{
    if (EnableCone == 0 || cluster.Cone.w >= 1) return false;
    float3 a = instance.World[0].xyz, b = instance.World[1].xyz, c = instance.World[2].xyz;
    float3 sizes = float3(length(a),length(b),length(c));
    if (min(sizes.x,min(sizes.y,sizes.z)) < 1e-6 || dot(cross(a,b),c) <= 0) return false;
    a /= sizes.x; b /= sizes.y; c /= sizes.z;
    if (max(sizes.x,max(sizes.y,sizes.z))-min(sizes.x,min(sizes.y,sizes.z)) > sizes.x*1e-4 ||
        abs(dot(a,b))+abs(dot(a,c))+abs(dot(b,c)) > 1e-4) return false;
    float3 apex = mul(float4(cluster.ConeApex.xyz,1),instance.World).xyz;
    float3 axis = normalize(mul(cluster.Cone.xyz,(float3x3)instance.World));
    float3 delta = apex-Camera.xyz;
    float distance = length(delta);
    if (distance <= 1e-5) return false;
    return dot(axis,delta/distance) >= cluster.Cone.w + 1e-5;
}
bool Reserve(uint counter, uint amount, uint limit, out uint base)
{
    uint first = Statistics.Load(counter), observed;
    [allow_uav_condition] while (true)
    {
        if (amount > limit || first > limit-amount) { base = 0; return false; }
        Statistics.InterlockedCompareExchange(counter,first,first+amount,observed);
        if (first == observed) { base = first; return true; }
        first = observed;
    }
}
[numthreads(64,1,1)]
void Reset(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (id.x < 64) Statistics.Store(id.x*4,0);
    if (id.x < 192) TemporalCounters.Store(id.x*4,0);
    if (ResetHistory != 0 && id.x < HistoryCapacity) LodHistory[id.x] = 0;
    if (id.x < ObjectCapacity) Success[id.x] = 0;
    if (id.x == 0) PageRequests.Store4(0, uint4(0,0,0,0));
    if (id.x < (PageCount+31)/32)
    {
        PageRequestBits.Store(id.x*4,0);
        PageUsage.Store(id.x*4,0);
    }
}
[numthreads(1,1,1)]
void BuildArguments()
{
    uint count = Statistics.Load(4);
    uint x = min(count,65535u);
    Arguments.Store3(0,uint3(x,count ? (count+x-1)/x : 1,1));
}
bool PageResident(VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset, VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster)
{
    uint page = asset.VertexOffset + cluster.PageIndex;
    bool resident = cluster.PageIndex < asset.TriangleOffset && page < PageCount && Residency[page].z != 0;
    if (resident)
    {
        // Intermediate pages are dependencies of the cut even if their clusters
        // are replaced. Keep their usage current to avoid eviction/refine loops.
        uint unused;
        PageUsage.InterlockedOr((page/32)*4,1u<<(page&31u),unused);
    }
    return resident;
}
void RequestPage(VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset, VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster, bool predicted = false)
{
    uint page = asset.VertexOffset + cluster.PageIndex;
    if (cluster.PageIndex >= asset.TriangleOffset || page >= PageCount) return;
    uint previous;
    uint mask = 1u << (page&31u);
    if (predicted)
    {
        if (Residency[page].z != 0) return;
        uint forecast;
        PageRequests.InterlockedAdd(8,1,forecast);
        if (forecast >= min(128u,PageRequestCapacity/8)) return;
    }
    else
    {
        // A later real request upgrades an earlier predicted append through this bit.
        PageUsage.InterlockedOr((page/32)*4,mask,previous);
    }
    PageRequestBits.InterlockedOr((page/32)*4,mask,previous);
    if ((previous&mask) != 0) return;
    uint offset;
    PageRequests.InterlockedAdd(0,1,offset);
    if (offset < PageRequestCapacity)
    {
        PageRequests.Store(16+offset*4,page | (predicted ? 0x80000000u : 0u));
    }
    else
    {
        PageRequests.InterlockedAdd(4,1,previous);
    }
}
void ResidentCut(VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset, GPUInstanceData instance, uint4 selected,
    uint assetId, uint object, uint lane)
{
    for (uint index = lane; index < asset.ClusterCount; index += 64)
    {
        TraversalQueue[QueueBase+index] = 0;
    }
    AllMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    for (uint root = lane; root < asset.RootCount; root += 64)
    {
        uint index = Roots[asset.RootOffset+root];
        if (!PageResident(asset,Clusters[asset.ClusterOffset+index]))
        {
            InterlockedAnd(Accepted,0);
        }
        TraversalQueue[QueueBase+index] = 1;
    }
    AllMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (Accepted == 0)
    {
        if (lane == 0) Stat(12);
        return;
    }
    int height = int((asset.Flags>>8)&63u);
    for (int level = height-1; level >= 0; --level)
    {
        for (uint index = lane; index < asset.GroupCount; index += 64)
        {
            VirtualGeometryGPUGroup node = Groups[asset.GroupOffset+index];
            if (node.Level != uint(level) || (GroupStates[StateBase+index]&1u) == 0) continue;
            bool active = true;
            for (uint parent = 0; parent < node.ParentCount; ++parent)
            {
                uint cluster = Hierarchy[asset.HierarchyIndexOffset+node.FirstParent+parent];
                active = active && TraversalQueue[QueueBase+cluster] == 1;
            }
            if (!active) continue;
            float4 sphere = WorldSphere(node.Bounds,instance);
            if ((EnableFrustum != 0 && FrustumCull(sphere)) || OcclusionCull(sphere,instance)) continue;
            bool resident = true;
            for (uint child = 0; child < node.ChildCount; ++child)
            {
                uint indexInAsset = Hierarchy[asset.HierarchyIndexOffset+node.FirstChild+child];
                VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster = Clusters[asset.ClusterOffset+indexInAsset];
                if (!PageResident(asset,cluster))
                {
                    resident = false;
                    RequestPage(asset,cluster);
                }
            }
            if (!resident) continue;
            for (uint parent = 0; parent < node.ParentCount; ++parent)
            {
                uint cluster = Hierarchy[asset.HierarchyIndexOffset+node.FirstParent+parent];
                TraversalQueue[QueueBase+cluster] = 0;
            }
            for (uint child = 0; child < node.ChildCount; ++child)
            {
                uint cluster = Hierarchy[asset.HierarchyIndexOffset+node.FirstChild+child];
                TraversalQueue[QueueBase+cluster] = 1;
            }
        }
        AllMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    }
    for (uint index = lane; index < asset.ClusterCount; index += 64)
    {
        if (TraversalQueue[QueueBase+index] == 0) continue;
        VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster = Clusters[asset.ClusterOffset+index];
        float4 sphere = WorldSphere(cluster.Bounds,instance);
        if ((EnableFrustum == 0 || !FrustumCull(sphere)) && !OcclusionCull(sphere,instance) && !ConeCull(cluster,instance))
        {
            TraversalQueue[QueueBase+index] = 2;
            InterlockedAdd(OutputCount,1);
        }
        else Stat(20);
    }
    AllMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (lane == 0)
    {
        Accepted = Reserve(4,OutputCount,Capacity,OutputBase);
        OutputCount = 0;
        Success[object] = Accepted;
        if (Accepted == 0) Stat(12);
        else Stat(16);
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (Accepted == 0) return;
    for (uint index = lane; index < asset.ClusterCount; index += 64)
    {
        if (TraversalQueue[QueueBase+index] != 2) continue;
        uint offset;
        InterlockedAdd(OutputCount,1,offset);
        VisibleVirtualCluster record;
        record.InstanceIndex = selected.x;
        record.ClusterIndex = asset.ClusterOffset+index;
        record.MaterialIndex = instance.MaterialIndex;
        record.Flags = assetId;
        Visible[OutputBase+offset] = record;
        VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster = Clusters[record.ClusterIndex];
        uint page = asset.VertexOffset+cluster.PageIndex;
        uint unused;
        PageUsage.InterlockedOr((page/32)*4,1u<<(page&31u),unused);
        Stat(24,cluster.TriangleCount);
        Stat(32+cluster.Level*4);
    }
}
[numthreads(64,1,1)]
void Traverse(uint3 group : SV_GroupID, uint lane : SV_GroupIndex)
{
    uint object = group.x + group.y*65535u;
    if (object >= min(ObjectCount.Load(0),ObjectCapacity) || Enabled == 0) return;
    uint4 selected = Objects[object];
    GPUInstanceData instance = Instances[selected.x];
    uint assetId = instance.VirtualGeometryAssetIndex;
    if (assetId >= AssetCount || (instance.Flags&12u) != 4u || instance.MaterialIndex >= MaterialCount) return;
    uint materialFlags = Materials.Load(instance.MaterialIndex*GPU_SCENE_MATERIAL_STRIDE+40);
    // Initial native path excludes alpha-test and two-sided raster classes.
    if ((materialFlags&6u) != 0) return;
    uint surfaceFlags = Materials.Load(instance.MaterialIndex*GPU_SCENE_MATERIAL_STRIDE+64+149*16+12);
    if ((surfaceFlags&3u) != 0 || ((surfaceFlags>>2)&3u) != 0) return;
    VirtualGeometryGPUAsset asset = Assets[assetId];
    if ((asset.Flags&1u) == 0) return;
    if (lane == 0)
    {
        Accepted = Reserve(0,asset.GroupCount,StateCapacity,StateBase) &&
            Reserve(8,asset.ClusterCount,StateCapacity,QueueBase);
        QueueCount = 0; QueueCursor = 0; OutputCount = 0;
        if (Accepted == 0) Stat(12);
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (Accepted == 0) return;

    // Establish a group-consistent cut before traversal. Fine-group demands
    // propagate to every consuming ancestor, including split parent sets.
    for (uint index = lane; index < asset.GroupCount; index += 64)
    {
        VirtualGeometryGPUGroup node = Groups[asset.GroupOffset+index];
        float4 sphere = WorldSphere(node.Bounds,instance);
        float distance = max(length(sphere.xyz-Camera.xyz)-sphere.w,1e-6);
        float errorPixels = node.MaxError*MaximumScale(instance)*ProjectionPixels/distance;
        float threshold = TargetPixels;
        uint historyBase = 0, epoch = 0, previous = 0;
        bool hasHistory = false;
        if (HysteresisEnabled != 0 && selected.x < HistorySlots && ForceLevel < 0)
        {
            uint4 identity = HistoryHeaders[selected.x*2];
            uint4 layout = HistoryHeaders[selected.x*2+1];
            historyBase = identity.w;
            epoch = layout.y;
            hasHistory = identity.z == assetId && index < layout.x && historyBase < HistoryCapacity &&
                index < HistoryCapacity-historyBase;
            if (hasHistory)
            {
                previous = LodHistory[historyBase+index];
                if ((previous>>1) == epoch && epoch != 0)
                    threshold *= (previous&1u) != 0 ? 1-HysteresisFraction : 1+HysteresisFraction;
            }
        }
        bool refine = ForceLevel >= 0 ? node.Level >= (uint)ForceLevel : errorPixels > threshold;
        if (StreamingPadding.y != 0 && !refine && (asset.Flags&2u) != 0)
        {
            uint packed = StreamingPadding.x;
            float3 direction = normalize(float3(packed&1023u,(packed>>10)&1023u,(packed>>20)&1023u)/1023.0*2-1);
            float predictedDistance = max(length(sphere.xyz-(Camera.xyz+direction*Camera.w))-sphere.w,1e-6);
            float predictedError = node.MaxError*MaximumScale(instance)*ProjectionPixels/predictedDistance;
            if (predictedError > threshold)
            {
                for (uint child = 0; child < node.ChildCount; ++child)
                    RequestPage(asset,Clusters[asset.ClusterOffset+Hierarchy[asset.HierarchyIndexOffset+node.FirstChild+child]],true);
            }
        }
        if (hasHistory)
        {
            LodHistory[historyBase+index] = (epoch<<1) | (refine ? 1u : 0u);
            if ((previous>>1) == epoch && ((previous&1u) != 0) != refine)
            {
                uint unused;
                TemporalCounters.InterlockedAdd(16,1,unused);
            }
        }
        GroupStates[StateBase+index] = refine ? 1u : 0u;
    }
    AllMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    uint hierarchyLevels = (asset.Flags>>8)&63u;
    for (uint level = 0; level < hierarchyLevels; ++level)
    {
        for (uint index = lane; index < asset.GroupCount; index += 64)
        {
            VirtualGeometryGPUGroup node = Groups[asset.GroupOffset+index];
            if (node.Level != level || GroupStates[StateBase+index] == 0) continue;
            for (uint parent = 0; parent < node.ParentCount; ++parent)
            {
                uint cluster = Hierarchy[asset.HierarchyIndexOffset+node.FirstParent+parent];
                uint consumer = Clusters[asset.ClusterOffset+cluster].GroupIndex;
                if (consumer != 0xffffffffu)
                {
                    uint unused;
                    InterlockedOr(GroupStates[StateBase+consumer],1,unused);
                }
            }
        }
        AllMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    }
    if ((asset.Flags&2u) != 0)
    {
        ResidentCut(asset,instance,selected,assetId,object,lane);
        return;
    }
    // Bit 1 marks generating groups already expanded, so shared roots enqueue
    // each child set once. Each cluster can enter the persistent queue once.
    for (uint root = lane; root < asset.RootCount; root += 64)
    {
        uint offset;
        InterlockedAdd(QueueCount,1,offset);
        TraversalQueue[QueueBase+offset] = Roots[asset.RootOffset+root];
    }
    AllMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    while (QueueCursor < QueueCount)
    {
        uint begin = QueueCursor;
        uint end = min(begin+64,QueueCount);
        if (begin+lane < end) CurrentClusters[lane] = TraversalQueue[QueueBase+begin+lane];
        // All waves must snapshot the same cursor before lane 0 advances it.
        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
        if (lane == 0) QueueCursor = end;
        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
        if (begin+lane < end)
        {
            uint index = CurrentClusters[lane];
            VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster = Clusters[asset.ClusterOffset+index];
            uint producer = cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex;
            bool expand = false;
            if (producer != 0xffffffffu)
            {
                expand = (GroupStates[StateBase+producer]&1u) != 0;
            }
            if (expand)
            {
                uint old;
                InterlockedOr(GroupStates[StateBase+producer],2u,old);
                if ((old&2u) == 0)
                {
                    VirtualGeometryGPUGroup node = Groups[asset.GroupOffset+producer];
                    float4 sphere = WorldSphere(node.Bounds,instance);
                    // Group bounds cover all descendants, allowing subtree rejection.
                    if ((EnableFrustum == 0 || !FrustumCull(sphere)) && !OcclusionCull(sphere,instance))
                    {
                        uint offset;
                        InterlockedAdd(QueueCount,node.ChildCount,offset);
                        for (uint child = 0; child < node.ChildCount; ++child)
                        {
                            TraversalQueue[QueueBase+offset+child] = Hierarchy[asset.HierarchyIndexOffset+node.FirstChild+child];
                        }
                    }
                    else Stat(20);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                float4 sphere = WorldSphere(cluster.Bounds,instance);
                if ((EnableFrustum == 0 || !FrustumCull(sphere)) && !OcclusionCull(sphere,instance) && !ConeCull(cluster,instance))
                {
                    // Compact in place behind the read cursor; queue entries are
                    // held in shared memory before any lane overwrites this prefix.
                    uint output;
                    InterlockedAdd(OutputCount,1,output);
                    TraversalQueue[QueueBase+output] = index;
                }
                else Stat(20);
            }
        }
        AllMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    }
    if (lane == 0)
    {
        Accepted = Reserve(4,OutputCount,Capacity,OutputBase);
        Success[object] = Accepted;
        if (Accepted == 0) Stat(12);
        else Stat(16);
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (Accepted == 0) return;
    for (uint output = lane; output < OutputCount; output += 64)
    {
        uint index = TraversalQueue[QueueBase+output];
        VisibleVirtualCluster record;
        record.InstanceIndex = selected.x;
        record.ClusterIndex = asset.ClusterOffset+index;
        record.MaterialIndex = instance.MaterialIndex;
        record.Flags = assetId;
        Visible[OutputBase+output] = record;
        VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster = Clusters[record.ClusterIndex];
        Stat(24,cluster.TriangleCount);
        Stat(32+cluster.Level*4);
    }
}

// Full resident cuts are already bounded by Capacity before native routing is
// published. Each partition has Capacity entries, so splitting cannot overflow.
[numthreads(64,1,1)]
void Partition(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (id.x >= Statistics.Load(4)) return;
    VisibleVirtualCluster record = Visible[id.x];
    GPUInstanceData instance = Instances[record.InstanceIndex];
    float4 sphere = WorldSphere(Clusters[record.ClusterIndex].Bounds,instance);
    uint offset;
    if (OcclusionCull(sphere,instance))
    {
        TemporalCounters.InterlockedAdd(0,1,offset);
        Deferred[offset] = record;
    }
    else
    {
        TemporalCounters.InterlockedAdd(4,1,offset);
        FirstVisible[offset] = record;
        TemporalCounters.InterlockedAdd(516,1,offset);
        CombinedVisible[offset] = record;
    }
}
[numthreads(64,1,1)]
void Retest(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (id.x >= TemporalCounters.Load(0)) return;
    VisibleVirtualCluster record = Deferred[id.x];
    GPUInstanceData instance = Instances[record.InstanceIndex];
    float4 sphere = WorldSphere(Clusters[record.ClusterIndex].Bounds,instance);
    if (OcclusionCull(sphere,instance)) return;
    uint offset;
    TemporalCounters.InterlockedAdd(260,1,offset);
    SecondVisible[offset] = record;
    TemporalCounters.InterlockedAdd(516,1,offset);
    CombinedVisible[offset] = record;
}
[numthreads(1,1,1)]
void BuildTemporalArguments()
{
    for (uint phase = 0; phase < 3; ++phase)
    {
        uint count = TemporalCounters.Load(phase*256+4);
        uint x = min(count,65535u);
        TemporalArguments.Store3(phase*12,uint3(x,count ? (count+x-1)/max(x,1u) : 1,1));
    }
}
